001cace6c2bc7177.name: face_target_and_step_back
001cace6c2bc7177.doc: Turns to face the target and steps back invulnerable to dodge a melee attack.

001f2c7bc70ff543.name: choose_wander_move
001f2c7bc70ff543.doc: Generic roaming AI picking a random walk, turn or wait, backing off walls and returning home when far. It is not used by the boss's own update loop.

003c9d9a13ec2eec.name: run_ai_loop
003c9d9a13ec2eec.doc: Main loop: allows guard and dodge, then each frame chooses behavior by aggro and distance.

003cb0de0bcba6f2.name: taunt_or_run_at_target
003cb0de0bcba6f2.doc: Plays with the target and fires rockets, or runs at the target.

008dfc51ebf7c0cd.name: wait_forever
008dfc51ebf7c0cd.doc: Loops forever, checking the death flag each frame.

00a2c1f23656baf5.name: walk_to_target
00a2c1f23656baf5.doc: Faces the player and walks toward the player's position until within stop_distance or max_frames.

00b56a4492c31638.name: wait_frames_and_check_phase
00b56a4492c31638.doc: Waits the given number of frames, checking the phase change each frame.

01012f2a57569b6c.name: fly_and_get_up_when_stunned
01012f2a57569b6c.doc: Plays the knocked-flying and get-up motions with interrupts locked, then runs the shared stun-then-unlock routine.

0114030e984f8bea.name: chase_target_clear
0114030e984f8bea.doc: Chases the target one step per frame while turning toward it, up to max_frames. Returns -1 when within stop_dist, -2 when a wall blocks the line toward the target, otherwise the frames spent.

0119babbd7d0202d.name: cast_rose_barrage
0119babbd7d0202d.doc: Creates six rose effects that fly in from fixed launch points to circle the boss (dealing 45 percent of its attack), orbit it for 30 frames, then fires them at the target one by one 9 frames apart at full attack. The boss neither dodges nor guards during the attack.

011f4878eb5062bc.name: set_max_height
011f4878eb5062bc.doc: Stores the highest height above ground this flyer may reach in monster variable set 2, slot 17. check_flight_step reports a step as blocked (-2) when it ends higher.

012e610eb9af26eb.name: spit_projectile
012e610eb9af26eb.doc: Faces the target and plays the attack 1 motion, creating the Shigu spit effect and releasing it at the end of the motion.

013ac48e0cb1676a.name: wander_and_look_for_target
013ac48e0cb1676a.doc: Idle behaviour: backs away from walls, walks back toward home when far from it, or randomly walks, circles or stands looking for the target. Sets monster var 0 to the chosen wander kind and returns 1 when it detects the target.

0169ce527375d1f6.name: walk_toward_target
0169ce527375d1f6.doc: Walks toward the player's position every frame (slamming when close) for up to max_frames.

016cefc871370938.name: shoot_wind_shot
016cefc871370938.doc: Turns to the target, plays attack 2 while tracking it, spawns the wind shot launch effect at the face frame, then the looping wind shot at motion time 0.608 with the monster's attack value.

0175b38cee05a788.name: fall_and_get_up
0175b38cee05a788.doc: Plays the knocked-flying motion with knockback, waits 45 frames, then plays the get-up motion.

017d7b288aeb6ec6.name: fight_after_rage
017d7b288aeb6ec6.doc: Combat loop once the rage hits are used up (enraged). It reads its life fraction once, on entry, and uses that value throughout. Within 120 units: if that life is under 30 percent it first tries a self-destruct charge; then it lunges when its last random roll (never rerolled for this test) is under 50, and otherwise, with life under 70 percent, self-destructs with a chance of (1 - life) or lunges. Farther away it runs at the target for up to 60 frames, and it circles or holds when more than four monsters are nearer the target. Returns 0 if rage hits become available again.

018dffba8cbe5f16.name: run_normal_ai
018dffba8cbe5f16.doc: AI loop while rage hits remain. Leaves when the target is farther than 290 units or rage hits run out. When another monster has attack priority above 3 it strafes or waits, otherwise it picks a long (200 to 290), mid (160 to 200) or close range action by distance.

01a4da49583a305b.name: wait_move_end
01a4da49583a305b.doc: Waits until the monster reaches its move_to destination, polling every frame with no timeout.

01c6f1f971b1460d.name: fly_back_and_get_up
01c6f1f971b1460d.doc: Stun program of e08a and e09a: meant to make the monster damageable and halt it, play the knocked-flying and get-up motions, then faint until the stun ends and allow guard and dodge again. In this script pair's old numbering the halt, motion and guard calls run set_photo_window, set_visible_monster_limit, get_home_pos, get_attack and set_life instead, and wait_stun_end does not follow the stun, so none of that is shown.

01c9592b3d6858b3.name: wait_move_end_for_frames
01c9592b3d6858b3.doc: Waits up to frames frames for the move_to walk to end and returns 0 when it does; falls off the end with no value on timeout. get_player_status is the old-numbered check_move_end.

01cdf03228739d90.name: walk_backward
01cdf03228739d90.doc: Meant to fly straight backward up to 100 units at height_offset above the ground. As in walk_sideways the clearance is measured straight ahead and any wall within 100 units returns -1 instead of shortening the move, and the ground height is taken with its sign reversed. The calls are old-numbered and reach unrelated natives (the target read runs as set_home_pos and overwrites the home position), so the monster does not move; otherwise it returns an unset value.

01cf7401a04ffb3f.name: circle_or_wait_near_target
01cf7401a04ffb3f.doc: Half the time circles the target 110 to 140 units out, otherwise stands waiting up to 30 frames for the target to come into view. Used when several monsters are nearer the target (distance rank above 3, or above 4 while enraged).

01d341b429e2bd96.name: on_stun
01d341b429e2bd96.doc: Ends active roses and runs the shared stun handling.

01de592c913ba2f8.name: run_behaviour_loop
01de592c913ba2f8.doc: Allows guarding and dodging, then runs the behaviour chooser every frame forever.

01e210c55c735a48.name: on_init
01e210c55c735a48.doc: Registers the two attack hit boxes, sets the aggro duration to 300 frames and starts the monster AI.

02371758ccdf9eb5.name: step_random_offset
02371758ccdf9eb5.doc: Picks a random point ahead of the monster, at a random angle offset and a distance of min_dist plus move_speed plus a random amount, and walks there. Stops when it arrives or the target comes within near_dist, returning the result of wait_move_or_target_near.

0243aae722468d23.name: turn_random_side
0243aae722468d23.doc: Turns to a random side by up to angle_range degrees and waits until done. Returns the frames waited.

028f8bb4372f3d70.name: forbid_guard_dodge_and_reset_motion
028f8bb4372f3d70.doc: Old-numbered code meant to forbid guarding and dodging and reset the motion. The engine runs set_visible_monster_limit(1, 1) then (2, 1), leaving the floor's visible monster limit at 2, and get_attack, which only reads the attack power.

0296bfe4a3d96aee.name: on_update
0296bfe4a3d96aee.doc: Main loop: chooses behavior every frame.

02a0cabb6d95e1af.name: act_on_aggro_state
02a0cabb6d95e1af.doc: Main per-cycle decision. Without aggro it fights within 230 units and wanders otherwise. With aggro it approaches or attacks within the aggro range and drops aggro outside.

02f2cbd94609b023.name: on_knockdown
02f2cbd94609b023.doc: Plays the knocked-flying motion, lies still for 45 frames and gets up.

030511df30ba4b26.name: walk_to_random_spot
030511df30ba4b26.doc: Sets variable 0 to 64 and walks to one of two fixed spots, chosen at random, for up to 600 frames, then sets variable 0 to 16, faces the target and waits 60 frames.

031fd1d20571642a.name: wait_idle_delay
031fd1d20571642a.doc: Stands still for the number of frames in monster var 4, then resets var 4 to 40.

0325d495e10fe4ce.name: prepare_knockdown_facing_target
0325d495e10fe4ce.doc: Disables guard and dodge, stops, faces the target and sets the act status to 1 at the start of a knockdown.

033190479cb3db89.name: chase_target_briefly
033190479cb3db89.doc: Walks toward the target for up to 90 frames, then stands.

03337a6dd1bbb8a4.name: pick_near_range_action
03337a6dd1bbb8a4.doc: Chooses an action for a close target: attack 1 or the flame shot, a dodge step followed by attack 1, or circling the target.

03567788999adffb.name: swing_sword_with_windup
03567788999adffb.doc: Faces the player, winds up (attack 2 in), tracks the player, then strikes with attack 2 and recovers.

0363bfe799006873.name: recoil_from_hit
0363bfe799006873.doc: Stops moving and turning, plays the damage knockback, waits 12 frames and returns to standing.

0367f201992dc565.name: turn_by_angle_and_wait
0367f201992dc565.doc: Turns by an angle relative to the current yaw and waits for the turn to finish. Returns the frames waited.

036b20790f3776d9.name: wander_or_wait_idle
036b20790f3776d9.doc: Idle behaviour while the monster has not noticed the player: walks away from walls, wanders around its home point or around the target, or stands and watches. Returns 1 if the target was detected while standing.

03794b7cb4deef9b.name: dodge_step_sideways
03794b7cb4deef9b.doc: Faces the player and plays walk right or left, then moves toward the point 30 degrees around the player at the same distance, invulnerable for at most 9 frames (about 27 units at speed 3). Both waits end early when the player is within 40 units, which cuts the step short.

038806ddba8c9936.name: on_dodge_melee
038806ddba8c9936.doc: Faces the target and dodges backward.

0390de3375b806a6.name: turn_by_angle
0390de3375b806a6.doc: Turns by an angle relative to the current heading and waits until done. Returns the frames waited.

039d3057c34d3d09.name: setup_attacks_and_feathers
039d3057c34d3d09.doc: Registers three hit windows on attack 2 and loads the Tig feather and feather hit effects into a free texture block when one is available.

03b299528eaa1f61.name: reset_motion_and_land
03b299528eaa1f61.doc: Resets the motion and turns scripted flight off.

03d151eaf9b496d4.name: play_attack_2_motion
03d151eaf9b496d4.doc: Plays attack 2 while tracking the target, then stands for 9 frames.

03d2c451ae50c00d.name: act_at_long_range
03d2c451ae50c00d.doc: Long-range choice: walk up to the target, or mostly stand and watch.

03d9da6284cc14bb.name: chase_target_checking_path
03d9da6284cc14bb.doc: Chases the target in short steps. Returns -1 when it gets within stop_dist and -2 when the line to the target is blocked.

03dd919a6c034a31.name: wait_motion_or_target_seen
03dd919a6c034a31.doc: Waits frame by frame until the current motion ends or the target comes into view. Returns 0 when the motion ended, 1 when the target was seen first.

042f715d4564ef3d.name: chase_target_checking_line_of_sight
042f715d4564ef3d.doc: Chases the target like face_then_chase_target but gives up with -2 if a wall blocks the line to it, or -1 once within stop_dist.

043cdd30a0e891d0.name: shoot_gear_poison_arrow
043cdd30a0e891d0.doc: Plays attack 2 and fires a gear poison arrow effect with the monster's attack value after 9 frames.

045709673ecb927d.name: recoil_and_stun
045709673ecb927d.doc: Locks interrupts, plays the damage motion for 3 frames, then stuns the monster and unlocks.

047d805cc47cb3d4.name: approach_distant_target
047d805cc47cb3d4.doc: Mostly walks toward a target farther than 290 units, otherwise stands waiting for it to come into view. Returns once the target is closer.

048fd63e68c810a2.name: turn_around_and_dash_if_seen
048fd63e68c810a2.doc: Turns to a random angle, waits briefly and, if the target is in view, runs at it.

04a8170c317ab18d.name: swing_attack
04a8170c317ab18d.doc: If above y -5, faces the target and plays attack 1.

04bc01fdb57bd40d.name: recoil_facing_target
04bc01fdb57bd40d.doc: Locks and faces the target, plays the damage motion, waits 12 frames, returns to standing and ends the locked action.

04bd3cfb0d96aede.name: warp_to_home_point
04bd3cfb0d96aede.doc: Moves the monster straight to (268.8, 800, -322.4), keeping its rotation, and waits a frame. b02a raw numbering, where set_pause_flags, check_pause_flags and get_dungeon_flag stand for set_pos, get_rot and set_rot.

04dda9a40fedd804.name: sidestep_around_target
04dda9a40fedd804.doc: Walks sideways to a point 45 degrees to the right or left around the target while tracking it for 40 frames.

04e7faf735cf758a.name: on_init
04e7faf735cf758a.doc: Registers the knockback and return attacks, makes the piece always visible, derives its index from its monster handle (24 to 29) and resets the shared variables.

04f05f4665a54ff2.name: on_dodge_shot
04f05f4665a54ff2.doc: Dodging a shot: sidesteps around the target, then plays the dodge return motion.

04f4792b57dc24e6.name: recoil_from_hit
04f4792b57dc24e6.doc: Stops all actions, plays the damage motion, waits 12 frames and returns to standing.

04f87da46332e60b.name: sidestep_around_target
04f87da46332e60b.doc: Invulnerable sidestep to the left or right to a point on a circle around the target. If the target is then within 90 units, half the time follows up with a charge.

04f8a87c06f63640.name: fly_to_point
04f8a87c06f63640.doc: Flies to the point, holding hover_height above the ground (the y argument is overwritten). Returns 1 on arrival, a blocked code if stopped, or 0 on timeout.

04fe3341168ee52d.name: step_no_rage_ai
04fe3341168ee52d.doc: Used once rage hits are used up. Within 100 flat units it flies at the target and swoops, otherwise flies toward the target until near. Returns 0 when rage hits remain.

050bcd08adc0dd06.name: wander_or_wait_idle
050bcd08adc0dd06.doc: Idle behaviour while the monster has not noticed the player: flies away from walls, wanders around its home point or the target, or hovers and watches. Returns 1 if the target was detected.

051bd40ecfe6839e.name: fly_around_point
051bd40ecfe6839e.doc: Picks the point on a circle of the given radius around a center, shifted by an angle from the line to the monster, turns to it and flies there. Returns the result of fly_to_point.

052c395383456087.name: walk_around_point
052c395383456087.doc: Turns toward and walks to the point at the given radius and angle around the center and waits to arrive.

053c58e773a067f4.name: act_at_close_range
053c58e773a067f4.doc: Close range choice: run in and use the shockwave attack, fire nose bullets, or circle the target.

05406d7b5ebb5d2b.name: wander_without_turning
05406d7b5ebb5d2b.doc: Walks a random distance in a random direction from the current yaw and waits to arrive. Returns the result of the wait.

05470c90dc7b76f9.name: circle_or_hold
05470c90dc7b76f9.doc: With a 25 percent chance circles the target at 110 to 140 units, otherwise sometimes stands and watches.

05563c8716a38551.name: limit_visible_monsters
05563c8716a38551.doc: Makes two set_visible_monster_limit calls (leaving the limit at 2) and turns model lighting off, then idles forever. The calls match the usual allow_guard_and_dodge and set_act_status(0) start of an update program, so they were probably written for an older native table.

056fb946b0f5ba09.name: dash_attack_forward
056fb946b0f5ba09.doc: Turns to the target, plays the attack 1 wind up, then dashes forward distance_factor times 150 units at the given speed with the attack 1 motion (a knockback hit), and slows to a stop with the attack 1 out motion.

057fcd68407aa6e5.name: react_to_player_disguise
057fcd68407aa6e5.doc: If the player is disguised, runs the follow behavior.

0585b230b3e64b70.name: wait_for_rose_hit_or_move
0585b230b3e64b70.doc: Waits for the rose in front of the boss to be hit (returns phase 4). Every given number of frames it glides to a random neighbouring slot; after five moves and a sixth wait it returns to the center and returns phase 5.

0588bb9f6c014e35.name: on_death
0588bb9f6c014e35.doc: Boss death: resets the camera, sets monster var 68, and the first time through stops the ship sound, restores nearest lock-on and runs event script 503. Then idles forever.

0599bbcb872e75ed.name: idle_around_target
0599bbcb872e75ed.doc: Low priority behaviour: circles the target or stands and waits.

059d8f6c96f15324.name: on_init
059d8f6c96f15324.doc: Registers the attack hit windows and clears the monster variables, including the shared kill counter in variable 127.

05ac8ddc5cb989f6.name: guard_with_shield_motion
05ac8ddc5cb989f6.doc: Turns to the target, plays the guard in, hold and out motions for about 60 frames.

05b87ab4a6f64c12.name: wait_frame_checking_phase
05b87ab4a6f64c12.doc: Checks the phase change, then waits one frame. Every wait in this script goes through here.

05c467ae8218cd8b.name: track_target_until_motion_end
05c467ae8218cd8b.doc: Turns toward the target every frame at turn_speed_deg degrees per frame until the current motion reaches its last frame, then stops turning.

05f0ffbf769ecc2b.name: idle_forever
05f0ffbf769ecc2b.doc: Loops forever, doing only the per-frame bookkeeping.

05f375ccbba5bf08.name: turn_and_walk_around_target
05f375ccbba5bf08.doc: Turns toward a point at angle_deg and dist around the target and walks there, shortened by walls. Returns -1 if there is no room.

06011fea290e82bc.name: check_life_change
06011fea290e82bc.doc: Compares the current life with the value saved in var 15. Returns 1 if dead, 2 if life dropped (recording the hit), 0 otherwise.

0609d25d43a77494.name: turn_by_angle
0609d25d43a77494.doc: Turns by delta_deg relative to the current facing and waits until the turn is done.

0629b3bd46f0ece6.name: init_swordsman
0629b3bd46f0ece6.doc: Registers the two combo attack hits and sword trails, sets up the AI, and extends the clip distance for grade 3 monsters.

062d4819de48ff67.name: wander_when_target_far
062d4819de48ff67.doc: Idle behaviour while the target is not close: turns away from walls, wanders around its home point, circles the target, waits to notice the target, or walks off in a random direction. Returns 1 when the target is detected.

062fe2d664e9cde6.name: act_at_close_range
062fe2d664e9cde6.doc: Close range choice: half the time an ultrasonic burst or spin charge, otherwise walks up to the target.

063199e81b0d0a0e.name: dodge_melee_by_stepping_back
063199e81b0d0a0e.doc: Snaps to face the attacker and dodges backward (dodge_backward), then stands and re-allows guard and dodge.

06529ee2ee949c68.name: sidestep_around_target
06529ee2ee949c68.doc: Steps to the right when the parameter is 1, otherwise to the left, to a point around the target at the same distance. Takes damage normally.

0661d76ce63126ea.name: turn_to_target_for_frames
0661d76ce63126ea.doc: Turns to face the target for at most max_frames, updating the boss.

066e304a967152fd.name: fly_toward_far_target
066e304a967152fd.doc: Chases the target in flight for up to 90 frames.

0689fa3d1502a397.name: fight_while_enraged
0689fa3d1502a397.doc: Combat loop once the monster is enraged: attack 1 or 2 when close, otherwise approaches. Returns when the target is too far (over 225).

068bc802c5b76963.name: shoot_paralysis_shot
068bc802c5b76963.doc: Plays attack 3: spawns the launch effect at the dcol0 frame and then fires a paralysis shot toward the target.

0695cb06d145c35d.name: hold_damage_pose_until_stop_ends
0695cb06d145c35d.doc: Stops all actions and plays the damage motion until the stop and long stop status flags clear.

069a1fd3782bcc24.name: on_guard
069a1fd3782bcc24.doc: Cancels the spit effect when guarding.

069a67400ef01e30.name: approach_distant_target
069a67400ef01e30.doc: Loops until the target is within 240 units, mostly chasing it and sometimes waiting.

069e84f2b0b08d24.name: update_and_wait
069e84f2b0b08d24.doc: Per-frame step shared by the AI waits: updates aggro from damage, ticks the aggro timer and clears aggro when it runs out, sets the model lighting from the rage state, then waits one frame.

06a80f465a081f66.name: swing_at_target
06a80f465a081f66.doc: Walks to face the player and does the attack 1 swing, then stands.

06a9183675bdfccb.name: finish_rose_effects
06a9183675bdfccb.doc: Ends every rose effect still active and empties their slots.

06ab108169332474.name: glide_to_ring_position
06ab108169332474.doc: Smoothly moves and turns the boss to a ring slot over the given frames, taking the short way round, and records the slot.

06bcbba1febba74f.name: choose_behavior_by_aggro
06bcbba1febba74f.doc: Per-frame decision: until enraged, fights when the target is within 330 and aggro is off, otherwise walks toward an aggroing target with raised defense and guard rates. Once enraged it runs the enraged behaviour.

06c12cd545f2de5a.name: step_back_dodge
06c12cd545f2de5a.doc: Steps 100 units backwards, invulnerable while moving, then returns to standing.

06dcede6df54115e.name: shoot_fire_ball
06dcede6df54115e.doc: Turns to the target and plays attack 2, spawning a dragon fire shot at the dcol_00 point aimed at the target with the monster's attack power. Stands for 9 frames afterwards.

06e128ad2b07c068.name: walk_to_random_nearby_point_without_turning
06e128ad2b07c068.doc: Like walk_to_random_nearby_point, but does not turn first.

06e9d949c8cb877d.name: fly_around_target
06e9d949c8cb877d.doc: Flies to a point at the given angle and radius around the target.

0716d16ff42c5d42.name: explode_pirate_bomb
0716d16ff42c5d42.doc: Makes the bomb monster die and explode at once, spawning the pirate bomb explosion effect.

07266ba93ab84d0c.name: swing_melee_attack
07266ba93ab84d0c.doc: Attack 3. Turns to the target and plays the melee swing while tracking the target.

072c4c1b76b514cc.name: strafe_or_wait
072c4c1b76b514cc.doc: Half the time circles the target at a random angle and radius and faces it; otherwise stands and waits for the target to come into view.

0742ea6dda3d61c9.name: recover_from_throw_and_reset
0742ea6dda3d61c9.doc: Recovers from a throw, waits 10 frames and resets the motion.

0743b6420235908a.name: wait_for_target_to_approach
0743b6420235908a.doc: Clears variable 0 and waits a frame. If the target is within 320, turns toward it, sets variable 0 to 1 and returns 0; nothing limits this to once, because variable 0 is cleared on entry and the noticed check reads a local that the original writes into variable 0 (set_monster_var with &noticed) instead of loading. Otherwise reads variable 0 back and plays the idle motion for 10 frames if it is 0. Its only caller runs it when the target is 600 or more away.

07671b8285ab6234.name: setup_mimic_attacks
07671b8285ab6234.doc: Registers two attack 1 hit windows for the mimic, adds a sword trail and initialises the monster AI.

0781ffde570e85c1.name: turn_and_move_around_target
0781ffde570e85c1.doc: Turns toward a point around the target and walks to it, returning -1 when blocked.

0787988a9ae8dfb4.name: act_at_long_range
0787988a9ae8dfb4.doc: Long range choice: approach, wait, circle the target, or run toward it.

07b27b4896ef7aca.name: attack_at_close_range
07b27b4896ef7aca.doc: Mostly (78 percent) lunges at the target; otherwise circles it at about 88 units or makes an invulnerable step back.

07b3ba763e8cc4ef.name: run_to_random_edge_point
07b3ba763e8cc4ef.doc: Turns to a random point 500 units out at the given height and flies there at a run.

07bcb3c8aede019a.name: run_toward_target_or_pounce
07bcb3c8aede019a.doc: Runs toward the target. If it gets close and in front it sets variables 0 and 1 to prepare a pounce. Returns 1 if the target got behind or too far, 0 otherwise.

07d244326cf39a29.name: play_guard_motion
07d244326cf39a29.doc: Locks interrupts and guards, 65 percent of the time briefly and otherwise after turning to the target and holding the guard for 60 frames.

07e3f1dd74786e67.name: chase_target_slowly
07e3f1dd74786e67.doc: Walks after the target for up to 240 frames, then stands.

08061cb0ef61dda6.name: restore_life_and_wait_frame
08061cb0ef61dda6.doc: Counts hits and restores life, then waits one frame. Most waits in this script go through it.

08117fb9c8555ac9.name: wait_target_detected
08117fb9c8555ac9.doc: Waits until the target is seen or heard. Returns 1 if detected, 0 on timeout.

0822eca3a6b66409.name: sidestep_invulnerable
0822eca3a6b66409.doc: Steps left or right at random to a point around the target while taking no damage, ending with the damage immunity switched off.

0831b57ea4545c74.name: self_destruct_bomb
0831b57ea4545c74.doc: Bomb death: drops the throw, zeroes life, runs the death drops and finish, then spawns the pirate bomb explosion effect at the bomb or, when it has no position yet, 25 units above the target, with the monster's attack stat as its damage. Never returns; the script ends in an idle loop.

084f5c2375877d5b.name: play_guard_motion
084f5c2375877d5b.doc: Turns to the attacker and plays the guard in, block and guard out motions with 18 frames of invulnerability.

084fb007899ebae1.name: choose_fear_state
084fb007899ebae1.doc: Picks the reaction in monster variable 1 from the proximity flags, playing any state queued in variables 2 and 3 first: run the event (1) when a monster is touching, surprise (5 then 6) when one is within 100, look around then turn toward it and wait (4, 0, 2) when it is off to the side, otherwise cower (3). A far monster only queues the delayed stand (2), because the look-around it sets is overwritten by 3.

0852ec3216123cbe.name: spin_toward_target
0852ec3216123cbe.doc: Plays the right or left spin walk, whichever is shorter, and waits until facing the target.

087d270e17741362.name: get_knocked_down_and_rise
087d270e17741362.doc: Plays the knocked-flying motion with knockback, waits and gets up.

089b85e041809247.name: fight_at_close_range
089b85e041809247.doc: Close-range choice: attack with a spin or spit, walk up to the target, side-step when low on life, or circle it.

089b9d1ebb1c079b.name: on_stun
089b9d1ebb1c079b.doc: Stops movement and turning while stunned, with guard and dodge disabled during the stun.

089ed6f21a00f885.name: run_ai_step
089ed6f21a00f885.doc: One AI decision: idles or fights depending on aggro and distance; once the rage hits are used up it fights enraged.

089f7e608f435f9b.name: circle_target_then_swing
089f7e608f435f9b.doc: Flies a curved path that starts off to a random side and homes in on the target, then swings the melee attack. Nothing calls it.

08bd13aa4cc50781.name: clear_body_hit_and_halt
08bd13aa4cc50781.doc: Clears the no-body-hit attribute, then resets the motion and stops moving and turning, leaving guard and dodge allowed.

08cb4dc3351d6e11.name: step_sideways_dodge
08cb4dc3351d6e11.doc: Steps 100 units to a random side with a sideways step motion, invulnerable during the movement, then returns to standing.

08e9fde91dcb7236.name: restore_defense_and_damage
08e9fde91dcb7236.doc: Resets the defense rate to 1 and makes the boss damageable.

0913a6d8d065f5ad.name: setup_attack_hits_and_ai
0913a6d8d065f5ad.doc: Registers the poison hit on attack 1 (0.382 to 0.697) and the knockback hit on attack 2 (0.522 to 0.652), then initialises the monster AI.

0913c4ec1e5dd3d7.name: wait_frame_update
0913c4ec1e5dd3d7.doc: Advances one frame while keeping the monster's lighting matched to its rage level.

092812ebae3fff01.name: wait_turn_watch_target
092812ebae3fff01.doc: Waits for a turn already started toward angle_deg until facing it within the turn speed or max_frames pass. Returns -1 at once if the target comes into view, otherwise the frames spent.

0930475fe550e9af.name: flash_until_explode_when_lifted
0930475fe550e9af.doc: When the player picks the bomb up it stops moving and flashes red and white, with a beep each pulse, in the last 30 frames of its 195-frame timer, then explodes.

094404f378fec1a7.name: wander_when_target_far
094404f378fec1a7.doc: Unused idle routine (chase_and_attack_loop never calls it): walks off on a random heading when a wall is within 30 units, walks to a point near home or watches when over 300 from home, otherwise mostly watches 30 frames, turns in place, circles the target or walks straight ahead. Returns 1 when the target is detected while watching.

094df9cd943b1a7f.name: wait_until_target_in_view
094df9cd943b1a7f.doc: Waits up to max_frames and returns 1 as soon as the target is inside the view cone.

09507acc3b6854e5.name: fight_while_no_rage_hits_left
09507acc3b6854e5.doc: Fight loop while no rage hits remain: walks up and attacks at close range, vanishes randomly, otherwise approaches. Returns when rage hits remain.

0955f6a41c09203c.name: lock_and_face_target
0955f6a41c09203c.doc: Cancels guard and motion, stops moving, faces the target for a frame and sets act status 1.

095e2e8d582e3048.name: approach_at_mid_range
095e2e8d582e3048.doc: Lunges, runs at the target, walks toward it, or circles it.

0963e3488c81f942.name: fly_to_ring_around_point
0963e3488c81f942.doc: Flies to the point radius units from the center, measured from the direction back toward the monster and turned by angle_offset_deg, turning to face it first. Returns the result of the flight.

096d9e521d5f1897.name: approach_at_long_range
096d9e521d5f1897.doc: Turns to the target and runs toward it for 45 frames.

09aa0ea57c25907c.name: chase_target_steps
09aa0ea57c25907c.doc: Turns toward the target, then chases it for up to max_frames, returning -1 when within stop_dist.

09aebc8f8f01d503.name: idle_until_target_near
09aebc8f8f01d503.doc: Repeats the strafe-or-wait behaviour until the target comes within 175 units, then returns 0.

09c7d88732027579.name: wait_move_end_syncing_life
09c7d88732027579.doc: Waits up to max_frames for the current move to finish, running the shared life bookkeeping each frame. Returns 0 when the move ends; on timeout it falls off the end without a return value.

09e0c0b3082b996f.name: fire_machine_gun_burst
09e0c0b3082b996f.doc: Spawns the machine gun effects at the turret's "shot" point, aimed 20 units above the target or, half the time, at the target itself, passes them the attack power and keeps aiming for 20 frames (5 when monster var 8 is 1) while it fires.

09f7587cb0e56b12.name: wait_move_until_near
09f7587cb0e56b12.doc: Waits, keeping the aggro bookkeeping running, for the move started by move_to. Returns 1 when the target comes within stop_dist, 2 when the move ends and 0 after max_frames.

0a0100323ec2c37d.name: wait_target_detected
0a0100323ec2c37d.doc: Waits until the target is detected by sight or sound; returns 1 if detected, 0 on timeout.

0a169b9aa3a60617.name: play_attack_one
0a169b9aa3a60617.doc: Plays attack 1 to the end and returns to the stand motion.

0a4f5f46cfd2fcc9.name: sidestep_to_far_side
0a4f5f46cfd2fcc9.doc: Flies past the target to its far side, 30 degrees off to the right or left at random and 50 units beyond its distance, in 30 frames.

0a542d8958975efd.name: recoil_from_damage
0a542d8958975efd.doc: Stops all actions, plays the damage knockback, waits 12 frames and stands.

0a570cefb54c2167.name: fly_at_target_fixed_heading
0a570cefb54c2167.doc: Turns to the target once, then flies along the fixed direction toward where it stood. Returns 1 when near, or the blocked code.

0a87f4f18355ae9d.name: fly_to_point_above_floor
0a87f4f18355ae9d.doc: Flies toward the point at the given speed, never lower than height 60, facing the direction of travel, until within stop_dist or max_frames pass. Returns the frames flown.

0aa6ef35dd1b2681.name: step_back_dodge
0aa6ef35dd1b2681.doc: Plays the step back motion (33 frames) and returns to standing.

0ae43d4d703e6ec4.name: approach_at_mid_range
0ae43d4d703e6ec4.doc: Mid-range choice: mostly runs at the target and slashes, sometimes circles the target, dashes sideways three times or steps back.

0af5d3af767c3e1b.name: get_up_after_throw
0af5d3af767c3e1b.doc: Recovery after being thrown: recovers from the throw (which already waits 10 frames), stops and ends the throw again, waits another 10 frames, plays the get-up motion to its end and returns 1.

0afb961560c3505b.name: fight_while_calm
0afb961560c3505b.doc: Calm combat loop. Dispatches to the close, mid or longest range behaviour by distance and strafes when it is not among the nearest monsters. Returns when the player is further than 225 or the monster becomes enraged.

0b0e939a7ac4e409.name: get_up_after_throw
0b0e939a7ac4e409.doc: Recovers from being thrown and plays the get up motion. Returns 1.

0b32bb227aac6bff.name: fire_thunder_shot
0b32bb227aac6bff.doc: Plays attack 1 while tracking the target, spawns the thunder shot launch effect at dcol0, then the looping thunder shot carrying the monster's attack value, and waits for the motion to end.

0b6aeb99e49d8371.name: dodge_melee_by_leaping_back
0b6aeb99e49d8371.doc: Faces the target and leaps backward, then allows guard and dodge again.

0b7bf8d4c952e34c.name: fight_far_range
0b7bf8d4c952e34c.doc: Far range choices: wait, circle the target or fly fast toward it.

0ba47fcd46efda0e.name: vanish_to_dodge_melee
0ba47fcd46efda0e.doc: Dodges a melee attack by vanishing and reappearing at the target for 15 to 44 frames.

0baf74e0575321c2.name: close_in_on_distant_target
0baf74e0575321c2.doc: Runs or walks toward a target further than 330 units, or waits, until it comes within 330 units.

0bb81874eec58cfc.name: on_init
0bb81874eec58cfc.doc: Registers the normal attack hits for attacks 1 and 2, loads the paralysis shot effects, and sets the monster to hover with flying movement and a maximum height of 55.

0beb5dc47106e491.name: circle_or_wait_near_target
0beb5dc47106e491.doc: Waiting behaviour while another monster holds the attack slot: half the time circles the target at about 145 distance, otherwise stands and watches it.

0bfcbb695aa5b094.name: fly_charge_at_target
0bfcbb695aa5b094.doc: Hovers, plays guard in while tracking the target, then flies at the target with the attack 2 motion (a knockback hit) for 30 frames, holding 40 units above the ground when the target is above it and 8 otherwise, and finishes with guard out.

0c15b125654b5045.name: run_at_target_and_spit
0c15b125654b5045.doc: Runs at the target, plays idle motions while watching it and spits poison mist if the target is in view.

0c23b1fb16a26e27.name: fight_target_while_calm
0c23b1fb16a26e27.doc: Calm fight loop: returns when the target is beyond 280 or the monster becomes enraged (rage hits left reaches 0). When its distance rank is above 1 it waits or circles; otherwise it picks the far (210 to 280), mid (130 to 210) or close range behaviour.

0c643aada63fde9a.name: walk_in_direction
0c643aada63fde9a.doc: Turns to the world heading angle_deg at turn_speed_deg, then walks dist units along it at move_speed (at least move_speed + 1). A heading below the turn speed, including every negative heading, is first increased by the turn speed. Returns 1 if the target comes within stop_dist, 2 when the walk ends, 0 after max_frames.

0c69b1aea01efb1b.name: wait_until_player_undisguised
0c69b1aea01efb1b.doc: While the player is disguised, stands and turns to face them. Returns when the disguise ends.

0c7c55cbdced2430.name: idle_while_user_monster
0c7c55cbdced2430.doc: If the player is disguised in a form this monster's kind recognises as its own (get_player_disguise is not -1), hovers in place via hover_idle_while_player_disguised until the disguise ends; otherwise returns at once.

0ca6b0beb8edbd3c.name: strafe_or_wait
0ca6b0beb8edbd3c.doc: Half the time circles the target at a random angle and radius and faces it; otherwise stands and waits for the target to come into view.

0cd5e82f8089ab00.name: track_target_frames
0cd5e82f8089ab00.doc: Turns to keep facing the target for the given number of frames, then stops turning. turn_speed is passed to the turn unconverted, so callers giving degrees get a near-instant turn.

0cdbc5d9d8113739.name: act_at_far_range
0cdbc5d9d8113739.doc: Calm long-range choice: walk closer, stand watching, circle the player or spit poison.

0d047b5bf7058d17.name: vanish_instead_of_guarding
0d047b5bf7058d17.doc: Locks interrupts and makes the monster vanish and reappear at the target in place of a guard.

0d5d7af8b18b0506.name: hover_at_current_position
0d5d7af8b18b0506.doc: Plays the walk motion and flies to its current position at hover height 25.

0d62174433a95aa2.name: circle_or_wait_at_distance
0d62174433a95aa2.doc: Used when many monsters are closer to the target: circles it at a distance or stands watching.

0d709b3935f7def3.name: circle_target_or_hold_still
0d709b3935f7def3.doc: Half the time flies at speed 2 to a point 140 to 170 units from the target, 30 to 60 degrees to either side of the line from the target to the monster (up to 60 frames), then turns to face the target; otherwise stands and waits up to 30 frames for the target to come within 35 units and 45 degrees of its facing.

0d7587f05011f182.name: flicker_model_color
0d7587f05011f182.doc: Cycles the model colour dim over a six frame cycle using the flicker counter.

0d89a1aec161dfc3.name: run_normal_speed_ai
0d89a1aec161dfc3.doc: AI loop while rage hits remain. Picks close, mid or far range actions by target distance, or passive actions when priority is above 100. Returns 0 when the target is beyond 240 units or the rage hits run out.

0da156a4600380fe.doc: Prints the debug text 'blow damage' and does nothing else, so the boss ignores knockdowns.

0daf0e4a59b83900.name: strafe_or_watch_target
0daf0e4a59b83900.doc: Half the time circles the player at about 75 units, otherwise stands watching the player.

0dba3c645886be4c.name: turn_toward_monster_for_frames
0dba3c645886be4c.doc: Turns this monster toward another monster for the given number of frames, then stops turning.

0dd2df3d03acf4a6.name: choose_behaviour
0dd2df3d03acf4a6.doc: Per-frame decision. It heals if needed, then fights, wanders or chases depending on aggro and distance, adjusting the dodge rate. With no rage hits left it uses the post-rage fight behaviour.

0df6bdade039a46c.name: fly_toward_random_direction
0df6bdade039a46c.doc: Turns to a random absolute heading of 0 to angle_range degrees, then flies min_dist plus up to dist_range units that way at hover_height above the ground.

0e122c2f936c0b67.name: show_seagra_map_part
0e122c2f936c0b67.doc: Shows or hides the boss-c map part of the p01_boss area that matches this piece's index.

0e6a22b64169b894.name: get_up_after_throw
0e6a22b64169b894.doc: After landing from a throw, waits 45 frames, gets up and returns 1.

0e7feaef0edaf87b.name: move_to_point_at_speed
0e7feaef0edaf87b.doc: Moves the monster in a straight line toward the point at the given speed, facing along the motion, until within stop_dist or max_frames pass. Also prints debug text.

0eaba92d3937cefa.name: hover_idle_while_player_disguised
0eaba92d3937cefa.doc: Flies to 5 units above the ground under it (the 25 passed as y is ignored), then idles in place while the player is disguised as a monster, turning to face the target when it is more than 90 degrees off; returns when the player is no longer disguised. The argument is not used.

0eac358a17a6a904.name: reposition_then_rose_attack
0eac358a17a6a904.doc: Increments the move counter, dashes to a random point, sometimes dashes around the target, then tries the rose barrage.

0eb08e37d2c53888.name: run_poison_fighter_ai
0eb08e37d2c53888.doc: Main loop: while hits are still needed to enrage it, fights when the target is within 225 units and idles when it is farther; once enraged, runs the enraged fight loop.

0eb100f969a492e1.name: fly_to_point_with_turn
0eb100f969a492e1.doc: Turns toward the point, then flies to it at speed 5. Returns 1 if the round state hit 0, 0 if it hit 8, 3 if it hit 9 (unless ignored) and 6 when it arrives.

0ebdb208ea5fccec.name: fly_backward
0ebdb208ea5fccec.doc: Meant to fly backward from its heading, but the back distance is never set, so (with zeroed locals) it targets its own x and z at height_offset above the ground and barely moves. The returned value is never set.

0ebee36109c8a8de.name: die_and_halt
0ebee36109c8a8de.doc: Plays the death motion and halts the monster.

0ec82fa99dd83eb2.name: dash_ahead_toward_target
0ec82fa99dd83eb2.doc: Turns to the target, then moves 100 units straight ahead, stopping when the target is within stop_dist or after max_frames. Returns -1 without moving when less than 100 units ahead are clear.

0eceb1a9d6ef867f.name: hover_if_player_disguised
0eceb1a9d6ef867f.doc: If the player is disguised as a monster, runs the hover-and-idle loop; otherwise does nothing.

0ed3aee44449e8f0.name: chase_target_steps
0ed3aee44449e8f0.doc: Turns to face the target, then each frame walks toward a point move_speed + stop_dist ahead of the monster on the line to the target, for up to max_frames. Returns -1 as soon as the target is within stop_dist, otherwise the frames used.

0ee7ff48d4273d6a.name: set_aggro_range
0ee7ff48d4273d6a.doc: Sets the aggro range (second variable set, slot 8): while aggressive, the monster keeps pursuing only while the target is within this distance and drops its aggro beyond it.

0ef0a6827c6af3d1.name: approach_until_target_present
0ef0a6827c6af3d1.doc: Unused loop: while there is no target (distance 99999 or more), mostly walks toward the target position for up to 90 frames, otherwise stands watching for 45 frames; returns once a target exists.

0f05178ba8c528d3.name: on_dodge_shot
0f05178ba8c528d3.doc: Dodges a shot with a sidestep and usually follows with a rose barrage or a dash and tornado.

0f0a27ca8712095b.name: recoil_and_stun
0f0a27ca8712095b.doc: Plays the damage motion for 3 frames then applies the shared stun routine and unlocks.

0f193a4a9185a099.name: walk_back_far
0f193a4a9185a099.doc: Walks backward to a point 100 to 115 units farther from the target than now with the walk back motion, invulnerable for the first 10 frames, then stands.

0f259a7a6c7a8783.name: get_aggro_range
0f259a7a6c7a8783.doc: Reads the monster's aggro range, stored in monster variable 2 slot 8, into out[0].

0f4393b24af64e50.name: fight_while_no_rage_hits_left
0f4393b24af64e50.doc: Fight loop while no rage hits remain: attacks 1 to 3 at close range and runs in from farther away. Returns when rage hits remain.

0f5208c78d8a9803.name: climb_wall_and_circle_arena
0f5208c78d8a9803.doc: Jumps onto the arena wall 980 units out and 400 up, lying sideways, then walks around the wall invincible and out of reach until it is the only monster left, and jumps back down with jump_to_target_spot.

0f64ee830b4f25ff.name: turn_to_target_offset
0f64ee830b4f25ff.doc: Turns toward the target at speed_deg, but offset_chance percent of the time aims offset_deg to the left or right (equal odds) of it. Waits for the turn and returns the frames it took.

0f6be855934af58b.name: fight_while_enraged
0f6be855934af58b.doc: Enraged fight loop (no rage hits left). Within 120 flat units it mostly runs at the player and swoops (10% shoots); farther it mostly shoots (20% runs at the player). Strafes or waits when more than five monsters are nearer the player, and returns 0 once it has rage hits left again.

0f6c922ccd882aea.name: attack_weak_combo
0f6c922ccd882aea.doc: Sets attack state 1, turns to the target, plays attack 1 while tracking the target until progress 0.267, then stands for 9 frames.

0f70beeaf2bb33a6.name: choose_attack_by_distance
0f70beeaf2bb33a6.doc: Picks the far, mid or near attack set from the distance to the target (over 300, over 120, or closer).

0f7cd47d45e886a3.name: play_attack2_and_wait
0f7cd47d45e886a3.doc: Plays the attack 2 motion once and waits for it to finish, keeping the aggro timer running.

0f8287627b5d3cf5.name: fly_around_target
0f8287627b5d3cf5.doc: Turns a flying monster toward a point at angle_deg and radius around the target, then flies there with fly_to_point, keeping the given height. Returns the flight result.

0f8d460d1a331868.name: wait_motion_end_update
0f8d460d1a331868.doc: Waits until the current motion ends. Returns 1.

0fa9dea4ac3aabc7.name: wait_motion_watch_target
0fa9dea4ac3aabc7.doc: Waits for the motion to end, returning 1 early if the target comes into view.

0fb384a48ffbdad6.name: maybe_play_idle_motion
0fb384a48ffbdad6.doc: Half the time plays the idle play motion while turning toward the target.

0fb9560037b89361.name: wait_motion_progress
0fb9560037b89361.doc: Waits until the motion progress is within the tolerance of the given value (default 0.03) or the motion ends. Returns the frames waited.

0fc18c9f35ccfc87.name: turn_toward_monster_for_frames
0fc18c9f35ccfc87.doc: Keeps turning toward another monster for the given number of frames.

1004a6b7bb6d9a1c.name: tick_for_frames
1004a6b7bb6d9a1c.doc: Runs the per-frame update for the given number of frames.

102b18921b53eba5.name: miss_three_times
102b18921b53eba5.doc: Plays the attack miss motion three times with a stand in between, then waits 8 frames.

10421f103cbba411.name: fly_around_target
10421f103cbba411.doc: Turns and flies to a point at the given angle and radius around the target. Returns the result of the flight.

10460ba1ef526720.name: setup_vanguard_attacks
10460ba1ef526720.doc: Registers the weak attack 1 and knockback attack 3 hit areas for both arms, loads the Vanguard shockwave and spin effects, and sets the photo window for grade 0.

104a08ac4321e3c7.name: fight_at_close_range
104a08ac4321e3c7.doc: Close range: casts a shot, then often charge attacks, or strafes or backs away.

105612b88eb493fc.name: wait_frames_updating
105612b88eb493fc.doc: Waits the given number of frames, running the life bookkeeping each frame.

105ffe4b8e51416a.name: chase_target_steps
105ffe4b8e51416a.doc: Turns toward the target, then chases it in steps of a fixed distance until near it or out of frames. Returns the frames used or -1 when already near.

107fb5b64edbfd89.name: run_fight_loop
107fb5b64edbfd89.doc: Main loop: allows guard and dodge, then repeatedly runs one decision step.

109e6eea8faf2513.name: act_at_long_range
109e6eea8faf2513.doc: Long range choice: usually a long aimed shot, otherwise wanders, waits for the target to come into view or sidesteps.

10db7481bb08b32c.name: attack_at_mid_range
10db7481bb08b32c.doc: Mid range choice: shoots an arrow, circles the target at a run, backs away, or does a few step-backs.

10df3aedddc76d6a.name: fight_at_far_range
10df3aedddc76d6a.doc: Far range (140 to 225): walks to the target, waits, circles it, or attack 2.

10e20204e6bd7d3e.name: turn_toward_nearest_monster_and_cower
10e20204e6bd7d3e.doc: Turns toward the nearest monster while walking, then stands frightened.

111776c677af3a92.name: fly_to_position_facing
111776c677af3a92.doc: Moves the ship straight to a point, decelerating so it arrives smoothly, while turning to the given facing angle. Afterwards keeps turning until the facing is reached.

112d71e0a2712628.name: play_griffon_death
112d71e0a2712628.doc: Stops its sounds and flame effect, runs event script 502, plays the death motion and finishes death.

1130a9f450dae39b.name: wander_or_watch
1130a9f450dae39b.doc: Idle behaviour while the player is away. Turns away from walls, walks back toward its home point when more than 300 away, otherwise randomly wanders, stands watching, strafes around the player or walks straight ahead. Sets monster var 0 to the kind of movement chosen. Returns 1 when the player is detected.

1133e69400d4af9d.name: recoil_from_hit
1133e69400d4af9d.doc: Plays the damage knockback motion, waits 12 frames, then stands up.

113519bff273a4fa.name: run_ai_forever
113519bff273a4fa.doc: Allows guarding and dodging, then runs the aggro and decision logic every frame.

1142b95129ee97e0.name: forbid_evasion_and_reset_motion
1142b95129ee97e0.doc: Start of the stun reaction: forbids guarding and dodging and stops the motion. In this script's old numbering the DIRECT finish_death(1/2, 1) calls are set_mask_flag and set_camera_mode is reset_motion.

1144814eb525bede.name: duel_target_with_dodges
1144814eb525bede.doc: Unused duelling loop: attacks, steps back, runs at the target or sidesteps depending on distance and rolls. use_normal_attack picks the normal attack instead of the dodge attack.

1144d3c17c025d70.name: fly_toward_target_until_near_updating
1144d3c17c025d70.doc: Flies toward the target until within the stop margin, optionally tilting toward it.

117f1009b5b88604.name: fly_toward_target_point
117f1009b5b88604.doc: Turns toward the target, then flies in a straight line toward where the target stood, at the ground height under the monster plus height_offset. Returns 1 within speed plus margin of that point, a negative check_flight_step result if blocked, or 0 after frames.

118337ff3e113994.name: on_knockdown
118337ff3e113994.doc: Ends flight and runs the knockdown recovery, then resumes flight.

1197a319283d02e3.name: spit_sticky_goo
1197a319283d02e3.doc: Plays attack 2 and, at motion time 0.372, spawns the sticky goo effect at the dcol01 frame with the monster's attack value, then waits for the motion to end.

11ae2551ce48ad97.name: watch_player_if_disguised
11ae2551ce48ad97.doc: If the player is disguised as a monster, waits and watches until the disguise ends.

11dca43439cfa9d4.name: wait_until_round_starts
11dca43439cfa9d4.doc: Sits at ground height until monster variable 8 is something other than 0, 8 or 16.

11e569da119790fe.name: track_monster_frames
11e569da119790fe.doc: Keeps turning toward another monster for a number of frames.

11f79b7c300b847f.name: walk_to_point_around_target
11f79b7c300b847f.doc: Walks to a point on a ring around the target at the given angle, returning -1 if the path is too short.

1204de4dde186218.name: get_knocked_flying_then_stun
1204de4dde186218.doc: Makes the monster damageable, forbids guarding and dodging and halts it, plays the knocked-flying and get-up motions, then the faint motion until the stun stars run out and guarding and dodging are allowed again.

1212c4b9661b5be0.name: play_spin_attack
1212c4b9661b5be0.doc: Plays the attack 1 wind-up, spawns the Himara spin attack effect with the monster's attack value, spins for 30 frames and plays the recovery.

1214b2fc60d98c0e.name: guard_against_shot
1214b2fc60d98c0e.doc: Forbids guard and dodge, plays the guard motions with a small knockback and allows them again.

123a7cd89884a196.name: idle_until_target_near
123a7cd89884a196.doc: Stands idle until the target comes within 250, then returns.

127b0e8b54120dad.name: walk_toward_target
127b0e8b54120dad.doc: Walks toward the target for up to 240 frames, then stands.

1292b61276fb9135.name: explode_on_land
1292b61276fb9135.doc: Stops moving, ends the throw and explodes.

129c85c74fbe6159.name: walk_in_direction
129c85c74fbe6159.doc: Despite the parameter names, the first argument is the turn speed in degrees and the second the walk speed. Turns to the world heading angle_deg, then walks dist units along it (at least the walk speed + 1). A heading below the turn speed, including every negative heading, is first increased by the turn speed. Returns 1 if the target comes within stop_dist, 2 when the walk ends, 0 after max_frames.

12afd01ed9e0e8df.name: setup_curse_bullet_attack
12afd01ed9e0e8df.doc: Registers the knockback lunge hit and loads the curse bullet effects into a free texture block.

12bd5978786c4391.name: play_attack_two
12bd5978786c4391.doc: Turns to the target and plays the attack 2 motion.

12c143be2452de74.name: fly_back_then_land_stunned
12c143be2452de74.doc: Plays the knocked-flying motion until the monster is near the ground or the motion ends, then the get-up motion, snaps it to the ground and leaves it stunned before unlocking.

12f6ddac532b4e6c.name: wait_forever
12f6ddac532b4e6c.doc: Loops forever, waiting a frame at a time.

12f978603a9ea5ee.name: change_phase
12f978603a9ea5ee.doc: Runs the ground or sky phase entry depending on bit 4 of flags, resizes the entry object and stores the flags.

12ffca82e7415511.name: wait_turn_to_angle_updating
12ffca82e7415511.doc: Waits, updating the boss, until the monster faces the angle or max_frames pass. Returns the frames waited.

13112ae5e8420505.name: wander_or_wait_idle
13112ae5e8420505.doc: Idle flight behaviour: flies away from walls, wanders around its home point or the target, or hovers watching. Returns 1 if the target was detected.

1316bfaf78078e3f.name: tick_until_move_end
1316bfaf78078e3f.doc: Runs frames until the current move ends or the frame limit passes. Returns 0 when the move ended.

131c06c317c45822.name: struggle_forever
131c06c317c45822.doc: Plays the struggle motion and idles while the monster is held up.

13362c89b36ea31b.name: act_at_mid_range
13362c89b36ea31b.doc: Calm mid-range choice: lunge slash, walk up or strafe around the player.

13465b0c1124e3aa.name: attack_at_close_range
13465b0c1124e3aa.doc: Walks up and strikes, uses an attack directly, dodges sideways or backward, or strafes beside the target once.

136cb82fef813c6c.name: wait_while_player_disguised
136cb82fef813c6c.doc: Stands and turns to face the target whenever it is outside a 90 degree cone until the player is no longer disguised.

13809a684f31c800.name: lunge_forward
13809a684f31c800.doc: Turns to the target, then lunges 100 units forward with the first attack, with guard and dodge disabled during the lunge.

1383c1e86fa899fc.name: turn_randomly_then_chase_target
1383c1e86fa899fc.doc: Idle state: turns to a random angle, waits for the target to come into view and then flies after it.

138ab3368dfeada0.name: run_enraged_ai
138ab3368dfeada0.doc: AI loop when no rage hits remain: shoots gear or poison arrows, runs away, steps back up to twice, or circles the target at a run. Returns 0 once rage hits are above 0 again. The close-range test reads a distance that is never set.

13ae435cc24cfb62.name: idle_forever
13ae435cc24cfb62.doc: Loops forever, doing only the per-frame bookkeeping.

13be8a8a4865abca.name: guard_and_counter
13be8a8a4865abca.doc: Plays guard in, takes the blocked hit, then with 30% chance counters with attack 2, otherwise plays guard out.

13e59a383db3d3ff.name: turn_by_angle
13e59a383db3d3ff.doc: Turns by an angle relative to the current heading and waits.

13ea055457285708.name: dash_step_left
13ea055457285708.doc: Sidestep to the left, invulnerable from frame 10 to 24, moving at 3.6 per frame (about 50 units). When the target is within 120 units it heads for a point 200 units to its left; otherwise it heads for a point 90 units from the target, 30 degrees to its other side, while turning to face it.

1403671432b0a93c.name: rush_and_roam_near_target
1403671432b0a93c.doc: Unused loop: sometimes rushes the target and attacks, otherwise runs toward a random point near it.

1411fbcc83dbd658.name: wander_or_wait_idle
1411fbcc83dbd658.doc: Idle behaviour while the monster has not noticed the player: walks away from walls, wanders around its home point or around the target, or stands and watches. Returns 1 if the target was detected while standing.

14137a66147d5669.name: step_back_dodge
14137a66147d5669.doc: Steps back toward a point 100 units behind, moving 2.7 per frame for 9 frames (about 24 units), invulnerable for the whole step, then returns to standing.

1422147f14b0a95a.name: fall_and_get_up
1422147f14b0a95a.doc: Plays the knocked flying motion, waits 45 frames, then gets up.

142e1277aa9aec57.name: setup_combo_attack_and_knife
142e1277aa9aec57.doc: Registers two combo hit windows on attack 1 and preloads the clown soldier knife effect.

143cefdfd72248ba.name: face_target_within_frames
143cefdfd72248ba.doc: Turns toward the target and waits at most max_frames.

144a77c9b2419b20.name: walk_around_target
144a77c9b2419b20.doc: Turns to face the point radius units from the target at angle_deg around it (0 is the side facing this monster), then walks there at move_speed. If less than 100 units are clear ahead, the walk is cut to the clear distance, and -1 is returned without moving when that is under twice stop_dist. Otherwise waits up to max_frames and returns 1 once the target is within stop_dist, 2 when the walk ends, 0 on timeout, and stops moving.

144aacfd7980729f.name: move_beside_target
144aacfd7980729f.doc: Moves to the point beside the target at the given angle, stopping short of walls. Returns -1 if there is no room.

1468a782a77a2fdb.name: turn_to_target_with_random_offset
1468a782a77a2fdb.doc: Turns toward the target, with offset_chance percent probability of aiming offset_deg to a random side of it, and waits until done.

14ab3119e21f6c25.name: turn_move_around_target
14ab3119e21f6c25.doc: Turns toward a point on a circle around the target at angle_deg and radius, then moves there. Returns -1 if a wall leaves too little room.

1521828b6707cc4e.name: fight_at_close_range
1521828b6707cc4e.doc: Close-range choice: runs or walks up and attacks, or backs off and sidesteps.

1527b3e651dc7cfc.name: act_at_close_range
1527b3e651dc7cfc.doc: Close range choice: 85 percent of the time walks up to within 65 units of the target and swings. Otherwise, when the target is within 70 units and fewer than 7 monsters exist, it summons sprouts 60 percent of the time, and then either walks up to the target (70 percent) or stands watching for it to come into view for up to 45 frames (30 percent). The walk in a fixed direction is never reached, because its roll test (roll < 100) is always true.

155310a2a91cfea3.name: fly_sideways_updating
155310a2a91cfea3.doc: Flies 300 units to the monster's right (go_right set) or left at hover_height above the ground, updating the boss. The flight result is dropped, so the return value is undefined.

1555834d634c4e0a.name: step_back_from_target
1555834d634c4e0a.doc: Dodge: becomes invulnerable and steps back to a point 30 to 40 units farther from the target than now, then waits for the motion to end and stands.

1557163007033fe6.name: wait_until_facing_angle
1557163007033fe6.doc: Waits until the monster's yaw is within tolerance of the angle (at least 3 degrees), or the turn is finished, or max_frames pass. Returns the frames waited.

1569300e897ed797.name: play_ground_slam_attack
1569300e897ed797.doc: Plays attack 1, waits 85 frames, then spawns five dust clouds in a ring of radius 20 around the marioa_null frame and waits for the motion to end.

15801d6affce34b6.name: fly_to_opposite_ring_point
15801d6affce34b6.doc: Chooses a point on the far side of the arena from the stored ring angle, turns to it and flies there at height 150.

15930c2f137a2e3a.name: swing_attack_1
15930c2f137a2e3a.doc: Walks up to the target, then plays attack 1 while tracking the target for 30 frames, pads to 35 frames, and finishes the motion.

15e8a149234db1b2.name: setup_combo_attacks
15e8a149234db1b2.doc: Registers the hit windows for attack 1 and attack 2 of the combo and initialises the AI.

16022ac5c451d299.name: dodge_ranged_attack
16022ac5c451d299.doc: Counters a shot by turning and swinging both arms, or steps sideways first then swings.

1606874390f1bf32.name: tick_until_motion_end
1606874390f1bf32.doc: Runs the per-frame update until the current motion ends. Returns 1.

160d94bbab3c37bf.name: is_facing_target_deg
160d94bbab3c37bf.doc: Degree version of is_facing_target_rad: returns 1 when the monster faces within arc_deg total of the target direction turned by offset_deg.

161f7523a385d657.name: wait_frames_updating
161f7523a385d657.doc: Waits the given number of frames, running the life bookkeeping each frame.

16256fac9014f63e.name: chase_target_until_near
16256fac9014f63e.doc: Walks after the target or stands watching until the target is within 230 units. Not called from this script.

1627dc4d3f9ad676.name: wait_for_move_or_target_near
1627dc4d3f9ad676.doc: Waits for the current move to finish. Returns 1 if the target got within near_dist, 2 if the move ended, 0 on timeout.

163108ec9571b19e.name: aim_and_fire_turret_loop
163108ec9571b19e.doc: Every frame aims the turret, and when the target is straight in front of it fires a burst with a 5 percent chance per frame.

1640d91437d6db7f.name: wait_target_in_view_updating
1640d91437d6db7f.doc: Waits, updating the boss, until the target is in view. Returns 1 when seen and 0 on timeout.

1644465b5aa72ff4.name: choose_wander_action
1644465b5aa72ff4.doc: Wander AI. Picks a random idle action: turn away from walls, return toward home, walk around the home point or the target, walk straight, or wait and watch for the player. Sets monster var 0 to 1, 4, 8, 16 or 32 to record which action it chose. Returns 1 when it noticed the target.

164ae0a8812c4b5f.name: fly_toward_target
164ae0a8812c4b5f.doc: Turns to face the target, then flies straight to its position at hover_height above the ground. Returns 1 when close, the check_flight_step result on an obstruction, or 0 after max_frames.

16666e46608fc0f0.name: turn_to_face_target_limited
16666e46608fc0f0.doc: Turns toward the target for at most max_frames.

16776be7bff07f74.name: explode_after_landing
16776be7bff07f74.doc: Stops moving, ends the throw, clears invulnerability and explodes.

168d65e5a23313b1.name: circle_distant_target
168d65e5a23313b1.doc: Idles while the target is 350 units or farther by circling to a point 240 units from it, turning toward it or standing watch. Returns 0 once the target is closer.

1690b6076e9d2452.name: side_walk_to_face_target
1690b6076e9d2452.doc: Turns to face the target, looping the walk right motion when the world yaw toward the target is negative and walk left otherwise, then stands. The choice ignores the monster's own facing, so the motion often does not match the turn direction.

16a4ab205f16d19a.name: turn_and_attack_2
16a4ab205f16d19a.doc: Faces the target, plays the second attack motion to its end, then stands for 9 frames. Sets state 1 with the walk motion first.

16a8b93cb73de38f.name: get_knocked_down_and_rise
16a8b93cb73de38f.doc: Is blown away, lies for 10 frames and gets up.

16ae2b5934589fa9.name: idle_if_player_disguised
16ae2b5934589fa9.doc: If the player is disguised, runs the disguised idle behaviour for this monster kind.

16b3f8eb026f9654.name: find_nearest_arena_corner
16b3f8eb026f9654.doc: Picks the closest of four fixed arena corner positions to the target and writes it out.

16d91a45847bffa5.name: move_random_offset
16d91a45847bffa5.doc: Moves without turning to a point base_dist + move_speed plus up to dist_range units ahead, turned up to angle_range degrees to one side, until the walk ends, the target comes within stop_dist or max_frames pass. Returns the wait_move_until_near result.

16ec7715c8cc3350.name: turn_and_block_hit
16ec7715c8cc3350.doc: Locks interrupts, turns to the target, plays the guard knockback for 12 frames and unlocks.

16f9de138924e119.name: approach_until_in_range
16f9de138924e119.doc: Walks or watches until the target is within 280 units.

1725c112ae9a4fd3.name: fight_by_distance
1725c112ae9a4fd3.doc: Main loop: runs the low life check and picks an action by distance to the target every frame.

173c5b6691ebc22b.name: update_aggro_from_damage
173c5b6691ebc22b.doc: Checks the monster's life change and, when it just took damage above the aggro damage minimum while not yet aggressive, sets the aggro flag (monster variable set 2, index 5). Prints the damage to the debug log.

174b1d51e024c8e8.name: run_rose_mode_step
174b1d51e024c8e8.doc: One step of the rose mode: always repositions and tries the rose barrage first (which increments the move counter), then acts on the new count: at 1 it sometimes dashes in with a tornado, at 2 it repositions and tries the roses again, and at 3 or more it switches to the tornado mode. The teleport branch for a count of 0 cannot be reached, since the counter is never below 0 in rose mode and the reposition has already raised it.

175e0306006d2cb1.name: turn_random_direction
175e0306006d2cb1.doc: Turns by a random angle to a random side and waits for the turn. It returns after the first attempt.

17618490a1983714.name: fire_wind_shot
17618490a1983714.doc: Plays attack 1, tracking the target, and spawns the wind shot launch and loop effects from the dcol0 frame with the monster's attack power.

1776b9ec1051aec2.name: wander_or_wait_for_target
1776b9ec1051aec2.doc: Idle behaviour: backs away from walls, drifts toward its home point, waits for the target, strolls around it or walks randomly. Returns 1 when it notices the target.

178b9952e675a375.name: play_guard_reaction
178b9952e675a375.doc: Locks interrupts, plays the guard motion for 8 frames and unlocks.

17c0a35c8a1da367.name: block_attack_with_guard
17c0a35c8a1da367.doc: Uninterruptible guard: guard-in, guard knockback, 8 frames of holding, guard-return motion.

17e3ca894f0d0d23.name: turn_randomly_and_walk_ahead
17e3ca894f0d0d23.doc: Meant to turn up to turn_range_deg degrees, but converts the range to radians and then the random turn to radians again, so it turns a whole number of degrees from 0 to about turn_range_deg/57, always to the same side. If 100 units ahead are clear it walks min_distance + speed plus a random 0 to distance_range units; if less is clear but more than stop_dist it walks just the random amount; otherwise it returns -1 without moving. Returns 1 if the target comes within stop_dist, 2 when the walk ends, 0 after max_frames.

17e93f8109a26309.name: share_damage_with_hull
17e93f8109a26309.doc: Subtracts the damage this turret took since the last frame from the hull life pool in monster variable 64.

180480ad28ab245c.name: turn_to_target_limit
180480ad28ab245c.doc: Turns the monster toward its target at turn_speed_deg and waits until it faces it or max_frames pass. Returns the frames used.

1838506c8252b685.name: turn_to_target_wait
1838506c8252b685.doc: Turns toward the target at the given speed and waits until facing it. Returns the frames spent turning.

18559857341a57da.name: wait_move_until_near
18559857341a57da.doc: Waits while a move order runs, tracking damage. Returns 1 when the target is within stop_dist, 2 when the move reaches its point, 0 on timeout.

18a16da38620ade7.name: fight_while_enraged
18a16da38620ade7.doc: Enraged behaviour: chases and dives at the target when under 75 units, otherwise shoots thunder shots or chases. Returns when the rage counter is above zero.

18ab9bbb87b176f8.name: init_flying_monster
18ab9bbb87b176f8.doc: Sets up a flying monster: no height limit, a 45 unit wall margin, 600 unit clip distance and the flying attribute.

18afe7d42f35e853.name: rise_above_owner
18afe7d42f35e853.doc: Sets state 1, then moves the light to 100 units above the owning monster over 60 frames and sets state 2.

18c27d6f3810f56d.name: dodge_back_invulnerable
18c27d6f3810f56d.doc: Dodge for melee attacks: with damage disabled for about 19 frames it plays the step back motion and, after 5 frames, moves for 14 frames toward a point on its own side of the target, 40 to 50 units farther from it than now; then it waits for the motion to end and stands.

18dd9500743a5e65.name: watch_disguised_player
18dd9500743a5e65.doc: Stands and turns to face the player while the player is disguised as a monster, returning when the disguise ends.

18e378dfff70aeb9.name: recoil_from_hit
18e378dfff70aeb9.doc: Stops all actions, plays the damage knockback, waits 12 frames and returns to standing.

190611521402b623.name: on_update
190611521402b623.doc: Allows guarding and dodging and then idles; the behaviour is driven by the reaction handlers.

19159a416e577677.name: close_action_before_rage
19159a416e577677.doc: Close-range choice (under 110 units) before the monster is enraged: lunge, one or two repeated lunges, walk at the target or circle it.

19356270c9ae77d8.name: leap_in_then_fight
19356270c9ae77d8.doc: On the first run (monster var 0 is 0) it leaps to a random point 140 units away while invulnerable. Then it loops, choosing an action from the situation each frame.

19385102ea6ba259.name: act_at_mid_range
19385102ea6ba259.doc: Mid-range choice (200 to 300): nose bullets, run up and charge, chase, or circle.

195c40621677abb8.name: recover_after_throw_and_restore_flight
195c40621677abb8.doc: Recovers from a throw, waits 10 frames, turns scripted movement back on and resets the motion.

196d88c9b24ecd10.name: charge_and_self_destruct
196d88c9b24ecd10.doc: Plays the attack 2 wind-up and charges toward a point 100 units ahead for up to max_frames, then blows itself up if it got within 34 units of the target, otherwise with an 80 percent chance at grade 0 and 50 percent at other grades. The Bombahe self-destruct effect hits for the attack power times the whole part of (5 times the life fraction plus 1), so 1 to 6 times its attack, and the monster plays the self-destruct death and halts forever. When it does not explode it plays the wind-down, stands 9 frames and returns 0.

197b77841b501bc5.name: set_speed_boost
197b77841b501bc5.doc: Stores a speed boost for flights in monster var 9. Nothing reads it back, since get_speed_boost overwrites the variable instead of loading it, so the boost set during the sky phase has no effect.

19987bd3b171aa2f.name: make_damageable_and_halt
19987bd3b171aa2f.doc: Meant to clear the no-damage attribute, forbid guard and dodge, stop moving and turning and reset the motion. The calls are in this script's old native numbering, and the engine runs the natives the numbers select (set_photo_window, set_visible_monster_limit, get_attack and so on), so none of that happens.

199a24c4de790196.name: stand_for_frames
199a24c4de790196.doc: Stops moving, plays the stand motion and waits the given number of frames.

19a97e01dc1265c7.name: choose_action_by_target_distance
19a97e01dc1265c7.doc: Picks the attack by target distance: over 450 the far chase, over 250 the medium approach, otherwise the aerial sequence.

19aff3b30e886272.name: wander_while_idle
19aff3b30e886272.doc: Idle behaviour picked at random: turn away from walls, walk back toward home when far from it, stand watching for the target, walk around home or the target, or walk in a random direction. Sets monster var 0 to the behaviour bit and returns 1 when the target is detected while standing.

19c253558bcf5657.name: fight_at_mid_range
19c253558bcf5657.doc: Mid range choice: slash, run at the target, walk toward it, or circle it.

19d031d8c145d2b9.name: walk_toward_target
19d031d8c145d2b9.doc: Walks toward the player for up to 90 frames and then stands.

19d33c902ad20382.name: act_at_far_range
19d33c902ad20382.doc: Calm long-range choice: walk up, stand watching, strafe or turn and charge.

19ea267bb812e5a9.name: fight_without_rage_loop
19ea267bb812e5a9.doc: Loops while the target is within 220 units. Repositions when another monster has priority, otherwise turns and fires a wind shot, often after a random side-step.

19f7a17bc2520891.name: dodge_melee_by_stepping_back
19f7a17bc2520891.doc: Locks interrupts and dodges a melee attack with the invulnerable back step.

1a1bcbbad488844e.name: circle_or_wait_near_target
1a1bcbbad488844e.doc: Low-priority behaviour near the target: circle it or stand watching it.

1a30868c60111b56.name: chase_target
1a30868c60111b56.doc: Turns toward the target and walks to its position each frame until within stop_dist (returns -1) or max_frames pass.

1a41d14f4e94a91a.name: turn_toward_target_until_motion_ends
1a41d14f4e94a91a.doc: Keeps turning toward the target until the current motion ends.

1a4c4944ed404c31.name: wait_until_target_close
1a4c4944ed404c31.doc: Stands idle until the target is within 280 units, then returns 0.

1a4ed7405dbde34b.name: setup_attacks_and_venom_effects
1a4ed7405dbde34b.doc: Registers the two hit windows of attack 1, sets a photo window for grade 0, loads the poison fluid effects into a free texture block and starts the AI.

1a58b9c9ee971739.name: track_monster_until_time
1a58b9c9ee971739.doc: Keeps turning toward another monster until the motion progress is within tolerance of time.

1a58c8b0a1f5fc74.name: struggle_when_lifted
1a58c8b0a1f5fc74.doc: Plays the struggle motion while being held, updating the boss every frame.

1a6f5806547b14a2.name: track_target_until_time
1a6f5806547b14a2.doc: Keeps turning toward the target until the motion progress is within tolerance of time (default 0.05).

1a99c7169d34aad0.name: swing_quick_combo
1a99c7169d34aad0.doc: Plays attack 1, cuts to attack 2 after 15 frames (18 at 30 fps scaled to PAL) and waits for the end.

1a9f15c21c79e2b2.name: dash_to_target_position
1a9f15c21c79e2b2.doc: Turns to the target, fixes its current position and flies straight there for up to max_frames. Returns 1 on arrival, a collision code if blocked, 0 on timeout.

1ab9f18be918a283.name: clear_rose_handles
1ab9f18be918a283.doc: Marks all six rose effect slots (variables 12 to 17) as empty.

1ad6822bd8055dbf.name: wait_frame_update
1ad6822bd8055dbf.doc: Waits one frame. The per-frame update hook it calls is do_nothing in this script, so there is no aggro update.

1ad68abaf7749719.name: is_facing_target_rad
1ad68abaf7749719.doc: Returns 1 when the monster faces within arc/2 radians of the target direction shifted by offset, else 0 (b02a raw numbering: the calls shown stand for get_rot and get_target_angle).

1aec7044cc71ecb4.name: face_target_and_sidestep
1aec7044cc71ecb4.doc: Turns to face the target and sidesteps invulnerable to dodge a shot.

1b06806aad48e10f.name: walk_around_point
1b06806aad48e10f.doc: Turns toward and walks to a point on a circle of the given radius around (x, y, z), placed angle_deg around from the monster's own side of the point. Returns 1 if the target comes within stop_dist, 2 if the walk ends, 0 on timeout.

1b2eecc1cd953c8b.name: watch_disguised_player
1b2eecc1cd953c8b.doc: If the player is disguised, idles in place until the disguise ends. Called every frame so the monster ignores a disguised player.

1b6304f6d2735716.name: fight_at_mid_range
1b6304f6d2735716.doc: Mid range choice (target 120 to 200 away): guard charge, ice ball, or flying around the target before looking for it.

1b6a583cbc8eb6c3.name: choose_attack_by_distance
1b6a583cbc8eb6c3.doc: Picks the far (over 450), mid (over 225) or close range attack from the flat distance to the target and bumps the attack counter in var 20.

1b74719913ecfe74.name: walk_to_target_attack
1b74719913ecfe74.doc: Plays attack 2 while walking toward the target.

1b7f729896f76e28.name: walk_ahead_by_target_distance
1b7f729896f76e28.doc: Turns to the target, then walks straight ahead as far as the target is away. Returns -1 if the path is blocked.

1b959434b0b61cdf.name: struggle_while_lifted
1b959434b0b61cdf.doc: Plays the struggle motion forever while the player holds it.

1ba96fceb19ad397.name: on_death
1ba96fceb19ad397.doc: Plays the death motion, finishes the death and runs event script 501.

1baf3594cb0f3023.name: sidestep_to_dodge_melee
1baf3594cb0f3023.doc: Dodges a melee attack by turning to the target and making an invulnerable sidestep, then stands and allows guard and dodge again. The step-back branch never runs because the 0 to 19 roll is always under 20.

1bc48260642ad669.name: shrug_off_knockdown
1bc48260642ad669.doc: Knockdown handler that ignores the knockdown: cancels the current action, snaps to face the target for one frame, then lets the AI resume. It plays no knockdown motion.

1bcdf7323fc00337.name: wander_or_watch
1bcdf7323fc00337.doc: Idle behaviour while the player is away. Walks off on a random heading when a wall is within 47 units; when more than 300 from home (re-homing beyond 800) it usually walks to a random point up to 150 units from home or watches 30 frames, otherwise it mostly watches 30 frames, turns in place, circles the player or walks straight ahead. Sets monster var 0 to the movement kind and returns 1 when it detects the player while watching; its random wander branch tests an uninitialised variable and never runs.

1be53e30376052e8.name: on_death
1be53e30376052e8.doc: Ten percent of the time pretends to die, then gets up with 20 to 50 percent life; otherwise plays the death motion and ends the monster.

1c01baeadaec30a3.name: search_for_target
1c01baeadaec30a3.doc: Used while no target is known: walks toward it or waits and watches, until a target appears.

1c11b208ea74552a.name: act_at_long_range
1c11b208ea74552a.doc: Long range choice: mostly shoots a wind shot or turns randomly and chases, sometimes walks closer and flies after the target or waits in view.

1c17cd797b9f4b35.name: act_at_mid_range
1c17cd797b9f4b35.doc: Mid-range choice: chase and attack, chase and stand, vanish, or circle the target.

1c24b2604db8c88c.name: run_toward_target
1c24b2604db8c88c.doc: Runs toward the target for 120 frames and stands.

1c36ffeb42453276.name: block_attack
1c36ffeb42453276.doc: Clears the queued actions, faces the player and plays the guard motion with a small pushback.

1c40590f6e11a555.name: walk_in_direction
1c40590f6e11a555.doc: Turns to the world heading angle_deg at turn_speed_deg, then walks distance units along it at speed (at least speed + 1), checking the death flag each frame. A heading below the turn speed, including every negative heading, is first increased by the turn speed. Returns 1 if the target comes within stop_distance, 2 when the walk ends, 0 after max_frames.

1c70b59ca1bbab55.name: circle_or_wait_near_target
1c70b59ca1bbab55.doc: Low-priority behaviour near the target: circle it or stand watching it.

1c71cea753c0ec20.name: track_monster_frames_updating
1c71cea753c0ec20.doc: Turns toward another monster each frame for the given number of frames.

1c7941c55147085c.name: fight_target_by_distance
1c7941c55147085c.doc: Fight loop that shoots fire balls, guard-charges and sidesteps depending on distance until the target is farther than 300. Not called by this script.

1c89a3a6be14d177.name: walk_random_direction
1c89a3a6be14d177.doc: Meant to turn up to angle_range degrees, but converts the range to radians and then the random turn to radians again, so it turns a whole number of degrees from 0 to about angle_range/57, always to the same side (under 57 it does not turn). If 100 units ahead are clear it walks base_dist + move_speed plus a random 0 to dist_range units; if less is clear but more than clearance it walks just the random amount; otherwise it returns -1 without moving. clearance is also the stop distance of the wait: returns 1 if the target comes within clearance, 2 when the walk ends, 0 after max_frames.

1c958cf9521e6c87.name: fight_while_enraged
1c958cf9521e6c87.doc: Combat loop once the monster is enraged. Under 110 units it swings or casts the curse or runs at the player; further out it mostly casts the curse. Returns when it calms down.

1cc10bb16c800b3b.name: play_attack_swing
1cc10bb16c800b3b.doc: Plays the attack motion while turning toward the target, then returns to standing.

1cd4db7ca8ea257e.name: fly_backward
1cd4db7ca8ea257e.doc: Meant to fly backward away from the monster's facing, but the distance is never set, so the destination is its own position; the returned value is never set either.

1cd8ba9fca252afa.name: walk_around_point
1cd8ba9fca252afa.doc: Turns toward and walks to a point on a circle around the given centre.

1cdfe03697b58aa7.name: on_damage
1cdfe03697b58aa7.doc: Plays the damage knockback, then returns to standing.

1cfb452153051318.name: stop_boss_se
1cfb452153051318.doc: Stops a sound effect on this monster.

1d0a1a52bcc85178.name: wait_move_until_near
1d0a1a52bcc85178.doc: Waits up to max_frames for a move_to walk. Returns 1 as soon as the target is within stop_dist, 2 when the walk reaches its point, 0 on timeout; stops moving on 1 or 2 but not on timeout.

1d163a7871887428.name: dodge_melee_with_counter
1d163a7871887428.doc: Dodges a melee attack by rushing forward in a dodge attack, stepping back or dodging in place.

1d3b7090392a5871.name: turn_to_angle
1d3b7090392a5871.doc: Starts turning to a heading and waits until it is reached. Returns the frames waited.

1d4485ca90199abf.name: track_target_until_motion_end_updating
1d4485ca90199abf.doc: Turns toward the target each frame until the current motion ends.

1d4ac87b84f6f3ee.name: idle_until_disguise_ends
