1d4ac87b84f6f3ee.doc: Stands and turns to face the target while the player is disguised, and returns once the disguise is gone. The monster kind argument is unused.

1d5b0c954d0a2264.name: setup_attack_and_heal_effects
1d5b0c954d0a2264.doc: Registers the weak knockback hit for attack 1, clears monster var 0, loads the heal effects into a free texture block when one is available, and starts the monster AI with init_monster_ai.

1d692a81af8717e0.name: counter_or_recoil_from_knockdown
1d692a81af8717e0.doc: On knockdown, 40 percent of the time turns toward the target and counters with attack 2, otherwise plays the damage reaction.

1da232259a567609.name: dodge_with_moonsault
1da232259a567609.doc: Dodges melee attacks with the moonsault routine.

1dba819cdd9aaa40.name: attack_at_mid_range
1dba819cdd9aaa40.doc: At 80 to 150 units it spits venom or performs one of the two melee-style attacks.

1dead8ed748f3005.name: choose_behaviour_by_aggro
1dead8ed748f3005.doc: Top-level AI step. With rage hits left it fights nearby targets, holds guard, or rushes a target in aggro range; with none left it uses the plain fight loop.

1def0246de1bc14c.name: hover_while_player_disguised
1def0246de1bc14c.doc: While the player is disguised as a monster, flies to 5 units above the ground at its position (the 25 passed as the height is replaced by fly_to_point), then only turns to face the target when it leaves a 90 degree arc. Returns when the disguise ends.

1e1c7345c49e6dca.name: fight_at_close_range
1e1c7345c49e6dca.doc: Close range choice: slash, circle the target, or step away.

1e25c4e2cd1cef3d.name: hover_until_player_undisguised
1e25c4e2cd1cef3d.doc: Descends to 5 units above the ground over up to 150 frames, then hovers, turning to the target whenever it is more than 90 degrees off, until the player is no longer disguised as a monster.

1e42cce2e258be2f.name: fly_in_direction
1e42cce2e258be2f.doc: Turns to the absolute angle in degrees and flies the given distance that way.

1e5a5ef770ca4f2d.name: setup_attack_hits
1e5a5ef770ca4f2d.doc: Binds collision objects, registers the normal attack hits for attacks 1 and 2 and the knockback hit for the dodge attack, and sets body size and clip distance.

1e742c2ce0a43741.name: fight_by_range_until_far
1e742c2ce0a43741.doc: Fight loop: while the target is within 175 units and get_rage_hits_left is nonzero, picks far (140 to 175), mid (90 to 140) or close range actions by distance; monsters not first or second nearest the target strafe or wait instead. Returns 0 when the target leaves or no rage hits are left.

1e7667c223d3c5a5.name: guard_hit_with_recoil
1e7667c223d3c5a5.doc: Guard program: locks interrupts, plays the guard motion with a small knockback for 8 frames, then returns to standing and unlocks.

1e7b36f6c2ac3882.name: record_last_damage
1e7b36f6c2ac3882.doc: Stores the life lost since the last check (old life minus new life) in monster variable 4.

1e94e288ef32d514.name: choose_far_range_action
1e94e288ef32d514.doc: Picks an action when the target is 140 to 240 units away: chase, shockwave attack, wander, or idle play.

1ea3da88140d7afc.name: track_target_until_motion_end
1ea3da88140d7afc.doc: Keeps turning toward the target every frame until the current motion has ended, then stops turning.

1eaa61c496ebb083.name: turn_to_orbit_angle
1eaa61c496ebb083.doc: Turns the ship to the yaw toward the target turned 90 degrees, +90 when group A of the ship parts has more survivors than group B, otherwise -90, and waits for the turn. This is the opposite rule to pick_orbit_angle.

1eb59c003af759be.name: sidestep_around_target
1eb59c003af759be.doc: Plays a random left or right step and moves to a point 20 degrees around the target at the same distance. The monster takes no damage during the step.

1eb9e28cb16243d9.name: walk_in_direction
1eb9e28cb16243d9.doc: Walks distance units in the given world angle without turning first and waits to arrive.

1ee7113f55850159.name: approach_target_until_close
1ee7113f55850159.doc: Runs at the target while it is farther than 200 units and walks in short steps when nearer, until within 80 units.

1ef31beca76812d8.name: threaten_for_frames
1ef31beca76812d8.doc: Sets variable 20 (which also stops the stall event), ends any spit effect, faces the target and plays the threaten motion, looping it for frames (PAL-scaled) with variables 0 and 8 at 32 until 0.408 into the return motion, then stands. A stun while variable 0 is 32 and the fish frame is within 60 of a monster runs event script 500. Returns 0.

1f0d003988707226.name: glide_to_arena_edge
1f0d003988707226.doc: Glides to one of five fixed points around the edge of the arena, chosen at random.

1f223226080c93e1.name: wait_for_target_in_view
1f223226080c93e1.doc: Waits up to max_frames for the target to enter the view cone. Returns 1 if it did, 0 otherwise.

1f243522d603f5bd.name: fight_at_mid_range
1f243522d603f5bd.doc: Mid range choice: nose bullets, run in and slam, approach on foot or circle around the target.

1f258c2f5c0a48b2.name: run_light_orb_ai
1f258c2f5c0a48b2.doc: Loops the idle motion and runs the state machine. When the host sets command 4 it rises above the host, state 2 slides to the orbit start, state 16 orbits with the light effect, state 64 returns to hover. Every frame it hovers around the host with a small oscillating sway.

1f26ed3d7bf01f1b.name: face_player_while_disguised
1f26ed3d7bf01f1b.doc: Drops to hover 5 units above the ground, then stands and turns to face the player whenever it is more than 90 degrees off, until the player's disguise ends.

1f28a5f3f1314c5a.name: fight_while_enraged
1f28a5f3f1314c5a.doc: Enraged behaviour: under 80 units either repeats its melee attack or spits venom, farther away spits venom with a longer arc. Returns when the target is over 280 units away.

1f45d25f8a85ab1b.name: track_monster_frames
1f45d25f8a85ab1b.doc: Turns toward another monster by handle every frame for the given number of frames, then stops turning. turn_speed_deg is degrees per frame.

1f4932afc1dbb4cb.name: on_init
1f4932afc1dbb4cb.doc: Registers the attack hit windows and sword trails, sets the faint photo window for grade 0 and loads the S wave L effect.

1f5dc35e0fb57fe3.name: begin_locked_action_facing_target
1f5dc35e0fb57fe3.doc: Forbids guard and dodge, resets motion, stops, faces the target and marks the monster busy.

1f663a1d0a4073b4.name: wait_forever_updating
1f663a1d0a4073b4.doc: Loops forever, running the per-frame update.

1f6fbf8c4a735c25.name: lunge_melee_attack
1f6fbf8c4a735c25.doc: Plays attack 1 while walking toward the target, then waits for the motion to end.

1f74eb7a0ddd9457.name: recoil_from_hit
1f74eb7a0ddd9457.doc: Stops all actions, makes the monster lockable, plays the damage knockback, waits 12 frames and returns to standing.

1f99472b83800684.name: lock_and_face_target
1f99472b83800684.doc: Locks the monster for a scripted reaction: forbids guard and dodge, cancels motion, movement and turning, snaps to face the target for one frame and sets act status 1.

1fa9e333544f1267.name: turn_to_angle
1fa9e333544f1267.doc: Turns to face angle_deg (degrees) at turn_speed_deg, waiting until it gets there or a full turn's worth of frames pass. Returns the frames spent.

1fc213fc95521e68.name: play_damage_then_faint
1fc213fc95521e68.doc: Clears no-damage and halts, plays the damage motion for 12 frames, then plays the faint motion until the stun stars run out and allows guard and dodge again.

201aa8c0eb23166d.name: run_no_rage_ai
201aa8c0eb23166d.doc: AI loop when no rage hits remain. Within 90 flat units it usually flies in and dives at the target, otherwise it shoots a wind shot or flies closer. Returns 0 when rage hits return.

203319e8f0b0dbd2.name: faint_until_stun_ends
203319e8f0b0dbd2.doc: Meant to play the faint motion until the stun stars are gone, then allow guard and dodge again. In this script's old native numbering the motion and mask flag calls run set_life and set_visible_monster_limit instead, so only the stun wait happens as meant.

203521f9ba011562.name: wander_or_wait_for_target
203521f9ba011562.doc: Idle behaviour: backs away from walls, returns toward home if far from it, otherwise randomly stands waiting for the player, circles the target, or walks in a random direction. Returns 1 if the player was detected while waiting.

20352edc710a902a.name: fight_at_long_range
20352edc710a902a.doc: Long range choice: shoots a bolt or flies around the target.

205ff287a6818985.name: act_at_close_range
205ff287a6818985.doc: Close range choice: dodge attack or shot, or if monster variable 0 is 1 or the hit counter in variable 1 is above 5, runs to a flank position and resets both; otherwise walks back and shoots or circles the target.

2060b756beca37cf.name: act_at_mid_range
2060b756beca37cf.doc: Mid-range behaviour: closes in and attacks when the target is within 150 and life is above 25 percent, otherwise tracks, circles, wanders or charges.

2062f30cfa2a3a3a.name: wait_target_in_view
2062f30cfa2a3a3a.doc: Waits up to max_frames for the target to enter the view cone. Returns 1 if it did, 0 on timeout.

2066df4404759580.name: sidestep_to_dodge_melee
2066df4404759580.doc: Dodges a melee attack by turning to the target and sidestepping 45 degrees around it at speed 3, then stands and allows guard and dodge again. The step-back branch never runs because the 0 to 19 roll is always under 20.

206b3d2a49dd6d83.name: block_attack
206b3d2a49dd6d83.doc: Plays the guard motion with a small pushback and the guard release, then stands.

206d84c0d1c7b562.name: turn_and_fly_toward_angle
206d84c0d1c7b562.doc: Turns to the given angle in degrees, then flies the given distance in that direction. Returns the result of the flight.

207c03461919402c.name: react_to_player_disguise
207c03461919402c.doc: If the player is disguised, stands facing the player until the disguise ends.

209457c578469c4c.name: fly_to_height
209457c578469c4c.doc: Moves the monster straight up (down when target_y is negative) by speed units per frame, for up to max_frames, until its y is within speed plus stop_margin of target_y; vertical movement stops outside 0 to 60 units above the ground. Returns 1 on arrival, the blocking result if blocked, 0 on timeout.

209c0c5e03042a67.name: move_in_direction
209c0c5e03042a67.doc: Moves the given distance toward the angle without turning first, waiting until the move ends or the frame limit.

20cbca1a101871ad.name: fly_backward
20cbca1a101871ad.doc: Meant to fly backward away from its facing, but the back distance is never set, so the destination is its own position and it barely moves; the returned result is never assigned either.

20d2f92e819b7ddb.name: attack_at_far_range
20d2f92e819b7ddb.doc: Far range attack choice: curve toward the target, shoot an aimed arrow, or fire a few circling arrows. Returns 1 if the sky phase started.

20dea980a99b7f72.name: wander_or_watch
20dea980a99b7f72.doc: Idle behaviour while the player is away. Turns away from walls, walks back toward its home point when more than 250 away, otherwise randomly wanders around home, stands watching for the player, strafes around the player or walks straight ahead. Sets monster var 0 to the kind of movement chosen. Returns 1 when the player is detected.

20e213afeb337592.name: on_damage
20e213afeb337592.doc: Reacts only while drill-charging (monster variable 15 is 1): cancels the action, plays a damage motion picked from the world yaw toward the target (the back motion can never be picked) with a small knockback, and waits 12 frames after it. Still in the air it then plays the attack swing; below ground level it snaps back to height 0.

2116285fb647cbe1.name: setup_attack_hits
2116285fb647cbe1.doc: Registers hits and sword trails for attacks 1 to 3 and the taunt, loads the cross cutter effect, sets life to 0.67 and clears monster var 7.

2123c3b2918d9fca.name: command_rose
2123c3b2918d9fca.doc: Sends a command to a rose through monster variable 8+rose; 1 resets it, 2 makes it act.

213b17b031ec3843.name: sidestep_then_attack
213b17b031ec3843.doc: With 50 percent chance steps 90 degrees to the right or left around the target, then slashes or lunges if the target is close and ahead, or does the moonsault.

213ea9a160a1795f.name: play_idle_loop
213ea9a160a1795f.doc: Loops the play motion for the given number of 58-frame rounds. When watch_target is 1 it ends early and returns 1 as soon as the target comes into view.

2147269af039acd5.name: swipe_claw_attack
2147269af039acd5.doc: Faces the target and plays attack 1 while tracking it. Sets monster var 1 to 1.

21491bd3b6cf83a8.name: guard_or_wander_at_far_range
21491bd3b6cf83a8.doc: 80 percent of the time stands in the guard motion for up to 45 frames or until the target is in view within 240 units; otherwise walks roughly straight ahead about 30 to 60 units, but only when the 100 units ahead are clear.

216f8a7f801ff981.name: get_turn_frames
216f8a7f801ff981.doc: Returns how many frames it takes to turn from the current yaw to the angle at the given speed (both in radians); 0 if under one frame.

2172ce4a07a7a1c6.name: act_at_close_range
2172ce4a07a7a1c6.doc: Calm close-range choice: lunge, step back or sideways dodge, or strafe.

2179c8f42be33193.name: wander_or_watch_target
2179c8f42be33193.doc: Half the time walks around the target at 90 to 120 units, otherwise stands and waits for the target to come into view.

21ac338a3093ea5c.name: chase_target_after_aggro
21ac338a3093ea5c.doc: Reaction when aggroed from beyond close range: throws bombs, walks toward the target, or runs at it.

21aca6d77a9d88e1.name: recoil_from_hit
21aca6d77a9d88e1.doc: Faces the target and plays the damage knockback motion.

21b201eead7fd404.doc: Registers the hit boxes for attack 1, loads the three ice shot effects, lifts the monster 20 units, sets flying limits (max height 45) and starts the monster AI.

21c16a9d5b5a0dc6.name: on_update
21c16a9d5b5a0dc6.doc: Disables guard, enables dodge and ignores hit push, then each frame runs the normal fight while the rage counter is above zero, otherwise the enraged one.

21fcaa571a5ed53a.name: run_to_target_and_attack
21fcaa571a5ed53a.doc: Runs to the target when it is more than 80 away, then 4 percent of the time does a double slash (target under 50) or lunge, and otherwise the moonsault, which only acts when the target is within 40.

22007c7a5131e35f.name: guard_briefly
22007c7a5131e35f.doc: Raises the guard, plays the guard knockback and lowers the guard again.

2201b47e3dfbfb8f.name: get_aggro_damage_min
2201b47e3dfbfb8f.doc: Writes into out[0] the smallest hit damage (monster variable set 2, slot 10) that makes this monster aggressive; update_aggro_from_damage compares each hit against it.

220dd0a0b7941a01.name: fight_loop_while_enraged
220dd0a0b7941a01.doc: Unused combat loop for the enraged state (no rage hits left): walks up to the target and uses a turning attack, or vanishes and reappears. Returns 0 when the target is farther than 400 or rage hits are available again.

221b612786e9042a.name: set_butterfly_slot
221b612786e9042a.doc: Stores the formation slot taken by the butterfly in a monster variable (9 + index - 1).

2264fce57de202d0.name: fight_target_before_rage
2264fce57de202d0.doc: Normal fight loop while the monster is not enraged: picks close, mid or far behaviour from the target distance. Returns when the target is further than 240 units or the rage hits are used up.

2287a716637ee113.name: act_at_close_range
2287a716637ee113.doc: Close range behaviour: usually melee or poison mist, sometimes a back step.

229f7c15893cd2fa.name: guard_hit
229f7c15893cd2fa.doc: Plays the guard knockback motion and stands.

22ad9a92d7b6231c.name: run_mammo_ai_loop
22ad9a92d7b6231c.doc: Main loop: fights when the target is within 280 units, otherwise spins to face it and walks toward it until within 69 units or 60 frames pass.

22adbbcb7e62fed0.name: on_init
22adbbcb7e62fed0.doc: Registers the dodge attack hit boxes, loads the fox bullet and muzzle flash effects, clears monster variables 0 and 1, and starts the monster AI.

22b7ae4a78556b8f.name: setup_vanguard_attacks
22b7ae4a78556b8f.doc: Registers the weak knockback hit of the first attack and loads the Vanguard shockwave and nose bullet effects.

22be917db7bf1c9c.name: run_bomb_behavior
22be917db7bf1c9c.doc: Self-destructs with a small explosion after 300 frames, or when it gets within 42 units of the target. It first turns and charges once, then chases a detected target, and wanders when none is detected.

22c3f0a7596e752f.name: wait_turn_to_angle
22c3f0a7596e752f.doc: Waits until the monster's heading is within the turn speed of angle_deg, or until max_frames pass, then stops turning. Returns the frames waited.

22c4d540cd0d6c5a.name: face_target_if_player_disguised
22c4d540cd0d6c5a.doc: When the player is disguised as this monster's own kind, stands and turns toward the target until the disguise ends. Does nothing otherwise.

22cd7db6b64d1b26.name: take_guarded_hit
22cd7db6b64d1b26.doc: Locks interrupts, plays the guard knockback and stands again.

22e3493b3ac5ce99.name: wait_move_end_update
22e3493b3ac5ce99.doc: Waits up to max_frames for the move order to finish, tracking damage.

22e40805ef2b1736.name: circle_target_or_idle
22e40805ef2b1736.doc: Circles the target at a random side angle, or stands and waits for it to come into view.

22efbc64ca1e24af.name: wait_frames_update
22efbc64ca1e24af.doc: Waits the given number of frames with life restored each frame.

22fd9cdae0eca6b3.name: wait_turn_to_angle
22fd9cdae0eca6b3.doc: Waits while the boss turns toward an angle in degrees, until it is within tolerance or time runs out. Returns frames waited.

23169fae7df01409.name: swing_sword_combo
23169fae7df01409.doc: Plays attack 2, then attack 1, and half the time dashes forward during the attack 1 part before the wind-down.

233423e6f45cc512.name: fight_at_far_range
233423e6f45cc512.doc: Far range: mostly runs at the target, otherwise runs in an arc around it.

234271e5cc2bfd31.name: walk_random_distance_ahead
234271e5cc2bfd31.doc: Walks a random distance in a direction randomly offset from the current yaw, without turning. Returns the move wait result.

2361c3d2d3e78fe7.name: get_distance_2d
2361c3d2d3e78fe7.doc: Meant to return the distance on the ground plane between two points, but the square root call (old numbering, meant as calc_square_root) has no native on this disc, so dist is never written and the returned value is unset.

236c4df9d48428cf.name: act_at_close_range
236c4df9d48428cf.doc: Calm close-range choice: slash or spit, dodge then slash, or circle the player.

2377de3ea50fa1cb.name: approach_distant_target
2377de3ea50fa1cb.doc: Walks toward the target or waits watching until it comes within 245.

237cff7eba8e5dab.name: wait_forever
237cff7eba8e5dab.doc: Loops forever, updating the frame each turn.

238565509b6263ea.name: choose_behaviour
238565509b6263ea.doc: Per-frame decision. While rage hits remain it fights, wanders or runs at the target depending on aggro and distance. With none left it uses the post-rage fight behaviour.

23a6a08bcb3e34e0.name: fall_and_die
23a6a08bcb3e34e0.doc: Falls to the ground, plays the death motion and finishes the death.

23b0ac828ac29758.name: cancel_spit_effect
23b0ac828ac29758.doc: Ends the spit effect whose slot is in variable 14 unless the variable holds -2, then sets it to -2. Variable 14 is also slot 0 of record_floor_time, so until the first spit the first call passes the floor time recorded by on_init to finish_effect.

23b71c3812933c52.name: fly_to_height
23b71c3812933c52.doc: Moves the monster vertically toward the height target_y at the given speed, for up to max_frames. Returns 1 on arrival, the blocking result if blocked, 0 on timeout.

23d04bd16e70ab82.name: fly_around_or_watch_target
23d04bd16e70ab82.doc: Half the time flies in an arc around the target then turns to face it; otherwise stands watching it.

2401681a81b4e4d6.name: attack_at_far_range
2401681a81b4e4d6.doc: Fires a wind shot or flies around the target. The roll is never set, so the branch is fixed by the uninitialised value.

2403b4b6313b9c34.name: do_nothing_args
2403b4b6313b9c34.doc: Empty stub that takes four arguments and ignores them.

24191f0d86da0a27.name: fight_while_no_rage_hits_left
24191f0d86da0a27.doc: Fight loop while no rage hits remain: swings at under 75 units, shoots the petrify shot at mid range, and also runs in or circles. Returns when rage hits remain.

241ea6c22216ef32.name: watch_disguised_player
241ea6c22216ef32.doc: If the player is currently disguised as a monster, runs the wait loop until the disguise ends.

243a15571f3ff37f.name: guard_hit_with_recoil
243a15571f3ff37f.doc: Guard program: locks interrupts, plays the guard motion with a small knockback for 8 frames, then unlocks.

24573fb7979c4e89.name: act_at_close_range
24573fb7979c4e89.doc: Close-range choice: run up and charge, fire nose bullets, or circle the target.

247677d21989f0c4.name: fly_along_angle
247677d21989f0c4.doc: Flies the given distance along an angle without turning first.

2478e9b30e9c20fa.name: face_target_until_motion_end
2478e9b30e9c20fa.doc: Keeps turning toward the target until the current motion ends.

2488f2914d82790b.name: recoil_then_maybe_step_back
2488f2914d82790b.doc: Plays the damage knockback and recovers. With an 8 percent chance it steps back afterwards.

24b7d16c5e043aa0.name: play_mammo_death
24b7d16c5e043aa0.doc: Death program: plays the death motion and finishes the death, then after 30 frames resets the player camera and runs event script 500.

24c7797f7896287e.name: play_griffon_combo
24c7797f7896287e.doc: Plays attack 4 and spawns the Griffon combo effect, shaking the camera partway through.

2501bece68aa0bb8.name: turn_by_angle
2501bece68aa0bb8.doc: Turns to a heading of delta_deg degrees added to the current yaw, at turn_speed_deg, and waits for it. The wrap for results beyond 180 degrees is approximate. Returns the frames the turn took.

25035b2e18dc8d23.name: dodge_shot_with_side_step
25035b2e18dc8d23.doc: Faces the target, side steps invulnerable and turns back to the target.

250df6274e9a2f78.name: attack_double_slash
250df6274e9a2f78.doc: Plays the double attack motion while turning toward the target for 18 frames.

251d8bca2de88645.name: write_monster_var_15
251d8bca2de88645.doc: Stores a value in monster variable 15.

252c2c455cc87f17.name: wait_for_move_end
252c2c455cc87f17.doc: Waits until the current move ends or the frame limit is reached.

253f0de77896ccdd.name: dive_at_target_and_retreat
253f0de77896ccdd.doc: Winds up with attack 1 in, flies at the target's position 10 units above the ground in the attack loop for up to 60 frames, then snaps to face the target and backs 150 units straight away from it, rising to 50 above the ground, with attack 1 out.

257efbf1f6c7a644.name: setup_melee_attacks
257efbf1f6c7a644.doc: Registers three attack hits (a combo hit on attack 1 and two normal hits on attack 2) and a sword trail for each attack, initializes the AI and sets the aggro duration to 150.

2581a77d3f451f27.name: chase_target_checking_clearance
2581a77d3f451f27.doc: Chases the target. Returns -1 if within stop_dist and -2 if the path to the target is blocked.

25a22c919cec147e.name: on_knockdown
25a22c919cec147e.doc: When knocked down after the intro, either gets knocked flying and gets up, or answers with a tornado attack.

25ad09144324e47e.name: compute_situation_flags
25ad09144324e47e.doc: Stores a bit field of the situation in monster var 0: target distance bands, whether the target or itself is far from the arena centre, and whether it is facing the target.

25b7b32edb3b8583.name: wait_turn_watch_target
25b7b32edb3b8583.doc: Turns toward the angle and stops early with -1 if the target comes into view. Otherwise returns the frames waited.

25be57ec53065c06.name: rush_at_target
25be57ec53065c06.doc: Drops the guard if it is up, then chases the target at 7 units per frame with the attack 1 motion for up to 90 frames.

25f9716339fdfe96.name: on_update
25f9716339fdfe96.doc: Allows guard and dodge, then each frame uses the normal AI when the target is within 300 units, the wander behaviour when farther, or the no-rage AI once rage hits are used up.

2601af63361cec9e.name: watch_disguised_player
2601af63361cec9e.doc: If the player is currently disguised as a monster, runs the wait loop until the disguise ends.

26224da86ac6e9ae.name: swing_and_send_shockwave
26224da86ac6e9ae.doc: Turns to the target, swings attack 1, and 32 frames in (PAL-scaled) spawns the Vanguard shockwave effect 60 units below the chn76 bone carrying the monster's attack value. The monster cannot dodge during the move.

2634c83d6a4f39e0.name: recover_after_throw
2634c83d6a4f39e0.doc: Recovers from being thrown, waits 10 frames and resets the motion.

26399a9d939cbd75.name: track_target_frames
26399a9d939cbd75.doc: Turns toward the target every frame for the given number of frames, then stops turning. The speed goes to the turn unconverted, so it is in radians per frame; the values callers give, such as 5, make the monster face the target almost at once.

26400d3228795075.name: hover_in_direction
26400d3228795075.doc: Meant to turn to angle_deg and fly distance (at least speed plus 1) along it at height_offset above the ground, stopping early when the target comes within clearance. The turn, position and move calls are old-numbered and reach unrelated natives, so the monster neither turns nor flies. Returns an unset value.

264ee5153bed6fdf.name: attack_at_far_range
264ee5153bed6fdf.doc: Beyond 150 units it spits a long venom shot, waits for the target to come into view or performs an attack.

268b90d77e079a1f.name: block_shot_with_guard
268b90d77e079a1f.doc: Stops all actions and plays guard in, a small guard knockback and guard out, then allows guard and dodge again.

26c368f44ee2ce0a.name: wait_for_target_in_view
26c368f44ee2ce0a.doc: Waits up to max_frames for the target to enter the view cone. Returns 1 if it did, 0 otherwise.

26f7dfa0a3727d3e.name: track_target_until_motion_end
26f7dfa0a3727d3e.doc: Keeps turning toward the target until the current motion ends.

270b225d4b16c8a9.name: turn_random_side
270b225d4b16c8a9.doc: Turns left or right of the current facing by 30 + turn_speed_deg + a random 0 to angle_range degrees and waits for the turn. Returns the frames waited; tries is unused because it returns on the first pass.

2713cf03289b1362.name: chase_target_steps
2713cf03289b1362.doc: Turns to face the target, then each frame turns toward it and walks to the point move_speed plus stop_dist ahead of the monster on the line to the target, for up to max_frames. Returns -1 as soon as the target is within stop_dist, otherwise the frames used.

2715a42babc87fc8.name: charge_and_shockwave
2715a42babc87fc8.doc: Turns to the target and swings attack 1, tracking it for 15 frames, then heads for a point 100 units toward it at 3.6 units per frame; 14 frames later (about 50 units) it releases a Vanguard shockwave below the chn76 bone and stops, then stands. The monster cannot dodge while it runs. Used as the monster's close attack.

2730a1b8ad1abf40.name: get_situation_flags
2730a1b8ad1abf40.doc: Returns a bit mask: 1 target within 2400 units, 2 farther, 4 target ahead, 8 target behind, 16 target in front and within 40 units, 32 low attack priority or no rage hits left.

273db8e4509add97.name: turn_to_target_random
273db8e4509add97.doc: Turns toward the target, offset left or right by offset_deg with offset_chance percent probability. Returns the frames spent.

274e73b1acd5d749.name: halt_after_death
274e73b1acd5d749.doc: Calls _EXT_154, finish_death under this script's old numbering (a number the current table never registers), then waits forever. play_death_and_halt reaches it only after its own endless loop, so it never runs.

278bcda92cca5748.name: wait_frames_updating
278bcda92cca5748.doc: Waits the given number of frames, updating aggro and the frame counter each frame.

27a417f995221fc1.name: approach_target_and_pick_action
27a417f995221fc1.doc: Walks toward the target while turning. It returns 0 when the target is over 360 units away, 1 when the target is behind it, 2 when it is within 60 units in front, 3 on a rare random roll, and 4 when it has low priority and the target is within 120 units.

27ca96ee151e0235.name: play_death_and_start_event
27ca96ee151e0235.doc: Starts death, turns off both light effects, plays the death motion and runs event script 500, then idles forever.

27cdc4c6fce354e1.name: setup_flying_attribs
27cdc4c6fce354e1.doc: Sets maximum height 999.9, wall margin 39, clip distance 600 and the flying attribute.

27d5ace00b740a3d.name: turn_to_target_and_wait
27d5ace00b740a3d.doc: Meant to turn toward the target at speed_deg and wait until facing it, but in this toolkit's old numbering start_turn_to_target starts no turn, the target angle read gets the monster's x position instead, and wait_turn_to_angle never reads the heading, so the monster does not turn: the wait ends at once or runs the full 360 frames, depending on those leftover values. Returns the frames waited.

27f85ae3fce05108.name: fly_random_forward
27f85ae3fce05108.doc: Turns to a random world heading of 0 to max_turn_angle degrees, then flies straight ahead min_distance plus up to max_extra_distance units, hover_height above the ground. Returns the result of the flight.

27f8722e53211ece.name: moonsault_over_target
27f8722e53211ece.doc: When the target is within 40 units, does a moonsault to the far side of the target, invulnerable while airborne. If the target is then within 80 units and ahead, follows up with the double or mid-range attack.

27fcdc79ca01a48a.name: wander_when_target_far
27fcdc79ca01a48a.doc: Idle behaviour while the target is not close: turns away from walls, wanders around its home point, circles the target, waits to notice the target, or walks off in a random direction. Returns 1 when the target is detected.

28103a6140f1c995.name: read_monster_var_15
28103a6140f1c995.doc: Reads monster variable 15 into the first element of the passed array.

284efa1d7e9fa8de.name: move_to_point_around_target
284efa1d7e9fa8de.doc: Walks to a point at a given angle around the target, unless the path is blocked (returns -1).

2860bfab86528c96.name: fight_while_calm
2860bfab86528c96.doc: Calm combat loop. Chooses the far, mid or close behaviour by distance and strafes when it is not among the nearest monsters. Returns when the player is further than 250 or the monster becomes enraged.

2874efc07a16b3e3.name: fight_while_calm
2874efc07a16b3e3.doc: Calm fight loop, used while rage hits remain: picks idling or a venom spit, the mid-range attack or a melee combo by target distance. Returns when the target is beyond 250 or the monster becomes enraged.

2882b12dba5dcf45.name: fly_in_direction
2882b12dba5dcf45.doc: Turns toward an absolute angle and flies the given distance that way.

288386abd068d0c3.name: wait_until_target_near
288386abd068d0c3.doc: Waits up to the given number of frames or until the target is within 320.

28928683483e58cd.name: close_in_from_far
28928683483e58cd.doc: Long-range choice (200 to 310 units): usually walks or runs toward the target, sometimes stands watching.

2894a4f11461eb72.name: finish_death_and_halt
2894a4f11461eb72.doc: Runs finish_death, then waits forever so the dead monster's script never runs another step.

2895f387071800c9.name: chase_target
2895f387071800c9.doc: Chases the target frame by frame while turning toward it; returns -1 if it gets within stop distance.

2896a222bcd020ca.name: close_in_or_sidestep
2896a222bcd020ca.doc: Close-range behaviour: 65 percent flies in and swoops; otherwise it sometimes (15 percent) flies around the target, else sidesteps left or right (67 percent) or flies backward.

289c5195814a7956.name: turn_to_target_wait
289c5195814a7956.doc: Starts turning toward the target and waits until the monster faces it, using wait_turn_to_angle with a limit of 360 frames, then stops turning. Returns the frames spent turning.

28b0c409312b7d94.name: set_aux_value_8
28b0c409312b7d94.doc: Stores a float in monster var 8, which nothing else reads.

28ca09fd76e16a1e.name: run_normal_ai
28ca09fd76e16a1e.doc: AI loop while rage hits remain. Leaves when the target is more than 300 flat units away, otherwise picks a long, mid or close range action by distance.

290c92674966de5a.name: watch_target_while_disguised
290c92674966de5a.doc: Stands and turns to keep facing the target (within 60 degrees) for as long as the player is disguised as a monster.

292340be36e569b0.name: fight_while_rage_hits_remain
292340be36e569b0.doc: Fight loop while rage hits remain: picks the long, medium or close range behavior by distance. Returns when the target is past 295 or no rage hits remain.

29235c92eec6a1e3.name: wait_turn_to_angle
29235c92eec6a1e3.doc: Waits while the monster turns toward the given angle, stopping when it is within tolerance or after max_frames. Returns the frames waited.

292589f441b1d470.name: run_ai_loop
292589f441b1d470.doc: Allows guard and dodge, then runs the behaviour step every frame.

2948540cdd498df8.name: fly_toward_angle
2948540cdd498df8.doc: Flies the given distance in the direction of the given angle in degrees, without turning first. Returns the result of the flight.

295469bd04f49494.name: wait_move_end_update
295469bd04f49494.doc: Waits up to max_frames for the current move to end.

295c3a5f77892386.name: wait_until_facing_angle
295c3a5f77892386.doc: Meant to wait frame by frame until the monster's yaw is within tolerance of the given angle. Written in the b02a raw numbering, where check_pause_flags stands for get_rot, so on this disc the yaw is never read and the loop compares the angle against an unset value.

29680c9ebbc6f817.name: fight_mid_range
29680c9ebbc6f817.doc: Mid range choices: charge combo, walk after the target, or play antics.

2977894a265e104c.name: setup_flying_movement
2977894a265e104c.doc: Sets the monster height ceiling to 999.9, wall margin to 42 and clip distance to 600, and switches on scripted flying movement.

2978e845b2010399.name: reposition_around_target
2978e845b2010399.doc: Half the time circles the target at about 90 units, otherwise stands and waits for the target to come into view. Used when another monster has attack priority.

29809527db972e1e.name: fight_at_close_range
29809527db972e1e.doc: Close range choice: may charge, shoots a bolt when very near, otherwise shoots, flanks and shoots, steps back or flies away at an angle.

2988cc82d9939161.name: walk_around_target
2988cc82d9939161.doc: Walks to a point on a circle around the target at the given angle, shortened if a wall is ahead. Returns -1 if there is no room.

29917fca17a6dd38.name: dodge_backward_invincible
29917fca17a6dd38.doc: Plays the backstep motion; after 10 frames turns invulnerable and moves toward a point 100 units behind at 4.2 units per frame for only 8 frames (about 34 units), then becomes damageable, stops and waits for the motion to end.

29b5e9c6326d1b22.name: step_sideways_in_view
29b5e9c6326d1b22.doc: Plays a step motion to a random side, waits up to 5 frames, then becomes immune and moves toward a point 100 units that way at 3.84 per frame for up to 3 more frames (so only about 12 units). Either wait ends early once the target is within 46 units and 45 degrees of its facing. Then waits for the motion to end and stands.

29bf2c71f44008fb.name: leap_along_arc
29bf2c71f44008fb.doc: Moves the monster from the start point to the end point over the given number of frames along a parabolic arc with the given gravity, never below the end height.

29c603b98e529d67.name: face_target_for_frames
29c603b98e529d67.doc: Keeps turning toward the target for a fixed number of frames, updating aggro, then stops turning. speed goes to the turn unconverted, so it is in radians per frame. Returns nothing despite its int type.

29d244aa09156dd8.name: dodge_backward
29d244aa09156dd8.doc: Steps 100 units backward, taking no damage during the step.

29d720d27b43f8cc.name: get_up_after_landing
29d720d27b43f8cc.doc: Recovers from a throw, plays the get-up motion and ends the throw state.

29de870a028d18f0.name: run_up_and_double_slash
29de870a028d18f0.doc: Turns, runs at the player, swings (attack 1), lunges 100 units forward and finishes with attack 2.

29e2cde43d30499d.name: walk_in_direction_for_distance
29e2cde43d30499d.doc: Turns to the given direction, then walks the distance, stopping early near the target or after max_frames.

29fea42159bf37e8.name: turn_to_face_target
29fea42159bf37e8.doc: Walks in place turning toward the target until it is facing it.

2a0b6af79a4c5525.name: run_ai_loop
2a0b6af79a4c5525.doc: Main loop: runs one AI step every frame.

2a1c548fc472bcad.name: cast_tornado_with_camera
2a1c548fc472bcad.doc: Pauses the player, pulls the camera in front of the boss, casts the tornado, then gives camera and control back.

2a200bb87c9b124a.name: strafe_to_arena_side_of_target
2a200bb87c9b124a.doc: Walks with battle walk motions to a point 140 units from the target toward the arena center. Returns 1 if the target is beyond 160 units, 0 once it has stood in place for 90 frames or its direction to the center is within 22.5 degrees of the target's.

2a2061cb085466b4.name: tick_aggro_timer
2a2061cb085466b4.doc: Advances the aggro timer by one. Returns 1 and resets the timer when it reaches the aggro duration, otherwise 0; always 0 when the duration is zero or less.

2a35d3a4b5614b03.name: start_stun_collapse_timer
2a35d3a4b5614b03.doc: If no collapse timer is running, sets monster var 6 to 120 frames. Also clears the jump and immunity attributes and the queued actions.

2a39605d572d3e63.name: stand_firm_on_melee_dodge
2a39605d572d3e63.doc: Stops moving and turning and clears invulnerability.

2a3f79a8c8d7a14b.name: wait_for_landing_after_throw
2a3f79a8c8d7a14b.doc: Waits until the monster is within 0.1 units of the ground after being thrown, then waits 3 frames, ends the throw, stops it and waits 30 more frames. Returns 1.

2a457e4e89ccd9c1.name: turn_to_angle_and_wait
2a457e4e89ccd9c1.doc: Turns toward the absolute angle in degrees and waits until it is reached. Returns the frames waited.

2a49e400b6eb82ca.name: on_land
2a49e400b6eb82ca.doc: After being thrown the monster dies at once, with no death smoke.

2a9cca918af8dbcc.name: strafe_or_turn_to_target
2a9cca918af8dbcc.doc: Half the time circles the target a short way, otherwise just turns to face it, then pauses 30 frames.

2a9e730d29362364.name: on_damage
2a9e730d29362364.doc: Stops and plays the damage motion, waits 12 frames and stands.

2acc6c2f442c549b.name: on_init
2acc6c2f442c549b.doc: Registers the Torentos attack hits, loads the smoke and small explosion effects into a free texture block, clears monster variables and sets very large clip and aggro ranges.

2acc84941ad25c01.name: handle_butterfly_defeat
2acc84941ad25c01.doc: If this butterfly was the next in order, it flies away and the counter advances; the seventh runs event script 501. Otherwise the round is reset (variable 8 set to 9) and events 504 or 505 may play.

2acd9ed1c3c9a31d.name: fly_around_point
2acd9ed1c3c9a31d.doc: Turns toward and flies to a point on a circle around the given centre.

2adb4bad14729ed5.name: idle_and_step_back_repeatedly
2adb4bad14729ed5.doc: Plays the idle play motion repeat_count times; when the target comes into view it steps back half the time.

2b31b6ecc600769f.name: run_ai_step
2b31b6ecc600769f.doc: One AI decision: idles or fights depending on aggro and distance; once the rage hits are used up it fights enraged.

2b3bf14e42099d97.name: move_beside_target
2b3bf14e42099d97.doc: Walks to the point at the target's current distance but angle_deg around it. If less than 100 units are clear ahead, the destination is cut to the clear distance, and it returns -1 without moving when that is too short to stop. Otherwise returns 1 if the target comes within stop_dist, 2 if the walk ends, 0 on timeout.

2b3f6efa1cd74127.name: chase_target
2b3f6efa1cd74127.doc: Each frame re-aims the move at the target and turns toward it, for up to max_frames. Returns -1 once closer than stop_dist, otherwise the frames spent.

2b5e9a9dc2344842.name: get_hit_counter
2b5e9a9dc2344842.doc: Returns the rapid-hit counter in monster var 18.

2b5f2d3e0b742f70.name: slash_quick_combo
2b5f2d3e0b742f70.doc: Plays attack 1, then after 15 frames (18 at 30 fps scaled to PAL) switches to attack 2 and waits for it to end.

2b8b879326492026.name: choose_idle_or_spit_venom
2b8b879326492026.doc: Random idle action: half the time turns to the target and spits venom; otherwise, with equal odds, stands and waits up to 30 frames for the target to come within 100 units and 45 degrees of its facing, or turns to the target and plays its idle play motion.

2ba1bf490cd3abc8.name: start_turn_to_target
2ba1bf490cd3abc8.doc: Meant to start turning toward the target at turn_speed radians per frame, but in this old numbering the turn call lands on no native, so the monster does not turn.

2ba201c44fe63bcb.name: strafe_or_idle_when_crowded
2ba201c44fe63bcb.doc: Used when another monster has priority: strafes around the target, stands watching, or plays and then spits mist if the target is in view.

2ba4c1212b8874fc.name: fly_backward
2ba4c1212b8874fc.doc: Flies backward, away from the current facing.

2baca9a7f7996bc8.name: wait_turn_to_angle
2baca9a7f7996bc8.doc: Waits until the monster's heading is within the turn speed of angle_deg, or until max_frames pass, then stops turning. Returns the frames waited.

2bad36eb6d25677b.name: step_back_invulnerable
2bad36eb6d25677b.doc: Monster steps 100 units backward from its facing direction while immune to damage, then returns to standing.

2badc61cdf2f4eda.name: cast_tornado
2badc61cdf2f4eda.doc: Plays the attack 2 motion and spawns San's tornado at the boss position.

2bae1e44c3e95183.name: wait_for_turn
2bae1e44c3e95183.doc: Waits for the monster to finish turning to the angle (degrees), at most max_frames or the computed turn time, and returns the frames waited.

2baf19decdc99d6a.name: circle_or_wait_near_target
2baf19decdc99d6a.doc: Used when the monster is not the nearest attacker: circles the target at about 80 units or stands waiting.

2bec620e71ad3df0.name: moonsault_over_target
2bec620e71ad3df0.doc: When the target is within 40, does an invulnerable moonsault to the far side of it, then sometimes casts magic and follows with a slash or lunge if the target is close and in front.

2bed299e1054017c.name: step_back
2bed299e1054017c.doc: Steps 100 units backward from the current facing, invulnerable from 28 to 80 percent of the step back motion, then stands.

2bfc72a9e0dc7325.name: is_facing_target_within_degrees
2bfc72a9e0dc7325.doc: Returns 1 if the monster's yaw is within the given number of degrees of the direction to the target, else 0.

2c1950a1bd244430.name: run_behaviour_loop
2c1950a1bd244430.doc: Allows guarding and dodging, then runs the behaviour chooser every frame forever.

2c409094f844a4a6.name: move_in_direction
2c409094f844a4a6.doc: Turns to angle_deg, then walks distance units (at least move_speed + 1) in that direction at move_speed, waiting until the target comes within near_dist or max_frames pass. A heading below turn_speed degrees, including every negative one, is first increased by turn_speed. Returns the wait result and stops moving.

2c468cb9ec708b75.name: turn_to_target_random
2c468cb9ec708b75.doc: Turns toward the target, but with offset_chance percent probability aims offset_deg to one side or the other (50/50). Waits up to 360 frames for the turn and returns the frames used.

2c508c953feee5d2.name: wait_target_in_view
2c508c953feee5d2.doc: Waits up to max_frames for the target to enter the view cone. Returns 1 if it did, 0 on timeout.

2c662ae9f0a39eb1.name: fly_in_direction
2c662ae9f0a39eb1.doc: Turns to a heading and flies the given distance along it.

2c77c66b50231b36.name: tick_until_motion_end_or_target_in_view
2c77c66b50231b36.doc: Runs frames until the motion ends (returns 0) or the target comes into view (returns 1).

2cb48e752af5d110.name: on_init
2cb48e752af5d110.doc: Registers the attack hit windows, sets the play photo window for grade 0 and initialises the shared AI.

2ccaa8a1bb0be08c.name: init_flying_monster
2ccaa8a1bb0be08c.doc: Sets up a flying monster: no height limit (999.9), a 30 unit wall margin, clip distance 600 (12000 world units) and scripted movement on.

2cd4cd85554bf72b.name: fly_to_point_steadily
2cd4cd85554bf72b.doc: Flies toward the point at 5 units per frame, turning at most 0.05 rad and changing height at most 1 unit per frame. Clears the exclamation mark after exclaim_frames frames and on finishing, and returns 1, 0, 3 or 6 in the same way as the turning flight.

2cf2ba7007f93718.name: wait_motion_end_tracked
2cf2ba7007f93718.doc: Waits with fight tracking until the current motion finishes.

2d1207d758bf3598.name: track_target_frames
2d1207d758bf3598.doc: Turns toward the target for frames frames, then stops turning. turn_speed goes to the turn as given, so it is in radians per frame.

2d124dcb7e83cef8.name: wait_frame_and_check_phase
2d124dcb7e83cef8.doc: Checks the half-life phase change, then waits one frame. Every wait in this script goes through it.

2d1b3c39e108f153.name: play_guard_motion
2d1b3c39e108f153.doc: Locks interrupts, plays the guard-in motion and a small guard knockback, then returns to standing and unlocks.

2d22317c3702bca4.name: walk_in_direction
2d22317c3702bca4.doc: Despite the parameter names, the first argument is the turn speed in degrees and the second the walk speed. Turns to the world heading angle_deg, then walks dist units along it (at least the walk speed + 1). A heading below the turn speed, including every negative heading, is first increased by the turn speed. Returns 1 if the target comes within stop_dist, 2 when the walk ends, 0 after max_frames.

2d47efa6cf414e0e.name: record_last_hit_and_damage
2d47efa6cf414e0e.doc: Stores the last hit type in variable 5 and the damage taken (previous_life minus life) in variable 6.

2d4e675527e6300b.name: turn_to_target_random
2d4e675527e6300b.doc: Turns toward the target at the given speed and waits until facing. With offset_chance percent probability it aims offset_deg to a random side instead. Returns the frames waited.

2d99e85c5a2c1067.name: choose_actions_forever
2d99e85c5a2c1067.doc: Main loop: picks and runs an action every frame.

2de4667e627d08d1.name: hop_to_point
2de4667e627d08d1.doc: Moves the monster from a start point to an end point over a number of frames along a parabolic arc set by the gravity value, never going below the end height.

2deaa06d5faacb5f.name: struggle_while_lifted
2deaa06d5faacb5f.doc: Plays the struggle motion forever while lifted.

2df4da6c5f70d9d6.name: check_phase_change
2df4da6c5f70d9d6.doc: Below 70% life (phase 0) runs event 510, sets phase 1 and spawns five monster 513 offscreen. Below 40% (phase 1) it runs event 510 again and sets phase 2. After a change the boss is not lockable until the player comes within 400 units.

2e09f7a3ec85f0df.name: setup_venom_attacks
2e09f7a3ec85f0df.doc: Assigns the collision objects, registers the attack 1 and dodge attack hits and loads the venom effects.

2e2be22447fba24c.name: fly_to_point_at_hover_height
2e2be22447fba24c.doc: Flies in a straight line at a fixed step toward x, z at hover_height above the ground under the monster at the start; the y argument is ignored. Vertical movement stops once a step would leave 0 to 45 units above the ground. Returns 1 within speed + near_dist of the point, the check_flight_step result if a step is blocked, or 0 after max_frames.

2e317a0a2b0fdec4.name: walk_to_point_around_target
2e317a0a2b0fdec4.doc: Turns toward a point at the given angle and radius around the target and walks there, shortening the walk if blocked. Returns -1 if too tight.

2e373ea46e6ae03f.name: chase_target_flying
2e373ea46e6ae03f.doc: Follows the target's current position each frame at a fixed height above ground, facing it (with pitch if tilt_to_target is set). Returns 1 on reaching it, a negative value if blocked, or 0 on timeout.

2e4d55865c40fbdd.name: approach_distant_target
2e4d55865c40fbdd.doc: Loops until the target is within 220 units, flying around it with step motions, turning toward it or waiting.

2e6ee1f09a1cb580.name: choose_behavior_by_aggro
2e6ee1f09a1cb580.doc: Top level choice: heals allies, then fights, wanders or runs at the target depending on enrage, aggro state and distance, raising the guard rate while approaching.

2e76a5a5aaacb891.name: wait_move_end
2e76a5a5aaacb891.doc: Waits until the monster reaches its move_to destination. Written in the b02a raw numbering, where get_player_status stands for check_move_end.

2e812f694b531f84.name: watch_player_if_disguised
2e812f694b531f84.doc: Starts watch_disguised_player only if the player is disguised in the form this monster's kind recognises as its own (get_player_disguise is not -1); otherwise returns at once.

2eb7ccd319c82d46.name: on_init
2eb7ccd319c82d46.doc: Registers the attack hits, loads the spit effect, resets the monster variables and the floor timer, and spawns monster 1001 if it is the only monster.

2eb88c3b9f5005bb.name: circle_or_watch_target
2eb88c3b9f5005bb.doc: Used when other monsters are nearer the target: circles the target at about 100 units or stands watching it.

2ec1cdb56835edd1.name: slide_toward_target
2ec1cdb56835edd1.doc: Moves the boss straight toward the target by setting its position each frame, turning toward it, with guard and dodge locked. Stops when closer than stop_dist or after max_frames; returns 1.

2ee6a368cac45d15.name: fight_at_close_range
2ee6a368cac45d15.doc: Close range (under 120): mostly runs at the target and plays attack 2, otherwise steps back or sidesteps.

2efc2296b771d6d6.name: fly_step_around_target
2efc2296b771d6d6.doc: Turns to the target, then in a step motion flies from its own position for the target distance plus extra_distance, heading angle_deg away from straight back from the target (150 means 30 degrees off the target, past it). The flight is split into two halves of frames/2 at hover heights 5 and 25.

2f0853b402b7dd55.name: end_knockdown_and_resume_flight
2f0853b402b7dd55.doc: Turns scripted flight back on, lifts off the ground, re-enables guard and dodge and clears the busy flag.

2f20305d34ee5483.name: fight_by_distance
2f20305d34ee5483.doc: Loop that picks close, mid or long-range behaviour from the distance to the target, circles if its priority is low, and returns when the target is over 330 units away.

2f27e74d8589bc81.name: hover_idle_while_player_disguised
2f27e74d8589bc81.doc: Flies to 5 units above the ground under it (the 25 passed as y is ignored), then idles in place while the player is disguised as a monster, turning to face the target when it is more than 90 degrees off; returns when the player is no longer disguised. The argument is not used.

2f340a4e13ce190d.name: teleport_to_random_arena_spot
2f340a4e13ce190d.doc: Marks the boss as warping and invulnerable, plays the San warp effect and teleport motion, fades out, moves to one of six arena positions, snaps to face the target and fades back in.

2f388f8c0e9cf6cc.name: idle_while_user_monster
2f388f8c0e9cf6cc.doc: When the player is disguised as this monster's own kind, idles until the disguise ends. Does nothing otherwise.

2f4274c4b3fdb6df.name: run_to_far_edge_and_rest
2f4274c4b3fdb6df.doc: When the player has moved since the last frame, walks to the point 250 units from the arena centre on the side away from the player (on the player's side when the player is 600 or more units away) and turns to face them. Then 30 percent of the time it slams the ground if the player is in the near range band, or else stands tired for 90 frames; otherwise it stands tired for 120 frames.

2f44e36893b361a6.name: fight_while_enraged
2f44e36893b361a6.doc: Combat loop once the monster is enraged. Swings when the player is under 40 units, charges when under 80, charges or walks up otherwise, and circles when it is not one of the nearest monsters. Returns when it calms down.

2f5bcdb6661d9cb1.name: walk_to_point_around_position
2f5bcdb6661d9cb1.doc: Walks to a point on a circle around a fixed position (such as home), facing it first. Returns the move result.

2f601f5b2bcf539f.name: approach_at_far_range
2f601f5b2bcf539f.doc: Mostly spins to face the target and walks toward it until within 130 units; sometimes circles 30 degrees around it instead and waits up to 30 frames for it to come into view.

2f7d129593c99f64.name: idle_forever_tracking_damage
2f7d129593c99f64.doc: Loops forever, waiting a frame at a time.

2fa50fc88af4d3d3.name: turn_to_target_until_motion_progress
2fa50fc88af4d3d3.doc: Keeps turning toward the target until the current motion reaches the given progress (default tolerance 0.05).

2fbf5c7958e140b9.name: fight_at_mid_range
2fbf5c7958e140b9.doc: Mid range (120 to 300): shoots sticky goo or runs at the target.

2fe7926b716be243.name: fly_backward
2fe7926b716be243.doc: Flies backward from its heading. The distance variable is never set.

2ff1bb6492e786ec.name: fight_far_range
2ff1bb6492e786ec.doc: Far-range choice: 80 percent shoots a fireball; otherwise circles the target and lunges if it reached it (the chase branch is unreachable, since its roll test is below 70 after failing below 80).

2ffa3b70064e6ac1.name: record_spawn_position
2ffa3b70064e6ac1.doc: Init program of e08a and e09a. Meant to store the monster's starting position in spawn_x, spawn_y and spawn_z through store_position_in_globals, but that routine's old-numbered get_pos runs loop_se_on_monster instead, so no position is read and only spawn_y is zeroed.

2ffc2e8d05c195ba.name: fight_by_range_until_target_leaves
2ffc2e8d05c195ba.doc: Fight loop that picks the short, mid or long range action from the distance to the target. It returns when the target is over 300 units away or no rage hits are left.

2ffd6969174fb616.name: run_monster_ai_loop
2ffd6969174fb616.doc: Disables guarding and enables dodging, then each frame fights by distance when the target is within 400 units, wanders otherwise, or runs the no-rage loop when no rage hits remain.

300fd2660b894fa1.name: strafe_or_wait
300fd2660b894fa1.doc: Half the time circles the target at a random angle and radius and faces it; otherwise stands and waits for the target to come into view.

3022e314c2bc30b4.name: run_ai_loop
3022e314c2bc30b4.doc: Forbids guard and dodge, then runs the behaviour step every frame.

302c10a533c9492a.name: pick_idle_movement
302c10a533c9492a.doc: Picks a random idle behavior: turning away from a wall closer than 60, circling its home point when more than 300 from it, circling the target, walking straight ahead, or waiting to detect the target. Returns 1 if it detected the target.

3039a2a827ca2190.name: take_off_with_jets
3039a2a827ca2190.doc: Starts the jet exhaust, plays the takeoff motion and rises to 60 units (80 if the target stands on raised ground) while invulnerable. Returns -2 without taking off if the boss is within 100 units of a fixed spot.

3046556669ca42f0.name: calc_turn_frames
3046556669ca42f0.doc: Estimates how many frames a turn from the current yaw to angle takes at turn_speed per frame. The wrap handling is faulty: a difference from minus pi to pi gets a full turn added and one above pi is left unwrapped, so only a difference below minus pi gives the short turn.

304c577666dd0754.name: chase_target_clear_updating
304c577666dd0754.doc: Chases the target while checking that the path ahead is clear.

304ea9dc54a18915.name: face_monster_until_motion_progress
304ea9dc54a18915.doc: Keeps turning toward another monster until the motion reaches the progress value.

30620f61bb57cba7.name: fight_at_mid_range
30620f61bb57cba7.doc: Mid range choice (target 150 to 230 away): usually walks toward the target, sometimes taunts.

30c282ed92a580fa.name: turn_and_move_around_target
30c282ed92a580fa.doc: Turns toward the point angle degrees and distance units around the target and moves there. When a wall is within speed + near_dist ahead it moves only that far, returning -1 without moving if that is under twice near_dist. Otherwise returns the result of waiting for the move.

30c5fcfb2aa5f653.name: chase_until_in_range
30c5fcfb2aa5f653.doc: Chases the target by walking or waits in view until it is within 280 units.

30ce354d33eb3eff.name: record_last_hit
30ce354d33eb3eff.doc: Stores the type of the last hit (variable 6) and the life lost (variable 7).

30d72b1016473992.name: flee_upward_after_defeat
30d72b1016473992.doc: Plays the damage reaction, then rises over 120 frames to height 1050.

30dc30b1fabf992d.name: fly_wander_random
30dc30b1fabf992d.doc: Turns a random angle, then flies a random distance forward. Returns the result of the flight.

30e522116512bb5f.name: play_stun_and_wait
30e522116512bb5f.doc: Disables guarding and dodging, plays the damage motion and then the faint motion until the stun ends.

31099225e65e1fdb.name: chase_target_while_turning
31099225e65e1fdb.doc: Each frame turns toward and moves to the target, returning -1 once within stop_dist.

3130527fa045759b.name: move_at_angle_by_distance
3130527fa045759b.doc: Moves distance units in the direction of angle (degrees) and waits for the move.

314d6f8dabe57c3e.name: turn_to_target_limit
314d6f8dabe57c3e.doc: Turns to face the target, waiting at most max_frames.

315e668bffb5937a.name: wait_move_end_update
315e668bffb5937a.doc: Waits for the current move to end or the frame limit, keeping the aggro bookkeeping running.

316a5404199fb2a1.name: move_random_offset
316a5404199fb2a1.doc: Moves to a point at a random angle and distance from the current position.

31b8b2694789cb0a.name: act_at_close_range
31b8b2694789cb0a.doc: Calm close-range choice: swing or curse, run up, strafe or step back.

31b9b5fda1655551.name: pick_orbit_angle
31b9b5fda1655551.doc: Returns the yaw toward the target turned 90 degrees: +90 when group B of the ship parts has more survivors than group A, otherwise -90. turn_to_orbit_angle uses the opposite rule, so the two can disagree.

31bc18c8bf6d11a5.name: close_in_on_distant_target
31bc18c8bf6d11a5.doc: Stands guarding or walks toward a target further than 240 units until it comes within 240 units.

31bd57ee6d024240.name: track_damage_taken
31bd57ee6d024240.doc: Compares current life with the stored life in variable 9. If life dropped it records the hit and increases the damage counter in variable 8.

31cd41fd4f505be6.name: pick_mid_range_attack
31cd41fd4f505be6.doc: Chooses one action for a target 85 to 140 units away: usually a red wave swing or attack 2, otherwise walks up to the target or plays idle taunts.

31ce2324b5927bd6.name: pick_random_side_angle
31ce2324b5927bd6.doc: Returns plus or minus 90 degrees in radians, chosen at random.

31d2fb7ea961e559.name: chase_target_on_foot
31d2fb7ea961e559.doc: Walks after the player for up to 120 steps.

31d826d7e5f6f8e2.name: begin_locked_action
31d826d7e5f6f8e2.doc: Forbids guard and dodge, stops the current motion, movement and turning, faces the target, and sets the act status to 1.

31e37fa7e3112b31.name: run_no_rage_ai
31e37fa7e3112b31.doc: AI loop when no rage hits remain. Shoots from range, strafes and runs to flank positions, pulls back with a dodge attack when the target is close. Returns 0 when rage hits return or the target is farther than 300 units.

31e3fecb3367e631.name: attack_and_flag_slots
31e3fecb3367e631.doc: Plays an attack sound and motion, then flags one to six random slots (variables 20 to 25) for other scripts.

320b9d3c886e40ea.name: rise_above_leader
320b9d3c886e40ea.doc: Sets state var 27 to 1 and flies over 60 frames to a point 100 above the leader monster, then sets the state to 2.

325310811db88e6f.name: get_pos_around_target
325310811db88e6f.doc: Writes into x, y and z the point dist units from the target at angle_deg degrees around it, measured from the direction pointing from the target back toward this monster (0 is the point between them).

3285733038041465.name: fight_target_enraged
3285733038041465.doc: Aggressive fight loop once the monster is enraged: approaches by walking or running and picks one of several slash attacks. Returns when the target is further than 250 units.

329b8a036b35f091.name: turn_to_target_wait
329b8a036b35f091.doc: Turns to face the target and waits until the turn finishes.

32a3cb4ed4d8775d.name: turn_to_face_target_within_frames
32a3cb4ed4d8775d.doc: Turns toward the target, waiting at most max_frames. Returns the frames waited.

32af26bf6d80321b.name: fight_target_in_range
32af26bf6d80321b.doc: Loops while the target is within 280 units, picking the far, mid or close range behaviour by distance. Returns when the target leaves range or no rage hits are left, and repositions instead when another monster has priority.

32cb847b98c7cbc8.name: fight_with_no_rage_hits_left
32cb847b98c7cbc8.doc: Fight loop used while the rage counter is zero: charges, steps back, strafes or keeps its distance depending on how close the target is. Returns when the target is more than 250 units away.

32ddaefd12f34584.name: move_around_target
32ddaefd12f34584.doc: Walks to the point at the target's current distance but angle_deg around it, cutting the path to the clear distance ahead when under 100 units are clear (returns -1 if too short). Returns 1 if the target comes within near_dist, 2 if the walk ends, 0 on timeout.

32f01b45d3e4f67b.name: play_blown_away
32f01b45d3e4f67b.doc: Blown-away reaction: locks the monster, plays the knocked-flying motion with a 20 frame knockback, lies still for 45 frames with act status 1, then plays the get-up motion and returns to standing. Releases the lock at the end.

32f1bd2d3ae8e4e5.name: walk_toward_target
32f1bd2d3ae8e4e5.doc: Walks toward the target for up to 240 frames, then stands.

32fdd3533705064c.name: turn_until_facing_angle_or_target_seen
32fdd3533705064c.doc: Like turn_until_facing_angle but returns -1 at once if the target comes into view.

3309dc75b0165788.name: turn_to_target_random
3309dc75b0165788.doc: Turns toward the target, with offset_chance percent probability of aiming offset_deg to a random side. Waits until done.

330d17afedac5ee4.name: turn_by_angle_and_wait
330d17afedac5ee4.doc: Turns by an angle relative to the current yaw and waits for the turn to finish. Returns the frames waited.

331c5a7c760a0c5c.name: idle_while_user_monster
331c5a7c760a0c5c.doc: If the player is disguised in a form this monster's kind recognises as its own (get_player_disguise is not -1), runs this monster's idle behaviour for that disguise (idle_while_player_disguised); does nothing otherwise.

3331c626395da35e.name: wait_frames_checking_death
3331c626395da35e.doc: Waits the given number of frames, checking the death flag each frame.

334c28cb33726bb2.name: pick_wander_action
334c28cb33726bb2.doc: Picks and runs one random wander behaviour for a flying monster: turns to a random heading when a wall is close ahead, and when over 300 from home either circles the home point or hovers watching for the target; otherwise it randomly hovers and watches, turns in place, orbits the target or flies straight (a last wander branch tests a local that is never set). Records the choice in monster variable 2 slot 0. Returns 1 when one of the two checked watches spots the target and 0 after the far-from-home choice; on the other paths it returns without setting a value.

33516d64aa155315.name: fly_around_point
33516d64aa155315.doc: Picks the point on a circle of the given radius around a center, shifted by an angle from the line to the monster, turns to it and flies there. Returns the result of fly_straight_to_point.

335a47c962398636.name: wait_move_end_update
335a47c962398636.doc: Waits up to max_frames frames, running the aggro update each frame, until the move_to walk finishes. Returns 0 when the walk ended; on timeout it falls off the end with no defined result.

335ae15a25afdee2.name: face_target_and_wait
335ae15a25afdee2.doc: Turns to face the target and waits until done. Returns the frames spent.

33622fe834e56a50.name: shoot_arrow_volley
33622fe834e56a50.doc: Fires count arrows in a row, replaying the attack 1 motion each time and aiming each at the target.

339bbb62a3e03702.name: faint_and_recover
339bbb62a3e03702.doc: Stun handler: lands, plays the damage motion for 12 frames and the get-up motion, then plays the faint motion until the stun stars run out and lifts off again.

339e43ca428802df.name: start_death
339e43ca428802df.doc: Begins death: stops all movement and turning and scatters the death drops (money, badge, items).

33bd93453df1e10f.name: play_attack_one
33bd93453df1e10f.doc: Turns to the target and plays the attack 1 motion.

33d4a46679a9ede8.name: fly_sideways
33d4a46679a9ede8.doc: Flies 300 units to the left or right of the current facing.

33d5a35c2de3b739.name: walk_to_point_around_target
33d5a35c2de3b739.doc: Turns to and walks to the point at the given angle and distance around the player.

33d79686e4723660.name: drop_items_and_run_death_event
33d79686e4723660.doc: Stops moving, drops the death items without smoke, runs event script 502 and halts.

3402f3a8102857dd.name: fight_after_rage_hits_spent
3402f3a8102857dd.doc: Fight loop used once the rage hits are used up, choosing between the fast shot, summoning and backing away; it strafes or watches while its attack priority is above 4. Its close-range check reads a distance that is never set. It never exits.

3408b7c8643f6405.name: sidestep_invulnerable
3408b7c8643f6405.doc: Invulnerable 100 unit sidestep to the left or right with the matching step motion.

340e1f4a28711a7c.name: circle_target_or_play
340e1f4a28711a7c.doc: Used when the monster is not among the nearest to the target (distance rank above 1, or above 2 in fight_until_target_leaves): half the time plays with the target; otherwise it either circles the target 130 to 160 units out or stands watching for up to 30 frames.

34415ea55047f48b.name: dodge_to_new_slot
34415ea55047f48b.doc: On the first dodge (monster variable 18 at 1) it runs event script 503. It then shows the exclamation mark, picks a new free formation slot, fires a non-sticky ball at the player and flies to the slot, returning the flight result (1, 0, 3 or 6) as the next state.

3463f1a357b3c142.name: setup_monster_attacks
3463f1a357b3c142.doc: Registers the normal and knockback attack hit windows for attacks 1 and 2, the sword trails, the kill counter variable 64 and the shockwave effect, then starts the monster AI.

347c6c1ac6f639fb.name: fly_toward_angle
347c6c1ac6f639fb.doc: Flies the given distance in the direction of the given angle in degrees, without turning first. Returns the result of the flight.

349486e7faf0db05.name: act_at_mid_range
349486e7faf0db05.doc: Calm mid-range choice: turn and cast the curse, run at the player, or sidestep at 45 degrees.

34b3a0e30ff1472a.name: walk_toward_target_until_near
34b3a0e30ff1472a.doc: Walks toward the target for 90 to 150 frames. Returns 0 if the target is within 90 units or out of the arena, 1 if it timed out or the target is far away.

34c1579eee130fef.name: finish_death_and_idle
34c1579eee130fef.doc: Finishes the death sequence and loops forever.

34c53b5734d43f08.name: spit_poison_mist
34c53b5734d43f08.doc: Turns to the player, plays attack 2 and releases a looping poison mist from the dcol01 bone carrying the attack data.

34ca3505eeb1659d.name: chase_target_then_shoot_fireball
34ca3505eeb1659d.doc: Turns to the target and chases it for up to 60 frames, then 70 percent of the time turns again and shoots a fireball. It never lunges.

34ff5439bd7e34f7.name: turn_to_target_limit
34ff5439bd7e34f7.doc: Turns toward the target, waiting at most the given number of frames.

3508eba8ddeadf64.name: tilt_toward_target_side
3508eba8ddeadf64.doc: Picks an X rotation of 15 degrees when the target's world X is more than 1 unit greater than the monster's, -15 when it is more than 1 unit smaller, otherwise 0, and passes it to tilt_toward_angle at 5 degrees per frame. Not called by this script.

3516cf9be25de5bd.name: turn_to_face_target_within_frames
3516cf9be25de5bd.doc: Turns toward the target at the given speed and waits until facing it or the frame limit. Returns the frames waited.

35239ffd9be3c9d9.name: play_taunt
35239ffd9be3c9d9.doc: Turns to the target, plays the play (taunt) motion while watching it, then stands for 6 frames.

3523d11cccd95338.name: hover_facing_target_while_disguised
3523d11cccd95338.doc: While the player is disguised as a monster, flies down to 5 units above the ground (up to 150 frames), then turns to face the target whenever it is more than 90 degrees off, until the disguise ends.

353812a9fb11adcc.name: sidestep_around_target
353812a9fb11adcc.doc: Dodge: turns to the target, then sidesteps 30 degrees left or right around it at the same distance, taking no damage while moving.

3547998ceb6cc15f.name: play_idle_taunt
3547998ceb6cc15f.doc: Sets attack state 32 and plays the play motion until it ends or the target comes into view within 49 units. Meant to return whether the target was seen, but it discards wait_motion_watch_target's result and returns a variable that is never assigned.

356bdd3cee80d911.name: slam_ground_shockwave
356bdd3cee80d911.doc: Plays attack 2 and spawns the Vanguard shockwave in front of it with the monster's attack power. Sets monster var 1 to 2.

35761bce607d7c3a.name: fight_by_distance_until_enraged
35761bce607d7c3a.doc: Loop that picks long, mid or close-range behaviour by target distance. Returns when the target is over 280 units away or the rage counter is zero.

3582dc1b7382016a.name: wait_frame_update
3582dc1b7382016a.doc: Checks the low life event and waits one frame.

35a29937b58cb586.name: wait_until_target_detected
35a29937b58cb586.doc: Runs frames until the target is seen in the view cone or heard moving nearby. Returns 1 if detected, 0 on timeout.

35d9051b889b97c1.name: wait_motion_watch_target
35d9051b889b97c1.doc: Waits for the motion to end. Returns 1 early if the target comes into view, else 0.

35dc92be5a37495e.name: act_at_close_range
35dc92be5a37495e.doc: Close range choice: walks in and swoops, circles the target in flight, or steps and flies sideways.

35fa0b0d1c0f6f14.name: fly_to_random_offset
35fa0b0d1c0f6f14.doc: Turns to a random absolute heading of 0 to angle_range degrees and flies base_dist plus up to dist_range units that way at hover_height above the ground.

36028116ee76f20c.name: summon_three_monsters
36028116ee76f20c.doc: Plays attack 2 and Tore's smoke, then creates three monsters of kind 16 plus its grade 10 units in front of itself if fewer than 18 monsters exist. If it summoned less than 300 floor-timer frames ago it first stands 15 frames or chases and uses attack 1, then casts anyway.

3606ad9050bf3db8.name: fight_by_distance_loop
3606ad9050bf3db8.doc: Loops while the target is within 240 units, choosing the far, mid or close behaviour by distance. Returns when the target leaves range or no rage hits are left.

36201539ecbd722c.name: fight_far_range
36201539ecbd722c.doc: Far range choices: chase the target, shockwave, or walk randomly or play antics.

362228726124806e.name: fire_feather_volleys
362228726124806e.doc: Plays attack 1 and fires four volleys of three feather projectiles at the player, then returns to flight. Sets monster var 30 to 1.

363013bc9b9a8105.name: chase_target_checking_path
363013bc9b9a8105.doc: Chases the target in short steps. Returns -1 when it gets within stop_dist and -2 when the line to the target is blocked.

3647e81cad6d5106.name: setup_slam_and_nose_bullet
3647e81cad6d5106.doc: Registers the weak knockback hit for attack 1 and loads the Vanguard shockwave and nose bullet effects into a free texture block. Sets a photo window for grade 0.

3670e886eb7e9976.name: fly_to_ring_around_point_updating
3670e886eb7e9976.doc: Flies to a point on a circle of the given radius around a center point.

367511417f2ea15b.name: act_on_aggro_state
367511417f2ea15b.doc: Main decision per cycle. With rage hits left it fights in range, wanders otherwise, and runs at the target under aggro. Without rage hits it uses the spent fight loop.

36a2969c89a279c7.name: move_random_offset_updating
36a2969c89a279c7.doc: Moves to a random point near the monster without turning.

36a3b7150388ac4a.name: wait_move_until_near_updating
36a3b7150388ac4a.doc: Waits, updating the boss each frame, for the move started by move_to. Returns 1 when the target comes within stop_dist, 2 when the move ends and 0 after max_frames.

36b86cd0c0235e30.name: fight_at_short_range
36b86cd0c0235e30.doc: Short range choice: turns to the target and uses attack 1, steps back from it, or chases the target for up to 20 frames and then uses attack 1.

36d205acef918fc5.name: pick_idle_movement
36d205acef918fc5.doc: Picks a random idle flight: turning from walls, returning toward home, circling the target, or hovering until it detects the target. Returns 1 if it detected the target.

36e127119b9b6442.name: wait_move_end_update
36e127119b9b6442.doc: Waits up to max_frames for the move order to finish, tracking damage.

3713189a896d7839.name: fight_at_close_range
3713189a896d7839.doc: Close-range choice (under 120 units): claw if under 70 units else fire shot, or run at the target or circle it.

37480439fa16bf43.name: stand_idle_frames
37480439fa16bf43.doc: Stops moving, plays the stand motion and waits for the given number of frames.

375b15a2d0f58352.name: dash_ahead_by_target_distance
375b15a2d0f58352.doc: Turns to the target and dashes forward as far as the target is away, passing through its position.

375b75a01c9cfffe.name: recover_from_stun
375b75a01c9cfffe.doc: Plays knocked flying and get up, then stuns, and returns to the guard stance if the target is more than 90 units away, otherwise stands.

375dbd38b4f8bef6.name: turn_to_target_timed
375dbd38b4f8bef6.doc: Turns toward the target at speed_deg and waits until facing it or max_frames pass. Returns the frames used.

37683c0686fdc474.name: fight_at_mid_range
37683c0686fdc474.doc: Mid range choice among a lunge, a rocket volley, a dash, a walk toward the target, circling it, or playing with it. Playing is more likely at high life.

37704b2951b233ba.name: choose_far_range_action
37704b2951b233ba.doc: Picks a far-range action at random: walking to the target, waiting, circling it, or walk-up attack.

3773b61b662311cd.name: move_beside_target
3773b61b662311cd.doc: Moves to the point at the given angle around the target at the current distance, shortened to the clear space ahead. Returns -1 when there is no room.

37891f9f86b51e7b.name: play_dodge_attack
37891f9f86b51e7b.doc: Plays the dodge attack motion to its end and stands for 8 frames.

37aba2fdee9bfb89.name: turn_by_angle_and_wait
37aba2fdee9bfb89.doc: Turns by an offset in degrees from the current yaw and waits until it is reached.

37c4466887535e0d.name: hover_while_player_disguised
37c4466887535e0d.doc: Flies toward 5 units above the ground below it at 0.875 units per frame for up to 150 frames (fly_to_point ignores the 25 passed as y), then turns toward the player whenever not facing within 90 degrees until the player is no longer disguised.

37f11cb525d460f0.name: fly_around_point
37f11cb525d460f0.doc: Flies to a point on a circle of the given radius around a center, offset by angle_offset_deg from the direction facing away from the center.

37fa91f530bb9c21.name: idle_around_target
37fa91f530bb9c21.doc: Low priority behaviour: circles the target or stands and waits.

3808bbc6f036553f.name: walk_random_direction
3808bbc6f036553f.doc: Meant to turn up to angle_range degrees, but converts the range to radians and then the random turn to radians again, so it turns a whole number of degrees from 0 to about angle_range/57, always to the same side (under 57 it does not turn). If 100 units ahead are clear it walks base_dist + move_speed plus a random 0 to dist_range units; if less is clear but more than clearance it walks just the random amount; otherwise it returns -1 without moving. clearance is also the stop distance of the wait: returns 1 if the target comes within clearance, 2 when the walk ends, 0 after max_frames.

381060cbff57d8f0.name: turn_random_side
381060cbff57d8f0.doc: Turns to a random angle to the left or right of the current facing.

3832bd5031c2014e.name: charge_at_noticed_target
3832bd5031c2014e.doc: Prints a notice message, enters state 1 and walks toward the target.

383e00045774cd54.name: fight_while_rage_hits_remain
383e00045774cd54.doc: Fight loop while rage hits remain: picks the long, medium or close range behavior by distance. Returns when the target is past 350 or no rage hits remain.

383ef36dd13aff44.name: turn_by_angle_and_wait
383ef36dd13aff44.doc: Turns by relative_deg from the current heading at turn_speed_deg and waits for the turn, returning the frames spent. When the new heading passes 180 degrees either way the wrap is faulty and the monster turns to a small wrong angle instead.

384aece642239003.name: chase_target_while_turning
384aece642239003.doc: Each pass turns fully to face the player, then walks for one frame toward a point 10 steps ahead and stops. The distance test is reversed, so it quits as soon as the player is further than stop_distance; otherwise it runs until max_frames (turn frames count too).

3855825c0ece8f09.name: wait_motion_end_update
3855825c0ece8f09.doc: Waits until the current motion ends, keeping the aggro bookkeeping running. Returns 1.

386498423ccec180.name: fight_while_enraged
386498423ccec180.doc: Combat loop once the monster is enraged: swings or runs at the target when close, spits goo or charges from afar, sometimes circles. Returns when it is no longer enraged.

386ac5918fd1b4e1.name: fight_near_target_until_far
386ac5918fd1b4e1.doc: Loop while the target is within 175 units: lunges when close, otherwise attacks, approaches or strafes beside the target. Returns 0 when the target moves away.

386d79fc0d28287f.name: follow_target_dropping_bombs
386d79fc0d28287f.doc: Flies level toward a point 120 units from the target, moving that point 3 degrees around it each frame while farther than 120, and drops a bomb every 60 frames while fewer than 20 monsters exist. Returns -2 if it starts below 20 units of altitude, the flight becomes invalid, it crosses below z 0 or the target is on raised ground; when it reaches the ground or max_frames runs out it falls off the end with no defined result.

3879429894809f23.name: track_target_frames
3879429894809f23.doc: Meant to turn toward the target every frame for the given number of frames. In this toolkit the target angle read and the turn call use old native numbers (the turn call does nothing), so the monster only waits the frames without turning, then stops turning.

38837e9d195d5868.name: on_update
38837e9d195d5868.doc: Pirate bomb behaviour: lobs itself in an arc toward the player (exploding if it comes within 30), then sits with a fuse of 195 frames, swelling and pulsing blue in the last 30, and finally explodes.

388925cf711c86b4.name: collapse_and_run_event_520
388925cf711c86b4.doc: Resets the camera, stops, plays the collapse motion and drops its loot, then runs event script 520.

38a378e9ee61af7f.name: setup_giltoni
38a378e9ee61af7f.doc: Binds the sword and obj86 objects, registers sword hits for the double and mid-range attacks and sword trails for those and the moonsault, sets phase var 0 to 0, loads the Giltoni shield and magic effects and sets clip distance 60.

38a66063851967bb.name: move_in_direction_updating
38a66063851967bb.doc: Moves a distance in the direction of the given angle without turning.
