38c969fce27cf8bd.name: fly_to_point
38c969fce27cf8bd.doc: Flies in a straight line toward a point at a fixed height above the ground. Returns 1 on arrival, a hit code when blocked, 0 when time ran out.

38d75105dc8b894b.name: dash_at_target
38d75105dc8b894b.doc: Turns to the target and dashes at it.

39003e84e34b719b.name: walk_backward_away
39003e84e34b719b.doc: Walks backward the given distance. When a wall is within 80 units behind, the walk is shortened by the free distance rather than to it, and it returns -1 without moving if less than min_dist remains, so more room behind makes a refusal more likely.

3928d7ae97534b10.name: on_update
3928d7ae97534b10.doc: Waits standing until the target is within 500 or the monster is aggroed, then loops choosing a behavior each frame.

39384d0f976ba0b2.name: swing_and_send_shockwave
39384d0f976ba0b2.doc: Plays attack 1, tracks the target, then spawns the S wave L shockwave effect on the ground at the dcol1 frame, carrying the monster's attack value.

395cbe816d96c6da.name: on_death
395cbe816d96c6da.doc: Falls to the ground, plays the death motion and finishes dying.

395ef8a66b3b5e48.name: wait_frames
395ef8a66b3b5e48.doc: Waits the given number of frames with a bare wait; zero or negative waits nothing.

3983016368cba8e2.name: wander_or_return_home
3983016368cba8e2.doc: Idle behaviour when the target is not near. It turns away from walls, walks back toward home when more than 300 units away, and otherwise wanders, strafes or stands watching. Sets monster var 0 to a code for the chosen wander kind. Returns 1 if the target is detected.

398d7b9f1e27332f.name: run_ai_step
398d7b9f1e27332f.doc: One AI decision: idles or fights depending on aggro and distance; once the rage hits are used up it fights enraged.

39b1fa787e94c269.name: setup_sword_attack_hits
39b1fa787e94c269.doc: Registers the sword attack hits (two medium hits on attack 1, a knockback hit on attack 2) and sword trail, and starts the AI.

39b3f5241aca4cc3.name: fight_at_close_range
39b3f5241aca4cc3.doc: Close range sequence (target under 120): 90 percent of the time a guard charge first, then a point-blank ice ball if the target is within 40, then an ice ball (sometimes after a sidestep), a backstep, or flying 100 units away at 35 degrees off straight back.

39b9cf094baad647.name: watch_distant_target
39b9cf094baad647.doc: Long range choice: stands and waits for the target to approach, sometimes turning slowly toward it first.

39c14d7711a9619a.name: turn_to_monster_for_frames
39c14d7711a9619a.doc: Turns toward another monster for the given number of frames.

39f6c655344a30cb.name: attack_at_mid_range
39f6c655344a30cb.doc: Mostly does a wind-up charge and sets monster var 0, otherwise walks toward the target.

3a28158b896240c2.name: chase_target
3a28158b896240c2.doc: Chases the target at move_speed for up to max_frames, returning -1 when within stop_dist.

3a2e5a75fd505016.name: wait_for_motion_progress
3a2e5a75fd505016.doc: Waits until the motion reaches the given progress within tolerance (default 0.03) or ends. Returns the frames waited.

3a408bd7c9f6a5ce.name: orbit_ring_a_sixth
3a408bd7c9f6a5ce.doc: Moves the boss 60 degrees along the ring of radius 150 around (250, 250) at height 100, 0.05 rad per frame, from the given angle, facing the ring center, and returns the end angle. Not called in this script.

3a67bc978047a7a5.name: turn_to_target_random
3a67bc978047a7a5.doc: Meant to turn toward the target, offset left or right by offset_deg with offset_chance percent probability, and wait up to 360 frames. In this toolkit the target angle read and the turn call use old native numbers (the turn call does nothing), so the monster does not turn. Returns the frames waited.

3a9f6121cc3fad39.name: stand_idle_frames
3a9f6121cc3fad39.doc: Stops moving, restarts the standing motion and waits the given number of frames.

3aa0ae612be4fe87.name: tilt_toward_angle
3aa0ae612be4fe87.doc: Meant to step the monster's X rotation toward target_deg by step_deg each frame, but the step count and direction are computed wrongly: it can tilt away from the target (from 15 toward 0 it goes to 25), take the long way round (from 0 toward -15 it turns about 340 degrees), and it always stops one step short. Only tilt_toward_target_side calls it.

3aa4c0b4912c21df.name: idle_while_player_disguised
3aa4c0b4912c21df.doc: Stands and keeps turning to face the target until the player is no longer disguised.

3aa99bc92138705c.name: set_height_limits
3aa99bc92138705c.doc: Stores the allowed movement height range in monster vars 0 and 1.

3ab4ae4d7c5bb17f.name: turn_by_angle_degrees
3ab4ae4d7c5bb17f.doc: Unused. Meant to turn the monster by offset_deg from its current yaw and return the frames waited. When the sum passes plus or minus 180 degrees the wrap is wrong (it divides by 2 pi or by pi and negates instead of adding or subtracting a full turn), so it turns to an unrelated heading.

3ac676131f7e0662.name: wait_frame_update
3ac676131f7e0662.doc: Advances one frame: refreshes aggro from damage taken, and while aggro is on, ticks its timer and clears aggro when the timer runs out.

3ad2ea84bb69472c.name: walk_random_direction
3ad2ea84bb69472c.doc: Walks a random distance in a direction randomly rotated from the current heading. Returns the move result.

3ae7947c7502d28f.name: track_monster_frames
3ae7947c7502d28f.doc: Keeps turning toward the given monster for a number of frames at turn_speed_deg, then stops turning.

3b029dca1e322ade.name: wait_target_in_view
3b029dca1e322ade.doc: Waits up to max_frames, returning 1 as soon as the target is within the view cone, else 0.

3b31d250fad5b019.name: is_point_in_rect
3b31d250fad5b019.doc: Returns 1 if the point lies inside the rectangle, else 0.

3b58ce62038a5516.name: fall_and_get_up
3b58ce62038a5516.doc: Plays the knocked flying motion, waits, then gets up.

3b5f86238633736a.name: approach_or_vanish
3b5f86238633736a.doc: Half the time walks toward the target, otherwise vanishes and reappears at it for 60 frames.

3b64214b1c9c2f50.name: attack_at_long_range
3b64214b1c9c2f50.doc: Long range choice: usually shoots a poison arrow, sometimes after circling the target, or strafes and wanders.

3b8a9df8e00c3d69.name: fight_when_enraged
3b8a9df8e00c3d69.doc: Returns at once unless the rage counter is zero. Then it runs at the target and attacks with attack 1 or 2 when near.

3b8ef4eea2c09d14.name: walk_to_target
3b8ef4eea2c09d14.doc: Turns to face the target, then walks straight along that heading as far as the target's distance, without checking for walls. Returns 1 if the target comes within stop_dist, 2 when the walk reaches its point, 0 on timeout.

3b97f3bdf5846e6d.name: get_up_after_throw
3b97f3bdf5846e6d.doc: Recovery after being thrown: finishes the throw, stops, waits 10 frames, plays the get-up motion and returns 1.

3b9cd135eb827ac7.name: wait_motion_watch_target
3b9cd135eb827ac7.doc: Waits for the motion to end. Returns 1 if the target comes into view first, 0 if the motion ended.

3b9d921dfd126588.name: walk_and_lunge_slash
3b9d921dfd126588.doc: Walks to the target, then plays attack 1 while lunging 100 units forward.

3babaecc006e3083.name: repeat_turning_forever
3babaecc006e3083.doc: Update program: runs fly_turning_toward_target over and over forever.

3bd0d404c1701dff.name: drift_along_direction
3bd0d404c1701dff.doc: Meant to move the monster each frame by speed toward the point dir_x, dir_y, dir_z until the target is closer than stop_distance or max_frames pass (-1 means no limit). The old-numbered position read, distance read and set_pos run as loop_se_on_monster, get_kind_pos and set_se_positional, so the monster does not move and the distance test reads an unset value. Returns the frames counted.

3bd181b6eef2c087.name: on_dodge_shot
3bd181b6eef2c087.doc: Answers a dodged shot by raising the guard, being pushed back, and lowering it again.

3beeb1128e98458a.name: sidestep_shot
3beeb1128e98458a.doc: Snaps to face the target and steps 30 units right when the world yaw toward it is negative, else left, then allows guard and dodge again.

3c0e0159ebb1d70c.name: approach_at_mid_range
3c0e0159ebb1d70c.doc: Mid-range choice (130 to 210 units): usually closes in, sometimes fires the shockwave attack at once or orbits the target.

3c1bd21c4eec7f02.name: is_inside_arena
3c1bd21c4eec7f02.doc: Returns 1 if a position is within 400 units of the arena center at (0, 0, 450). The position it tests is never filled in, so the result depends on uninitialised data.

3c2bda2fbf80bdd6.name: wait_frames_checking_death
3c2bda2fbf80bdd6.doc: Waits the given number of frames, checking the death flag each frame.

3c345b6bb6e1e78a.name: chase_target
3c345b6bb6e1e78a.doc: Each frame turns toward the target and moves to its position until it is within the stop distance or the frame limit is reached.

3c83c50358247d79.name: attack_combo_early_second_swing
3c83c50358247d79.doc: Attack 1 then attack 2 after 45 percent of the first motion.

3caeacc0325d2129.name: wait_idle_delay
3caeacc0325d2129.doc: Waits monster var 5 frames, then resets that delay to 20.

3cb9e24e16365ad5.name: on_dodge_shot
3cb9e24e16365ad5.doc: Dodging a shot: sidesteps around the target, then plays the dodge return motion.

3cdaa6e587e64853.name: fly_to_height
3cdaa6e587e64853.doc: Moves the monster straight up or down toward the given height, stopping within the tolerance. Returns 1 on arrival, a nonzero blocked code if something stops it, or 0 on timeout.

3cdaad32a6198092.name: run_and_slash_combo
3cdaad32a6198092.doc: Runs at the target, performs the lunging attack 1 and follows with attack 2 while turning toward the target.

3cfb23c95c14adde.name: increment_hit_counter
3cfb23c95c14adde.doc: Adds one to the rapid-hit counter in monster var 18.

3d008c6624b617b4.name: advance_one_frame
3d008c6624b617b4.doc: Runs one orbit update and waits a frame; every wait helper in this script goes through it so the boss keeps circling.

3d19fd8a9b77c04e.name: chase_on_foot_far
3d19fd8a9b77c04e.doc: Far-range approach: runs the waypoint route if the target is on raised ground, then chases the target on foot for up to 90 frames and rests 90 frames out of breath if the chase timed out without reaching the target.

3d294353c1046bf8.name: dodge_shot_by_sidestepping
3d294353c1046bf8.doc: Snaps to face the shooter, dodges sideways (dodge_sideways), turns back to the target and stands, then re-allows guard and dodge.

3d2c090331c0b83e.name: wait_motion_progress
3d2c090331c0b83e.doc: Waits until the motion progress is within the tolerance of the given value (default 0.03) or the motion ends. Returns the frames waited.

3d80701f4aa43587.name: report_missing_shot_attack
3d80701f4aa43587.doc: Prints the debug text 'not SHOT_ATTACK' for a monster that has no shot attack.

3d82d8005a02946a.name: on_update
3d82d8005a02946a.doc: Allows guarding but not dodging by mask flags and repeats the aggro-based behaviour choice each frame.

3d8a1646d648f649.name: fall_and_stagger
3d8a1646d648f649.doc: Stun program: drops scripted flight and plays the knocked-flying then get-up motions until each ends or the monster is under 10 units above the ground, restores flight 10 units above the ground, then plays the faint motion until the stun stars run out and allows guarding and dodging again.

3d8ba39eb31ff440.name: fight_close_range
3d8ba39eb31ff440.doc: Close range choices: swipe (60%), walk after the target for up to 60 frames, or step back away from it.

3d8d22c1bd7283fd.name: dodge_shot_script
3d8d22c1bd7283fd.doc: Dodges a ranged attack with a sidestep and stands.

3dc12146f19f8a57.name: recover_after_throw
3dc12146f19f8a57.doc: Recovers after being thrown and gets up. Returns 1.

3df67cec646138f1.name: chase_target_until_near
3df67cec646138f1.doc: Turns to the target and walks toward it. Returns -1 once within stop_dist, otherwise the frames spent.

3df8f278338c593d.name: choose_next_action
3df8f278338c593d.doc: Melee attack if the target is within 60 units. Otherwise strafes toward the target and then runs in to attack, or backs away and casts, depending on the result.

3e1ed70e0b943893.name: choose_behavior_by_rage_and_aggro
3e1ed70e0b943893.doc: Chooses between fighting, approaching or wandering based on aggro state, distance and rage hits.

3e3eafd336ad6357.name: die_and_stay_dead
3e3eafd336ad6357.doc: Death state: plays the death motion, runs the death routine and idles forever.

3e45e194075a6d3c.name: swing_attack
3e45e194075a6d3c.doc: Turns to the target and plays attack 1 while tracking it.

3e47e652e03d3b85.name: recover_from_throw_checked
3e47e652e03d3b85.doc: Recovers from being thrown, waits 10 frames and resets the motion.

3e4f34669a986e08.name: turn_to_angle
3e4f34669a986e08.doc: Turns to the given angle in degrees at the given speed and waits until done. Returns the frames waited.

3e785cf970914a2c.name: lunge_with_mid_range_attack
3e785cf970914a2c.doc: Plays the mid-range attack and moves toward the target for 6 frames, covering up to 60 units, then stands.

3e7ec6cb970e979f.name: track_monster_until_time
3e7ec6cb970e979f.doc: Keeps turning toward another monster until the motion progress is within tolerance of the given time (default tolerance 0.05).

3e80696dc0eea482.name: circle_or_watch_target
3e80696dc0eea482.doc: Used when the monster is low priority: half the time circles the target at about 130 units, otherwise stands watching it.

3e931e2c14e7ee53.name: setup_attack_hits
3e931e2c14e7ee53.doc: Registers the weak knockback hit for attack 1 and the medium hit for attack 2, with sword trails, and clears monster var 0.

3e9dad615a1f3f44.name: idle_forever
3e9dad615a1f3f44.doc: Waits forever, running wait_frame_update each frame so the model lighting keeps following the rage state.

3eb2da08a4d85088.name: on_guard
3eb2da08a4d85088.doc: Guard reaction: if the attacker is farther than 80 units there is a 5 percent chance of a dodge and counter attack; then plays the guard knockback and unlocks.

3ec3621fca3ec0e2.name: fly_sideways_far
3ec3621fca3ec0e2.doc: Flies 300 units to one side of its facing (yaw minus 90 degrees when go_left is nonzero, plus 90 degrees otherwise) at hover_height above the ground. The returned value is never set.

3ed931105717e115.name: fly_around_target
3ed931105717e115.doc: Turns toward and flies to a point at an angle and radius around the target.

3ede1330a73d42fc.name: turn_to_target_wait
3ede1330a73d42fc.doc: Turns toward the target at the given speed and waits until facing it.

3ee0ad67577fe452.name: turn_and_fly_toward_angle_updating
3ee0ad67577fe452.doc: Turns to an angle in degrees, then flies the given distance that way.

3eff9e4feb7d1e61.name: compute_phase_duration
3eff9e4feb7d1e61.doc: Calculates a duration from the phase and the monster count, but the result is never used.

3f36226a41e4e09b.name: shoot_water_ball
3f36226a41e4e09b.doc: Turns to the target, plays attack 2 and spawns the water shot launch effect and then the looping water shot at the face frame, passing the attack power.

3f36a80104541859.name: turn_to_angle_and_wait
3f36a80104541859.doc: Starts turning toward an absolute yaw in degrees and waits until it is reached. Returns the frames waited.

3f476191359d3801.name: scale_frames_to_pal
3f476191359d3801.doc: Converts a frame count timed for 30 frames per second to the PAL 25 frames per second by multiplying by 25/30.

3f4d4c1cb724cf86.name: track_target_frames
3f4d4c1cb724cf86.doc: Turns toward the target every frame for the given number of frames, then stops turning. Despite the parameter name, turn_speed_deg goes to the turn unconverted, so it is in radians per frame; the values callers give, such as 4.2, make the monster face the target almost at once.

3f54d9f1752de115.name: run_normal_ai
3f54d9f1752de115.doc: AI loop while rage hits remain. Leaves when the target is more than 190 flat units away, otherwise picks a long, mid or close range action by distance.

3f56296669b97c7e.name: fly_sideways
3f56296669b97c7e.doc: Flies 300 units to the left or right of the current heading.

3f5a5a868f990dcd.name: fight_target_enraged
3f5a5a868f990dcd.doc: Fight loop once the rage hits are used up: spin attacks and fireballs by distance, with step backs, until the target is further than 330 units.

3fcb8a487feccdf3.name: lock_and_snap_to_target
3fcb8a487feccdf3.doc: Locks the monster for a scripted reaction: forbids guard and dodge, resets the motion, stops moving and turning, snaps to face the target, waits a frame and sets act status 1. Unused here.

3fe129bc1fca35ad.name: turn_toward_target_with_offset
3fe129bc1fca35ad.doc: Turns toward the target; with offset_chance percent probability aims offset_deg to a random side of it.

3fecacfe8cf84598.name: turn_and_guard_briefly
3fecacfe8cf84598.doc: Meant to walk while turning toward the target, then guard in, hold the guard 30 frames and guard out; its motion and knockback calls use native numbers that run set_life, get_attack and get_body_radius instead, so in game only the turn and the waits work.

400e849cb129e65f.name: turn_and_sidestep_shot
400e849cb129e65f.doc: Faces the target and sidesteps away from a ranged attack.

401ba778d1778a45.name: begin_knockdown_state
401ba778d1778a45.doc: Forbids guarding and dodging, resets motion, faces the target and sets the action status to 1.

4020ff478a079974.name: act_on_aggro_state
4020ff478a079974.doc: Main decision per cycle. With rage hits left it fights within range, wanders otherwise, and chases when aggro is active.

402a629427e0e7d2.name: fight_while_enraged
402a629427e0e7d2.doc: Combat loop once the monster is enraged: attacks or walks at the target when close, attacks or runs in when far. Returns when it is no longer enraged.

402be05776e90bc9.name: vanish_to_guard
402be05776e90bc9.doc: Guards by vanishing and reappearing at the target for 15 to 44 frames.

403b0a58b0df45fd.name: wait_target_detected
403b0a58b0df45fd.doc: Waits frame by frame up to max_frames for the target to be seen or heard (can_detect_target). Returns 1 when detected, 0 on timeout.

403da0cddeba1af2.name: stand_idle_frames
403da0cddeba1af2.doc: Stops moving, plays the stand motion and waits the given frames.

404190f369deb245.name: dash_to_random_arena_point
404190f369deb245.doc: Picks one of five fixed points in the arena, turns to it and dashes there.

40431c2da46cf8b8.name: play_attack_two
40431c2da46cf8b8.doc: Plays attack 2 (the body attack with the knockback hit window) while turning toward the target, then returns to standing.

404f3056cc56c9bf.name: turn_to_monster_until_motion_time
404f3056cc56c9bf.doc: Keeps turning toward another monster until the motion progress is within the tolerance of the given value.

40544476954fa5c9.name: on_update
40544476954fa5c9.doc: Main loop: chooses behavior every frame.

405ce2c79f771458.name: walk_around_target
405ce2c79f771458.doc: Turns to face the point radius units from the target at angle_deg around it (0 is the side facing this monster), then walks there at move_speed. Only move_speed + stop_dist units ahead are probed: if less is clear, the walk is cut to the clear distance, and -1 is returned without moving when that is under twice stop_dist. Otherwise waits up to max_frames and returns 1 once the target is within stop_dist, 2 when the walk ends, 0 on timeout, and stops moving.

40666d6d2075e8bf.name: wait_target_in_view
40666d6d2075e8bf.doc: Waits until the target is inside the view cone. Returns 1 if seen, 0 on timeout.

406fd77697d297a2.name: move_random_offset
406fd77697d297a2.doc: Moves to a point at a random distance and angle offset from the current facing.

407728741484dd77.name: finish_beam_effects
407728741484dd77.doc: Ends the launch and loop beam effects if they exist, telling the loop effect to stop with state 2, and clears their handle variables.

4087c240abcfe949.name: jump_and_fire_flame_ring
4087c240abcfe949.doc: Attack 1: rises 50 units while invulnerable, fires four flame shots in a cross, 10 frames apart, from the dcol02 bone, then drops back and shakes the camera. Attack power is 130% of normal.

40943c02976c0c1a.name: circle_or_wait_at_distance
40943c02976c0c1a.doc: Used when many monsters are closer to the target: circles it, waits or plays antics.

40a10657f4d659ec.name: walk_after_target
40a10657f4d659ec.doc: Walks after the player for up to 240 frames and then stands.

40a4d3d20ed98ba4.name: circle_target_or_hold
40a4d3d20ed98ba4.doc: Half the time circles the target at a distance of about 100 to 130, otherwise stands and watches until the target is in view.

40cfe158bc32606b.name: choose_mid_range_action
40cfe158bc32606b.doc: Mid-range choice: weak attack, walk up to the target, or three strafing steps beside it followed by watching for the target.

40d827a27a1288e0.name: shoot_sticky_goo
40d827a27a1288e0.doc: Plays attack 1 and, at 63 percent of the motion, spawns the sticky goo effect at the dcol1 frame with the monster's attack as damage. Then turns back to the target.

40ed152bde3ab0b2.name: pick_close_range_action
40ed152bde3ab0b2.doc: Close range choice: 70 percent one of the three attacks (rush 50, cross cutter 25, lunge 25 percent), otherwise a back hop or a sidestep. The distance it checks to choose between those two is never assigned.

40ef7eb65c7bbe30.name: setup_lunge_attack
40ef7eb65c7bbe30.doc: Registers the weak knockback hit box on attack 1 (0.486 to 0.583), clears monster var 0 and starts the monster AI with init_monster_ai.

410fd87494e07eef.name: circle_target_or_wait
410fd87494e07eef.doc: Flies around the target, or hovers and waits for it to come into view.

41113b8e4fb334e8.name: recoil_and_step_back
41113b8e4fb334e8.doc: Plays the damage knockback and stands, and 8 percent of the time steps back afterwards.

4112b51c8ea4c1eb.name: struggle_forever
4112b51c8ea4c1eb.doc: Plays the struggling motion forever; used for a monster lying helpless.

411aad7b50af28a7.name: step_sideways_dodge
411aad7b50af28a7.doc: Steps toward a point 100 units to a random side, moving 3.6 per frame for 6 frames (about 22 units) while invulnerable, then returns to standing.

41200a52a2195494.name: fight_by_distance_until_enraged
41200a52a2195494.doc: Loop that picks close, mid or long-range behaviour by target distance. Returns when the target is over 290 units away or the rage counter is zero.

412ab8b49dca88ef.name: charge_then_chase
412ab8b49dca88ef.doc: Rolls at the player (attack 2) for up to 120 frames; if a wall blocks the straight line to the player it walks after it for 30 frames instead, then stands.

416aa7ea233bb87f.name: face_target_and_move_ahead
416aa7ea233bb87f.doc: Turns to face the target and walks 100 units straight ahead, stopping within stop_dist of the target. Returns -1 without moving if anything blocks the 100 units ahead.

416b13ee36a8f254.name: fight_while_enraged
416b13ee36a8f254.doc: Combat loop for the enraged state; returns when the monster calms down or the target is beyond 290 units. Within 156 units it swings (attack 1 under 60 units, else attack 2) or spin-dashes, up to 160 it spin-dashes, and farther out it chases for up to 60 frames.

419a31eea6f42378.name: wait_target_detected
419a31eea6f42378.doc: Waits up to max_frames and returns 1 when the target is seen inside the view cone or heard (moving faster than min_speed within hear_dist), else 0.

41b21f837c782782.name: wait_move_until_near
41b21f837c782782.doc: Waits up to max_frames for a move_to walk. Returns 1 as soon as the target is within stop_dist, 2 when the walk ends, 0 on timeout; stops moving on 1 or 2.

41b46eaf38b05160.name: fly_to_center_and_fire_beam
41b46eaf38b05160.doc: Flies up to the arena center at height 300, fires the demon beam sweep and returns to the swim loop.

41bbf12c989e07e0.name: play_air_damage_reaction
41bbf12c989e07e0.doc: Ends beam effects, stops moving and plays the air damage motion, then returns to the swim loop.

41c26b21234007fb.name: turn_and_walk_to_point_around_target
41c26b21234007fb.doc: Turns toward a point on a ring around the target and walks to it. Returns -1 if the path is too short.

41c7e956c0a3f235.name: begin_knockdown_lock
41c7e956c0a3f235.doc: Forbids guarding and dodging, resets the motion, stops turning, releases scripted movement and sets the act status to busy.

41d8fa6eda8203e9.name: record_floor_time
41d8fa6eda8203e9.doc: Stores the current floor timer in monster variable 14+slot.

4201abb33396e819.name: pick_idle_movement
4201abb33396e819.doc: Picks a random idle behavior: turning away from walls, returning toward home, circling the target, or waiting to detect it. Returns 1 if it detected the target.

421b69aed3fa229e.name: fly_to_point
421b69aed3fa229e.doc: Flies in a straight line toward x, z at height units above the ground under the monster; the y argument is ignored. Vertical movement stops outside 0 to 40 units above the ground. Returns 1 on arrival, the check_flight_step result if blocked, 0 on timeout.

423293102ebe0494.name: fight_at_close_range
423293102ebe0494.doc: Close range choice: sometimes shoots feathers, then walks up and lunges if within 94 units or shoots, or circles the target.

4248fa1ed5286a29.name: is_near_other_butterfly
4248fa1ed5286a29.doc: Returns 1 if any other butterfly (kinds 502 to 508) is within 50 units of this one.

4272465fe915dec6.name: flash_while_lights_circle
4272465fe915dec6.doc: While the states of the red, blue and yellow Atramilia lights (monster vars 27 to 29) are all 32, meaning all three are circling above the boss with their light effect, keeps the boss invincible with lighting off and flickers its colour. Returns as soon as any state differs, at once if they are not all 32 yet; the invincibility and unlit model are left for the caller to reset.

4274c463a7dc4e4b.name: walk_to_target
4274c463a7dc4e4b.doc: Turns to face the target, then walks straight to it, ending stop_dist short or after max_frames. Returns -1 when something blocks the way, otherwise the wait result.

428b0f80172e9f3d.name: fly_constant_speed_to_point
428b0f80172e9f3d.doc: Meant to fly toward the point at a constant step until near or blocked, but the step length is never set and the speed argument is unused, so it does not fly at any set speed; with the local at zero it stops on the first frame without moving.

42aa507417d34646.name: walk_in_direction
42aa507417d34646.doc: Turns to the world heading angle_deg at turn_speed_deg, then walks dist units along it at move_speed (at least move_speed + 1). A heading below the turn speed, including every negative heading, is first increased by the turn speed. Returns 1 if the target comes within stop_dist, 2 when the walk ends, 0 after max_frames.

42ad5124ae2e43b4.name: fight_target_at_range
42ad5124ae2e43b4.doc: Combat loop that returns 0 once the target is beyond 200 units. A monster ranked third or further from the target (get_priority above 2) only runs the far-range idle; otherwise inside 100 units it picks the lunge, attack 2 or the weak attack, and farther out it uses the weak attack, walks up, or strafes beside the target, but that strafe loop never counts its steps and repeats forever.

42adaea7cb0fd28e.name: setup_healer_monster
42adaea7cb0fd28e.doc: Registers the weak attack 1 and knockback attack 2 hit areas, sets the photo window for grade 0, loads the heal effects and sets the heal timer var 7 to 90 before initialising the monster AI.

42b08cca9231ee47.name: allow_dodge_again
42b08cca9231ee47.doc: Clears the no-dodge mask flag set before guarding.

42b1ace355d7764a.name: turn_and_guard
42b1ace355d7764a.doc: Stops, turns to the target and holds the guard motion for 8 frames.

42c0de086d101eb7.name: swipe_attack
42c0de086d101eb7.doc: Flies to the target's position and plays attack 2.

42cd891e5dc0e168.name: fight_without_guard_loop
42cd891e5dc0e168.doc: Forbids guarding, allows dodging and clears the act status, then runs approach_until_target_close and fight_by_range_until_far every frame forever. The rage hits it reads are never used.

42e499a800e35e13.name: run_boss_ai_loop
42e499a800e35e13.doc: If the collapse timer is set, collapses for that many frames (running event 530 the first time) and then gets back up. Then loops forever: update situation flags, choose actions and run the current action.

42e5912a51767be3.name: cancel_spit_on_dodge_melee
42e5912a51767be3.doc: Dodge melee program: halts with guard and dodge forbidden, ends any active spit effect and allows guard and dodge again.

4334afd876550432.name: act_at_far_range
4334afd876550432.doc: Calm long-range choice: lunge slash, walk closer or stand watching.

435d17d28fc87ef5.name: lock_and_face_target
435d17d28fc87ef5.doc: Forbids guard and dodge, stops all motion, faces the target and sets action status 1.

4370aff89920d7c2.name: run_to_side_of_target
4370aff89920d7c2.doc: Picks a point 200 units from the target at 120 degrees to either side (50 percent each) of the line from the target back to this monster, snaps to face it and runs there at speed 7, giving up after about 114 frames.

4372c5299fcddb82.name: setup_flying_shooter
4372c5299fcddb82.doc: Registers two knockback hit windows on attack 2 and preloads the fire, ice, thunder, wind or holy bolt effects for the monster kind (112 to 131). It then makes the monster a flyer with max height 40 and lifts it 15 units.

4378965ffa1072e9.doc: Prints the debug text 'guard' and does nothing else.

438d6f02f227daaf.name: write_orbit_angle
438d6f02f227daaf.doc: Stores the orbit angle in monster variable 0.

4391450b610a30e8.name: increment_hit_count
4391450b610a30e8.doc: Adds one to the hit counter in monster variable 1.

4397fde3afb74225.name: launch_robot_missile
4397fde3afb74225.doc: Plays the missile launch motion and fires a homing robot missile, aimed at character 0, from 60 units above its own position or above a point 20 units to its side, then stands for 30 frames.

439c6c8943023241.name: wait_for_motion_progress
439c6c8943023241.doc: Waits until the current motion reaches the given progress, or ends. A tolerance of -1 uses 0.03. Returns the frames waited.

43a5e850165e26da.name: fight_close_range
43a5e850165e26da.doc: Close range choices: swing combos, shockwave, step back or circle the target.

43aac3c1f75f47d6.name: wait_while_player_disguised
43aac3c1f75f47d6.doc: Stands and turns to face the target whenever it is outside a 90 degree cone until the player is no longer disguised.

43acacae60ed9acd.name: on_stun
43acacae60ed9acd.doc: Stun program: makes the monster damageable and halts it, plays the damage motion for 12 frames, then plays the faint motion until the stun stars run out and allows guarding and dodging again.

43b9321424200359.name: wait_target_detected
43b9321424200359.doc: Waits up to max_frames frames until can_detect_target sees or hears the target. Returns 1 on detection, 0 on timeout.

43e24f133588549b.name: move_in_direction
43e24f133588549b.doc: Walks dist units along angle_deg (degrees) from the current position at move_speed, waiting until the target is within stop_dist or max_frames pass, then stops. Does not turn first.

43e4914711c60d83.name: face_target_until_time
43e4914711c60d83.doc: Keeps turning toward the target until the current motion's progress is within tolerance of time (default 0.05), then stops turning.

4406ad6ae24f8946.name: on_init
4406ad6ae24f8946.doc: Registers the monster's attack hit windows and initialises the shared AI.

440edb7af7aaeb2a.name: fight_mid_range
440edb7af7aaeb2a.doc: Mid range choices: swing, shockwave, chase, or play antics.

441264837b60d3c5.name: play_jump_motions
441264837b60d3c5.doc: Plays the jump start and jump end motions.

4414ac9570e102c8.name: play_until_target_in_view
4414ac9570e102c8.doc: Plays the idle play motion and waits up to 35 frames for the target to come into view.

442c9808cea96006.name: store_var_20
442c9808cea96006.doc: Stores value in monster variable 20, one of the variables (8 to 135) shared by all monsters on the floor.

445926c712ac5e7a.name: on_dodge_melee
445926c712ac5e7a.doc: After a dodge of a melee hit, charges at the target once enraged.

445fd1c64676b22b.name: fight_after_rage_ends
445fd1c64676b22b.doc: Fighting loop used once no rage hits are left: slashes or runs at the target depending on distance. Returns when rage hits are available again.

446f6e067e4f2850.name: read_ai_mode
446f6e067e4f2850.doc: Reads monster variable 0, the AI mode (2 attacks, 1 idles), into the first element of the array.

4470a8c094e09462.name: turn_to_target_until_motion_end
4470a8c094e09462.doc: Keeps turning toward the target until the current motion ends.

4477036100162429.name: track_target_until_time
4477036100162429.doc: Turns toward the target every frame until the motion progress is within tolerance (default 0.05 when -1) of time, then stops turning. Never ends if the motion passes that point between frames.

44bd4f4133632984.name: setup_melee_monster
44bd4f4133632984.doc: Init program: registers the hit windows of attack 1 (poison), attack 2 (thirst) and attack 3 (the K mimic hit settings) and starts the monster AI.

44c9f95252ca817a.name: flank_target_randomly
44c9f95252ca817a.doc: Turns to the target and, with the step right or step left motion chosen at random, flies at 4 units per frame toward a point the target's distance plus 50 units from itself, on a heading 30 degrees to one side of the target: up to 15 frames at 5 units above the ground, then up to 15 at 25. Although fly_to_point_around_target is passed 150 or -150 degrees, the point is measured from the monster, so it lies beside and a little beyond the target rather than on its far side.

44e001d50d02a6ad.name: fight_at_mid_range
44e001d50d02a6ad.doc: Mid range choice (target 130 to 210 away): fire ball, taunt, walk or run closer when its life is low, or circle the target.

44ffd6cbd6b6f7df.name: get_angle_difference_to_point
44ffd6cbd6b6f7df.doc: Meant to return the signed angle from the facing direction to the target point, wrapped to -PI..PI. Written in the b02a raw numbering, where play_monster_se stands for calc_atan2, so on this disc it plays a sound instead and the angle is never computed; it returns the unset value minus facing, wrapped.

451255764849750a.name: lunge_with_attack_two
451255764849750a.doc: Turns to the target and plays attack 2 (the knockback attack), tracking the target for 6 frames, then moves toward a point 100 units ahead at 4.5 units per frame for 14 frames (about 63 units), waits 7 more frames, stands and waits 9 frames.

451ecaee55e53291.name: dodge_shot_by_sidestep
451ecaee55e53291.doc: Dodges a shot with the invulnerable sidestep.

451f391ec2000d63.name: on_dodge_shot
451f391ec2000d63.doc: Sidesteps a shot to the left or right with a damage-left or damage-right motion.

45338358516916d7.name: stop_and_end_throw
45338358516916d7.doc: Recovery after being thrown: stops moving, ends the throw state, waits 10 frames and returns 1.

45343b5666b43ea8.name: recoil_from_knockdown
45343b5666b43ea8.doc: Runs the same damage reaction as a normal hit while locked, then releases the action lock.

4551b27c4412e7da.name: walk_random_offset
4551b27c4412e7da.doc: Walks a random distance along a randomly rotated heading without turning first.

4555c926ea8590f6.name: hover_around_target
4555c926ea8590f6.doc: Meant to turn toward a point at the given angle and distance from the target and fly there at height_offset above the ground, stopping short of a wall within 50 units and returning -1 when too little room is left. Its position, turn and move calls are old-numbered and reach unrelated natives, so it does not turn or fly there as meant; otherwise it returns an unset value.

457cefab81183ac3.name: play_attack_two
457cefab81183ac3.doc: Walks up to the target and plays attack 2.

458560187cf69296.name: strafe_to_center_side_of_target
458560187cf69296.doc: Walks with battle walk motions to the point 140 units from the target toward the arena center. Returns 1 if the target is more than 120 away, 0 once it has stood in place for 90 frames or its direction to the center is within 22.5 degrees of the target's.

45a4acdbd4034bf2.name: step_back_dodge
45a4acdbd4034bf2.doc: Steps back 100 units, invulnerable only until 12 percent of the step motion, then stands.

45aa3121b4f81d5f.name: fight_by_distance
45aa3121b4f81d5f.doc: Combat loop: picks the far (300 or more), mid (200 to 300) or close routine by target distance. Wanders instead when a higher priority is set. Returns when the target is lost.

45bb023eb30cb726.name: get_flat_target_distance
45bb023eb30cb726.doc: Writes the horizontal distance to the target into out_dist.

462725421dad56b2.name: approach_at_far_range
462725421dad56b2.doc: At 135 to 230 units it runs or walks toward the target, slashes or waits for it to appear.

463478207111bf87.name: circle_or_wait_at_distance
463478207111bf87.doc: Used when the monster is not among the nearest to the target (distance rank above 1, or above 2 in the enraged loop): half the time circles the target 160 to 190 units out, otherwise stands and waits up to 30 frames for it to come into view.

46370ba41fdab91e.name: walk_toward_target_to_range
46370ba41fdab91e.doc: Walks toward the target until it is 30 or 50 units away. Returns 0 when it arrived, 1 if it lost the facing or the target moved beyond 160 units.

463affa3070b1332.name: back_step_dodge
463affa3070b1332.doc: Walks backward 100 units while invulnerable. The parameter is unused.

464a5ea26d5a40eb.name: stand_and_wait
464a5ea26d5a40eb.doc: Stops moving, plays the stand motion and waits the given frames.

465c153c65b83c15.name: choose_action
465c153c65b83c15.doc: Picks the next action: back step and cast when far, sidestep and melee when close, otherwise strafe or run in. The arena center circle action is never reached.

4676040c1bce7914.name: get_knocked_down_and_rise
4676040c1bce7914.doc: Plays the knocked-flying motion with knockback, lies down 30 frames and gets up.

468e1f52664861dc.name: fall_and_die
468e1f52664861dc.doc: Falls to the ground, plays the death motion and finishes dying.

469e942184c0f6f0.name: fire_flame_volley
469e942184c0f6f0.doc: Attack 2: fires four flame shots from the dcol02 bone at 130 percent attack, straight ahead every 15 frames when the player is within 400 units, otherwise alternately to either side every 30 frames. range_mask and the enrage roll are overwritten, so they have no effect.

469ea3542e111ba2.name: fight_while_calm
469ea3542e111ba2.doc: Combat loop before the monster is enraged: picks the close, mid (115 to 180) or far (180 to 245) routine by target distance. Returns when the target is too far or the monster becomes enraged.

46a2768a7fd2c2f4.name: face_then_chase_target
46a2768a7fd2c2f4.doc: Turns to face the target, then chases it until within stop_dist (returns -1) or max_frames pass (returns the frames used).

46ae9841009d9e71.name: lock_and_end_flight
46ae9841009d9e71.doc: Forbids guard and dodge, resets the motion, stops turning, waits a frame, turns scripted flight off and sets the action status to 1.

46d65ac16e4446d8.name: die_and_start_defeat_event
46d65ac16e4446d8.doc: Plays the death motion with drops and no smoke, then runs event script 501 and waits forever.

46dbe081a4c05186.name: on_update
46dbe081a4c05186.doc: Main loop: chases the target inside the arena, returning to the center when outside 380 units, otherwise performs attack steps and keeps minion 1001 alive.

46e01484cfb0028c.name: watch_target_if_player_disguised
46e01484cfb0028c.doc: If the player is currently disguised as a monster, runs the watching loop until the disguise ends.

46e0396d7606c046.name: wait_until_target_in_view
46e0396d7606c046.doc: Waits up to max_frames for the target to enter the view cone. Returns 1 if seen, 0 on timeout.

46ea5e29e1b5511e.name: act_at_close_range
46ea5e29e1b5511e.doc: Close range choice: attack 1 or 2, circle the target, or step back.

46eb8c8c0b5bbf07.name: strafe_or_play
46eb8c8c0b5bbf07.doc: Idle choice: half the time strafes left or right of the target or just stands watching, otherwise plays and pounces.

4722775a03b1bdee.name: turn_by_angle_updating
4722775a03b1bdee.doc: Turns by the given number of degrees relative to the current yaw, updating the boss.

473d2abf3462c529.name: fight_step_while_enraged
473d2abf3462c529.doc: One enraged fight decision, made when no rage hits are left: melee attack 1 or a step back when the target is within 60, otherwise a bomb throw, one or two step backs, or a dash past the target that ends with the monster fainting for 90 frames. Returns 0 at once while rage hits remain.

47438a241825c62c.name: track_target_until_time
47438a241825c62c.doc: Turns to keep facing the target until the motion progress reaches the given time.

4758ba4b0412e350.name: run_monster_ai
4758ba4b0412e350.doc: Allows guard and dodge, then runs the behaviour pick every frame.

476a953b4d3ca67d.name: fight_by_range_until_rage_ends
476a953b4d3ca67d.doc: Fight loop that picks the long, mid or close range action from the distance to the target. It returns when the target is over 320 units away or no rage hits are left.

4785f68759f6d784.name: dive_attack_and_retreat
4785f68759f6d784.doc: Turns to the target and flies at it 3 units above the ground (up to 90 frames), then plays attack 1 while flying at its new position (up to 75 frames). After the attack it faces the target and backs away toward a point 150 units beyond itself, 50 units above the ground, at 4 units per frame for at most 30 frames (about 120 units).

479c9ce29caefb10.name: slide_to_point
479c9ce29caefb10.doc: Moves the boss straight to a point by setting its position each frame, optionally rotating to face the motion. Returns 0 on arrival and 1 on timeout.

479fe62c6f582204.name: face_monster_for_frames
479fe62c6f582204.doc: Keeps turning toward another monster for the given number of frames.

47b8850ef6b4901f.name: on_damage
47b8850ef6b4901f.doc: Ends active roses; once the intro is done, also interrupts the boss with a damage reaction.

47c2095a114defa4.name: vanish_and_reappear_at_target
47c2095a114defa4.doc: Plays the dodge motion, becomes impossible to lock on to, and after half of frames teleports to the player's position, waits the other half, then plays the dodge return motion (which carries a hit) and can be locked on again.

47d1a7854144a0e5.name: stand_and_tick_frames
47d1a7854144a0e5.doc: Stops moving, plays the stand motion and runs the given number of frames.

47d9c2b93a3221cb.name: walk_in_direction
47d9c2b93a3221cb.doc: Despite the parameter names, the first argument is the turn speed in degrees and the second the walk speed. Turns to the world heading angle_deg, then walks dist units along it (at least the walk speed + 1). A heading below the turn speed, including every negative heading, is first increased by the turn speed. Returns 1 if the target comes within stop_dist, 2 when the walk ends, 0 after max_frames.

47eb978a7ab5e352.name: stop_after_landing
47eb978a7ab5e352.doc: Stops moving and turning, clears invulnerability and returns 1.

47ee6fee6e5c8c3d.name: face_target_now
47ee6fee6e5c8c3d.doc: Sets the monster's yaw to face the target at once. Written in the b02a raw numbering, where the calls shown stand for get_target_angle and set_rot.

481669a7dad3b4b0.name: choose_close_range_action
481669a7dad3b4b0.doc: Picks a close-range action at random: lunge attack, sidestep or backstep, or moving beside the target.

4832132258efada0.name: swing_quick_attack_one_then_two
4832132258efada0.doc: Plays attack 1 for 12 frames and then attack 2 for 45 frames without moving.

483d41bf6af831f3.name: choose_wander_action
483d41bf6af831f3.doc: Wander AI, meant to pick a random idle action: turn away from walls, return toward home, walk around the home point or the target, walk straight, or wait and watch for the player, recording the choice in monster var 0 (1, 4, 8, 16 or 32). Returns 1 when it noticed the target and 0 after the far-from-home branch; other paths end without a return value. Written in this script's old native numbering, so the distance, position, rotation, clearance and motion calls run other natives or none, and the branch that records 1 tests a variable that is never set.

48512be6ca711109.name: move_beside_target
48512be6ca711109.doc: Moves to a point at an angle around the target, stopping at a wall (returns -1 if no room).

48590e5004e3c547.name: write_ai_mode
48590e5004e3c547.doc: Stores the AI mode in monster variable 0.

48706be74d620afc.name: attack_at_close_range
48706be74d620afc.doc: Close-range choice: usually chases and attacks (70 percent weak combo, 30 percent shockwave), sometimes charges at a run or circles the target.

487d50453589e4c9.name: fight_mid_range
487d50453589e4c9.doc: Mid range choices: wait, or turn and walk toward the target.

489b908ac25db8ca.name: fight_loop_while_enraged
489b908ac25db8ca.doc: Fight loop once no rage hits are left (enraged); returns when rage hits are available again. Repositions when another monster has priority; otherwise within 90 units it mostly lunges, and farther out it lunges (40 percent) or runs at the target.

48aad398647e8c3d.name: on_init
48aad398647e8c3d.doc: Attaches the cannon to the battleship map piece (tbig-m0 for handle 25, tbig-m1 for handle 26) and adds its life to the ship's shared life totals.

48bb9fdbe8fe7e3c.name: play_first_hit_scene_once
48bb9fdbe8fe7e3c.doc: Once a hit on the boss has done no damage, sets monster var 18 to 1 and runs event script 507 (the hint that no attack works on the Rainbow Butterfly and the Lafrescia flower may hold the clue). Does nothing once var 18 is set.

48bbcd811b92baac.name: run_after_target
48bbcd811b92baac.doc: Runs at the player for up to 120 frames and swings (walk_up_and_swing) if it gets within 30 units.

48ca79b69dd71998.name: fight_target_by_range
48ca79b69dd71998.doc: Main fight loop: returns when the target is beyond 330 or the monster is enraged, otherwise picks the far, mid or close range behaviour by distance.

48dc768e848103d1.name: run_at_target_position
48dc768e848103d1.doc: Turns to the target and runs straight to where it stood with acceleration.

48eaa05b5349ff3f.name: play_taunt
48eaa05b5349ff3f.doc: Sets attack var 1 to 32 and plays the play (taunt) motion while watching the target.

48ec8714dc7abea9.name: init_orbiting_light
48ec8714dc7abea9.doc: Sets up the light as an always-visible, bodiless monster with no map collision and clears its orbit vars and state.

48f3b712fc436fba.name: mark_floor_time
48f3b712fc436fba.doc: Stores the current floor timer in monster variable 5.

48fa3118030f96c3.name: hop_back_from_melee
48fa3118030f96c3.doc: Reacts to a melee attack with a back hop (70 percent) or a sidestep.

49161acffb3d2dff.name: stand_still_for_frames
49161acffb3d2dff.doc: Stops moving, plays the stand motion and waits the given number of frames.

4916f209da1e839d.name: fly_to_point_around_target
4916f209da1e839d.doc: Turns toward and flies to a point at a given angle and distance around the target.

49188f516363587b.name: run_user_monster_mode
49188f516363587b.doc: If the player is disguised in a form this monster's kind recognises as its own (get_player_disguise is not -1), runs face_target_while_disguised until that ends: the monster stands and turns toward its target whenever it is more than 60 degrees off. Does nothing otherwise. The monster kind it passes is not used.

493c514a1f2bb97e.name: fly_sideways
493c514a1f2bb97e.doc: Flies toward a point 300 units to the right or left of its heading, for at most frames frames (callers use speed 2 for 60 frames, about 120 units). The returned value is never set.

494a7b0b86f77ee1.name: chase_target_until_near
494a7b0b86f77ee1.doc: While the target is 240 or more units away, mostly chases it and sometimes stands watching. Returns 0 once the target is closer.

4960e8ccf15ef31e.name: swing_attack_two
4960e8ccf15ef31e.doc: Plays attack 2 once and waits for it to end.

4962a44e015676b0.name: guard_against_hit
4962a44e015676b0.doc: Raises a guard, absorbs the hit with a small knockback, lowers the guard and resumes standing. Interrupts are locked meanwhile.

497048c29aadd04a.name: turn_to_target_random
497048c29aadd04a.doc: Turns toward the target, but with offset_chance percent probability aims offset_deg to one side or the other (50/50). Waits up to 360 frames for the turn and returns the frames used.

4995d404babf589e.name: wander_and_look_for_target
4995d404babf589e.doc: Idle behaviour: backs away from walls, walks back toward home when far from it, or randomly walks, circles or stands looking for the target. Sets monster var 0 to the chosen wander kind and returns 1 when it detects the target.

49972ce002811e71.name: chase_then_maybe_shoot
49972ce002811e71.doc: Chases the target on foot, then 70 percent of the time shoots a flame shot.

49a0765896efa8ee.name: wait_for_motion_progress
49a0765896efa8ee.doc: Waits until the motion progress is within the margin of the target value (default 0.03) or the motion ends. Returns frames waited.

49a6fb6fc95fd022.name: wait_for_player_then_fight
49a6fb6fc95fd022.doc: Stands until the player comes within 500 or it is aggroed, then fights forever.

49b9cba7be53f757.name: drop_bomb_in_flight
49b9cba7be53f757.doc: If the boss is more than 5 units up and fewer than 20 monsters exist, plays the bomb attack motion and creates a bomb monster (id 1006) at the dco2 point.

49c30848e2d7f327.name: fly_to_origin
49c30848e2d7f327.doc: Flies the ship to the world origin, facing the orbit angle. Not called by on_update.

49d046cc40d3af83.name: act_at_close_range
49d046cc40d3af83.doc: Calm close-range choice: walk up and swing or lunge, slash combo, strafe, or dodge in place.

49e92f2b4796b76b.name: halt_briefly_on_knockdown
49e92f2b4796b76b.doc: Knockdown program: forbids guarding and dodging, stops the motion and turning and waits one frame, then turns scripted flight off and straight back on in the same frame, nudges itself up off the ground and allows guarding and dodging again. It never falls or plays a knockdown motion.

49f882ec5ab9b45d.name: get_knocked_down_and_rise
49f882ec5ab9b45d.doc: Is blown away, lies down for 30 frames and gets up.

49fb2f9dfd47efda.name: set_slot_flag
49fb2f9dfd47efda.doc: Sets monster variable 20 plus slot to 1.

49fec1d56379f59a.name: circle_target_when_crowded
49fec1d56379f59a.doc: Used when the monster is low priority: half the time circles the target at about 110 units, otherwise stands watching it.

4a0b321be2fe6433.name: setup_summoner_monster
4a0b321be2fe6433.doc: Registers two attack 1 hit windows, sets the photo window for grade 0, loads Tore's smoke and the small explosion effects, resets the floor timer and monster vars and initialises the monster AI.

4a0b6b8d1532a578.name: attack_at_mid_range
4a0b6b8d1532a578.doc: Mid-range choice: swing attack 1, run at the target, walk up, or circle the target.

4a273dd51ed56ce1.name: turn_until_facing_or_target_seen
4a273dd51ed56ce1.doc: Like turning until facing an angle, but returns -1 at once if the target comes into view.

4a401e052b0b8866.name: recoil_from_hit
4a401e052b0b8866.doc: Clears the body hit flag, stops all actions, plays the damage knockback and recovers to the stand motion.

4a4d7d24b43a50e5.name: walk_around_target
4a4d7d24b43a50e5.doc: Turns to face the point radius units from the target at angle_deg around it (0 is the side facing this monster), then walks there at move_speed. Only move_speed + stop_dist units ahead are probed: if less is clear, the walk is cut to the clear distance, and -1 is returned without moving when that is under twice stop_dist. Otherwise waits up to max_frames and returns 1 once the target is within stop_dist, 2 when the walk ends, 0 on timeout, and stops moving.

4a5797fccf64200c.name: summon_monster_with_smoke
4a5797fccf64200c.doc: Plays the attack 2 summon animation, spawns smoke and creates monster 1002 plus the grade at the dcol0 bone. Does nothing if 20 or more monsters exist.

4a5b577c0ec482fd.name: fight_while_calm
4a5b577c0ec482fd.doc: Calm combat loop choosing far (140 to 175), mid (90 to 140) or close behaviour. Returns when the player is further than 175 or the monster becomes enraged.

4a61a3cd2e8dd641.name: fall_and_get_up
4a61a3cd2e8dd641.doc: Plays the knocked-flying motion, stays down 30 frames with act status 1, then gets up and stands.

4a9bdea4491af4b4.name: spin_dash_attack
4a9bdea4491af4b4.doc: Attack 3: winds up, dashes 300 units forward at speed 7.4 with the spin effect on for 45 frames, then plays the recovery motion.

4aa60860387095fe.name: turn_to_monster_for_frames
4aa60860387095fe.doc: Keeps turning toward another monster for the given frames, then stops turning.

4ab32415a6943a22.name: pick_idle_movement
4ab32415a6943a22.doc: Picks a random idle behavior: turning away from a wall closer than 140, circling its home point when more than 300 from it, or standing to watch for the target, turning, circling the target or walking straight ahead. Returns 1 if it saw the target. Not called from this script.

4abbf5ac82ae35c2.name: trigger_phase_change_event
4abbf5ac82ae35c2.doc: Once, when life is under 67 percent or no other monsters remain, ends the Atlamillia light effects of the three Atramilia lights (the effect slots in monster vars 24 to 26), makes the boss invulnerable, stops its sound and runs event script 500. Monster var 7 marks that it has run.

4ace3e10c17254c9.name: fight_while_calm
4ace3e10c17254c9.doc: Calm combat loop. Casts the heal spell when ready, watches a disguised player, and picks the far, mid or close behaviour by distance. Returns when the player is further than 270 or the monster becomes enraged.

4ad4944eca938cd6.name: turn_to_random_side
4ad4944eca938cd6.doc: Turns to a random side of the current heading and waits for the turn. Returns after the first pass.

4af9bd991c749482.name: hover_around_host
4af9bd991c749482.doc: Places the orb on its wobbling hover point around the host and advances the two wobble angles by angle_step.

4afd9edce9104b31.name: track_monster_until_time_updating
4afd9edce9104b31.doc: Turns toward another monster each frame until the motion reaches the given time.

4b0484d432ed19b7.name: attack_shockwave
4b0484d432ed19b7.doc: Sets attack state 2, turns to the target, plays attack 2 while tracking, spawns the Vanguard shockwave effect 16 units ahead with the monster's attack value, then stands for 9 frames.

4b1bbff5dc9d3870.name: finish_death_and_idle
4b1bbff5dc9d3870.doc: Finishes the death sequence and then idles forever.

4b2ee7ba9e249726.name: slam_ground_with_attack_3
4b2ee7ba9e249726.doc: Plays attack 3, spawns a shockwave at the dcol00 bone position and shakes the camera.

4b50fc5259d667e6.name: wander_around_home
4b50fc5259d667e6.doc: Idle behaviour. Turns away from walls, walks back toward home when far away, otherwise stands watching for a target or wanders around the target or in a random direction. Returns 1 when it detects a target.

4b6158852515587c.name: chase_target_in_flight
4b6158852515587c.doc: Flies toward the target's current position every frame, tracking it, for up to max_frames. Faces the target in pitch too when pitch_to_target is set. Returns 1 on arrival, a collision code if blocked, 0 on timeout.

4b70ce3dd96791cc.name: run_butterfly_boss_ai
4b70ce3dd96791cc.doc: State machine: 1 circle the arena, 2 beam, 3 reform, 4 hide, 5 split, 6 scale powder. Clears the owner effects before splitting and ends when a state returns 0.

4b79de0c2c528f38.name: block_attack_with_guard
4b79de0c2c528f38.doc: Uninterruptible guard: walks while turning to the target, guards for 60 frames, then returns to standing.

4b7d106bcc1441fd.name: attack_at_near_range
4b7d106bcc1441fd.doc: Near range choice under 120 units: 70 percent attacks (mostly the shockwave slam, sometimes the arm swing or lunge), otherwise steps back. The sideways steps are unreachable because the distance it tests is never set.

4ba89bbd29528c75.name: turn_to_target_for_frames
4ba89bbd29528c75.doc: Turns to face the target and waits at most max_frames.

4baba0688156ef80.name: wait_motion_end_or_target_in_view
4baba0688156ef80.doc: Waits until the motion ends (returns 0) or the target enters view (returns 1).

4bb8d58950820429.name: move_around_target_by_angle
4bb8d58950820429.doc: Moves to the point angle degrees around the target at its current distance. If map collision lies within 100 units straight ahead of its facing, it instead moves that far toward the point, returning -1 without moving when that is under twice near_dist. Otherwise returns the result of waiting for the move.

4bc8cdb7e96b9dc1.name: fly_to_point_around_target_updating
4bc8cdb7e96b9dc1.doc: Picks a point around the target, turns to face it and flies there.

4bd03d724f573c36.name: turn_to_angle
4bd03d724f573c36.doc: Turns to the absolute heading angle_deg at turn_speed_deg degrees per frame, wrapping both to the -180 to 180 range, and waits until the heading is reached or about 360 divided by the speed frames pass. Returns the frames waited.

4bd544b1185fc492.name: play_attack_1_motion
4bd544b1185fc492.doc: Plays attack 1 while tracking the target, then stands for 9 frames.

4bdfcf0eedec4d93.name: track_monster_until_time
4bdfcf0eedec4d93.doc: Keeps turning toward another monster until the current motion's progress is within tolerance of time (default 0.05 when -1), then stops turning.

4c060773d82e69b2.name: wander_or_wait_for_target
4c060773d82e69b2.doc: Idle behaviour: backs away from walls, returns toward home if far from it, otherwise randomly stands waiting for the player, circles the target, or walks in a random direction. Returns 1 if the player was detected while waiting.

4c1e9e49d0460db9.name: wait_turn_to_angle
4c1e9e49d0460db9.doc: Waits while the monster turns toward the given angle, until it is within tolerance or the frame limit is reached. Returns the frames waited.

4c625c9b4c4c7eac.name: on_init
4c625c9b4c4c7eac.doc: Registers the attack 1 knockback hit windows, loads the Vanguard shockwave effect, sets a photo window on attack 2 for grade 0 monsters and starts the AI.

4c8bc0f1b78d0a2b.name: pick_idle_movement
4c8bc0f1b78d0a2b.doc: Picks a random idle behavior: turning away from walls, returning toward home, circling the target, or waiting to detect it. Returns 1 if it detected the target.

4c9e16c0fd47c871.name: dash_past_target
4c9e16c0fd47c871.doc: Runs to a point three target-distances ahead, a little below the monster's height, for up to the given number of frames and then stops.

4ca802ea845a4449.name: track_monster_frames
4ca802ea845a4449.doc: Turns to keep facing the given monster for the given number of frames.

4caf1996c5b67517.name: recoil_with_knockback
4caf1996c5b67517.doc: Plays the damage motion with a knockback and waits before standing.

4cbe0db390993cae.name: freeze_for_guard
4cbe0db390993cae.doc: Start of the guard reaction: stops moving and turning (apply_reserved_texture is the old-numbered stop_moving).

4cf10c0c2247bc80.name: fly_sideways
4cf10c0c2247bc80.doc: Flies toward the point 300 units to the monster's right (go_right set) or left, hover_height above the ground. The returned value is never set.

4d0a694aa81ef956.name: run_orbit_attack_loop
4d0a694aa81ef956.doc: Update loop: plays the intro sound once, then loops the play motion while orbiting and runs attack_and_flag_slots every 90 frames.

4d0d1bef92f22fd0.name: run_monster_ai_loop
4d0d1bef92f22fd0.doc: Allows guarding and dodging, then runs the behaviour chooser every frame.

4d1145dde4199417.name: face_target_until_motion_end
4d1145dde4199417.doc: Keeps turning toward the target until the current motion ends.

4d7d31a032ab2753.name: watch_target_while_player_disguised
4d7d31a032ab2753.doc: Stands and keeps turning toward the target as long as the player's disguise is type 2.

4d87d80007ca70ac.name: run_ai_loop
4d87d80007ca70ac.doc: Runs the action choice every frame.

4d8d7f453bce8893.name: wander_or_wait_for_target
4d8d7f453bce8893.doc: Idle flight: flies around home, returns toward home if far from it, or waits for the player, at a height of 30 or 60. Returns 1 if the player was detected.

4d909db0bb4581c8.name: setup_elemental
4d909db0bb4581c8.doc: Registers the M combo 2 attack hits, loads the shot effects for this monster's element, lifts the monster 20 units and starts flying AI with a max height of 45.

4d93c26409cd0a4c.name: hold_still_to_guard
4d93c26409cd0a4c.doc: Holds still in the air while guarding.

4d998d2da526857c.name: set_jet_exhaust
4d998d2da526857c.doc: With enabled set, creates two Pol jet effects owned by the boss and stores their slots in monster variables 3 and 4. Otherwise flags both effects to fade out and stops the jet sound.

4dc8a4d055a9a3d3.name: swing_and_advance
4dc8a4d055a9a3d3.doc: Turns to the target and plays attack 2, tracking it for 10 frames, then moves toward a point 100 units ahead at 2.6 units per frame for 14 frames (about 37 units), stops, finishes the motion and stands 9 frames.

4dd045f520ebca6d.name: wander_when_idle
4dd045f520ebca6d.doc: Idle behaviour while no target is engaged: backs away from walls, walks around its home point, stands watching, or paces around the target, recording the movement type in a monster variable. Returns 1 as soon as the target is detected, otherwise 0.

4dd71014c673e9dc.name: recover_from_throw_and_resume_flight
4dd71014c673e9dc.doc: Recovers from a throw, updates for 10 frames, re-enables scripted movement and resets the motion.

4dea44b2c73b8ed1.name: on_dodge_melee
4dea44b2c73b8ed1.doc: Dodging a melee hit: faces the target and sidesteps around it with invulnerability.

4e139ffb57f595b5.name: lock_and_face_target
4e139ffb57f595b5.doc: Disables guarding and dodging, stops moving and turning, faces the target and sets the action status to 1.

4e25e4dc5e5f3f14.name: get_radius_limits
4e25e4dc5e5f3f14.doc: Reads the movement radius range from monster vars 2 and 3.

4e4b118a99748a78.name: play_guard_reaction
4e4b118a99748a78.doc: Locks interrupts, plays guard in, a knockback guard hit, then guard out and returns to the stand motion.

4e55ad9b23f50b1b.name: set_radius_limits
4e55ad9b23f50b1b.doc: Stores the allowed movement radius range in monster vars 2 and 3.

4e58604df463b33d.name: setup_knockback_attacks
4e58604df463b33d.doc: Registers the knockback hits for attacks 1, 2 and the 3 loop, loads the spin effect, starts the AI and sets the minimum damage that aggroes it to 5 percent of max life.

4e5be944fd15e80a.name: walk_around_target
4e5be944fd15e80a.doc: Turns to face the point radius units from the target at angle_deg around it (0 is the side facing this monster), then walks there at move_speed. If less than 100 units are clear ahead, the walk is cut to the clear distance, and -1 is returned without moving when that is under twice stop_dist. Otherwise waits up to max_frames and returns 1 once the target is within stop_dist, 2 when the walk ends, 0 on timeout, and stops moving.

4e8904bc4117da2a.name: on_update
4e8904bc4117da2a.doc: Allows guard and dodge, clears the action status, then each frame runs the normal AI when the target is within 300 units, the wander behaviour when farther, or the no-rage AI once rage hits are used up.

4ec3501990504408.name: fight_by_distance_range
4ec3501990504408.doc: Loop that returns when the target is beyond 220 units or the rage counter is zero. Circles when others are closer, otherwise picks the far, mid or near action by distance.

4f1aacd2edc51295.name: calc_accel_to_cover_distance
4f1aacd2edc51295.doc: Writes into out_accel the constant acceleration that covers the distance in the given frames from a starting speed, 2(d - v*t)/t^2. Writes 0 if frames is 0.

4f1ac0b53d2cfedb.name: get_angle_side
4f1ac0b53d2cfedb.doc: Compares two angles (radians) and returns 1 when target is more than tolerance counter-clockwise of current, -1 when more than tolerance clockwise, 0 when within tolerance.

4f7a71d185e1aa38.name: attack_at_close_range
4f7a71d185e1aa38.doc: Close-range choice under 75 units: walk-up lunge or turn-and-attack, run-in slash combo or lunge, circling the target, or a dodge backward or sideways.

4f85d613ffa9d410.name: chase_target_facing
4f85d613ffa9d410.doc: Turns to the target, then walks toward it one frame at a time, turning as it goes. Returns -1 when within near_dist, otherwise the frames spent when max_frames runs out.

4f9fc45c26b05e28.name: spit_venom
4f9fc45c26b05e28.doc: Plays the second attack motion, tracks the target until the motion is 0.538 through, then spawns the venom spit effect at the mouth bone moving with velocity (vel_x, vel_y, vel_z) and carrying the monster's attack value. Waits for the motion to end.

4fa55dd0ee9a4494.name: track_target_flickering
4fa55dd0ee9a4494.doc: Turns toward the target for the given frames while flickering the model colour.

4fa91965d33cb121.name: act_at_long_range
4fa91965d33cb121.doc: Long range choice: 10 percent of the time, if fewer than 7 monsters exist, walks up to the target and summons sprouts; otherwise 75 percent of the time walks up to the target. Of the rest, 40 percent looks around (it then tests the result for 1, but look_around_for_target returns 0 on a sighting, so the follow-up chase never comes from a sighting), 30 percent idles watching for the target for up to 75 frames and chases it if seen, and 30 percent stands for 30 frames.

4fb042775e95f077.name: turn_and_walk_forward
4fb042775e95f077.doc: Turns to the angle, then walks the given distance ahead and waits to arrive. Returns the result of waiting for the move.

4fdd0fbe07d40ba5.name: turn_to_face_target
4fdd0fbe07d40ba5.doc: Turns toward the target and waits until facing it. Returns frames used.

4fee6cf779562594.name: act_at_long_range
4fee6cf779562594.doc: Long range behaviour: 45% summon, otherwise walks around the target or stands until it detects the target, then summons.

4ffa303bbb428c5a.name: act_at_close_range
4ffa303bbb428c5a.doc: Close range behaviour: 25% fires the fast shot, otherwise backs away, turning or firing if it has no room.

5003c08c5f846b9e.name: fight_target_before_rage
5003c08c5f846b9e.doc: Normal fight loop while the monster is not yet enraged: picks close, mid or far behaviour from the target distance. Returns when the target leaves 250 units or the rage hits run out.

5012a36358cf1d42.name: wait_motion_time
5012a36358cf1d42.doc: Waits frame by frame until the motion progress is within tolerance of time (0.03 when tolerance is -1) or the motion ends. Returns the frames waited.

5015d7498235f643.name: pick_idle_movement
5015d7498235f643.doc: Picks a random idle behavior: turning away from walls, returning toward home, circling the target, or waiting to detect it. Returns 1 if it detected the target.

50691c5c2dcdedfa.name: sidestep_around_target
50691c5c2dcdedfa.doc: Dodge: becomes undamageable, steps left or right at random and flies for up to 10 frames to the point 60 degrees around the target at the same distance, 25 units above the ground; then waits up to 30 frames for the move to end and stops.

506a9ec47020a6fe.name: dodge_shot_with_side_step
506a9ec47020a6fe.doc: Turns to the target and side steps.

508ca5b9faf3d763.name: start_rose_attack_if_high
508ca5b9faf3d763.doc: Turns to face the target. If the boss is more than 45 units up, plays attack 1, casts the rose barrage and returns 0; otherwise dashes to a random arena point and returns 1.

509a08ed5fdf2132.name: play_damage_until_stop_ends
509a08ed5fdf2132.doc: Stops all actions, plays the damage knockback and keeps waiting until the stop status flags clear, then stands.

50a0b351f360e894.name: on_dodge_melee
50a0b351f360e894.doc: Dodges a melee attack by turning to the target and stepping back away from it.

50bae90b03df9e19.name: wait_turn_watch_target
50bae90b03df9e19.doc: Turns toward angle_deg until reaching it or max_frames pass. Returns -1 at once if the target comes into view (view_dist, half_angle_deg), otherwise the frames used.

50c3306caf357a0e.name: turn_random_side
50c3306caf357a0e.doc: Turns by a random angle to the left or right of the current heading and returns the frames spent. The return sits inside the loop, so only the first try runs and the stand motion afterward never plays.

50c8c499896c1d76.name: choose_wander_action
50c8c499896c1d76.doc: Wander AI. Picks a random idle action: turn away from walls, return toward home, walk around the home point or the target, walk straight, or wait and watch for the player. Sets monster var 0 to 1, 4, 8, 16 or 32 to record which action it chose. Returns 1 when it noticed the target.

50d74ccb0a590976.name: decide_behavior
50d74ccb0a590976.doc: One AI step. Unaggroed: fights if the target is within 330 units, otherwise wanders. Aggroed: fights when close (under 210) with raised defense, charges if farther inside the aggro range, otherwise drops aggro.

510152576e825769.name: recover_from_throw_and_reset
510152576e825769.doc: Recovers from being thrown, waits 10 frames and resets the motion.

511358f53e422d08.name: attack_target_once
511358f53e422d08.doc: Uses attack 1 if the target is within 30 units, otherwise attack 2, then stands briefly.

511e210e79d3d7cb.name: swing_around_target_on_curve
511e210e79d3d7cb.doc: Turns to the target and runs a curved path toward it, bending left or right at random.

5128380f58bc82e8.name: setup_attack_hits_and_ai
5128380f58bc82e8.doc: Registers the normal attack hit (attack 1) and the knockback attack hit (attack 2), then initialises the monster AI.

512a6680c4fcd366.name: choose_wander_action
512a6680c4fcd366.doc: Wander AI. Picks a random idle action: turn away from a wall closer than 49, walk around the home point when more than 300 from it, or turn, walk around the target, walk straight, or wait and watch for the player. Sets monster var 0 to 1, 4, 8, 16 or 32 to record which action it chose. Returns 1 when it noticed the target.

513245fd9a98c810.name: init_charging_swordsman
513245fd9a98c810.doc: Registers the knockback charge hits (attack 1) and the normal attack 2 hit with its sword trail, then sets up the AI.

514fb92dee50cecc.name: walk_around_point
514fb92dee50cecc.doc: Turns toward and moves to a point on a circle of the given radius around (x, y, z), at angle_deg from the line to the monster.

5163e951aed8639c.name: dodge_melee_by_step
5163e951aed8639c.doc: Dodges a melee attack by turning to the target and either stepping back or sidestepping, then allows guard and dodge again. The roll call passes only the result variable, so get_random_int fails and the choice is fixed by the uninitialised roll rather than being 50/50.

516ba9820bc53d9c.name: play_guard_knockback
516ba9820bc53d9c.doc: Locks interrupts, plays the guard knockback motion for 8 frames and unlocks.

516d2228ad8270b2.name: fire_feather_volleys_fast
516d2228ad8270b2.doc: Same as the normal volley attack with shorter gaps between feathers. Sets monster var 30 to 1.

516f4fd594afe99a.name: run_ai_loop
516f4fd594afe99a.doc: Allows guard and dodge, then each frame ignores a disguised player, reads the target situation and acts on it.

51bc4ccd42910b25.name: attack_at_close_range
51bc4ccd42910b25.doc: Under 80 units it either swings repeatedly (when the target is within 50 units) or spits a short venom shot.

51cd1e832e0eaa4e.name: on_dodge_shot
51cd1e832e0eaa4e.doc: Blocks a shot with the guard knockback motion for 8 frames.

51df6af99c6bbfb4.name: walk_around_target
51df6af99c6bbfb4.doc: Walks to the point radius units from the target at angle_deg around it, returning -1 if that path is blocked. Otherwise returns the result of wait_move_until_near.

52059d32849b99a0.name: guard_hit
52059d32849b99a0.doc: Stops and plays the guard knockback.

520bed4885468942.name: get_blown_away_then_stunned
520bed4885468942.doc: Heavy hit reaction: makes the monster damageable, forbids guarding and dodging and halts it, plays knocked-flying, blown-away loop and get-up, then the faint motion until the stun stars run out and guarding and dodging are allowed again.

52155cb590fe0ec7.name: wait_move_until_near
52155cb590fe0ec7.doc: Waits for the current move to finish. Returns 1 if the target came within stop_dist, 2 if the move ended, 0 after max_frames.

5273fbb5d9952652.name: on_init
5273fbb5d9952652.doc: Loads the gear arrow and gear poison arrow effects into a free texture block and starts the monster AI.

5282e8968fc64ae7.name: wait_frame_tracking_damage
5282e8968fc64ae7.doc: Passes the turret's damage to the hull, then waits a frame. Used in place of a bare wait by all the helpers below.

528a77ec15711969.name: play_death_and_halt
528a77ec15711969.doc: Plays the death motion, finishes the death and halts.

528c6fa6ee7d96aa.name: wait_motion_time_updating
528c6fa6ee7d96aa.doc: Updates the boss each frame until the motion progress is within tolerance of the given time or the motion ends. Returns the frames waited.

5291dd3fe47e1473.name: walk_toward_target
5291dd3fe47e1473.doc: Turns to the target, then walks 100 units straight ahead when the 100 units ahead are clear; returns -1 when anything is closer (and stop_dist is above 0). Otherwise returns the result of wait_move_until_near.

529b90215a208513.name: attack_at_far_range
529b90215a208513.doc: Far-range choice: long-range fireball, approach, or circle the target and wait.

52c8f9f11b2080e4.name: pounce_at_target
52c8f9f11b2080e4.doc: Turns to the target and plays attack 2 while stepping toward it at 6.2 units per frame for about 16 frames, then holds about 19 more frames and stands for 9.

52e9212d6bd3aff0.name: swing_sword_once
52e9212d6bd3aff0.doc: Faces the player and does the first sword swing (attack 1) while tracking the player, then returns to standing.

530af435ea3cdab9.name: walk_at_target
530af435ea3cdab9.doc: Walks toward the target for up to 240 frames.

530c35ef0529f045.name: run_rush_attack_loop
530c35ef0529f045.doc: Repeats the rush-and-explode step every frame.

530faf6edd611fc3.name: run_waypoint_route_toward_target
530faf6edd611fc3.doc: Used when the target stands on raised ground. Picks the entry point nearest to the target out of four, then runs the boss along a fixed four-point route in the arena, stopping when the target comes within 120 units or the route ends.

533ffb74245eac52.name: turn_to_target_limit
533ffb74245eac52.doc: Turns toward the target at turn_speed_deg and waits up to max_frames frames for the heading to be reached, then stops turning. Returns the frames waited.

5348b3b7ced17ea8.name: play_guard_knockback
5348b3b7ced17ea8.doc: Plays the guard motion with a small push back and holds for 8 frames while interrupts are locked.

534d3e4e8d30c1c0.name: turn_to_target_wait
534d3e4e8d30c1c0.doc: Turns to face the target and waits until the turn finishes.

53657ae433ca8905.name: idle_until_disguise_ends
53657ae433ca8905.doc: Stands and turns to face the target while the player is disguised, and returns once the disguise is gone. The argument is unused.

538791e027f7867f.name: chase_target
538791e027f7867f.doc: Turns toward the target and moves at it each frame for up to max_frames, returning -1 once within stop_dist and otherwise the frames used. Does not turn to face first, unlike turn_then_chase_target.

53bb463ae0ff01dd.name: setup_combo_attacks
53bb463ae0ff01dd.doc: Registers the M combo 2 attack hit windows for attack 1 and attack 2 and starts the AI.

53c04a63a056e52c.name: wait_until_facing_angle
53c04a63a056e52c.doc: Waits while turning until the yaw is within tolerance of the angle, shaking the camera lightly on footsteps.

53e55bd953de0a8b.doc: Registers four normal-attack hit windows on attack 1, loads the three thunder shot effects, raises the monster 20 units, sets up flying (max height 45) and starts the monster AI.

5401249d9906158a.name: play_idle_taunt
5401249d9906158a.doc: Plays the play motion and waits for the target to come into view.

5402a3eb0876062a.name: run_lin_caught_game_over
5402a3eb0876062a.doc: Runs event script 520, the boss-defeat game over that d03b02 plays when a monster reaches Lin, and waits a frame.

54156da686b801da.name: choose_idle_movement
54156da686b801da.doc: Picks the next idle move at random: turn away when there is no room ahead, return toward home when far from it, circle the target, or move toward it. Sets monster variable 0 to the move chosen. Returns 1 when it detects the target.

542d32563921249b.name: face_target_while_disguised
542d32563921249b.doc: Idle loop for a monster while the player is disguised: keeps standing and turns toward the target when it is more than 60 degrees off. Returns once the player is no longer disguised.

54310ec0265ec8cd.name: walk_toward_target
54310ec0265ec8cd.doc: Walks toward the target for up to 240 frames, then stands.

54474be7cf9ea8a5.name: fly_backward
54474be7cf9ea8a5.doc: Flies backward away from the monster's facing direction using the given speed and hover height.

548730bb90faddaf.name: turn_to_random_side_angle
548730bb90faddaf.doc: Picks a random angle left or right of the current heading and turns to it. It returns after the first turn.

548753549bbd3e36.name: run_fight_loop
548753549bbd3e36.doc: Main loop: fights when the target is within 190 units, otherwise wanders.

548bfddd0fd1f194.name: swing_attack_1_then_2_late
548bfddd0fd1f194.doc: Plays attack 1 and switches to attack 2 at 52.8 percent of the first motion.

549145e238c76ed2.name: wait_turn_to_angle
549145e238c76ed2.doc: Waits up to max_frames, updating aggro each frame, for the monster to face angle_deg within 3 degrees (the check meant to widen this to the turn speed compares radians with 3.0, so it never does) or for get_angle_side to report it within the turn speed, then stops turning. Returns the frames waited.

54aa37c93eb9266a.name: fight_while_enraged
54aa37c93eb9266a.doc: Enraged behaviour: claws or shoots fire at close range, runs at the target otherwise. Returns when the rage counter is above zero again.

54b0bef0fa35b6aa.name: strafe_or_wait_for_target
54b0bef0fa35b6aa.doc: Half the time walks to a point 90 to 120 units from the target, 30 to 60 degrees to a random side, then faces it; otherwise stands and waits up to 30 frames for the target to come into view.

54b9b7cff94c14f9.name: fight_target_by_range
54b9b7cff94c14f9.doc: Calm fight loop, used while rage hits remain: runs the user monster mode, returns when the target is beyond 240, and picks the far, mid or close range behaviour by distance.

54d594641ee81966.name: block_shot_with_guard
54d594641ee81966.doc: Raises the guard, plays the guard knockback and lowers the guard again.

54f2d9098e4a251d.name: play_short_damage_stun
54f2d9098e4a251d.doc: Locks interrupts, plays the damage motion for 3 frames, then stuns and unlocks.

54fe807a89e38028.name: face_target_while_disguised
54fe807a89e38028.doc: Idle loop for a monster while the player is disguised: keeps standing and turns toward the target when it is more than 60 degrees off. Returns once the player is no longer disguised.

5500626783015c4f.name: chase_target
5500626783015c4f.doc: Moves toward the target for up to max_frames, turning as it goes. Returns -1 when within stop_dist, otherwise the frames used.

5503cf1b2987be76.name: fly_toward_target
5503cf1b2987be76.doc: Turns to the target, then flies to where it stood, hovering above the ground. Returns 1 on arrival, a blocked code if stopped, or 0 on timeout.

55259dc0269f702c.name: hold_damage_pose_while_stopped
55259dc0269f702c.doc: Stop-status handler: cancels all actions, plays the damage motion with no knockback and holds it until the stop status bits (8 and 0x20) clear, then returns to the stand motion. Prints a debug line.

5532c7753feeb4a2.name: play_shockwave_charge_attack
