5532c7753feeb4a2.doc: Turns to the target and plays attack 1, tracking it for 12 frames, then lunges toward a point 100 units ahead at 5.4 units per frame for 14 frames (about 75 units) and releases the Vanguard shockwave from the chn76 frame. The monster does not dodge attacks while it runs.

553fe44a9a296d73.name: finish_throw_recovery
553fe44a9a296d73.doc: Recovers from being thrown, waits 10 frames and resets the motion.

5541ba0b674cc233.name: fight_at_mid_range
5541ba0b674cc233.doc: Mid range choice: charges, walks closer, backs away slowly or stands and watches.

5542002e31debd32.name: fight_at_long_range
5542002e31debd32.doc: Long range choice: sidestep around the target, play idly, stand watching the target, or throw bombs.

555f06fdb241beab.name: run_ai_loop
555f06fdb241beab.doc: Runs the action choice every frame.

556deee6ec762550.name: track_target_until_time
556deee6ec762550.doc: Keeps turning toward the target until the current motion reaches the given progress. A tolerance of -1 means 0.05.

558027468baea04f.name: on_init
558027468baea04f.doc: Registers the claw hit boxes and sword trails, loads the dragon fire shot effects into a free texture block, and starts the monster AI.

558b67d456db067f.name: wait_turn_watch_target
558b67d456db067f.doc: Waits while turning toward the angle but returns -1 as soon as the target is in view. Otherwise returns the frames waited.

559d326980cd4f29.name: chase_target_in_flight
559d326980cd4f29.doc: Keeps flying toward the live target position, facing it (tilting up and down when tilt is set). Returns 1 on arrival, a blocked code if stopped, or 0 on timeout.

55a2f7e94d12fb51.name: turn_to_monster_until_motion_progress
55a2f7e94d12fb51.doc: Keeps turning toward another monster until the motion reaches the given progress, within the tolerance (default 0.05).

55b2f00f7ecb297a.name: on_knockdown
55b2f00f7ecb297a.doc: Plays the damage knockback inside a locked action.

55b621f131a5e93d.name: face_target_until_motion_progress
55b621f131a5e93d.doc: Keeps turning toward the target until the motion progress is within the tolerance of the given value (default 0.05).

55c93ed5741fce9c.name: choose_fight_or_wander
55c93ed5741fce9c.doc: One decision step. While the monster is not enraged (rage hits left above 0) it fights within 290 flat units or wanders when not aggravated, and when aggravated fights within 180, charges inside its aggro range or drops the aggro; once enraged it runs the enraged fight loop.

55d54ec18260f089.name: wait_turn_watch_target
55d54ec18260f089.doc: Like wait_turn_to_angle, but gives up and returns -1 as soon as the target comes into view.

55f11e3486a86e3e.name: run_boss_loop
55f11e3486a86e3e.doc: Boss entry: on first run it becomes invincible, scales to 8 and flies up into place, then loops swimming while updating the boss every frame.

560563000b2f37d4.name: turn_to_face_target
560563000b2f37d4.doc: Walks in place while turning toward the target until it is facing it.

56080abaadbbcbf7.name: recover_from_stun_and_fly
56080abaadbbcbf7.doc: Plays the faint motion until the stun ends, then resumes flight and re-enables guard and dodge.

5611bc9829e170fd.name: pick_mid_range_action
5611bc9829e170fd.doc: Mid range choice: usually approaches and attacks with cross cutter or lunge, or closes in on the target, or taunts first.

561f17e6b398c26d.name: circle_arena_then_cast
561f17e6b398c26d.doc: Moves relative to the arena center at (-2195, 488, -475). Below 40 percent life it does a moonsault to the arena edge. Otherwise it circles around the arena, then casts magic.

5628a689d8e6a49d.name: turn_and_fly_in_direction
5628a689d8e6a49d.doc: Turns to a heading in degrees, then flies the given distance along it. Returns the result of fly_straight_to_point.

562b6968b0c26fca.name: run_frame_with_aggro_and_defense
562b6968b0c26fca.doc: Updates aggro from damage, counts down the aggro timer and clears aggro when it ends, refreshes the defense rate and waits one frame. Called every frame by all the waiting helpers.

56319bf3798e739b.name: stand_still_for_frames
56319bf3798e739b.doc: Stops moving, plays the stand motion and waits the given frames.

56522ac7c7db006d.name: fight_while_rage_hits_remain
56522ac7c7db006d.doc: Fight loop while rage hits remain: picks the long, medium or close range behavior by target distance. Returns when the target is past 800 or no rage hits remain.

5655045bcbfbc98a.name: jump_into_magma
5655045bcbfbc98a.doc: Walks toward the magma pool nearest the player, jumps in with a splash and settles into the magma stand pose, switching to the dripping effect and heating the skin (full defense). With wait_frames_2 nonzero it then watches for the target. Returns 0 on diving in, 1 if it was already in magma.

5660011eb1483a7f.name: turn_until_facing_angle
5660011eb1483a7f.doc: Waits, ticking the fight tracking, while the monster turns until its yaw is within tolerance_deg (or at least 3 degrees) of angle_deg or max_frames pass, then stops turning. Returns the frames waited.

566fe75a3fc27253.name: fly_around_target
566fe75a3fc27253.doc: Flies to a point at the given angle and radius around the target, turning toward it first.

5677ed1bcb7fb346.name: step_back_from_target
5677ed1bcb7fb346.doc: Plays the step back motion and moves to a point 25 to 40 units farther from the target than now.

567ed40dac4355d9.name: fight_target_by_distance
567ed40dac4355d9.doc: Enraged fight loop, used once no rage hits remain: shoots ice balls, guard-charges and sidesteps depending on distance until the target is farther than 240.

5687cef74dc29559.name: act_at_close_range
5687cef74dc29559.doc: Calm close-range choice: mostly swings (or walks toward the player when over 50 units), sometimes walks up quickly or strafes sideways.

568acb02f9a6049b.name: on_update
568acb02f9a6049b.doc: Allows guard and dodge, clears the action status, then runs the AI step every frame.

568f7fe053c319ab.name: sidestep_around_target
568f7fe053c319ab.doc: Plays a random left or right step and moves 30 degrees around the target at the same distance, taking no damage while the motion starts.

56a1bcca447058ce.name: spit_fire_shot
56a1bcca447058ce.doc: Plays attack 2 while tracking the target, spawns a fire shot at the face point at 0.592 of the motion and the looping fire shot at 0.608, passing the monster's attack value to the second.

56a3da6bac2df3de.name: choose_behaviour
56a3da6bac2df3de.doc: Per-frame decision. While rage hits remain it fights, wanders or chases depending on aggro and distance. With none left it uses the post-rage fight behaviour.

56a7ebcc3cb171b1.name: run_ai_step
56a7ebcc3cb171b1.doc: One AI decision: idles or wanders when the target is far, acts on the situation flags when it is near, and runs after it when aggro.

56ca3b75f08cae9b.name: get_knocked_flying_and_recover
56ca3b75f08cae9b.doc: Plays the knocked-flying and get-up motions, waits out the stun and returns to flying.

56d600e9e2d5916b.name: update_and_wait
56d600e9e2d5916b.doc: Runs the per-frame life bookkeeping, then waits one frame. Every blocking helper in this script ticks through here.

56ea00c3608a438a.name: calc_turn_frames
56ea00c3608a438a.doc: Returns how many frames a turn to the angle takes at turn_speed (absolute angle difference over speed).

56ec35fc8d8b2b74.name: step_back
56ec35fc8d8b2b74.doc: Plays the step back motion and moves 40 units backward.

56ee62b16059a6a3.name: fade_out_and_reappear_on_arena_edge
56ee62b16059a6a3.doc: Fades the boss out over 96 frames, moves it to a random spot 500 units from the centre, resets the scale and fades back in, restoring the damage rates of the current form.

56f0892759522cd2.name: fly_toward_heading
56f0892759522cd2.doc: Flies a distance along an absolute heading in degrees without turning first.

56fa9db0026a3941.name: attack_at_far_range
56fa9db0026a3941.doc: Far-range choice: run at the target, walk toward it, or stand watching.

570c1c24f96ff761.name: track_target_frames
570c1c24f96ff761.doc: Turns toward the target every frame for the given number of frames, then stops turning. Despite the parameter name, turn_speed_deg goes to the turn unconverted, so it is in radians per frame; the values callers give, such as 4.2, make the monster face the target almost at once.

572ef22fbdb4b4c5.name: explode_nose_bomb
572ef22fbdb4b4c5.doc: Kills the monster silently and spawns the robot missile explosion carrying its attack, setting the effect's owner to 0 if the player had lifted it (var 1). Then halts.

5733d64b781c4bf7.name: wait_target_in_view
5733d64b781c4bf7.doc: Waits up to max_frames for the target to come within max_dist and half_angle_deg of the front. Returns 1 when seen, 0 on timeout.

57bb5017b782d74e.name: hold_guard_until_threatened
57bb5017b782d74e.doc: Keeps the guard stance until the target comes within 90 units moving fast, then drops the guard and may charge. Re-raises the guard if the flag was set. Returns on aggro or no rage hits left.

57e98351fc0e9e33.name: pulse_skin_and_set_heat
57e98351fc0e9e33.doc: Flickers the skin from bright to dark for 10 cycles, then sets it bright with full defense when heated, or dark with defense halved when cooled.

5807d8e85e1c96bc.name: return_to_orbit_position
5807d8e85e1c96bc.doc: Flies the light in 60 frames to its orbit point around the owning monster (monster var 31), computed from the orbit angles in monster vars 0 to 2.

5819601fa3ec4174.name: fly_around_point
5819601fa3ec4174.doc: Flies to a point at the given radius and angle around a fixed centre, such as its home point.

581e5854ded9467a.name: get_pos_around_target
581e5854ded9467a.doc: Writes the point dist units from the target, at angle_deg around it measured from the monster's side, to the three output arrays.

582a21d006d68a04.name: swing_arms_with_shockwaves
582a21d006d68a04.doc: Plays attack 2, spawning a pair of Griffon sweep effects at the right claw and then at the left claw, each travelling sideways.

582bccf73f595b15.name: fight_at_long_range
582bccf73f595b15.doc: Long range choice: mostly approaches, stands and watches, plays, or circles the target, with a 20% chance of a dash attack.

5830b892d2a7ee24.name: fly_to_far_side_of_target
5830b892d2a7ee24.doc: Flies the ship to a point 1000 units from the origin in the target's direction at height 300, facing the orbit angle.

589242d34bef050e.name: charge_with_attack_2
589242d34bef050e.doc: Faces the player and does attack 2 with a charge toward the player, then stands.

589b9525cb0878c4.name: on_update
589b9525cb0878c4.doc: Every frame fights if the target is within 180 units, otherwise picks a wander action.

58a44d20ec93fa70.name: turn_then_chase_target_updating
58a44d20ec93fa70.doc: First turns to face the target, then walks toward it at its own height each frame, updating the boss, until within stop_dist (returns -1) or max_frames pass.

58aa37d7a115da06.name: chase_until_target_close
58aa37d7a115da06.doc: Walks toward the target, or stands waiting, until the target is within 240 units.

58b1dbf364dfe634.name: track_monster_until_time
58b1dbf364dfe634.doc: Turns toward another monster every frame until the motion progress is within tolerance (default 0.05 when -1) of time, then stops turning.

58b961dbb6d31608.name: wait_frames_update
58b961dbb6d31608.doc: Waits the given number of frames, keeping the model lighting matched to the rage state each frame.

58b9f9e166bdc921.name: chase_target
58b9f9e166bdc921.doc: Chases the target, turning and moving toward it every frame, for up to max_frames. Returns -1 when it gets within stop_dist, else the frames used.

58ccb1a9ff5b76a3.name: wait_motion_progress
58ccb1a9ff5b76a3.doc: Waits until the motion reaches the given progress (0 to 1) within the tolerance, default 0.03, or ends. Returns the frames waited.

58d2e68f43b3f4b0.name: step_normal_ai
58d2e68f43b3f4b0.doc: Normal AI step while rage hits remain: handles a disguised player, then picks a long, mid or close range action by flat distance to the target, or strafes when busy.

58defad1a3b6714d.name: act_at_medium_range
58defad1a3b6714d.doc: Medium range choice: summon sprouts, approach, wander or wait for the target.

59123db1a53bf34c.name: breathe_scale_powder
59123db1a53bf34c.doc: Turns toward the player and releases butterfly scale powder twice over 120 frames. Always returns 2: the split check after the turn never fires, because turn_to_yaw_at_current_height always returns 0.

591d4116f243c7e8.name: pick_far_range_action
591d4116f243c7e8.doc: Chooses an action for a target 180 to 270 units away: usually walk closer, sometimes wander.

592f16e6536a5a69.name: walk_around_target
592f16e6536a5a69.doc: Turns to face the point radius units from the target at angle_deg around it (0 is the side facing this monster), then walks there at move_speed. Only move_speed + stop_dist units ahead are probed: if less is clear, the walk is cut to the clear distance, and -1 is returned without moving when that is under twice stop_dist. Otherwise waits up to max_frames and returns 1 once the target is within stop_dist, 2 when the walk ends, 0 on timeout, and stops moving.

593c3c3672349b65.name: fly_around_target
593c3c3672349b65.doc: Flies to a point at the given angle and radius around the target.

593d95c1f2a83a98.name: wait_move_end
593d95c1f2a83a98.doc: Waits until the current move has ended.

59645858e58a329e.name: walk_in_direction
59645858e58a329e.doc: Meant to turn to the world heading angle_deg and walk dist units along it (at least the walk speed + 1), returning 1 if the target comes within stop_dist, 2 when the walk ends, 0 after max_frames. Despite the parameter names, the first argument is the turn speed in degrees and the second the walk speed, and a heading below the turn speed (including every negative heading) is first increased by the turn speed. This copy uses an old call numbering, so its position, move and stop calls do not do what they are meant to.

5972c8036bf4fdd6.name: idle_if_player_disguised
5972c8036bf4fdd6.doc: If the player is disguised, runs the disguised idle behaviour for this monster kind.

598a32237237c348.name: finish_death_and_idle
598a32237237c348.doc: Finishes the death handling and idles forever.

59949cef01d064d1.name: fly_in_direction
59949cef01d064d1.doc: Turns to angle_deg, then flies distance units along it at height above the ground. Returns the result of fly_to_point.

59a0476565a7957f.name: turn_to_target_limited
59a0476565a7957f.doc: Turns to face the target, waiting at most max_frames.

59ab782492879e3f.name: turn_toward_target_while_spinning
59ab782492879e3f.doc: Plays the left or right spin motion according to which side the target is on and turns to face it.

59d552943344e72b.name: scan_left_and_right
59d552943344e72b.doc: Turns swing_deg left and right in a four-step pattern, standing and watching for the target at each stop. Returns 0 as soon as the target is seen.

59ecdbc91307d138.name: rush_at_target_then_spit
59ecdbc91307d138.doc: Turns to the target, runs at it, and 70 percent of the time spits sticky goo on arrival.

59faa4ea9461fc47.name: choose_mid_range_action
59faa4ea9461fc47.doc: At mid range it shoots a water ball (60%), turns and chases, circles the target at a random side angle or strafes sideways.

5a30386106e3ff6d.name: act_at_close_range
5a30386106e3ff6d.doc: Calm close-range choice: swing or charge, strafe around the player or step back.

5a3c15d9074ca8dd.name: sidestep_for_distance
5a3c15d9074ca8dd.doc: Plays the walk-right or walk-left motion and moves up to distance units to that side, until the target comes within stop_distance or max_frames pass. The clearance is measured straight ahead along its facing, not to the side: if less than 100 units ahead are clear, distance is reduced by the clear amount and it returns -1 without moving when that leaves less than stop_distance. Otherwise the return value is undefined.

5a579fc86fc495c6.name: move_until_near_or_done
5a579fc86fc495c6.doc: Waits while a move runs. Returns 1 if the target comes within stop_dist, 2 once the move reaches its point, 0 if the frame limit runs out.

5a5a7a3e08ff05fe.name: turn_to_angle_and_wait
5a5a7a3e08ff05fe.doc: Starts turning to an absolute angle in degrees at the given speed and waits until facing it. Returns the frames waited.

5a6650b1348046b9.name: on_update
5a6650b1348046b9.doc: Allows guard and dodge and runs one decision step every frame.

5a70ecc765904221.name: walk_to_point_around_center
5a70ecc765904221.doc: Turns toward and walks to a point on a circle around the given center.

5a9bc72820b8e805.name: side_walk_toward_target
5a9bc72820b8e805.doc: Moves toward the target position with the side walk motion, until within the stop distance or the frame limit.

5a9e8d5cd37fe4ce.name: fire_butterfly_beam
5a9e8d5cd37fe4ce.doc: Rises to height 1050 facing the player, aims and sweeps a beam toward where the player stood over 60 frames, dropping a rainbow fire pillar every 3 frames. Then returns to the orbit height. Returns 5 if the split signal (var 8 = 16) arrives during the rise or the beam; a split during the return flight only cuts that flight short, and the result is 1.

5ab759b214b6fc2f.name: fly_around_point
5ab759b214b6fc2f.doc: Turns toward and flies to a point on a circle around the given center.

5ac1f4518b8de6e3.name: perform_charge_attack
5ac1f4518b8de6e3.doc: Does attack 2: a wind-up, a charging loop of up to 90 frames chasing the target (the knockback hit), then the finishing motions.

5ad01440b47d2c9b.name: circle_arena_dropping_bombs
5ad01440b47d2c9b.doc: Flies to the edge of a circle around the arena center and orbits it for the given number of frames, dropping a bomb monster every 60 frames while fewer than 20 monsters exist. Does nothing when below 30 units of altitude.

5ae057ac699d292d.name: close_in_and_attack_loop
5ae057ac699d292d.doc: Loop that keeps attacking while the target is within 230 units, using run-through slashes or approaches; returns 0 when it leaves. Not called by anything in this script.

5af165dac10d9c81.name: walk_random_direction
5af165dac10d9c81.doc: Turns by a random angle up to angle_range degrees (one side only) and walks base_dist plus move_speed plus a random amount when 100 units ahead are clear, or just the random amount when the clear space is still more than clearance. Returns -1 when the clear space is clearance or less, otherwise the wait_move_until_near result.

5af5b3029ff71146.name: on_dodge_melee
5af5b3029ff71146.doc: Dodge: snaps to face the target, stands and unlocks.

5afef4595d46d49d.name: attack_at_close_range
5afef4595d46d49d.doc: Close-range choice: charge at the target or circle it, resetting the charge flag in monster var 0 afterwards.

5aff88dda1b34aad.name: on_update
5aff88dda1b34aad.doc: Main loop: wanders until the target is within 300, then fights normally, or uses the enraged routine once enraged.

5affa316a56c8262.name: fall_and_stay_stunned
5affa316a56c8262.doc: Plays the flying and get-up motions, then the faint motion until the stun ends.

5b0a87ad3b1734eb.name: on_init
5b0a87ad3b1734eb.doc: Registers the two hit windows of the claw combo and the sword trails of attack 1, loads the dragon fire shot effects and clears the attack var.

5b1244055696f789.name: wait_motion_watch_target_updating
5b1244055696f789.doc: Updates the boss until the motion ends (returns 0) or the target comes into view (returns 1).

5b2ca867b65206b0.name: fight_while_enraged
5b2ca867b65206b0.doc: Combat loop once the monster is enraged. Slashes under 75 units, spits poison at mid range, otherwise mostly poison and sometimes walks up or circles. Returns when it calms down.

5b5402fbdfd9a8e8.name: on_update
5b5402fbdfd9a8e8.doc: Main loop: fights when the target is within 280, otherwise walks, turns and runs toward it.

5b87e5725b3f161a.name: attack_combo_late_second_swing
5b87e5725b3f161a.doc: Attack 1 then attack 2 after 55 percent of the first motion.

5b91c6aeecee5089.name: circle_arena_then_attack
5b91c6aeecee5089.doc: Circles the arena center at radius 800 and height 850, speeding up for 90 frames (to 0.02 rad per frame) and then slowing to a stop. Then returns 6 (scale powder) if the player is within 1000 units, otherwise 2 (beam). Returns 5 on the split signal.

5b99927ec0472945.name: fly_to_point_at_height_updating
5b99927ec0472945.doc: Flies in a straight line to the point while keeping the hover height above ground, updating the boss each frame.

5b9b72a86ff667ff.name: set_aggro_damage_min
5b9b72a86ff667ff.doc: Stores the minimum damage that triggers aggro in monster variable 2 slot 10.

5bb4b7d53f72e79e.name: wait_motion_time
5bb4b7d53f72e79e.doc: Waits frame by frame until the motion progress is within tolerance (default 0.03 when -1) of time, or the motion ends. Returns the frames waited.

5bb7ce94f5a48442.name: track_target_frames
5bb7ce94f5a48442.doc: Turns toward the target every frame for the given number of frames, then stops turning. turn_speed is already in radians here.

5bb810b1ee7435da.name: turn_to_target_limit
5bb810b1ee7435da.doc: Turns toward the target at turn_speed_deg and waits until facing it or max_frames pass. Returns the frames used.

5bbdce1672f2847b.doc: Registers the hit boxes for attack 1, loads the three water shot effects, lifts the monster 20 units, sets flying limits (max height 45) and starts the monster AI.

5bd3c27fa4440e77.name: wait_motion_time
5bd3c27fa4440e77.doc: Waits until the motion progress is within tolerance of time (0.03 when tolerance is -1) or the motion ends. Returns the frames waited.

5be207b9eeee750d.name: fight_loop_while_enraged
5be207b9eeee750d.doc: Fight loop once no rage hits are left (enraged); returns when rage hits are available again. Within 120 units it picks one of the three attacks, farther out it mostly walks toward the target, sometimes strikes, and sometimes strafes beside it three times.

5bfbbde8167906c7.name: walk_to_point_around_target
5bfbbde8167906c7.doc: Walks to a point on a ring around the target at the given angle, returning -1 if the path is too short.

5c090eb2ab20d3a1.name: wander_when_target_far
5c090eb2ab20d3a1.doc: Idle behaviour while the target is not close: turns away from walls, wanders around its home point, circles the target, waits to notice the target, or walks off in a random direction. Returns 1 when the target is detected.

5c0d6a89d26cf0ed.name: run_butterfly_states
5c0d6a89d26cf0ed.doc: Main loop that dispatches on the state global: 1 wait for the round to start, 2 fly to the start slot, 3 fire a sticky ball and regroup above the centre after a reset, 6 hover, 5 dodge to a new slot, 0 end.

5c1fdf4fda5e74c4.name: shoot_curse_bullet
5c1fdf4fda5e74c4.doc: Aims at the target, then fires a curse bullet (launch effect, then loop effect) from the dcol0 bone using the second attack.

5c270c60382bdd36.name: turn_to_target_wait
5c270c60382bdd36.doc: Turns to face the target and waits until the turn finishes.

5c2d3e943f0b4099.name: teleport_then_rose_attack
5c2d3e943f0b4099.doc: Increments the move counter, teleports and tries the rose barrage.

5c2e97c5b757e619.name: calc_deceleration_for_distance
5c2e97c5b757e619.doc: Writes into out_accel[0] the constant acceleration needed to cover the distance given the start speed over the given frames.

5c3214ee67ce238f.name: fight_target_within_range
5c3214ee67ce238f.doc: Combat loop that returns when the target is beyond 240 units or the rage counter is zero. It picks the wary, long, mid or close range action from the target distance.

5c472eb293e19530.name: fight_by_distance_loop
5c472eb293e19530.doc: Loops while the target is within 400 units, choosing the far, mid or close behaviour by distance. Returns when the target leaves range or no rage hits are left.

5c4fb353f06d3c6f.name: wander_nearby
5c4fb353f06d3c6f.doc: Walks (0.2 units per frame) or runs (0.4) toward a point 20 to 40 units along the line from the monster to the arena centre, measured from dest, which is never initialised (with zeroed locals that is just past the centre), turning toward the centre at 2 degrees per frame with no time limit; then stands.

5c564b3475d04b2a.name: fight_while_calm
5c564b3475d04b2a.doc: Calm combat loop choosing the far, mid or close behaviour by distance. Returns when the player is further than 220 or the monster becomes enraged.

5c74375cf48aac5e.name: walk_in_direction_of_target
5c74375cf48aac5e.doc: Faces the target, then walks up to distance units forward (0), backward (1), left (2) or right (3) of that facing with the matching walk motion, stopping early when the target is within near_dist or after max_frames.

5c7bc16ff3035a13.name: fire_feather_volley
5c7bc16ff3035a13.doc: Meant to play attack 1 and fire four rounds of three Griffon feather L1 effects from the dcol00 bone at the target (one at the bone and one 20 units either way along x), then play the attack-out motion. The motion, target and spawn calls are old-numbered (the motions run as set_life, the spawns as get_monster_grade, set_damage_kind_rate and set_entry_object_size), and the first wait_motion_time can never end, so no feathers are fired and the script waits there forever.

5c9dde7ddbe48eda.name: unlock_interrupts
5c9dde7ddbe48eda.doc: Allows the monster to guard and dodge again by clearing mask flag bits 1 and 2.

5ca3612023bf11c8.name: setup_sword_attacks
5ca3612023bf11c8.doc: Registers the normal attack (attack 1) and weak knockback attack (attack 2) hit windows with sword trails and initialises the AI.

5caa486d69ed3220.name: fight_calm_close_range
5caa486d69ed3220.doc: Close range choice while not enraged: attack when within 50, otherwise approach or circle the target.

5cc2507104c13770.name: fly_in_direction
5cc2507104c13770.doc: Turns to an absolute angle in degrees and flies the given distance that way.

5cec18a1135a86af.name: calc_turn_rate_to_angle
5cec18a1135a86af.doc: Returns the difference between target_angle and the current yaw divided by divisor. The wrap is broken: it adds 2 pi whenever the difference is below pi, so the result is almost always a full turn too large. Nothing calls it.

5cedc59cdae59abc.name: turn_to_angle
5cedc59cdae59abc.doc: Starts turning to a heading and waits until it is reached. Returns the frames waited.

5d0fc04c5ba5be3b.name: sidestep_dodge
5d0fc04c5ba5be3b.doc: Steps 100 units left or right with damage disabled during the move, then stands.

5d4a731125766ace.name: fly_to_start_slot
5d4a731125766ace.doc: Makes the butterfly targetable, places it at height 1050 above the kind 501 monster, records its own formation slot, faces directly away from that slot and flies there, turning around on the way. Returns the flight result (1, 0, 3 or 6) as the next state.

5d5cc664582acacd.name: fire_holy_shot
5d5cc664582acacd.doc: Plays attack 1, tracking the target, and spawns the holy shot launch and loop effects from the dcol0 frame with the monster's attack power.

5d5ec5ee1e50a791.name: fly_to_point_decelerating
5d5ec5ee1e50a791.doc: Meant to fly straight to the point, slowing so it stops there. The position read and set_pos are old-numbered (they run as loop_se_on_monster and set_se_positional), so the monster does not move, and the deceleration is computed from current_speed before it is set. Returns the frames counted.

5d76b453814c5150.name: act_at_medium_range
5d76b453814c5150.doc: Medium range behaviour: 60% ice shot, 12% turn and look, otherwise fly around the target or sidestep.

5d820691710551cf.name: shoot_aimed_arrow
5d820691710551cf.doc: Attack 1. Turns to the target, draws a DE arrow effect, tracks the target for 31 frames and releases the arrow at it.

5d8f669fb52b4fee.name: face_monster_for_frames
5d8f669fb52b4fee.doc: Keeps turning toward another monster for the given number of frames.

5d900cd61d1fbebe.name: setup_aggro_and_clip
5d900cd61d1fbebe.doc: Sets the aggro ranges (500 far, 80 near), initial monster variables, and the clip distance: 35 for a normal monster (also saving its spawn position) and unlimited for a boss.

5da7d84dc1718091.name: slam_ground_shockwave
5da7d84dc1718091.doc: Plays attack 1 and spawns the Griffon shockwave with the monster's attack power, shaking the camera.

5daa2b8080376172.name: stop_all_actions
5daa2b8080376172.doc: Stops moving and turning and resets the motion.

5dc498ca1a130d6d.name: wait_motion_end
5dc498ca1a130d6d.doc: Waits until the current motion finishes, then returns 1.

5dc65e5f5c9a1f9f.name: lock_and_face_target
5dc65e5f5c9a1f9f.doc: Old-numbered copy of lock_and_face_target. The calls meant to forbid guard and dodge, reset the motion and stop moving run as set_visible_monster_limit (left at 2), get_attack and get_home_pos with no outputs, so only stopping the turn, snapping to face the target and the one-frame wait take effect.

5dd48efa5daca9a0.name: turn_to_angle
5dd48efa5daca9a0.doc: Turns to the given heading in degrees at the given turn speed and waits until done. Returns the frames waited.

5dde4d0e6d423062.name: dodge_backward
5dde4d0e6d423062.doc: Becomes immune to damage, plays the step-back motion and heads for a point 100 units behind at 3.4 per frame, but stops moving after about 5 frames (roughly 17 units); stays immune until the motion ends, then stands.

5df4127ac917945b.name: on_update
5df4127ac917945b.doc: Main loop: runs one AI decision every frame.

5df6f69f57b821f8.name: step_back_dodge
5df6f69f57b821f8.doc: Plays the step back motion, invulnerable from frame 6 to frame 20, then returns to standing.

5e0a224ed39889cc.name: wait_motion_status_four
5e0a224ed39889cc.doc: Waits until the motion status reads 4, meaning the motion reached its last frame. Written in the b02a raw numbering, where the call shown as measure_flight_clearance stands for get_motion_status.

5e1b12928a4ae7dc.name: attack_repeat_swing_if_close
5e1b12928a4ae7dc.doc: Attack 1, repeated up to two more times while the target stays within 70 units.

5e209637e56da4f5.name: face_monster_until_time
5e209637e56da4f5.doc: Turns toward another monster every frame until the motion progress is within tolerance (default 0.05 when -1) of time, then stops turning.

5e2455ab7041dd6f.name: play_knocked_down_pose
5e2455ab7041dd6f.doc: Plays the knocked-flying motion for 150 frames and, if get_up is set, the get-up motion and a return to standing.

5e3403a2c3d82f29.name: watch_player_if_disguised
5e3403a2c3d82f29.doc: If the player is wearing a disguise, runs the disguised-player watching state for this monster kind.

5e41c181dfe5a99e.name: recoil_from_hit
5e41c181dfe5a99e.doc: Stops all actions, plays the damage knockback, waits 16 frames and goes back to standing.

5e506bfbbfde2d8e.name: walk_around_point
5e506bfbbfde2d8e.doc: Walks to a point on a circle of radius around the given point, angle_deg off the line from the point back to the monster, after turning to face it. Waits until within stop_dist of the target or max_frames pass and returns the wait result.

5e611863bb810963.name: wait_and_react_to_player_status
5e611863bb810963.doc: Waits up to the given frames, checking the player status every 3 frames. Status 8 can trigger the sky phase (25 percent); status 2 can trigger a curved dash and a melee swing. Returns 1 or 2 for those, else 0.

5e73f1ae8eb0368b.name: turn_to_target_wait
5e73f1ae8eb0368b.doc: Turns toward the target at turn_speed_deg and waits up to 360 frames for the turn to finish. Returns the frames used.

5e7d66fdfbfe7f0e.name: move_to_ring_position
5e7d66fdfbfe7f0e.doc: Instantly places the boss at a ring slot and records it as the current slot.

5e9b9e8cccb7966a.name: walk_along_angle_without_turning
5e9b9e8cccb7966a.doc: Moves the given distance along a world angle in degrees without turning, and waits for the move to end.

5ea4f4f31ed89ee1.name: fight_with_rage_hits_left
5ea4f4f31ed89ee1.doc: Fight loop used while rage hits are left: picks the close, mid or long range behaviour from the target distance. Returns when the target is beyond 250 units or the rage hits run out.

5eb91e5bd8bc959d.name: wander_while_idle
5eb91e5bd8bc959d.doc: Idle behaviour while no target is engaged: turns away from a wall closer than 42, flies in a circle around its home point when more than 300 from it (moving home to its position at the target's height plus 40 beyond 800), and otherwise randomly stands watching, turns, circles the target or flies around. Returns 1 when a target is detected.

5ebc63e9491f0c84.name: dodge_back_and_counter
5ebc63e9491f0c84.doc: Steps back 35 units invulnerable for 6 frames, then counterattacks with the dodge attack (80% chance with no rage hits left, otherwise 30%) or returns to its stance.

5ebd1558c3e5ffc3.name: on_dodge_melee
5ebd1558c3e5ffc3.doc: Dodge: becomes invulnerable during the dodge in motion, faces the target and almost always follows with a dodge attack.

5ec6e0e47c0872e0.name: run_ai_forever
5ec6e0e47c0872e0.doc: Allows guarding and dodging, then runs the decision logic every frame.

5ede4bbff4f1d038.name: get_ring_position
5ede4bbff4f1d038.doc: Gives the position and facing for slot 0 (center, high) or slots 1 to 6 (evenly spaced around a ring of radius 150 at height 100 around the point 250,250).

5ee1277955480ce8.name: fight_while_enraged
5ee1277955480ce8.doc: Loop for the enraged state that returns when the target is beyond 220 units. Chooses the sword attack when close, the flame shot, walking up or circling.

5efd37d4a4744185.name: approach_distant_target
5efd37d4a4744185.doc: Walks toward the target or waits watching until it comes within 225.

5efe531bdbfdb350.name: split_into_butterflies
5efe531bdbfdb350.doc: Rises to height 1050, flies to the arena center, plays the butterfly merge effect, event 512 (stops music slot 0) and sound 9, and fades the body out over 90 frames, becoming unlockable. Sets monster var 8 to 17 to release the swarm and runs event 511 (starts music slot 1), then after 60 frames sets var 8 to 1 so the first butterfly is next. If monster var 18 is still 0 it runs event 502, the message that the butterfly has split into seven. Returns 4.

5f1af9b4fe36de91.name: walk_around_target
5f1af9b4fe36de91.doc: Turns to face the point radius units from the target at angle_deg around it (0 is the side facing this monster), then walks there at move_speed. Only move_speed + stop_dist units ahead are probed: if less is clear, the walk is cut to the clear distance, and -1 is returned without moving when that is under twice stop_dist. Otherwise waits up to max_frames and returns 1 once the target is within stop_dist, 2 when the walk ends, 0 on timeout, and stops moving.

5f3a510a2104f4d8.name: lob_bomb_then_fuse
5f3a510a2104f4d8.doc: Throws itself in a ballistic arc along its own facing (the direction to the player is computed but overwritten), exploding if the player comes within 30 units and stopping when its speed (2.5, falling 0.04 a frame) runs out after 62 frames, when it drops below the player's height or when it hits a wall; the 120 frame limit is never reached. It then counts down the 195 frame fuse in monster var 2, pulsing blue and swelling up to 1.1 times its size in the last 30 frames, and explodes.

5f43a15d0b1ec762.name: reset_slot_timer
5f43a15d0b1ec762.doc: Stores the current floor timer in monster variable 30 plus slot, restarting that slot's timer.

5f54e2fbd2d0c7d7.name: recover_after_throw
5f54e2fbd2d0c7d7.doc: Recovers from being thrown, waits 10 frames and resets the motion.

5f7c7b2b0b404273.name: fight_while_calm
5f7c7b2b0b404273.doc: Calm fight loop picking far (180 to 290 flat units), mid (120 to 180) or close behaviour, or strafing and waiting when more than three monsters are nearer the player. It never checks the rage count, so it keeps running after the monster is enraged until the player is farther than 290.

5fcd5c2567cbd964.name: wait_target_detected
5fcd5c2567cbd964.doc: Waits up to max_frames until the target is seen or heard. Returns 1 if detected, 0 on timeout.

5fd5b646ab3b4eb5.name: chase_target_on_foot
5fd5b646ab3b4eb5.doc: Runs after the target (speed 3.2, turning 4.2 degrees per frame) for up to 120 frames or until within 40 units, then goes back to standing.

5fee0a1be4f9c697.name: face_target_and_forbid_evasion
5fee0a1be4f9c697.doc: Forbids guard and dodge, resets the motion, stops moving and turning, turns instantly to the target and sets the action status to 1.

60247f111737d6ec.name: run_monster_ai
60247f111737d6ec.doc: Allows guard and dodge, then runs the behaviour pick every frame.

60312b1ffb232e00.name: watch_player_if_disguised
60312b1ffb232e00.doc: Starts watching the player when the player is disguised as another monster.

603626601c237554.name: is_facing_target_rad
603626601c237554.doc: Returns 1 when the monster's facing is within arc/2 radians of the target direction shifted by offset, else 0.

6037f3c856c8c9e6.name: chase_target_straight
6037f3c856c8c9e6.doc: Chases the target position directly while turning toward it. Returns -1 once within the stop distance, otherwise the frames spent.

603bdbdf907014bb.name: pick_near_range_action
603bdbdf907014bb.doc: Close-range choice: swings (attack 1 under 60 units, else attack 2), spin-dashes, or chases the target for up to 90 frames.

60464ac3944b3c5e.name: turn_randomly_then_chase_target
60464ac3944b3c5e.doc: Idle state: turns to a random angle, waits for the target to come into view and then flies after it.

604afd0ed158e7a2.name: hover_in_place
604afd0ed158e7a2.doc: Loops the walk motion and flies toward the point 38 units above the ground under the monster at 2 units per frame, stopping once within 37 units of it or after 120 frames.

6057359ed328804e.name: setup_kotoren_attack
6057359ed328804e.doc: Registers the Kotoren contact attack, resets the monster variables and the floor timer, disables body hits and extends the clip distance.

60652ebd17161a1e.name: fight_target_by_range
60652ebd17161a1e.doc: Loop that returns when the target is beyond 240 units. It wanders if another monster is nearer, otherwise picks the far, mid or near action from the distance.

606bd320502a1ae6.doc: Registers four normal-attack hit windows on attack 1, loads the three wind shot effects, raises the monster 20 units, sets up flying (max height 45) and starts the monster AI.

6084f103aff4ebd9.name: fight_until_rage_hits_left
6084f103aff4ebd9.doc: Fight loop used when no rage hits are left: close range combos and chasing. Returns 0 once rage hits are left.

608eeddd01b83ea0.name: get_monster_var_20
608eeddd01b83ea0.doc: Returns monster variable 20. Not used by this boss.

60992e76d7f60e8f.name: slash_and_step
60992e76d7f60e8f.doc: Turns to the target and plays attack 1, tracking it for 20 frames, then moves toward a point 100 units ahead at 1.75 units per frame for only 5 frames (about 9 units), stops, finishes the motion and stands 9 frames.

60aff763daa7d120.name: fight_by_distance_loop
60aff763daa7d120.doc: Loops while the target is within 230 units, choosing the far, mid or close behaviour by distance. Returns when the target leaves range or no rage hits are left.

60d3b8680b0ded66.name: find_clear_direction
60d3b8680b0ded66.doc: Tests dir_count evenly spaced directions around the monster and returns the first yaw whose free distance is at least min_clear (the spare distance goes to clear_slack[0]), or -100 if none.

61049f50f94e7ac4.name: run_toward_target_until_close
61049f50f94e7ac4.doc: Runs at the target while turning toward it until within 160, occasionally stopping to stand for 10 to 30 frames at random.

610d340dde2c6572.name: fight_target_normally
610d340dde2c6572.doc: Combat loop before the monster is enraged: picks the close, mid or far routine by distance, and returns when the target is farther than 300 or the monster is enraged.

61198d14d088fa02.name: aim_turret
61198d14d088fa02.doc: Turns the turret toward the target at pi/32 per frame, measuring the target's angle from the ship's heading (the yaw of the monster in active slot 0). Turrets 27 to 30 only follow the target on the positive-angle side and otherwise turn to +90 degrees at pi/64; turrets 31 to 34 only follow it on the negative-angle side and otherwise turn to -90 degrees. Returns 0 when it turns to the fixed side.

613df4202ca11dc0.name: approach_target_to_distance
613df4202ca11dc0.doc: Turns to face the target, then each frame turns toward it and walks toward a point move_speed plus stop_dist units ahead of itself in the target's direction, at its own height, checking the death flag. Returns -1 once within stop_dist, otherwise the frames used.

614d123b4ccad7ff.name: walk_random_direction
614d123b4ccad7ff.doc: Meant to turn up to angle_range degrees, but converts the range to radians and then the random turn to radians again, so it turns a whole number of degrees from 0 to about angle_range/57, always to the same side (under 57 it does not turn). If 100 units ahead are clear it walks base_dist + move_speed plus a random 0 to dist_range units; if less is clear but more than clearance it walks just the random amount; otherwise it returns -1 without moving. clearance is also the stop distance of the wait: returns 1 if the target comes within clearance, 2 when the walk ends, 0 after max_frames.

614e1f0fa898eab6.name: walk_toward_target
614e1f0fa898eab6.doc: Walks toward the target for up to 240 frames or until within 50, then stands.

6164d8b094e31263.name: on_land
6164d8b094e31263.doc: After being thrown: recovers, plays get up and returns 1.

6177319e9045d945.name: init_guarding_charger
6177319e9045d945.doc: Registers two knockback attack hits for attack 1 and sets up the AI.

61844a4ad7aafb1a.name: get_up_after_throw
61844a4ad7aafb1a.doc: Recovers after being thrown and returns 1.

61bd81871c3303c5.name: claw_attack
61bd81871c3303c5.doc: Turns to the target, plays attack 1 while tracking it, then stands for 9 frames.

61e10a57d4c0f857.name: guard_with_shield
61e10a57d4c0f857.doc: Monster stops and faces the player, spawns the Giltoni shield effect and plays a guard motion that pushes back, then returns to standing.

61e2b612c58e00f0.name: finish_throw
61e2b612c58e00f0.doc: Recovers the monster from being thrown, waits 10 frames and resets its motion.

61e6b97491bad0a7.name: turn_to_attacker_and_stand
61e6b97491bad0a7.doc: Dodge-melee handler that does not dodge: forbids dodging, snaps to face the target, stands, then allows guard and dodge again.

61eccfd6539ae330.name: begin_knockdown_state
61eccfd6539ae330.doc: Starts a knockdown: forbids guard and dodge, resets the motion, stops turning, disables scripted movement and sets act status 1.

61f510ffc462d9c1.name: finish_being_thrown
61f510ffc462d9c1.doc: Finishes the throw state and returns 1.

6210daa102466f17.name: turn_to_target_limit
6210daa102466f17.doc: Turns toward the target for at most max_frames and returns the frames spent.

6213e85dab7962ae.name: walk_around_target
6213e85dab7962ae.doc: Turns to face the point radius units from the target at angle_deg around it (0 is the side facing this monster), then walks there at move_speed. Only move_speed + stop_dist units ahead are probed: if less is clear, the walk is cut to the clear distance, and -1 is returned without moving when that is under twice stop_dist. Otherwise waits up to max_frames and returns 1 once the target is within stop_dist, 2 when the walk ends, 0 on timeout, and stops moving.

6233f95b1c931a6c.name: act_at_medium_range
6233f95b1c931a6c.doc: Medium range behaviour: fires the fast shot or summons, or backs away.

62451e807ccddf95.name: turn_to_face_shooter
62451e807ccddf95.doc: Forbids defense, snaps to face the target, walks to finish the turn and allows guard and dodge again.

625eb856ab103672.name: move_beside_target
625eb856ab103672.doc: Moves to the point beside the target at angle_deg, returning -1 if the way is blocked. Otherwise returns the result of wait_move_until_near.

626332b962b86b4b.name: attack_at_close_range
626332b962b86b4b.doc: Close-range choice: half the time charges; otherwise beyond 30 units it swings the sword combo, and within 30 units it steps back (60 percent) or sidesteps. The circling branch needs life above 0.25 and equal to 0, so it never runs.

6299ec56bfc16c50.name: wander_or_wait_idle
6299ec56bfc16c50.doc: Idle behaviour while the monster has not noticed the player: walks away from walls, wanders around its home point or around the target, or stands and watches. Returns 1 if the target was detected while standing.

629a839f3f07fa32.name: get_planar_offset
629a839f3f07fa32.doc: Writes the x and z offset of the given length in the direction of a yaw angle (sin and cos) to the two output variables.

62c79ffdc4fa5c1b.name: track_monster_until_motion_progress
62c79ffdc4fa5c1b.doc: Keeps turning toward another monster until the motion reaches the given progress.

62e675761bcab2fa.name: circle_or_wait_at_distance
62e675761bcab2fa.doc: Used when many monsters are closer to the target: waits, circles it, or plays antics.

62ef3fc153b78bde.name: strafe_or_wait
62ef3fc153b78bde.doc: Half the time circles the target at a random angle and radius and faces it; otherwise stands and waits for the target to come into view.

62f095c3e808d57c.name: chase_target_facing
62f095c3e808d57c.doc: Turns to face the target, then each frame walks toward a point move_speed + near_dist ahead in the target's direction, for up to max_frames. Returns -1 once within near_dist of the target, else the frames used.

62f818515cc95191.name: walk_in_direction
62f818515cc95191.doc: Turns to the world heading angle_deg at turn_speed_deg, then walks dist units along it at move_speed (at least move_speed + 1). A heading below the turn speed, including every negative heading, is first increased by the turn speed. Returns 1 if the target comes within stop_dist, 2 when the walk ends, 0 after max_frames.

630f92c05399eaa4.name: set_cutscene_lock
630f92c05399eaa4.doc: When enabled, pauses player stepping and control and turns on the camera lock; when disabled, restores the follow camera and the player controls.

631138f41b3319cf.name: mid_action_before_rage
631138f41b3319cf.doc: Mid-range choice (110 to 160 units) before the monster is enraged: lunge, curse bullet, approach, stand, or side-step.

63197889ed3f28f9.name: run_surface_phase
63197889ed3f28f9.doc: Surface phase loop of four rounds: fires the flame ring from a ring point twice, walks up and roars, then fires from a ring point again. After that it switches to the magma phase (var 9 = 1) with the smoke effect and cooled skin at half defense.

6322d4842b7490bf.name: track_target_until_motion_end
6322d4842b7490bf.doc: Keeps turning toward the target until the current motion ends.

6330cbbdab9b4505.name: walk_random_direction
6330cbbdab9b4505.doc: Meant to turn up to angle_range degrees, but converts the range to radians and then the random turn to radians again, so it turns a whole number of degrees from 0 to about angle_range/57, always to the same side (under 57 it does not turn). If 100 units ahead are clear it walks base_dist + move_speed plus a random 0 to dist_range units; if less is clear but more than clearance it walks just the random amount; otherwise it returns -1 without moving. clearance is also the stop distance of the wait: returns 1 if the target comes within clearance, 2 when the walk ends, 0 after max_frames.

6331c4fcf980cef3.name: hover_while_player_disguised
6331c4fcf980cef3.doc: While the player is disguised as a monster, flies down to 5 units above the ground (up to 150 frames), then only turns to face the target whenever it is more than 90 degrees off, until the disguise ends.

633784b07873f679.name: drop_items_if_dead
633784b07873f679.doc: If monster variable 64 is set, plays the death sequence and drops items.

6345010f27380992.name: recoil_from_hit
6345010f27380992.doc: Clears the queued actions and plays the damage motion with pushback, then lets the monster guard and dodge again.

6356dea7acb18325.name: turn_random_side
6356dea7acb18325.doc: Turns to a random side of the current heading, left or right with equal odds, by a random angle up to angle_range plus 30 degrees. Returns the frames spent.

639e8a509edb37f9.name: get_knocked_flying_then_stun
639e8a509edb37f9.doc: Clears no-damage, forbids guard and dodge and halts, plays the knocked-flying and get-up motions to their ends, then plays the faint motion until the stun stars run out.

63a7a17a83ae4737.name: face_target_and_forbid_evasion
63a7a17a83ae4737.doc: Forbids guard and dodge, resets the motion, stops moving and turning, turns instantly to the target and sets the action status to 1.

63ae6e093c683cf8.name: turn_to_target_until_motion_progress
63ae6e093c683cf8.doc: Keeps turning toward the target until the current motion reaches the given progress, within the tolerance (default 0.05).

63d8f8f66321768d.name: turn_by_angle
63d8f8f66321768d.doc: Turns the model by delta_deg from its current yaw and returns the frames spent.

63e13137f2422235.name: fly_back_then_get_up_stunned
63e13137f2422235.doc: Stun program: makes the monster damageable and halts it, plays the knocked-flying and get-up motions, then faints until the stun stars run out and allows guarding and dodging again.

63e2608efcddef2c.name: wander_while_idle
63e2608efcddef2c.doc: Idle behaviour picked at random: turn away from a wall closer than 64 units, circle the home point when more than 300 from home (resetting home when over 800), stand and watch for the target, turn on the spot, walk around the target, or walk straight ahead up to 1000 units. Sets monster var 0 to the behaviour bit and returns 1 when the target is detected while standing; the random-direction walk branch tests an unset local and never runs.

63ecc51acf5aba7e.name: on_update
63ecc51acf5aba7e.doc: Allows guard and dodge and runs one decision step.

63ed81f2541d148a.name: strafe_or_watch_target
63ed81f2541d148a.doc: Used when another monster has priority: half the time strafes around the target, otherwise stands watching it.

63fb6b68d6fb98b7.name: wait_target_detected
63fb6b68d6fb98b7.doc: Waits up to max_frames, returning 1 as soon as the target can be detected by sight within view_dist and half_angle_deg or by sound within hear_dist at min_speed, else 0.

6402f11ef2c6cbc0.name: approach_target_until_close
6402f11ef2c6cbc0.doc: Walks or runs toward the target while turning, occasionally pausing to turn in place. Returns 0 if the target is beyond 200, and stops when closer than 80.

64311623f7be8bc1.name: is_attack_enabled
64311623f7be8bc1.doc: Returns this piece's shared attack flag.

644238c5349130af.name: turn_to_target_updating
644238c5349130af.doc: Turns to face the target, updating the boss, and returns the frames waited.

6447b1c869d8a078.name: vanish_and_reappear_at_target
6447b1c869d8a078.doc: Plays the dodge motion, becomes unlockable, then after half the frames teleports onto the target's position, waits the other half and plays the dodge return motion, whose hitbox strikes the target.

646edb530b1b46e2.name: strafe_or_wait_for_target
646edb530b1b46e2.doc: Half the time circles the target at about 90 units, otherwise stands watching it.

64750673af4185a4.name: step_back_from_melee
64750673af4185a4.doc: Faces the player and does the backward dodge step.

64793fd848701dbf.name: setup_claw_and_roll_attacks
64793fd848701dbf.doc: Registers the claw hit box and the two rolling knockback hit boxes. Sets a photo window on the rolling attack for grade 0.

64839a2065664c06.name: aim_cannon_at_target
64839a2065664c06.doc: Turns the cannon toward the target at pi/32 per frame, measuring the target's angle from the ship's heading (the yaw of the monster in active slot 0). Cannon 25 only follows the target on the positive-angle side and otherwise turns to +90 degrees at pi/64; cannon 26 only follows it on the negative-angle side and otherwise turns to -90 degrees. Returns 0 when it turns to the fixed side.

6487628b5e8eb07f.name: dodge_step_left
6487628b5e8eb07f.doc: Sidestep to the left, invulnerable from frame 10 to 24 of the step motion, moving at 3.6 per frame (about 50 units). When the target is within 110 units it heads for a point 200 units to its left; otherwise it heads for a point 85 units from the target, 30 degrees to its other side, while turning to face it.

64989e9c161d1b5f.name: act_at_close_range
64989e9c161d1b5f.doc: Close range choice: attack 1 or 2, circle the target, or vanish and reappear.

649b25baf59c2939.name: turn_to_target_random
649b25baf59c2939.doc: Turns toward the target, with offset_chance percent probability of aiming offset_deg to a random side. Waits until done.

64e6f3a4dfd133f7.name: fire_cannon_shot
64e6f3a4dfd133f7.doc: Fires a cannonball from the shot point with a muzzle flash and sound, then keeps aiming for 60 frames (30 when the ship has set monster var 8).

64e887ad938a10d7.name: chase_target
64e887ad938a10d7.doc: Turns toward the target and walks to its position each frame until within stop_dist (returns -1) or max_frames pass.

64e89a3796a692d6.name: turn_and_walk_to_point_around_target
64e89a3796a692d6.doc: Turns toward a point on a ring around the target and walks to it. Returns -1 if the path is too short.

64fd9ce75f184125.name: circle_above_leader
64fd9ce75f184125.doc: Starts the Atlamillia light effect and circles for 150 frames at radius 30 around a point 100 above the leader monster, then sets state var 27 to 64.

651f4f5a413be9a7.name: run_seagra_loop
651f4f5a413be9a7.doc: Per-frame state machine: state 1 slams the ground then goes limp (4); state 4 shows the map part and lies limp until it is hit (which sets the shared shock flag) or, after 210 frames, the partner is over 450 units away; state 2 recovers, with the electrocution effect if the shock flag is set, clears its attack flag and goes idle (3); state 3 or 0 starts an attack once its attack flag is set.

6543e9e0b8481bd9.name: turn_toward_target_until_motion_end
6543e9e0b8481bd9.doc: Keeps turning toward the target until the current motion ends.

6580a5ed2ce70a47.name: chase_target_stopping_short
6580a5ed2ce70a47.doc: Turns to face the target, then each frame walks toward a point speed + stop_dist ahead in the target's direction. Returns -1 once within stop_dist of the target, else the frames used.

65944849001e9114.name: wait_frames_update
65944849001e9114.doc: Runs the shared per-frame update and waits for the given number of frames.

65b2e33b1883593a.name: choose_behavior
65b2e33b1883593a.doc: Per frame decision: fights or wanders when not aggro, rolls at the target while aggro and in range, or runs the no-rage fight loop when no rage hits remain.

65bcf5d7db861021.name: fight_after_rage_hits_spent
65bcf5d7db861021.doc: Fight loop used while no rage hits remain, alternating the lunge slash with chasing. It returns 0 if rage hits are available again.

65c09013cde85932.name: wander_or_wait_for_target
65c09013cde85932.doc: Idle behaviour: turns away from a wall closer than 49, circles its home point when more than 300 from it, otherwise stands waiting for the target, turns, strolls around the target or walks straight ahead. Returns 1 when it notices the target while standing.

65dcdc88b1c8346b.name: on_guard
65dcdc88b1c8346b.doc: Raises the guard, takes a small knockback, waits 8 frames and lowers the guard.

65f19ccb487cc29a.name: guard_facing_target
65f19ccb487cc29a.doc: Snaps to face the target, plays guard in, the guard loop for 30 frames and guard return.

6628c3bd161725fa.name: wander_while_idle
6628c3bd161725fa.doc: Idle behaviour while no target is engaged: turns away from walls, drifts back toward home when far from it, and otherwise randomly stands watching, turns, circles the target or walks around. Returns 1 when a target is detected.

6666243d689200d8.name: choose_combat_or_idle_behaviour
6666243d689200d8.doc: One decision step: while not enraged it fights, idles or runs at the target depending on aggro state and distance (raising guard rate while running); once enraged it fights relentlessly.

666d1298ad341a40.name: setup_robot_boss
666d1298ad341a40.doc: Registers the boss's body parts, its smash and jump-landing attack hits, initial AI variables, the missile and shockwave effects and the photo window, and puts the camera in low player mode.

6670e120e6f2bdb5.name: fight_while_enraged
6670e120e6f2bdb5.doc: Enraged fight loop, used once no rage hits are left: melee or a short venom spit under 80 units, venom spits at longer range. Returns 0 when the target is beyond 280 units.

667e5b7a95d661a5.name: fly_backward
667e5b7a95d661a5.doc: Intended to fly the monster backward, away from the direction it faces. The distance is never set, so the destination ends up at its own x and z. Returns an unset result.

668866ce2e8f3703.name: fly_sideways
668866ce2e8f3703.doc: Flies 300 units to the side of the monster's facing (go_left turns the heading by -90 degrees, which callers pair with the step-right motion) at ground height plus height. The flight result is not captured, so the return value is undefined.

66ae17a11a64aab4.name: walk_up_and_swing
66ae17a11a64aab4.doc: Walks up to the player, turns and swings (attack 1) while tracking, then stands.

66d66a3a40db39c2.name: lock_and_snap_to_target
66d66a3a40db39c2.doc: Locks the monster for a scripted reaction: forbids guard and dodge, resets the motion, stops moving and turning, snaps to face the target, waits a frame and sets act status 1. Unused here.

66f914cd75fb19cf.name: hover_idle_while_player_disguised
66f914cd75fb19cf.doc: Settles to 5 units above the ground under its position (1 unit per frame, up to 150 frames), then idles while the player is disguised, turning to face the target whenever it is more than 90 degrees off; returns when the disguise ends.

670fb5163f9a3b9a.name: chase_and_play_attack_two
670fb5163f9a3b9a.doc: Chases the target, turns to face it and plays attack 2.

671fc6be474dde0e.name: attack_by_distance
671fc6be474dde0e.doc: Chooses an attack by the target distance: under 40 units attack 2 with a Vanguard shockwave, under 60 attack 1, and under 120 a spinning charge (attack 3) at the target. Returns the frames to rest afterwards (30, 30 or 12), or 0 without attacking when the target is 120 or more away.

672b9be3a29388a0.name: step_back_from_melee
672b9be3a29388a0.doc: Faces the target and steps back, then allows guard and dodge.

6730990868c347ad.name: fight_at_mid_range
6730990868c347ad.doc: Mid-range choice (75 to 135 units): usually shoots a thunder shot, otherwise idles, flies around the target or sidesteps.

6740055a0ecdeab5.name: fly_around_point
6740055a0ecdeab5.doc: Flies to a point on a circle of the given radius around the centre, at an angle offset from the bearing to the centre.

6743fd5257526ca2.name: approach_distant_target
6743fd5257526ca2.doc: Loop that returns once the target is within 240 units: side-steps around it, turns toward it or stands watching.

67700b0e55b2300e.name: turn_to_face_target_limited
67700b0e55b2300e.doc: Turns to face the target and waits for the turn, giving up after max_frames.

6776ad830c491ccd.name: wait_target_detected
6776ad830c491ccd.doc: Waits frame by frame up to max_frames until the target is detected by sight or hearing. Returns 1 when detected, 0 on timeout.

67846eb73ae06e3d.name: wait_motion_time
67846eb73ae06e3d.doc: Waits until the motion progress is within tolerance of the given time or the motion ends. Returns the frames waited.

678fa089312fc78c.name: on_dodge_melee
678fa089312fc78c.doc: Dodges a melee attack with a back step while invincible, then counterattacks with the dodge attack (80 percent when enraged, otherwise 30) or recovers.

6791e2a463671b47.name: fight_enraged
6791e2a463671b47.doc: Combat routine once the monster is enraged: dives at the target if it is within 100 on the ground plane, otherwise flies toward it.

679f27a53a123d7e.name: recover_from_throw_and_resume
679f27a53a123d7e.doc: Recovers from a throw, waits 10 frames, turns scripted movement back on and resets the motion.

67b2aede466059f7.name: shoot_fire_ball
67b2aede466059f7.doc: Plays attack 1, tracking the target, and spawns a fire shot from the dcol0 point, then the looping fire shot carrying the monster's attack power.

67d78810e7c34163.name: struggle_forever
67d78810e7c34163.doc: Restarts the struggling motion and idles forever. The call after the loop is never reached.

67ed3178bd90a443.name: wait_target_in_view
67ed3178bd90a443.doc: Waits up to max_frames and returns 1 as soon as the target is within max_dist and inside the half-angle view cone, else 0.

67ed4aba97a3ea3a.name: fight_while_enraged
67ed4aba97a3ea3a.doc: Combat loop once the monster is enraged. Within 75 units it uses the slash combo or the run-up double slash, further out the double or lunge slash, sometimes just runs at the player. Returns when it calms down.

680c7801e2cd3568.name: walk_to_point_around_position
680c7801e2cd3568.doc: Meant to pick the point radius units from the centre on the monster's side, rotated by angle_offset_deg, turn to it and fly there at height_offset above the ground. The angle reads, turn and move calls are old-numbered and reach unrelated natives, so it does not turn or fly there as meant. Returns an unset value.

6810aa2deb45098d.name: turn_to_target_and_wait
6810aa2deb45098d.doc: Turns to face the target at the given speed and waits until it does. Returns the frames waited.

6843431f50c1b623.name: setup_boss
6843431f50c1b623.doc: Makes the boss non-colliding and non-lockable, places it at the arena center high above, and loads the rose, rose hit and tornado effects.

68499694db4737f0.name: fly_to_height
68499694db4737f0.doc: Flies vertically toward the given height. Returns 1 on arrival, a negative flight check result if blocked, or 0 if the frame limit runs out.

68499e91ff631dca.name: walk_around_target
68499e91ff631dca.doc: Turns to face the point radius units from the target at angle_deg around it (0 is the side facing this monster), then walks there at move_speed. If less than 100 units are clear ahead, the walk is cut to the clear distance, and -1 is returned without moving when that is under twice stop_dist. Otherwise waits up to max_frames and returns 1 once the target is within stop_dist, 2 when the walk ends, 0 on timeout, and stops moving.

68a79439c1969ce9.name: wander_or_return_home
68a79439c1969ce9.doc: Idle behaviour when the target is far. It turns away from walls, walks back toward home when more than 300 units away, and otherwise wanders, strafes or stands watching. Sets monster var 0 to a code for the chosen wander kind. Returns 1 if the target is detected.

68d0e69a7fb90b2d.name: get_time_since_mark
68d0e69a7fb90b2d.doc: Returns how many floor timer ticks have passed since monster variable 5 was set by mark_floor_time.

68eac923b9928bee.name: watch_player_if_disguised
68eac923b9928bee.doc: If the player is wearing a disguise, stands and watches the player instead of acting.

68ed3912da763692.name: block_attack_with_guard
68ed3912da763692.doc: Uninterruptible guard: walks while turning to the target, raises its guard, holds for 60 frames, lowers it and returns to standing.

68f2502680c4a176.name: stand_idle_frames
68f2502680c4a176.doc: Stops moving, restarts the stand motion and waits frames frames with the aggro update.

68f973e051bf8cd6.name: choose_far_range_action
68f973e051bf8cd6.doc: At far range it mostly shoots water balls or turns and chases; otherwise it walks and flies toward the target or waits for it to come into view.

68fc2511784aced6.name: fly_sideways
68fc2511784aced6.doc: Flies 300 units to one side of its heading.

6905dfdc82f09bb5.name: choose_behaviour_by_aggro
6905dfdc82f09bb5.doc: Top-level AI step. With rage hits left it fights, wanders when the target is far, or dashes or walks at a target in aggro range; with none left it uses the plain fight loop.

6905fde0ded2e494.name: idle_for_frames
6905fde0ded2e494.doc: Stops moving, restarts the standing motion and waits the given number of frames, running the aggro update.

69167acdb92c90cf.name: fight_while_enraged
69167acdb92c90cf.doc: Enraged loop, run once no rage hits remain: with attack priority above 3 it walks 200 units along world heading 180 or idles 30 frames; otherwise it spits sticky goo, spin-attacks or walks in, and every round ends with a 60 frame run at the target. Its long-range branch reads a distance that is never set. Returns when rage hits are above zero again.

693e9b0627ea6bdd.name: freeze_if_disguised_as_52
693e9b0627ea6bdd.doc: If the player is disguised as monster kind 52, turns to face the target and then waits forever. Otherwise returns.

694726ad00a620cf.name: chase_target_steps
694726ad00a620cf.doc: Turns to face the target first, then chases it like chase_target, moving in steps relative to the monster's own height. Returns -1 when within stop_dist, else the frames used.

694c33484862ade3.name: chase_target_steps
694c33484862ade3.doc: Chases the target one step at a time while turning toward it; returns -1 if it gets within stop distance.

6955cce19a72a82b.name: struggle_forever
6955cce19a72a82b.doc: Stays in the struggle motion while lifted.

695fcbb6296e5447.name: wait_turn_to_angle
695fcbb6296e5447.doc: Waits until the yaw is within the turn speed of the requested angle or max_frames pass, then stops turning. Returns the frames waited.

6964fd9692656c57.name: move_in_direction
6964fd9692656c57.doc: Moves toward angle_deg for dist units without turning first, waiting for the move to end.

6966146792514c47.name: move_random_offset
6966146792514c47.doc: Moves without turning to a point base_dist + move_speed plus up to dist_range units ahead, turned up to angle_range degrees to one side, until the walk ends, the target comes within stop_dist or max_frames pass. Returns the wait_move_until_near result.

696b4ad8ecde1e09.name: run_ai_loop
696b4ad8ecde1e09.doc: Main loop: idle and fight by distance while the rage hits remain, fight enraged once they are used up.

696c5142c6706030.name: hold_damage_pose_until_stop_ends
696c5142c6706030.doc: Stop-status handler: cancels all actions, plays the damage motion with no knockback and holds it until the stop status bits (8 and 0x20) clear, then returns to the stand motion. Prints a debug line.

696cb7082f199d83.name: fly_to_height
696cb7082f199d83.doc: Moves vertically to the given height at speed, stopping on reaching it (returns 1), on a flight obstruction (returns the check_flight_step result), or after max_frames (returns 0).

696ea636b81512d1.name: wait_for_target_in_view
696ea636b81512d1.doc: Waits up to max_frames for the target to enter the view cone. Returns 1 if it did.

69794c9422ba6236.name: run_calm_ai
69794c9422ba6236.doc: AI loop while rage hits remain. Leaves when the target is farther than 280 units or rage hits run out, otherwise picks a long (160 to 280), mid (60 to 160) or close range action by distance.

6994d6c1d330a248.name: on_lifted
6994d6c1d330a248.doc: While the player carries the bomb, stops its movement and runs the fuse (monster var 2) up to 195 frames, flashing red and white with a beep in the last 30. Then it explodes.

69b8e9401f8cd9af.name: setup_elemental_shooter
69b8e9401f8cd9af.doc: Registers the normal attack hit window and loads the shot effects for its element (fire, wind, ice, thunder for grades 0 to 3). Lifts the monster 45 units, makes it a flier with max height 55 and starts the AI.

69cab6e78562d803.name: fight_while_enraged
69cab6e78562d803.doc: Behaviour once enraged: raises the defense rate to 1.2, then swings or slams when the target is under 150 away and otherwise chases it.

69dcf23884c7d14d.name: dive_at_target
69dcf23884c7d14d.doc: Flying monster attack: turns to the target, plays attack 1 while flying to where the target stood, then stands and pauses 9 frames.

69ea6e966c8ec6f5.name: on_guard
69ea6e966c8ec6f5.doc: Turns to the target and plays the guard knockback motion.

6a08c5c254e487f5.name: charge_in_place_tracking
6a08c5c254e487f5.doc: Plays attack 1 in, then holds attack 1 for track_frames frames while turning toward the target, then attack 1 out.

6a1aad9701dff4cd.name: walk_up_and_roar
6a1aad9701dff4cd.doc: Walks up to the player and roars, with fireballs in the later stages.

6a1cedb3ba98a367.name: run_double_speed_ai
6a1cedb3ba98a367.doc: AI loop once rage hits are used up: chases and attacks with doubled chase and some doubled turn speeds, or chases or idles when priority is above 100. target_dist is never read in this function, so the 140 to 240 unit branch tests an unset value. Returns 0 once rage hits are above 0 again.

6a3add11540b66ee.name: on_update
6a3add11540b66ee.doc: Allows guard and dodge, then runs the decision step every frame.

6a54c3ea874b8d25.name: wait_for_motion_end_orbiting
6a54c3ea874b8d25.doc: Waits until the current motion ends while the boss keeps orbiting.

6a66e2d87da0b490.name: walk_sideways
6a66e2d87da0b490.doc: Meant to fly 90 degrees to the right (go_right) or left of the facing, 100 units at height_offset above the ground. The clearance is measured straight ahead, not to the side, and any wall within 100 units leaves a distance of 0, so with a positive min_distance it returns -1 instead of shortening the move. The position, facing, clearance and move calls are old-numbered (the clearance check runs as set_lockon_mode), so the monster does not move; otherwise it returns an unset value.

6a75eda3744eb06c.name: play_knockback_swing
6a75eda3744eb06c.doc: Faces the target and plays attack 2, the knockback swing.

6a827b83a47f2039.name: play_stall_event_once
6a827b83a47f2039.doc: Once more than 900 frames have passed since the time recorded in slot 0, runs event script 550 and sets variable 20 so it runs only once. threaten_for_frames also sets variable 20, so the event never runs after Shingala has threatened.

6ac891e5ff626f22.name: charge_with_combo_attack
6ac891e5ff626f22.doc: Winds up with attack 2 in, chases the target in the attack 2 loop, then finishes with attack 2.

6ad508df10192462.name: turn_to_angle_and_wait
6ad508df10192462.doc: Sets the turn target and speed (degrees) and waits for the turn to finish. Returns the frames waited.

6ad519ef7aa84c7e.name: act_at_mid_range
6ad519ef7aa84c7e.doc: Mid range choice: usually spits fire, otherwise wanders and chases, circles the target or flies sideways.

6adaff463d73975f.name: recover_after_throw
6adaff463d73975f.doc: Recovers from a throw, waits 10 frames and resets the motion.

6ae00075ff795d6d.name: dodge_melee_by_backing_away
6ae00075ff795d6d.doc: Backs away from a melee attack using the invulnerable walk back move, then stands.

6af566ba27d62976.name: fight_while_rage_hits_remain
6af566ba27d62976.doc: Loop used while rage hits remain: picks the long, medium or close range behavior by target distance. Returns 0 when the target is out of range or no rage hits remain.

6afcad6ea3a5db0d.name: act_at_mid_range
6afcad6ea3a5db0d.doc: Calm mid-range choice: spit poison, walk up or circle the player.

6b1f3f80b2eef105.name: is_target_in_view
6b1f3f80b2eef105.doc: Meant to return 1 when the target is closer than max_dist and within half_angle_deg of the monster's facing, else 0. In this toolkit the three reads use old native numbers: the heading read does nothing and the distance and angle reads call unrelated natives, so the result does not reflect where the target is.

6b4b0a4e051edde6.name: wait_move_end_timeout
6b4b0a4e051edde6.doc: Waits up to max_frames for the monster to reach its move_to destination, then stops moving; returns 1 on timeout, else 0. Written in the b02a raw numbering (get_player_status and apply_reserved_texture stand for check_move_end and stop_moving).

6b5d1ba46ebc2110.name: charge_at_target_in_guard
6b5d1ba46ebc2110.doc: Raises its guard, then flies at and chases the target (rising to its height if above it) in the attack 2 loop before lowering the guard.

6b5df3952e7a1028.name: wait_turn_to_angle
6b5df3952e7a1028.doc: Waits for the monster to face angle_deg within 3 degrees (the code compares the turn speed in radians against 3, so a larger tolerance practically never applies), for the turn to finish, or for max_frames. Stops turning and returns the frames waited.

6b7c8c9099f1590c.name: on_init
6b7c8c9099f1590c.doc: Loads the ice shot effects, sets up flight with a maximum height of 40 and lifts the monster 15 units.

6b97360d0cc23693.name: fall_dead_to_ground
6b97360d0cc23693.doc: Death fall: stops, scatters the death drops, turns scripted movement off so ground search and map collision apply again, and loops the damage motion until the monster is on the ground or 900 frames pass. Returns the frames spent.

6b9886822cda060e.name: wait_move_end_update
6b9886822cda060e.doc: Waits up to max_frames for the move to end and returns 0 when it ended.

6ba9d0ee1dd5ddc3.name: get_knocked_down_and_rise
6ba9d0ee1dd5ddc3.doc: Faces the blow, is knocked flying, then gets up. The action status is set for 3 frames after landing.

6bd65b5403f1e3cb.name: play_death_motion
6bd65b5403f1e3cb.doc: Starts the death sequence, plays the death motion to its end and halts.

6bdfd119528ab92a.name: begin_locked_action
6bdfd119528ab92a.doc: Forbids guarding and dodging, resets the motion, stops moving and turning, faces the target and marks the action status as busy.

6bf202a32895160a.name: walk_to_point_around_home
6bf202a32895160a.doc: Turns toward and walks to a point radius units from the given center, angle_deg degrees around from the direction pointing from the center toward the monster (0 is the point on the monster's side). Returns the wait result: 1 if the target comes within stop_dist, 2 when the walk ends, 0 after max_frames.

6bf67887531c6ebf.name: face_target_until_motion_progress
6bf67887531c6ebf.doc: Keeps turning toward the target until the motion progress is within the tolerance of the given value (default 0.05).

6c0b5372197128da.name: dash_to_target
6c0b5372197128da.doc: Turns to face the target, then dashes straight along that facing to the target's distance. Returns -1 at once if the path ahead is shorter than move_speed plus near_dist, else the wait_move_or_target_near result.

6c188835a0b71baa.name: rush_and_slam_after_shot
6c188835a0b71baa.doc: Dodge-shot program: when monster var 0 has bit 2, 4 or 16 set (turning to fire or firing nose bullets, circling while wandering, or standing watching) or the target is over 300 units away, runs at the target and does the charging slam; otherwise does nothing.

6c34520604e4ace4.name: freeze_on_knockdown
6c34520604e4ace4.doc: Freezes the boss in place and ends the locked action.

6c43c61b0ca2fd9e.name: swing_attack_one_then_two
6c43c61b0ca2fd9e.doc: Plays attack 1 for 18 frames and then attack 2 for 40 frames without moving.

6c4ede44fe091332.name: fly_toward_angle
6c4ede44fe091332.doc: Flies the given distance in the direction of the given angle in degrees, without turning first. Returns the result of the flight.

6c7f78bc90ff845c.name: walk_up_and_attack
6c7f78bc90ff845c.doc: Walks up to the player, then slams the ground if the player is close, or roars (before the first enrage stage) or fires the flame ring.

6c8b27110bb086e4.name: strike_attack
6c8b27110bb086e4.doc: Faces the target and plays attack 3, then stands for 9 frames.

6cac15276cfdfdb2.name: fly_around_or_watch_target
6cac15276cfdfdb2.doc: Half the time flies in an arc around the target then turns to face it; otherwise stands watching it.

6cb0e2214a2f33ea.name: turn_by_angle
6cb0e2214a2f33ea.doc: Turns by delta_deg relative to the current heading at speed_deg and returns the frames spent. When the new heading passes 180 degrees either way the wrap is faulty and the monster turns to a small wrong angle instead.

6cec1b7452a92271.name: fight_target_before_rage
6cec1b7452a92271.doc: Normal fight loop while not enraged: picks close, mid or far behaviour from the horizontal target distance. Returns when the target is further than 330 units or the rage hits run out.

6cf12996e33cac5b.name: face_target_for_frames
6cf12996e33cac5b.doc: Like face_target_at_speed, but gives up after max_frames.

6cf6e0112f71d968.name: walk_around_target
6cf6e0112f71d968.doc: Turns to face the point radius units from the target at angle_deg around it (0 is the side facing this monster), then walks there at move_speed. If less than 100 units are clear ahead, the walk is cut to the clear distance, and -1 is returned without moving when that is under twice stop_dist. Otherwise waits up to max_frames and returns 1 once the target is within stop_dist, 2 when the walk ends, 0 on timeout, and stops moving.

6d0cc42504863fdf.name: walk_to_random_nearby_point
6d0cc42504863fdf.doc: Picks a random point at a random angle and distance from the monster, turns to it and walks there.

6d235060887dbc7f.name: act_at_medium_range
6d235060887dbc7f.doc: Medium range behaviour: usually turns and slashes or runs at the target, sometimes walks around it.

6d367bd184e30c7a.name: wait_target_detected_updating
6d367bd184e30c7a.doc: Waits, updating the boss, until the target is seen or heard. Returns 1 when detected and 0 on timeout.

6d3d98ca54c90b46.name: on_dodge_shot
6d3d98ca54c90b46.doc: Dodges a shot with a sidestep.

6d3e1a766ccbb442.name: pick_ranged_action
6d3e1a766ccbb442.doc: Half the time shoots a feather volley, otherwise turns randomly or circles the target.

6d4a1adab1353b66.name: wait_motion_time
6d4a1adab1353b66.doc: Waits until the motion progress is within the tolerance of the given value, or the motion ends. A tolerance of -1 means 0.03. Returns the frames waited.

6d4d9db0056c9219.name: lunge_with_attack_1
6d4d9db0056c9219.doc: Faces the player and plays attack 1; after 12 frames moves toward a point 100 units ahead at 2.8 units per frame for 28 frames (about 78 units), then stops, stands and waits 9 frames.

6d54427fef5a35ad.name: track_target_until_motion_end
6d54427fef5a35ad.doc: Keeps turning toward the target each frame until the current motion ends, then stops turning.

6d55b0b2024ec0bc.name: wander_or_wait_for_target
6d55b0b2024ec0bc.doc: Idle behaviour: turns away from a wall closer than 49, circles its home point when more than 300 from it, otherwise randomly stands waiting for the player, turns, circles the target or walks straight ahead. Returns 1 if the player was detected while waiting.

6d69b3d5dacff53c.name: wait_target_in_view
6d69b3d5dacff53c.doc: Waits up to max_frames for the target to enter the monster's view cone (max_dist, half_angle_deg). Returns 1 when seen, 0 on timeout.

6d7a028ff7b9ed16.name: struggle_forever
6d7a028ff7b9ed16.doc: Plays the struggle motion in a loop.

6d8cea64e298ce09.name: choose_mid_range_action
6d8cea64e298ce09.doc: Picks an action when the target is 85 to 140 units away: shockwave attack, attack 2, chasing, or idle play.

6d976f0bf6411db1.name: strafe_around_target_or_watch
6d976f0bf6411db1.doc: Half the time flies to a point 60 units from the target, 30 to 60 degrees to a random side, 30 units above the ground, then faces it; otherwise stands and waits up to 30 frames for the target to come into view.

6d97836b6f6e5b69.name: fight_enraged
6d97836b6f6e5b69.doc: Combat loop once the monster is enraged: runs at the target and attacks with a slash, swing or lunge swing.

6da3148711e198e8.name: track_monster_until_time
6da3148711e198e8.doc: Keeps turning toward another monster until the current motion reaches the given progress. A tolerance of -1 means 0.05.

6da86a8495280d9b.name: charge_at_target
6da86a8495280d9b.doc: Turns to the target and chases it for up to 60 frames, then stands.

6dc2c4532da5585f.name: choose_behavior_by_aggro
6dc2c4532da5585f.doc: If not aggroed, fights when the target is within 800 and otherwise runs toward it; if aggroed, fights within 280 and runs toward it within the aggro range, else clears the aggro.

6dc6b6997d724e0a.name: step_back_from_melee
6dc6b6997d724e0a.doc: Answers a melee attack with an invulnerable step back.
