6de2cc2af8b5b49e.name: fight_with_rage_hits_left
6de2cc2af8b5b49e.doc: Fight loop used while rage hits are left: long range behaviour at 150 to 350 units, close range below that. Returns when the target is beyond 350 units or the rage hits run out.

6df0eb06999ae5a5.name: track_target_until_time
6df0eb06999ae5a5.doc: Keeps turning toward the target until the motion progress is within tolerance of time (default 0.05).

6e0bee615166cab8.name: setup_poison_mist_attack
6e0bee615166cab8.doc: Registers the normal hit on attack 1, loads the poison mist loop and hit effects into a free texture block when one is available, and starts the monster AI with init_monster_ai.

6e2eab9b5c73d7d6.name: run_magma_phase
6e2eab9b5c73d7d6.doc: Magma phase loop: rests on the surface on the first round, then attacks from the magma. After four rounds it leaves the magma and switches to the surface phase (var 9 = 2).

6e84d2a395a994db.name: init_body_and_flags
6e84d2a395a994db.doc: Init program written in the b02a raw numbering. Going by its arguments and the b02a1 init it clears attribute and mask flags so the monster can guard and dodge, sets act status 0 and a clip distance of 999, and registers frame bcol00 as body object 0 with size 6.

6e92f6ad5eaefd1a.name: wait_for_round_result
6e92f6ad5eaefd1a.doc: Hovers at height 1050 until monster variable 8 becomes 8 (returns 0) or 9 (returns 1, the round was reset and the butterfly revives).

6ec64e191f59cd0c.name: dodge_shot_by_flying_sideways
6ec64e191f59cd0c.doc: Flies a sidestep around the target, faces it, plays the dodge return motion and allows guard and dodge again.

6ed29f30cdf06b54.name: check_player_disguise
6ed29f30cdf06b54.doc: If the player is currently disguised as a monster, hovers calmly until the disguise ends.

6ed890fec2cbc140.name: fight_by_distance
6ed890fec2cbc140.doc: Reacts to a disguised player, returns if no rage hits remain, circles the target or waits when another monster has attack priority, otherwise picks by horizontal distance: long 160 to 250, medium 120 to 160, close below 120 or above 250. Prints the distance.

6ee1e24873697ce2.name: wait_for_motion_end
6ee1e24873697ce2.doc: Waits until the current motion ends, checking the phase change each frame. Returns 1.

6ee2e53be096df43.name: choose_mid_range_action
6ee2e53be096df43.doc: Picks a mid-range action at random: walk-up attack, walking to the target, or moving beside it.

6eff77316c5bfcd7.name: attack_at_close_range
6eff77316c5bfcd7.doc: Mostly claws or rolls at the target, otherwise steps back or circles it.

6f092db19baa92cf.name: wander_random
6f092db19baa92cf.doc: Meant to turn up to angle_range degrees, but converts the random turn to radians twice, so it turns only 0 to about angle_range/57 degrees (always to the same side). If 100 units ahead are clear it walks min_dist plus move_speed plus a random amount up to dist_range; if less is clear but more than near_dist it walks just the random amount; otherwise returns -1. Returns the wait_move_or_target_near result.

6f10ae330cf7cf7b.name: choose_next_action
6f10ae330cf7cf7b.doc: Sets monster var 1, the next action: a queued action from var 2 if there is one; otherwise within 80 units attack 2 (within 60) or attack 1, queueing idle (7) after; within 800 units the shockwave (9) when the target is behind, else walk (8); idle (7) when farther.

6f11f65e78d383c4.name: play_death_and_wait_forever
6f11f65e78d383c4.doc: Plays the death motion, finishes the death and waits forever.

6f168f1094498949.name: leap_backward_invulnerable
6f168f1094498949.doc: Snaps to face the target and plays the step back motion; after 5 frames it heads for a point 100 units straight behind at 4 units per frame but stops 14 frames later, about 56 units back. It takes no damage until the move stops.

6f1ad10ecb13f07d.name: play_attack_2_motion
6f1ad10ecb13f07d.doc: Plays the attack 2 motion and waits for it to end.

6f24090565f1b04b.name: chase_target
6f24090565f1b04b.doc: Each frame turns toward the target and walks at its position, until the target is within stop_dist. Returns -1 when it got that close, otherwise the frames passed (max_frames on timeout).

6f4b97a35c37aae0.name: step_along_orbit_ring
6f4b97a35c37aae0.doc: Each frame, places the boss on a ring of radius 400 around the arena center at a wobbling height, facing along the ring, and advances the stored ring angle by one degree.

6f6129e3855e5ffd.name: halt_movement
6f6129e3855e5ffd.doc: Meant to cancel the current movement order by sending the monster to its own position at speed 0 and stopping it. The calls are in this script's old native numbering and run as loop_se_on_monster, get_distance_to and get_home_pos, so nothing is stopped.

6f6207a9310577a9.name: fight_in_range_loop
6f6207a9310577a9.doc: Fight loop while the target is within 190 units: picks far, mid or close actions by distance, or flies around when its priority is low. Returns 0 when the target goes beyond 190.

6f7d796c2e93bc8f.name: fly_in_direction_without_turning
6f7d796c2e93bc8f.doc: Flies distance units along the absolute heading angle_deg without turning first, at height_offset above the ground under the monster. Returns the fly_to_point result: 1 on arrival, a negative value if blocked, or 0 after frames.

6f8b3b7fee7fd238.name: attack_at_mid_range
6f8b3b7fee7fd238.doc: Mid range choice among the slam, the arm swing, the lunge or chasing the player.

6f995fb776aa30bb.name: fight_while_enraged
6f995fb776aa30bb.doc: Enraged loop. The distance it tests is never set, so it always runs at the target for up to 90 frames, then within 110 units attacks: half the time the lunge combo, otherwise the heavy swing (within 44 units) or the heavy lunge. Returns when rage hits are available again.

6f9ce07858e7e042.name: turn_toward_target_for_frames
6f9ce07858e7e042.doc: Keeps turning toward the target for a set number of frames. turn_speed_deg is passed to the turn without converting it to radians, so the turn is near-instant.

6fc042c8fb978902.name: turn_to_target_limit
6fc042c8fb978902.doc: Turns to face the target, waiting at most max_frames.

6fd62edcde430117.name: turn_to_face_target
6fd62edcde430117.doc: Walks in place turning until the monster faces the target, then stops turning.

6ff34f1f58f66bce.name: run_monster_ai_loop
6ff34f1f58f66bce.doc: Allows guarding and dodging, then runs the behaviour chooser every frame.

6ffe4fb76de35507.name: play_fear_state
6ffe4fb76de35507.doc: Plays the reaction chosen in variable 1: runs the event, looks around, jumps in surprise, holds the surprised loop, turns toward the monster or just stands frightened.

70141785b1897a2e.name: fight_or_wander_forever
70141785b1897a2e.doc: Main loop: fights by distance when a target exists, otherwise wanders.

701f8582ee82553a.name: stun_then_unlock
701f8582ee82553a.doc: Plays the faint motion, waits for the stun stars to run out, then allows guarding and dodging again.

7022e7287b01e844.name: jump_to_target_spot
7022e7287b01e844.doc: Leaps in an arc over 50 frames onto the target's position, or the arena centre if the target is over 600 units out, turning to face the target in mid-air. It is invincible during the jump and shakes the camera on landing.

702d04e4df9eef2f.name: set_hit_counter
702d04e4df9eef2f.doc: Sets the rapid-hit counter in monster var 18.

70316b594c2c5869.name: stop_actions_and_disable_lighting
70316b594c2c5869.doc: Meant to stop moving and turning, reset the motion and set act status 0 at the start of the damage program (recoil_from_damage in e08a, e09a and b07a_atora_yellow). In this toolkit's old numbering the stop, reset and act-status calls run get_home_pos, get_attack and set_model_lighting, and stop_turning does nothing here, so its only effect is turning the model's scene lighting off.

703c5c5ce5fb8e85.name: read_orbit_angle
703c5c5ce5fb8e85.doc: Reads the current orbit angle from monster variable 0.

70866541f561b135.name: run_normal_ai
70866541f561b135.doc: AI loop while rage hits remain. Leaves when the target is farther than 300 units or rage hits run out, otherwise picks a long, mid or close range action by distance.

709510dbe2d5dea4.name: run_ai_loop
709510dbe2d5dea4.doc: Fights when the target is within 550 units, otherwise falls back to the shared wander routine.

70a7d2c6de8f5033.name: sidestep_from_shot
70a7d2c6de8f5033.doc: Answers a shot with an invulnerable sidestep.

70b5d0cc9e1a89a0.name: fly_sidestep_around_target
70b5d0cc9e1a89a0.doc: Turns damage off, loops the step right or step left motion at random and flies at 3 units per frame toward the point 60 degrees around the target at the same distance, 25 units above the ground, for at most 8 frames (about 24 units); then turns damage back on, waits up to 25 frames for any walk to end and stops moving.

70c8155fe1460e53.name: wait_motion_reach_last_frame
70c8155fe1460e53.doc: Meant to wait until the motion status reads 4 (last frame); the status read is old-numbered and runs as get_monster_life.

70ec3d3ff7f46950.name: watch_for_downed_player
70ec3d3ff7f46950.doc: Waits the given number of frames. If the player has status 8 (knocked down) and the cooldown in monster variable 5 has run out, it lunges and combos and starts a 90-frame cooldown; the stored cooldown is reset to 0 when it returns.

71076364a64f0cff.name: walk_toward_target
71076364a64f0cff.doc: Turns to face the target, then walks straight ahead as far as the target is away. Returns the wait_move_until_near result: 1 when the target comes within stop_dist, 2 when the walk ended, 0 on timeout.

7120d132529ed178.name: stop_machine_gun_effect
7120d132529ed178.doc: Finishes the machine gun effect stored in monster variable 3, if any, and clears the variable.

712c50afbbc14933.name: wait_until_facing_angle
712c50afbbc14933.doc: Waits until the monster's yaw is within the larger of 3 degrees and the given tolerance of the angle (both in degrees), or max_frames pass, then stops turning. Returns the frames waited.

7138ebe8179519f1.name: recoil_from_hit
7138ebe8179519f1.doc: Plays the damage knockback, waits 12 frames and stands.

7184fba1d2d7aa8f.name: fight_by_range_until_far
7184fba1d2d7aa8f.doc: Combat loop while rage hits remain: returns 0 when the target is beyond 200 units or get_rage_hits_left reaches 0; otherwise monsters first or second nearest the target pick the far (140 to 200), mid (100 to 140) or close range action by distance, and the rest circle or watch.

7199a29231ba8622.name: turn_random_side
7199a29231ba8622.doc: Turns left or right (50/50) by a random amount up to angle_range plus turn_speed_deg plus 30 degrees, waits for the turn and returns the frames used. Returns on the first try, so the retry loop never repeats.

71b37dbe0bc89064.name: act_at_mid_range
71b37dbe0bc89064.doc: Mid range choice: turns to the target and walks up to it.

71b5fc2de90fc5ba.name: fly_sideways
71b5fc2de90fc5ba.doc: Flies 300 units to the monster's right (go_right set) or left.

71b94e548f99c5ae.name: charge_at_aggroed_target
71b94e548f99c5ae.doc: Turns to the target and charges at it for up to 160 frames, stopping at walls, then stands.

71c77b7d906504fd.name: choose_fight_or_wander
71c77b7d906504fd.doc: One decision step: fights, wanders, charges or drops aggro depending on rage hits left, aggro state and target distance.

71e8da6e87c2120f.name: fly_to_point
71e8da6e87c2120f.doc: Turns toward the point, then flies to it at 5 units per frame. Returns 1 on arrival.

71ec583014db9305.name: on_dodge_shot
71ec583014db9305.doc: Stops and plays the attack miss motion.

71f2617fd0ab525d.name: fight_calm_far_range
71f2617fd0ab525d.doc: Far range choice while not enraged: approach, play, circle or charge.

71f5efc67954ee38.name: dash_and_cast_tornado
71f5efc67954ee38.doc: Decrements the move counter, dashes at the target and casts a tornado, with a 60 percent chance of a second one.

71f90725480f9f75.name: recoil_from_hit
71f90725480f9f75.doc: Plays the damage knockback motion, waits, and returns to the stance.

72046b60cc5be9f4.name: fight_while_no_rage_hits_left
72046b60cc5be9f4.doc: Fight loop while no rage hits remain: attack 1 or 2 within 120, the spin attack within 160, otherwise walks toward the target. Returns when rage hits remain or the target is past 800.

7228d26a7bec5eb3.name: flicker_model_for_frames
7228d26a7bec5eb3.doc: Turns lighting off and cycles the model colour for the given frames, then restores lighting.

722f95fe7c1e2be7.name: on_guard
722f95fe7c1e2be7.doc: Usually guards behind the Giltoni shield effect for 60 frames, invincible only for the first 30; 30 percent of the time it handles the hit like a dodged shot instead (sidestep and counter).

723d6a1a8505ea45.name: fly_in_direction
723d6a1a8505ea45.doc: Flies the given distance along a heading in degrees without turning the model first. Returns the result of fly_straight_to_point.

7287ff2f189f8985.name: reset_jump_and_queue_on_guard
7287ff2f189f8985.doc: Guard handler: clears the jump and immunity attributes and the queued actions.

729cd1e063ede30e.name: approach_distant_target
729cd1e063ede30e.doc: Loop that walks toward the target until it is within 255 units, sometimes standing and watching.

72b3b18793eb20f7.name: choose_wander_action
72b3b18793eb20f7.doc: Wander AI. Picks a random idle action: turn away from walls, return toward home, walk around the home point or the target, walk straight, or wait and watch for the player. Sets monster var 0 to 1, 4, 8, 16 or 32 to record which action it chose. Returns 1 when it noticed the target.

72bc2727ea2ddefe.name: fly_in_direction
72bc2727ea2ddefe.doc: Turns to an absolute angle and flies dist units that way.

72c48e82ed1e167e.name: is_point_flyable
72c48e82ed1e167e.doc: Returns 1 if the point's y is within the height limits in monster vars 0 and 1 and, unless var 14 is set, check_flight_step passes at the point: ground below it, not above the flyer's maximum height, and no wall within the distance to the point plus the wall margin from the monster along the cast heading. That heading is never set (the result of get_angle_to is not stored), so the wall probe does not look toward the point. The radius limits it reads are unused.

72ce4718cbf09563.name: charge_at_target_in_guard
72ce4718cbf09563.doc: Raises its guard, then flies at and chases the target (rising to its height if above it) in the attack 2 loop before lowering the guard.

72e34fc2ad363a39.name: sidestep_around_target
72e34fc2ad363a39.doc: Walks a short arc to the right or left around the target while tracking it.

72ec3467b0b1532b.name: step_away_in_direction
72ec3467b0b1532b.doc: Plays the back, left or right step motion (direction 1, 2 or 4) and flies that way for the distance.

73024a933b2cbe27.name: circle_target_or_wait
73024a933b2cbe27.doc: Circles the target at a random side angle, or stands and waits for it to come into view.

730fe1df90f7c05b.name: fall_and_stay_stunned
730fe1df90f7c05b.doc: Plays the flying and get-up motions, then the faint motion until the stun ends.

73362f9ebfc55ac7.name: dodge_melee_by_stepping_back
73362f9ebfc55ac7.doc: Locks interrupts and steps back to 100 to 110 units beyond the target's distance at speed 3, taking no damage during the step, then stands and re-allows guard and dodge.

733b7bd0c4b715cb.name: fight_at_close_range
733b7bd0c4b715cb.doc: Close range choice: walk up and use a dash attack or combo, circle the target, or step back and sometimes play idly.

7351ac97d14213e7.name: fall_and_get_up
7351ac97d14213e7.doc: Plays the knocked-flying motion, stays down 30 frames, then gets up.

735c0242238c1291.name: fight_while_rage_hits_left
735c0242238c1291.doc: Fight loop used when rage hits are left: picks the far, mid or close routine by target distance. Returns 0 when the target is out of range or no rage hits remain.

735e781608b1228c.name: dodge_shot_by_sidestepping
735e781608b1228c.doc: Sidesteps around the target to avoid a shot, then stands.

73674fcfe5be373e.name: approach_at_mid_range
73674fcfe5be373e.doc: 10 percent uses the shockwave; otherwise mostly spins to face the target and walks in, and sometimes circles 30 degrees around it instead and waits up to 30 frames for it to come into view.

7369a0ddf6295fb3.name: setup_sword_hit
7369a0ddf6295fb3.doc: Registers the weak knockback hit and sword trail on attack 1, resets monster var 0 and starts the monster AI with init_monster_ai.

73721e750dbca9e4.name: act_at_long_range
73721e750dbca9e4.doc: Long range behaviour: walks or runs toward the target and spits mist, or wanders a short distance.

7384c8d4684b03f8.name: walk_around_point
7384c8d4684b03f8.doc: Walks to the point radius units from the given point at angle_deg around it, turning to face it first. Returns the result of wait_move_until_near.

7387994a6adbc97a.name: wait_turn_unless_target_seen
7387994a6adbc97a.doc: Waits, updating the boss, until the monster faces the angle; returns -1 early if the target comes into view, otherwise the frames waited.

738989962dccaa2c.name: attack_at_mid_range
738989962dccaa2c.doc: Half the time spits venom (a flatter shot inside 120, a lobbed one beyond); otherwise does one of its two melee attacks.

739f794d661ef3c0.name: sidestep_to_dodge_shot
739f794d661ef3c0.doc: Dodges a ranged attack by sidestepping at speed 3, then stands and allows guard and dodge again.

73bc49b3f5fc3338.name: wait_motion_end_or_target_in_view
73bc49b3f5fc3338.doc: Waits until the motion ends (returns 0) or the target enters the view cone (returns 1).

73c5a8a348b4bb68.name: check_life_change
73c5a8a348b4bb68.doc: Compares the current life with the life stored last time. Returns 1 if life is zero or less, 2 if it dropped (and records the damage), 0 otherwise.

73d08c318ed36c00.name: get_pos_around_target
73d08c318ed36c00.doc: Writes into x, y, z the point dist units from the target at angle_deg around it, measured from the direction back toward this monster (0 is the near side). Written in the b02a raw numbering.

73e40aa3fe4e953f.name: turn_toward_target_with_random_offset
73e40aa3fe4e953f.doc: Turns toward the target, with a percent chance of aiming a random side offset away from it.

73fbe0b91e6f0df5.name: lunge_slash_at_target
73fbe0b91e6f0df5.doc: Walks up to the target, then does attack 1, tracking the target for 20 frames and then sliding forward at speed 3.2 for 8 frames (about 26 units, toward a point 300 units ahead) during the swing, and stands for 9 frames.

73fea819811808e1.name: steer_toward_target_until_aligned
73fea819811808e1.doc: Flies forward at height 850, turning toward the player when in view or toward the arena center otherwise. Returns 6 when facing the player, or 5 on the split signal. Never called.

7406f8711c2eb548.name: sum_var_15_by_flags
7406f8711c2eb548.doc: Reads monster variable 16 as flags and variable 15 as a value, and writes the value once per set bit (bit 1 and bit 2) into the first element of the array.

740f3f7aa897bf93.name: stand_idle_frames
740f3f7aa897bf93.doc: Stops moving, plays the stand motion and waits for the given number of frames.

7411af38dbbb6209.name: wait_for_move_end
7411af38dbbb6209.doc: Waits, ticking the fight tracking, until the current move ends or max_frames pass. Returns 0 when the move ended; on timeout it falls off the end without setting a return value.

742e06b84de7ab71.name: act_on_situation
742e06b84de7ab71.doc: Acts on the bit mask from classify_target_situation: attacks by distance when the target is close and straight ahead (16), rarely (2 percent) spins toward a target beyond 240 units that is not within 45 degrees ahead (2), spins when it is within 240 but outside the facing arc (1 and 8), and when inside the arc (1 and 4) walks to 50 units and then spins to face it, giving up if the walk loses the target.

7439e4429a666c6a.name: fly_along_heading
7439e4429a666c6a.doc: Flies the given distance along an absolute heading in degrees without turning first.

746e8c7122bd8853.name: approach_and_drill_medium_range
746e8c7122bd8853.doc: Mid-range approach: runs the waypoint route if the target is on raised ground, otherwise drill-charges, then chases on foot for up to 150 frames and rests 90 frames out of breath if the chase timed out without reaching the target.

7471597ee0c13733.name: orbit_host_with_light
7471597ee0c13733.doc: Sets orb state 32, starts the Atla light effect owned by this monster and circles at radius 30 around a point 100 units above the host for 150 frames. Then ends the effect and sets orb state 64.

7473c21ca5fe10f2.name: fight_enraged
7473c21ca5fe10f2.doc: Combat loop once the monster is enraged; returns when it calms down. Within 85 units it runs in and swipes or steps back; farther out it charges with the combo attack, runs closer or plays antics.

7474fd3e43b6d75c.name: turn_then_walk_along_angle
7474fd3e43b6d75c.doc: Turns to the given angle, then moves the given distance in that direction. Returns the move wait result.

74777d153bd1e9ef.name: fly_backward
74777d153bd1e9ef.doc: Meant to fly backward away from the current facing, but the back distance is never assigned, so the flight length is undefined. Unused in this script.

74835b3e44dbaf6e.name: shoot_petrify_shot
74835b3e44dbaf6e.doc: Turns to the target and plays attack 2, spawning the petrify shot from the dcol02 frame half way through.

74c07b86640778b6.name: chase_target_until_near
74c07b86640778b6.doc: Turns and moves toward the target every frame until closer than stop_dist (returns -1) or max_frames passes. Returns the frames spent.

74d7d3edebbaebbc.name: idle_if_player_disguised
74d7d3edebbaebbc.doc: If the player is disguised, runs the disguised idle behaviour for this monster kind.

74e34a0043ea8f32.name: run_ai_loop
74e34a0043ea8f32.doc: Main loop: runs one AI step every frame.

74ed57c8f52c1005.name: step_back_or_sidestep
74ed57c8f52c1005.doc: Steps back if the target is within 80 units, otherwise sidesteps left or right around it. Keeps turning toward the target until the motion ends.

750cd706a9d34216.name: walk_toward_target_slowly
750cd706a9d34216.doc: Walks slowly toward the target for 150 to 240 frames or until it is within 320.

7514d2ddd5e7569c.name: fall_and_get_up
7514d2ddd5e7569c.doc: Plays the knocked flying motion, waits, then gets up invulnerable.

751724d52277d725.name: move_around_point
751724d52277d725.doc: Turns toward and walks to a point on a circle of the given radius around (x, y, z), placed angle_deg around from the monster's own side of the point. Returns 1 if the target comes within near_dist, 2 if the walk ends, 0 on timeout.

753424578001b2a9.name: chase_target_slowly
753424578001b2a9.doc: Walks after the target for up to 240 frames, then stands.

7535cbbd6536dff8.name: move_in_direction
7535cbbd6536dff8.doc: Moves the given distance along an absolute angle without turning.

754772353a57ded2.name: pick_close_range_attack
754772353a57ded2.doc: Chooses one action for a target within 85 units: mostly attack 2, the red wave swing, the late or early second swing combos, with a small chance of stepping back or circling the target.

7552c2f7c3664bbe.name: fall_dead_and_halt
7552c2f7c3664bbe.doc: Falls to the ground, plays the death motion and halts after finishing the death.

756bb084fc12dfa9.name: fly_to_point
756bb084fc12dfa9.doc: Flies in a straight line to the given point at the given speed and hover height. Returns 1 on arrival, the blocking result if the flight check fails, 0 on timeout.

756c28037d2e7959.name: lock_interrupts_stop
756c28037d2e7959.doc: Locks the monster for a scripted action: forbids guard and dodge, resets the motion and stops all movement and turning.

7571d3972a4c1d3d.name: turn_randomly_and_walk_ahead
7571d3972a4c1d3d.doc: Meant to turn up to turn_range_deg degrees, but converts the range to radians and then the random turn to radians again, so it turns a whole number of degrees from 0 to about turn_range_deg/57, always to the same side. If 100 units ahead are clear it walks min_distance + speed plus a random 0 to distance_range units; if less is clear but more than stop_dist it walks just the random amount; otherwise it returns -1 without moving. Returns 1 if the target comes within stop_dist, 2 when the walk ends, 0 after max_frames.

757728c698cbb4ef.name: circle_or_watch_target
757728c698cbb4ef.doc: Far-range idle: half the time walks around the target on a circle about 100 to 130 units out, or stands watching it; otherwise plays the idle play motion.

75b551a2c2f555db.name: watch_player_if_disguised
75b551a2c2f555db.doc: If the player is wearing a disguise, runs the disguised-player watching loop for this monster kind.

75d0a760d0a6b623.name: struggle_forever_when_lifted
75d0a760d0a6b623.doc: Plays the struggle motion and idles while the monster is held up.

75d55ab39c644b07.name: dodge_melee_by_flying_sideways
75d55ab39c644b07.doc: Locks interrupts, faces the target and flies a sidestep around it, then allows guard and dodge again.

75d906e8420cf62c.name: fight_before_rage
75d906e8420cf62c.doc: Combat loop while the monster still has rage hits left (not yet enraged), choosing the close, mid or far action by distance. Returns 0 when the target is beyond 280 units or the rage hits run out.

75e18e804479c815.name: repeat_attack_one_while_close
75e18e804479c815.doc: Plays attack 1 and repeats it up to two more times while the target stays within 70 units.

75e6e715bb10b661.name: wait_move_until_near
75e6e715bb10b661.doc: Waits while moving until it is within stop distance of the target (returns 1), the move ends (2), or time runs out (0).

75ea2d591db96c74.name: spit_poison
75ea2d591db96c74.doc: Attack 2: tracks the target, then spawns the looping venom effect at dcol02 with the monster's attack value.

75f48ac529ef03fd.name: wait_frames_checking_life
75f48ac529ef03fd.doc: Waits the given frames, running the low life event check each frame.

75fac0365ba823e0.name: fire_fast_shot
75fac0365ba823e0.doc: Turns to the target and does attack 1, firing the fast shot from bone dcol0 in the facing direction with the monster's attack value and speed 10. Sets monster var 0 to 1.

763dea04d9ca7d1f.name: play_knockdown_and_recover
763dea04d9ca7d1f.doc: Plays the damage motion with scripted movement disabled, then re-enables movement and lifts off the ground again.

764737caf4de61b0.name: init_untargetable_monster
764737caf4de61b0.doc: Setup for a monster that cannot be locked on: sets the no-lock-on attribute, clears monster vars 0 to 2 and sets a huge clip distance so it is never culled.

764bdc144710b2f1.name: on_update
764bdc144710b2f1.doc: On first run places the monster at its start position facing back; on later runs it is moved to one of four fixed spots by a quick move and its life reset, then it stays in the normal motion.

7653455d6eda447e.name: lunge_then_combo_on_downed_player
7653455d6eda447e.doc: Plays attack 3, rushing to the player's position with a camera shake, then follows with the combo if the player is knocked down (status 8).

7654268190577408.name: orbit_camera_around_arena
7654268190577408.doc: While the camera lock is set, moves the camera to 800 units from the arena center on the side facing the player and looks at the arena center. Does nothing otherwise.

766ec72fc2da1b7a.name: stand_and_wait
766ec72fc2da1b7a.doc: Plays the stand motion and waits the given frames.

76b50e9e9cfc9a7f.name: stop_turning
76b50e9e9cfc9a7f.doc: Written in the b02a raw numbering, where the calls shown (check_pause_flags, set_dungeon_flag) stand for get_rot and turn_to: meant to stop the turn by turning to the current yaw at speed 0.

76b7ade63017ed86.name: on_init
76b7ade63017ed86.doc: Registers the knockback attack hits for attack 2, clears the monster variables and makes the monster invulnerable and not lockable.

76be55bcf4146e47.name: circle_or_wait_near_target
76be55bcf4146e47.doc: Used when the monster is not the nearest attacker: circles the target at about 140 units or stands watching.

76dd7fc7b450cce7.name: fight_by_distance_range
76dd7fc7b450cce7.doc: Loop that returns when the target is beyond 290 units or the rage counter is zero. Circles when others are closer, otherwise picks the far, mid or near action by distance.

76ea6f015daf27df.name: die_and_start_event_on_second_death
76ea6f015daf27df.doc: Death program of Gaja Ein and Gaja Zwei: adds one to monster variable 64, which all monsters on the floor share, plays the death motion and finishes the death, then 30 frames later, if this was the second of the pair to die, resets the player camera and runs event script 504. Then waits forever.

770c077a63840ec6.name: fight_target_by_distance
770c077a63840ec6.doc: Fight loop that picks claw swipe, fire ball, a run at the target or a walk toward it depending on distance, until the target is farther than 280. Not called by this script.

771c7b7fdad65751.name: charge_twice_with_approach
771c7b7fdad65751.doc: Charges for 60 frames, walks up to the target, and charges again.

77326c05f68d67e1.name: recover_after_landing
77326c05f68d67e1.doc: After a throw landing, stops moving, ends the thrown state, waits 10 frames and stops the motion. In this script's old numbering apply_reserved_texture, _EXT_155 and set_camera_mode stand for stop_moving, end_throw and reset_motion.

778e328556ea0307.name: fly_and_release_arrow
778e328556ea0307.doc: Flies toward the point with the attack 1 motion for 60 frames and sets the arrow effect to fire on frame 31.

77a2c5f65e1b5423.name: play_damage_knockback_locked
77a2c5f65e1b5423.doc: Locks and faces the target, plays the damage knockback motion, waits 12 frames and returns to stand.

77a62a81e1468a1a.name: sidestep_to_dodge_melee
77a62a81e1468a1a.doc: Dodges a melee attack with an invulnerable sidestep 30 degrees around the target, then allows guard and dodge again. The step-back branch is never taken because the 0 to 19 roll is always under 20.

77a8229998612d8a.name: walk_around_target
77a8229998612d8a.doc: Turns to face the point radius units from the target at angle_deg around it (0 is the side facing this monster), then walks there at move_speed. If less than 100 units are clear ahead, the walk is cut to the clear distance, and -1 is returned without moving when that is under twice stop_dist. Otherwise waits up to max_frames and returns 1 once the target is within stop_dist, 2 when the walk ends, 0 on timeout, and stops moving.

77c681b400182d50.name: act_at_far_range
77c681b400182d50.doc: Far-range behaviour: shoots, dashes, approaches, waits for the target or runs at it.

77d987ec593af4a9.name: advance_by_target_distance
77d987ec593af4a9.doc: Faces the target, then moves straight ahead as far as the target is away. Returns -1 without moving if a wall is within speed + near_dist ahead, otherwise the result of waiting for the move (1 near the target, 2 arrived, 0 timeout).

77da33ce1bb87f1e.name: die_and_count_kills
77da33ce1bb87f1e.doc: Frees this monster's ring slot, plays the death motion and drops, and counts the kill in monster var 10. At 10 kills in stage 0 and 20 kills in stage 1 it advances the stage and runs event 510. Spawns monster 513 and halts.

77da9741997f1f51.name: fly_around_point
77da9741997f1f51.doc: Flies to a point on a circle around a fixed centre.

77ddada239b5d7c0.name: lift_off_ground
77ddada239b5d7c0.doc: Nudges the monster up out of the ground: raises it by the depth below the ground plus 1 when get_air_height is negative, or by 1 when exactly 0. Does nothing when it is already above the ground.

77e2c379728ede2b.name: fly_to_point_around_target
77e2c379728ede2b.doc: Flies to a point on the far side of the target, rotated by angle degrees and extra_dist units farther out, using the right or left step motion.

780e2513a29d6238.name: set_lighting_by_rage
780e2513a29d6238.doc: Turns model lighting off while the monster still has hits left before it enrages (rage hits left above 0), and on once it is enraged or is a boss (-1).

7812a5b373ca41b4.name: turn_to_random_side_angle
7812a5b373ca41b4.doc: Turns to a random angle to the left or right of the current heading and returns at once after the first turn; the remainder of the loop is never reached.

7814c859b0fbfb35.name: face_target_until_motion_end
7814c859b0fbfb35.doc: Keeps turning toward the target until the current motion ends.

782318b93a380db2.name: watch_disguised_player
782318b93a380db2.doc: Stands and turns to face the player for as long as the player is in a disguise, returning to the caller once the disguise ends.

784c70caf21499f7.name: walk_random_direction
784c70caf21499f7.doc: Meant to turn up to max_turn_deg degrees, but converts the range to radians and then the random turn to radians again, so it turns a whole number of degrees from 0 to about max_turn_deg/57, always to the same side. If 100 units ahead are clear it walks min_distance + speed plus a random 0 to max_extra_distance units; if less is clear but more than stop_clearance it walks just the random amount; otherwise it returns -1 without moving. stop_clearance is also the stop distance of the wait: returns 1 if the target comes within it, 2 when the walk ends, 0 after max_frames.

78631c437f7a4b55.name: charge_target
78631c437f7a4b55.doc: Runs at the target with a lunge, or just runs after it for up to 120 frames.

786ade6ea4e65009.name: recover_after_throw
786ade6ea4e65009.doc: Recovers from a throw, waits 10 frames and resets the motion.

787039d2336935cb.name: wander_and_look_for_target
787039d2336935cb.doc: Idle behaviour: backs away from walls, walks back toward home when far from it, or randomly walks, circles or stands looking for the target. Sets monster var 0 to the chosen wander kind and returns 1 when it detects the target.

7877b3164f9b7a0c.name: fight_at_close_range
7877b3164f9b7a0c.doc: Close range sequence (target under 140): 90 percent of the time a guard charge first, then a point-blank fire ball if the target is within 40, then a fire ball (sometimes after a sidestep), a backstep, or flying 100 units away at 35 degrees off straight back.

7879f6897440b7bf.name: recoil_from_hit_and_check_phase
7879f6897440b7bf.doc: Faces the target, plays the damage knockback, and checks for a phase change.

78995d916beef2b5.name: circle_or_wait_at_distance
78995d916beef2b5.doc: Used when many monsters are closer to the target: circles it or hovers watching.

78af8426227971fb.name: wait_move_until_near
78af8426227971fb.doc: Waits up to max_frames for a move_to walk. Returns 1 as soon as the target is within stop_dist, 2 when the walk reaches its point, 0 on timeout; stops moving on 1 or 2 but not on timeout.

78c88a396d51097c.name: read_last_hit
78c88a396d51097c.doc: Reads the last hit type and life lost from monster vars 16 and 17 into the two output arrays.

79109f80e8d99607.name: on_knockdown
79109f80e8d99607.doc: Plays the damage motion, waits, and charges at the target once enraged.

791a477f55eef531.name: wait_until_target_detected
791a477f55eef531.doc: Waits up to max_frames and returns 1 as soon as the target is detected with the given detection parameters.

791be6d1af3c19c8.name: on_update
791be6d1af3c19c8.doc: Opening and main loop: teleports in, dashes to its starting spot, marks the intro done, then runs one AI decision per frame.

79215373a863f783.name: approach_aggro_target
79215373a863f783.doc: Walks toward the target while turning, then stands. Used while aggro is active and the target is in range.

792611094ae6c3fd.name: approach_at_far_range
792611094ae6c3fd.doc: Chases the target, waits for it, circles it, or rolls at it.

796f4e547e99c558.name: idle_while_player_disguised
796f4e547e99c558.doc: If the player is disguised as a monster, runs the idle-and-face-player loop; otherwise does nothing.

7975ef3e1d40778c.name: wander_around_home
7975ef3e1d40778c.doc: Idle behaviour copied from the common monster AI. Turns away from walls, walks back toward home when far away, or stands watching for a target. Returns 1 when it detects one.

79826c6bc5ff9de1.name: run_at_target
79826c6bc5ff9de1.doc: Runs at the target for up to 90 frames, then stands.

798a4267ce9d72ba.name: is_aggro
798a4267ce9d72ba.doc: Returns the aggro flag, monster variable set 2 index 5, which is nonzero while the monster is chasing the player.

7999f2ab8b30f3e6.name: face_player_while_disguised
7999f2ab8b30f3e6.doc: While the player is disguised, stands and turns to face the player whenever they are more than 90 degrees off its facing. Returns once the disguise ends.

79a14dc4cf7ad57c.name: attack_at_close_range
79a14dc4cf7ad57c.doc: Close range attack choice: dash then swing, run to an edge point, shoot an arrow while circling, or curve around the target.

79c6eefbdaecd4bc.name: get_abs_int
79c6eefbdaecd4bc.doc: Returns the absolute value of an int.

79cb3c13cf28e212.name: move_in_direction
79cb3c13cf28e212.doc: Moves dist units (at least move_speed + 1) along heading angle_deg at move_speed without turning, until the walk ends, the target comes within stop_dist or max_frames pass. Stops moving afterward.

79cde8f7681ee176.name: update_range_flags
79cde8f7681ee176.doc: Stores range flags in monster var 0: one distance band bit (1 at distance 0, 2 within 80, 4 within 800, 8 beyond), plus 16 within 80 and 64 within 60. Bits 32 and 128 come from a facing check over a full 360 degree arc, so they are always set.

7a19298a77895f50.name: wait_turn_unless_spotted
7a19298a77895f50.doc: Waits for the monster's yaw to reach angle_deg within tolerance_deg, up to max_frames frames, but returns -1 at once if the target comes into view (view_range, view_angle). Otherwise returns the frames waited.

7a1cc2a606d242a4.name: on_death
7a1cc2a606d242a4.doc: Plays the death motion, drops its items and finishes dying, then idles forever.

7a25696201c6a9c0.name: act_at_long_range
7a25696201c6a9c0.doc: Long range choice: paralysis shot, fly around the target, or chase it in flight.

7a2e3055e4bb61d6.name: setup_attacks_and_home
7a2e3055e4bb61d6.doc: Registers the normal attack (attack 1) and knockback attack (attack 2) hit windows and stores the home position.

7a3e24eec8f77e42.name: die_or_revive
7a3e24eec8f77e42.doc: On death, 10 percent of the time the monster plays the death motion invulnerable, comes back with 20 percent life (get_random_float(0.3) truncates to 0), gets up and returns 0. Otherwise it dies for good.

7a4cb31d0f49d8a6.name: sidestep_invulnerable
7a4cb31d0f49d8a6.doc: Invulnerable sidestep to the left or right around the target, keeping the same distance.

7abaab3b1a4af763.name: hover_toward_target_at_height
7abaab3b1a4af763.doc: Flies toward the target at a fixed height without body collision, slowing down once within 135 units. Returns 0 if the flight path becomes invalid, otherwise the frames flown.

7abdef73db77029e.name: wait_frame_update
7abdef73db77029e.doc: Advances the aggro and damage bookkeeping, runs the shared per-frame step and waits one frame. Every wait in this script goes through it.

7aebb38eb2b1869a.name: attack_from_magma
7aebb38eb2b1869a.doc: Dives into the magma pool nearest the player if not already in magma; if it was already in magma it fires a flame volley instead. At enrage stage 2 it fires another volley, and 5 percent of the time a third.

7b0935f653fc80d2.name: wait_until_target_within
7b0935f653fc80d2.doc: Meant to wait frame by frame until the target is closer than arrive_distance or max_frames pass, then halt movement. The old-numbered distance read runs as get_kind_pos, which writes nothing, so the test reads an unset value, and halt_movement does nothing. The position arguments are unused. Returns 0.

7b13d3dc42974e11.name: fly_to_point
7b13d3dc42974e11.doc: Flies in a straight line toward x, z at speed units per frame; the y argument is ignored and replaced by the ground height under the monster plus height_offset, and vertical motion stops whenever the monster would be 30 or more units above the ground. Returns 1 within speed plus margin of the point, a negative check_flight_step result if blocked, or 0 after frames.

7b23602dfcc5b117.name: turn_to_target_with_random_offset
7b23602dfcc5b117.doc: Turns toward the target, with a chance (offset_chance percent) of adding or subtracting an offset angle.

7b26cf08eec4dc5e.name: lerp_float
7b26cf08eec4dc5e.doc: Linear interpolation from start to end at step out of steps.

7b35db42784e9070.name: run_ai_loop
7b35db42784e9070.doc: Allows guard and dodge, then runs the behaviour step every frame.

7b4b73f0b2e27b12.name: fight_loop_near_target
7b4b73f0b2e27b12.doc: Unused fight loop (on_update runs fight_by_distance instead): shockwave charge inside 75 units, nose bullets up to 200, and farther out mostly nose bullets with some walking up or circling. Wanders or watches when more than two monsters are nearer the player, and returns 0 when there is no target.

7b52ed98d28d25a6.name: check_player_disguise
7b52ed98d28d25a6.doc: If the player is disguised as a monster, hovers calmly until the disguise ends.

7b618a6b48707e13.name: dash_ahead_toward_target
7b618a6b48707e13.doc: Turns to face the target, then dashes 100 units straight ahead when the 100 units in front are clear; returns -1 without moving when anything is closer (and stop_dist is above 0). Otherwise returns the wait_move_until_near result.

7b7786411ba0caea.name: setup_sword_attacks_and_ai
7b7786411ba0caea.doc: Registers the body and damage collision objects and the normal attack and dodge attack hit windows, then starts the AI.

7b778797c3c956d6.name: wait_turn_to_angle
7b778797c3c956d6.doc: Waits, running the aggro update each frame, until the monster's yaw is within 3 degrees of angle_deg (the code compares the turn speed in radians against 3, so a larger tolerance practically never applies), until it is within one frame's turn (turn_speed_deg) of angle_deg measured across the 180 degree wrap, or until max_frames pass. It does not start the turn itself. Stops turning and returns the frames waited.

7baa63ec900e8b73.name: on_stun
7baa63ec900e8b73.doc: Plays the damage motion for 12 frames and unlocks.

7bc260400cb16b36.name: on_land
7bc260400cb16b36.doc: Recovers after being thrown and gets up.

7bcc598642b1b09f.name: wait_until_target_in_view
7bcc598642b1b09f.doc: Waits up to max_frames and returns 1 as soon as the target is in the view cone, else 0.

7bd19488e2aea333.name: turn_then_chase_target
7bd19488e2aea333.doc: Turns to the target, then keeps re-aiming at its position each frame. Returns -1 once closer than stop_dist, otherwise the number of frames spent when max_frames is reached.

7bd4b378511acf79.name: clear_beam_effect_slots
7bd4b378511acf79.doc: Sets the four beam effect handle variables (96 to 99) to -9999, meaning no effect.

7be527950ca787e3.name: approach_distant_target
7be527950ca787e3.doc: Loop that returns once the target is within 220 units: walks toward it or stands watching.

7c252867fc478a94.name: play_death_and_hold
7c252867fc478a94.doc: Stops, starts the death drops and plays the death motion without smoke, then holds the final pose forever.

7c2d7509403c035a.name: step_back_from_target
7c2d7509403c035a.doc: Plays the step back motion and moves to a point further from the target while taking no damage, then stands.

7c30aff8d16b735d.name: wait_motion_end_and_check_phase
7c30aff8d16b735d.doc: Waits until the current motion ends, checking the phase change each frame. Returns 1.

7c4bd0b11d892ad3.name: perform_attack_1
7c4bd0b11d892ad3.doc: Turns to the target, plays attack 1 for 37 frames and stands for 9 frames.

7c543d08ab03094e.name: guard_against_melee
7c543d08ab03094e.doc: Plays the guard motions to answer a melee attack.

7c67ceb854da8e14.name: sidestep_invulnerable
7c67ceb854da8e14.doc: Steps toward a point 100 units to the left or right at random, moving about 4.1 per frame for only 4 frames (about 16 units), immune to damage during the move.

7c6b3b9b47ba1556.name: run_griffon_ai_loop
7c6b3b9b47ba1556.doc: Allows dodging and then repeatedly chooses an attack by distance to the player.

7c8cf1f4af6f5e09.name: get_knocked_down_and_rise
7c8cf1f4af6f5e09.doc: Plays the knocked-flying motion, lies down for 45 frames, then plays the get-up motion.

7cb4e3b342746fa5.name: pick_action_by_distance
7cb4e3b342746fa5.doc: Picks the far action at 400 or more, the mid action from 150 to 400 and the close action below that.

7cbd6e108b042a46.name: circle_target_or_idle
7cbd6e108b042a46.doc: Circles the target, waits for it to come into view, or plays the idle taunt.

7cdc1d9d82f17f5b.name: chase_target_with_spin
7cdc1d9d82f17f5b.doc: First turns to the target, then moves toward it for up to max_frames, choosing the walk or spin motion by facing. Returns -1 if within stop_dist, otherwise the frames spent.

7cf4f50df5d01a93.name: move_in_direction
7cf4f50df5d01a93.doc: Moves dist units along a heading without turning the model first, and waits for the move to end.

7cfb98a63ba9a0a3.name: play_taunt
7cfb98a63ba9a0a3.doc: Walks to face the target, plays the taunt motion with guard and dodge disabled, then returns to the stance.

7cfd6ff40c3a5512.name: stand_idle_frames
7cfd6ff40c3a5512.doc: Stops and stands idle for the given number of frames.

7d05e784f0993d46.name: swing_heavy_attack
7d05e784f0993d46.doc: Turns to the target and plays attack 2 in place while tracking it, then stands for 9 frames.

7d0b8676dfc665de.name: walk_in_direction
7d0b8676dfc665de.doc: Walks the given distance along an angle given in degrees, without turning first.

7d2a2ebcfc24c35a.name: choose_behaviour
7d2a2ebcfc24c35a.doc: Per-frame decision: before it can be enraged it fights near the target, wanders when unaware, or charges when aggro and in range.

7d2cda3a7d6243f5.name: fall_and_get_up
7d2cda3a7d6243f5.doc: Plays the knocked-flying motion, stays down 45 frames, then gets up.

7d338d5b82c95bb2.name: on_update
7d338d5b82c95bb2.doc: Main loop: chooses behavior every frame.

7d621d2984848335.name: choose_idle_movement
7d621d2984848335.doc: Idle AI step: picks a random behaviour (turn away from walls, wander around home, stand and watch, circle the target, walk straight ahead) and records it in monster variable 0. Returns 1 when it detects the target while watching.

7d66ed5be603aa63.name: fight_calm_far_range
7d66ed5be603aa63.doc: Far range choice while not enraged: run in, walk in or wait.

7d6ddb5315e4f1b9.name: face_target_to_dodge_melee
7d6ddb5315e4f1b9.doc: Melee dodge handler: snaps to face the target and stands, with guarding and dodging disabled for that frame, then allows them again.

7d71b89e56d923b2.name: shoot_fireball
7d71b89e56d923b2.doc: Plays attack 2, tracks the target, then spawns a fireball activation and a flame shot loop effect at the dcol2 frame carrying the monster's attack value.

7d7e4f1ab6eada39.name: swing_attack_one
7d7e4f1ab6eada39.doc: Sets monster var 0 to 1 and plays attack 1 while turning toward the target.

7dc77582185eff33.name: check_flight_step
7dc77582185eff33.doc: Checks whether a flying monster can step from x, y, z along heading. Returns -2 when the point is under the ground (or has no ground below) or higher than the maximum height, -1 when a wall is closer than step plus the wall margin, 0 when the step is free.

7ddb5a23ac257418.name: get_ground_delta_at
7ddb5a23ac257418.doc: Writes into out[0] how much higher the ground is at the given point than under the monster.

7df4479b21025dc4.name: wait_move_end_timeout
7df4479b21025dc4.doc: Waits frame by frame for the move_to walk to finish, then stops moving. Returns 0 when the walk ended, 1 when max_frames ran out.

7dfecf3fe8dd4088.name: watch_disguised_player
7dfecf3fe8dd4088.doc: If the player is disguised, idles in place until the disguise ends.

7e139217febdfd79.name: act_at_long_range
7e139217febdfd79.doc: Long range choice: walk or run toward the target, wait, circle it, or turn and shoot.

7e257e6d45e0a0d2.name: approach_until_target_close
7e257e6d45e0a0d2.doc: Repeats the far-range wander until the target comes within 200 units, then returns 0.

7e387950d1ca8c24.name: act_at_medium_range
7e387950d1ca8c24.doc: Medium range behaviour: walks around the target and attacks, plays and spits mist, or walks toward it.

7e39429ed1fc95fe.name: wander_or_wait_idle
7e39429ed1fc95fe.doc: Idle behaviour while the monster has not noticed the player: walks away from walls, wanders around its home point or around the target, or stands and watches. Returns 1 if the target was detected while standing.

7e398d9cee44810f.name: dodge_back_and_counter
7e398d9cee44810f.doc: Dodges backward invulnerable for 6 frames, then lunges forward with the dodge attack, invulnerable during the lunge.

7e4392e93bf05dcd.name: watch_target_while_disguised
7e4392e93bf05dcd.doc: Stands and turns to keep facing the target (within 90 degrees) for as long as the player is disguised as a monster.

7e56dd5f36994fe2.name: step_back_to_dodge_melee
7e56dd5f36994fe2.doc: Faces the target and steps back invulnerably.

7e5aec6d84319b24.name: fly_random_direction
7e5aec6d84319b24.doc: Turns to a random world heading from 0 to turn_range_deg degrees, then flies forward min_distance plus a random 0 to extra_distance_range units with fly_to_point for up to max_frames. Returns the fly_to_point result.

7e62f9499758959e.name: approach_at_long_range
7e62f9499758959e.doc: Long-range choice (210 to 330 units): usually chases the target to about 130 units, sometimes orbits it.

7ea9f7985592dc81.name: wait_motion_end_update
7ea9f7985592dc81.doc: Waits until the current motion ends, keeping the model lighting matched to the rage state each frame. Has no timeout and returns 1.

7ee65fa1e5f5da51.name: wait_motion_end_updating
7ee65fa1e5f5da51.doc: Waits until the current motion ends, running the life bookkeeping each frame. Always returns 1.

7ef64a06c4e6804f.name: get_knocked_flying_then_stun
7ef64a06c4e6804f.doc: Stun program: makes the monster damageable, locks guard and dodge, re-enables lock-on, plays the knocked-flying and get-up motions, then plays the faint motion until the stun stars run out and allows guard and dodge again.

7ef6a5ea9b8b4fba.name: reform_from_butterflies
7ef6a5ea9b8b4fba.doc: Waits 120 frames, then waits until monster var 8 is 0 (all seven butterflies have regrouped above the center after a wrong-order reset), plays event 513 and the merge effect, fades the body back in at the arena center and runs event 510. Then flies out to the orbit height and returns 1.

7effa1816d273630.name: dash_and_cast_tornado_sometimes
7effa1816d273630.doc: Increments the move counter in var 11, checks for the half-life phase change, and 18 percent of the time walks to face the target, dashes at it and runs in to cast a tornado.

7f3ce9256f52785a.name: get_up_after_fall
7f3ce9256f52785a.doc: Land program of e08a and e09a: meant to recover from the throw twice (damageable again, stop moving, end the throw, wait 10 frames, reset the motion) and then play the get-up motion. In this script pair's old numbering those calls run set_photo_window, get_home_pos, get_attack and set_life, or no native at all, so only the two 10-frame waits and the motion-end wait happen. Returns 1.

7f4f19e69edc85f3.name: fight_far_range
7f4f19e69edc85f3.doc: Far range choices: wait or turn and walk toward the target.

7f4f5fafbf0eee5f.name: side_step_invulnerable
7f4f5fafbf0eee5f.doc: Steps to a random side around the target, invulnerable during the step, keeping the same distance from the target.

7f5d113857102111.name: setup_poison_attacks
7f5d113857102111.doc: Registers the attack 1 slash hit window (0.378 to 0.556): one capsule between entry objects 0 and 2 with radius argument 4, or on grade 2 two larger spheres instead (radius arguments 6 at object 0 and 8.8 at object 2). Then loads the poison mist effects into a free texture block when one is available and starts the monster AI with init_monster_ai.

7fa35418546406cd.name: dash_back_from_target
7fa35418546406cd.doc: Unused. Without playing a motion of its own, it moves at speed toward a point 30 to 40 units farther from the target than now, taking no damage for about the first 11 frames, then waits for the current motion to end and stops.

7fabe20633a44551.name: track_monster_frames
7fabe20633a44551.doc: Keeps turning toward another monster for a number of frames.

7fd857edc598a888.name: recoil_from_hit
7fd857edc598a888.doc: Refills life, stops all actions, plays the damage motion in place, waits 12 frames after it and plays the stand motion.

7fe0cd995829ba23.name: walk_turning_toward_target
7fe0cd995829ba23.doc: Walks in place while turning toward the target until the player disguise value is non-zero.

800e3748f2f1ef1f.name: fly_to_hover_position
800e3748f2f1ef1f.doc: Flies over 60 frames to the hover point around the host given by the wobble angles in monster vars 0 to 2.

8018ba5630376f3e.name: dash_with_attack_one
8018ba5630376f3e.doc: Plays attack 1 while dashing at the target for 15 frames.

802e824b3dcd9756.name: act_at_mid_range
802e824b3dcd9756.doc: Calm mid-range choice: charge, walk up or strafe.

802f66baac06a1c5.name: is_flight_target_valid
802f66baac06a1c5.doc: Returns 1 if the boss can fly in a straight line to the point: the flight path and line of sight are clear, the point is above 3 units and over solid ground.

80310d805182e8d2.name: fight_while_no_rage_hits_left
80310d805182e8d2.doc: Enraged loop (no rage hits left): by distance it walks toward the target, swings, or summons sprouts. Returns when rage hits remain or the target is farther than 600. Not called in this script.

8046c296872fe9ae.name: turn_move_around_target
8046c296872fe9ae.doc: Turns toward a point at angle_deg and radius around the target and walks there. Shortens the move to the clear distance ahead and returns -1 when too little room is left; otherwise returns the wait_move_or_target_near result.

8078600f89e0d2ab.name: fly_to_height
8078600f89e0d2ab.doc: Moves straight up or down toward a height until close enough, blocked or out of time.

808222b9e3f00fd5.name: wander_or_watch_target
808222b9e3f00fd5.doc: Half the time walks around the target at a random distance, otherwise stands and waits for the target to come into view.

809677586e9449f9.name: fly_curved_path_to_point
809677586e9449f9.doc: Flies on a curving path that starts turned curve_angle from the direct heading and bends toward the point (or the moving target if track_target) by homing_weight each frame, turning the model to match and applying the scale step. Stops within margin of the point, when blocked, or after max_frames, and returns the frames flown.

809daa5a48997d46.name: face_monster_for_frames
809daa5a48997d46.doc: Keeps turning toward another monster for a number of frames.

80a713590681c774.name: run_current_action
80a713590681c774.doc: Runs the action in monster var 1: walking, turning, jumping, smashing, missiles, nose bomb, laying eggs or pausing. Some actions pick a different attack by the situation flags.

80b6a7f6a2c9d8b9.name: step_back_far
80b6a7f6a2c9d8b9.doc: Plays the step back motion and moves 200 units backward, taking no damage while moving.

80c9e7a3c434a06a.name: chase_target_until_near_or_out_of_bounds
80c9e7a3c434a06a.doc: Walks toward the target while turning to it. Returns -1 if within stop_dist, -2 if the target is past z -900, 1 if the frames ran out.

80f2ac87c40c02af.name: track_target_until_time
80f2ac87c40c02af.doc: Keeps turning toward the target until the current motion reaches the given progress.

80fdfabfe509e479.name: on_update
80fdfabfe509e479.doc: Main loop: fights by distance while a target exists, otherwise runs toward it.

810115407915895c.name: walk_around_point
810115407915895c.doc: Walks to a point on a circle around a center, offset from the direction facing away from the center.

812580eef4eaec1b.name: guard_after_turning
812580eef4eaec1b.doc: Turns to the target, plays the guard knockback and waits 8 frames.

8137addc4d479b05.name: chase_target_briefly
8137addc4d479b05.doc: Chases the target for up to 90 frames, then stands.

813e8541ae03d6d1.name: play_damage_and_recover
813e8541ae03d6d1.doc: Stops all actions, plays the front damage motion, waits 12 frames and stands.

817bcaf32ca7c5b1.name: die_if_death_flag_set
817bcaf32ca7c5b1.doc: If the shared monster variable 64 is set, which the Arch Demon boss (b13a) does when it dies, runs the death routine and never returns.

81915d68716ed0af.name: set_state
81915d68716ed0af.doc: Sets this piece's state (monster variable 2, private to the piece).

81a7429603053354.name: walk_up_and_slash
81a7429603053354.doc: Walks up to the target, faces it and does attack 1.

81a7cb9ebd08c472.name: face_player_while_disguised
81a7cb9ebd08c472.doc: Stands and turns to face the player until the player is no longer disguised.

81b5240fbb2b7dfa.name: hold_death_forever
81b5240fbb2b7dfa.doc: Calls the unregistered _EXT_142 (meant as finish_death under the old numbering, so it does nothing) and then waits forever.

81b981f0adad01da.name: wait_motion_time
81b981f0adad01da.doc: Waits until the current motion reaches the given progress (0 to 1) within tolerance, or ends. Returns frames waited.

81c95597322efd46.name: walk_around_target_updating
81c95597322efd46.doc: Walks to a point at the given angle and radius around the target.

81cda3c0c493ea5d.name: recover_from_throw_and_reset
81cda3c0c493ea5d.doc: Recovers from a throw, updates for 10 frames and resets the motion.

81f93ff066721091.name: pick_far_range_action
81f93ff066721091.doc: Far range choice: approaches and throws a cross cutter or lunges, or closes in, or taunts first.

8202a9b944762c5f.name: turn_random_side
8202a9b944762c5f.doc: Turns to a random angle to the left or right of the current heading and returns after the first turn.

82398972845d1437.name: on_init
82398972845d1437.doc: Registers the attack hit window, switches the monster to scripted flight, raises it 10 units and caps its height at 55.

827f47e491f9e3a2.name: walk_toward_target
827f47e491f9e3a2.doc: Walks toward the target for up to 240 frames, then stands.

8280ff84b4876e75.name: on_death
8280ff84b4876e75.doc: Runs event script 510, starts the death and halts.

828434b8f017cbb8.name: shoot_feather_volley
828434b8f017cbb8.doc: Turns to the target, plays the attack 1 wind up and fires six Tig feather projectiles from the eff276 to eff290 model points at speeds 8, 7 and 6, three angled 0.18 radians to one side of its facing and three to the other, each with the monster's attack value.

82b9b06bfcfbcb9a.name: run_behaviour_loop
82b9b06bfcfbcb9a.doc: Main loop. While rage hits remain it idles until the target is near, fights when the target is within 360 units, or when aggroed approaches and summons monsters. With no rage hits left it uses the post-rage fight behaviour.

82cfb7b0e8d3a626.name: recover_after_throw_and_hover
82cfb7b0e8d3a626.doc: After being thrown, ends the throw, gets up and sets its height to 10 above the ground. Returns 1.

82ec5031e21f77c0.name: aim_and_shoot_bullet
82ec5031e21f77c0.doc: Loops the attack 1 aiming motion while tracking the target for the given frames plus up to 4, then fires a fox bullet from dcol00 with the monster's attack value and a muzzle flash.

82f0c7fdb95cef8c.name: dodge_sidestep_around_target
82f0c7fdb95cef8c.doc: Sidesteps left or right on a circle around the target with the walk left or right motion, invulnerable during the move.

82fd022feb2ee938.name: fly_to_height
82fd022feb2ee938.doc: Moves the monster straight up at speed per frame (down if target_y is negative) until it is within speed + stop_margin of height target_y, for up to max_frames. Vertical movement stops once it is 40 units above the ground. Returns 1 on arrival, the check_flight_step result if blocked, 0 on timeout.

82fd1ccfe47568ef.name: turn_and_play_antics
82fd1ccfe47568ef.doc: Turns to the target, plays the play motion while watching it, then stands.

830431bf482caa95.name: block_attack
830431bf482caa95.doc: Turns toward the player, plays the guard-in, guard and guard-out motions and stands.

830c6cf4dc2db37b.name: finish_throw_and_allow_lock_on
830c6cf4dc2db37b.doc: Ends a throw, re-enables lock-on and returns 1.

8312628cc01e4a33.name: setup_bombahe_attacks
8312628cc01e4a33.doc: Registers the normal and knockback hits of the first attack, loads the Bombahe self-destruct effect, clears monster var 0, sets the photo window on the self-destruct death for grade 0 and starts the monster AI with init_monster_ai.

831c69122d2a7add.name: turn_to_target_random
831c69122d2a7add.doc: Turns toward the target. With offset_chance percent probability the aim is off by offset_deg to a random side.

835a3f533993da64.name: end_locked_action
835a3f533993da64.doc: Ends a locked action: lets the monster guard and dodge again and sets its act status to 0.

837c8fe84fa952b4.name: approach_at_far_range
837c8fe84fa952b4.doc: Mostly walks toward the target, sometimes waits, or circles it.

83a605b86f4501d8.name: on_damage
83a605b86f4501d8.doc: Cancels everything, plays the damage knockback, and counts the hit in variable 4.

83b7cdb54e18499d.name: all_roses_in_state
83b7cdb54e18499d.doc: Returns 1 if all six roses report the given state.

83c3092a793d0481.name: walk_attacking_then_swing
83c3092a793d0481.doc: Walks toward the target with attack 1 looping, max_steps times in a row (up to 20 frames each), then finishes with attack 3. The early exit checks a result variable that is never set, so all steps always run.

83c9f0bd5a444211.name: get_distance_2d
83c9f0bd5a444211.doc: Distance on the ground plane between two points.

83cb6be10e70c2a5.name: fight_after_rage_hits_spent
83cb6be10e70c2a5.doc: Fight loop used while no rage hits remain: melee up close, poison mist or running at the target farther away. Returns 0 when rage hits are available again or the target is beyond 230 units.

83e1ce818d939611.name: idle_loop
83e1ce818d939611.doc: Plays the idle motion and runs the empty per-frame hook every frame.

83e269f8a09c1396.name: face_target_after_dodge
83e269f8a09c1396.doc: Snaps to face the target and stands, then allows guarding again.

83f2eab495392e0e.name: fight_before_rage
83f2eab495392e0e.doc: Combat loop while rage hits remain (not yet enraged), choosing the close, mid or far action by distance (under 120, 120 to 170, 170 to 280). Returns 0 when the target is beyond 280 units or the rage hits are used up.

840a8d4acd42efd2.name: on_init
840a8d4acd42efd2.doc: Sets a clip distance of 500, registers the attack 1 hit box (poison for monster grades 1 to 3), starts the AI, sets flying attributes, lifts the monster 10 units and limits its height to 55.

840efc98663204f9.name: track_target_until_motion_end
840efc98663204f9.doc: Turns toward the target every frame at turn_speed_deg degrees per frame, with the aggro update, until the current motion reaches its last frame, then stops turning.

84435cdf2e7ea2fd.name: play_death_and_vanish
84435cdf2e7ea2fd.doc: Plays the death motions, ends the light effect stored in monster var 25 and restores collisions and stops.

844c58fb6ae2cf6d.name: pick_idle_movement
844c58fb6ae2cf6d.doc: Picks a random idle behavior: turning away from walls, returning toward home, circling the target, or waiting for it to appear. Returns 1 if it saw the target. Not called in this script; idling uses wait_for_target_to_approach.

84514502dcae43ed.name: track_target_until_time
84514502dcae43ed.doc: Keeps turning toward the target until the motion time is within tolerance of time (default 0.05 when tolerance is -1), then stops turning.

845684a2c7917605.name: run_combat_loop
845684a2c7917605.doc: Allows guard and dodge and repeats the combat decision step every frame.

8461a724f2e44bb8.name: track_target_until_time
8461a724f2e44bb8.doc: Keeps turning toward the target until the motion time is within tolerance of time (default 0.05 when tolerance is -1), then stops turning.

8471a2d07be97930.name: start_rose_round
8471a2d07be97930.doc: Casts the tornado, commands the roses in a random pattern, waits until all are in state 2, then glides to a random ring slot. Returns the next phase number 3.

84846d134326d194.name: wait_motion_end_checking_death
84846d134326d194.doc: Waits until the current motion ends, checking the death flag each frame. Returns 1.

849e26c0c967a158.name: fly_to_target
849e26c0c967a158.doc: Turns to the target, then flies straight at its position at hover_height above the ground. Returns 1 on arrival, the flight collision result if blocked, or 0 after max_frames.

84baf63beca19d7f.name: pick_free_slot
84baf63beca19d7f.doc: Returns a formation slot (1 to 8) that no butterfly occupies and that is not the current slot, or 0 if none is free.

84bf382c7cca43ff.name: choose_behavior
84bf382c7cca43ff.doc: Top-level behaviour pick. Casts the heal spell when ready, then calm monsters fight if the player is within 270 and wander otherwise, aggravated monsters fight within 170 and run at the player otherwise, and enraged ones use the enraged combat loop.

84cd050bd7dab16b.name: wait_move_end_updating
84cd050bd7dab16b.doc: Updates the boss each frame until the current move ends or max_frames pass.

84e0fbffa363277e.name: guard_against_shot
84e0fbffa363277e.doc: Stops and plays the guard knockback motion against a ranged attack.

84e36f32662269d7.name: on_init
84e36f32662269d7.doc: Makes the monster impossible to lock on to, enables velocity control and sets up its aggro ranges.

84f4b5ffe837d02f.name: dodge_step_sideways
84f4b5ffe837d02f.doc: Steps left or right around the player at the same distance, invulnerable during the step.

850dfe95bf6e4a91.name: sense_nearest_monster
850dfe95bf6e4a91.doc: Sets bit flags in monster variable 0 from the nearest monster: 8 if closer than 6, 1 if closer than 100, 2 if farther than 260, 4 if it is not roughly in front.

85153f83a57c2363.name: fight_by_target_distance
85153f83a57c2363.doc: Loops, calling the long (400 to 200), mid (200 to 100) or short range choice from the distance to the target. Returns 0 when the target is farther than 400.

8569ae5a19c20abc.name: is_flight_point_clear
8569ae5a19c20abc.doc: Returns 1 if the boss can fly straight to the point without hitting anything and the point's height is between 0 and 50.

85763cc8552ccf9f.name: leap_along_arc
85763cc8552ccf9f.doc: Moves the monster along a ballistic arc from the start point to the end point over the given number of frames, with the given gravity, never dropping below the end height once it has been reached.

85787118bfbea43c.name: rush_and_explode
85787118bfbea43c.doc: One step of the Kotoren behaviour: on the first step it turns to the player and plays attack 1 out, then half the time rushes to within 21 units; within 42 units it explodes (small explosion carrying its attack power), and if it was the last monster runs event script 510. Over 300 frames after the floor-time mark it explodes on its own, with an attack value not yet read and without the event.

8596a5a48216197e.name: fly_sideways
8596a5a48216197e.doc: Flies 300 units to the monster's right (go_right set) or left.

85a08fe93c224fca.name: dash_around_target
85a08fe93c224fca.doc: Turns toward the point radius units from the target at angle_deg around it and dashes there for up to 180 frames, at height_offset above the ground under the boss.

85ab70ca3a7c608d.name: circle_or_watch_target
85ab70ca3a7c608d.doc: Used when other monsters are nearer the target: circles it at about 160 units or stands watching.

85b0ab1313a12e32.name: wait_move_until_near
85b0ab1313a12e32.doc: Waits up to max_frames for a move_to walk. Returns 1 as soon as the target is within stop_dist, 2 when the walk ends, 0 on timeout; stops moving on 1 or 2 but not on timeout.

85bb38ce6b70615d.name: recover_from_throw_and_resume_flight
85bb38ce6b70615d.doc: Recovers from a throw, waits 10 frames, turns scripted flight on and resets the motion.

85be5a18b5786ceb.name: dodge_melee_by_stepping_back
85be5a18b5786ceb.doc: Locks interrupts, steps backward and restores guard and dodge.

85cc2000e4b8a031.name: strafe_or_watch_target
85cc2000e4b8a031.doc: Half the time circles the player at about 95 units, otherwise stands waiting for the player to stay in view.

85d1de2e54620f95.name: move_beside_target
85d1de2e54620f95.doc: Walks to the point beside the target at angle_deg, at the target's current distance. Shortens the path to the clear space ahead and returns -1 when too little is left; otherwise returns the wait_move_until_near result.

85d232a48242d3ed.name: stand_and_watch_while_disguised
85d232a48242d3ed.doc: Stands and turns to face the player until the player's disguise ends.

85d906bd027194d9.name: find_clear_direction
85d906bd027194d9.doc: Looks at dir_count evenly spaced directions around the monster for one with at least min_clear room (dist if -1). Returns that angle and writes the spare room to clear_slack[0], or -100 when none is clear.

85f7d6624c5a2fee.name: wait_target_in_view
85f7d6624c5a2fee.doc: Waits until the target is in view; returns 1 if seen, 0 on timeout.

85fba4b77faf7654.name: wait_to_detect_target
85fba4b77faf7654.doc: Waits up to max_frames for can_detect_target to succeed. Returns 1 when the target is detected, 0 otherwise.

8600403e7ece3d1a.name: face_target_now
8600403e7ece3d1a.doc: Sets the monster's yaw to face the target at once, with no turning animation.

86125df0ae6b1800.name: circle_target_when_crowded
86125df0ae6b1800.doc: Used when the monster is low priority: half the time circles the target at 70 to 100 units, otherwise stands watching it.

8615525efa330ba4.name: float_around_leader
8615525efa330ba4.doc: Update program of the red light. Whenever the command in monster var 30 is 4 it rises above the leader; state 2 in var 27 then drifts to the circle start, state 16 circles above the leader with the light effect, and state 64 flies back to the orbit position and sets state 4. Every frame it orbits the leader, advancing its orbit angles by a sway step that swings between plus and minus pi/32.

86158df4240d593c.name: hover_idle_while_player_disguised
86158df4240d593c.doc: Floats up to height 25 above its position, then idles in place while the player is disguised as a monster, turning to face the target when it is more than the allowed angle off; returns when the player is no longer disguised.

8656635249e042a0.name: wait_motion_time
8656635249e042a0.doc: Waits until the motion's progress reaches time within tolerance (default 0.03 when -1) or the motion ends. Returns the frames waited.

865c0909d07ae2e6.name: fight_target_enraged
865c0909d07ae2e6.doc: Fight loop once the rage hits are used up: charges when the target is 80 or more units away and charges or circles up close. Returns when the target is further than 240 units.

866949ac521fe4d3.name: face_then_chase_target
866949ac521fe4d3.doc: Faces the target, then chases it for up to max_frames at ground height. Returns -1 once within stop_dist.

866fa1ed0440dfdd.name: dodge_shot_by_side_step
866fa1ed0440dfdd.doc: Steps sideways away from a shot and restores guard and dodge.

867fe1a4ff809c96.name: struggle_forever
867fe1a4ff809c96.doc: Plays the struggling motion and then waits forever.

868256c697ed2aec.name: fly_around_target
868256c697ed2aec.doc: Turns toward and flies to a point on a circle around the target.

8683a2789190e9cb.name: run_ai_forever
8683a2789190e9cb.doc: Allows guarding and dodging, then runs the decision logic every frame.

868759ed63945bba.name: walk_toward_heading
868759ed63945bba.doc: Walks the given distance along an absolute heading without turning first.

868a916cb8beb416.name: turn_randomly_to_one_side
868a916cb8beb416.doc: Picks a random heading to the left or right of the current yaw and turns to it. It returns after the first turn, so the repeat loop never runs more than once.

86a6305c8f0382ed.name: fight_at_mid_range
86a6305c8f0382ed.doc: Mid-range choice (70 to 200 units): spit, approach by walking or running, side-step, or wander around the target.

86a8745c5bae20af.name: get_form_flags
86a8745c5bae20af.doc: Reads monster var 6: bit 1 is the form hurt by Max's weapons, bit 2 the form hurt by Monica, bit 4 the sky phase.

86b8a5de9e23d41c.name: on_knockdown
86b8a5de9e23d41c.doc: Resets for knockdown and cancels the spit effect.

86c84e20260a6d5b.name: fly_to_point_at_height
86c84e20260a6d5b.doc: Flies the monster in a straight line to the point (x, z), hovering hover_height above the ground, for up to max_frames. Returns 1 on arrival within speed plus stop_margin, the blocking result if the step hits something, 0 on timeout.

86f73c813b549af0.name: brace_against_shot
86f73c813b549af0.doc: If the target is farther than 170, holds the attack pose for 42 frames while taking no damage; otherwise just resets.

871f1bff7956860f.name: lunge_heavy_attack
871f1bff7956860f.doc: Turns to the target and plays attack 2 while tracking it for 12 frames, then moves toward a point 100 units ahead at 2.625 units per frame for 14 frames (about 37 units), waits for the motion to end and stands for 9 frames.

874b3bf28277ef3a.name: face_player_while_disguised
874b3bf28277ef3a.doc: Idle loop while the player is disguised: turns to face the player when not already within 60 degrees of facing it, and stands otherwise. Returns when the disguise is removed.

874bcd13a7e17810.name: track_monster_frames
874bcd13a7e17810.doc: Keeps turning toward another monster for the given number of frames.

874d74c4c56741bc.name: run_at_target
874d74c4c56741bc.doc: Turns to the target and runs at it for up to 120 frames, then stands.

874e972e7bf87ac6.name: fight_at_mid_range
874e972e7bf87ac6.doc: Mid-range choice (120 to 200 units): fire shot, run or walk closer depending on life, circle the target, or taunt then claw.

876b14c5fb2553ed.name: chase_target_checking_line_of_sight
876b14c5fb2553ed.doc: Chases the target like face_then_chase_target but gives up with -2 if a wall blocks the line to it, or -1 once within stop_dist.

877f07ab7ea88dc2.name: on_land
877f07ab7ea88dc2.doc: Lands after being thrown and gets up. Returns 1.

878da17ffebc83b8.name: recoil_from_hit
878da17ffebc83b8.doc: Plays the damage knockback motion, waits it out and returns to play motion.

87a20a6547a767be.name: face_target_for_frames
87a20a6547a767be.doc: Keeps turning toward the target for the given number of frames.

87ab1e7b9bcbe9b0.name: attack_in_close_range
87ab1e7b9bcbe9b0.doc: Close-range attack choice: walks or runs up and swings a normal or dodge attack, or does a shuffle, step back or sidestep.

87acec58abd94253.name: setup_boss
87acec58abd94253.doc: Makes the boss impossible to lock on to and lets its script place it, stores its handle in variable 30, resets the orbit and damage variables, shows the boss02 map parts and sets photo 1027.

87d8d33434b9103f.name: set_monster_vars
87d8d33434b9103f.doc: Stores three values into monster variables 0, 1 and 2.

87f23b26e3fc690a.name: on_update
87f23b26e3fc690a.doc: Allows guarding and dodging and then idles; this monster never attacks.

87fe9c8e1b494b4a.name: walk_toward_angle
87fe9c8e1b494b4a.doc: Meant to fly distance (at least speed plus 1) along the absolute angle angle_deg without turning first, at height_offset above the ground, stopping early when the target comes within clearance. The position and move calls are old-numbered and reach unrelated natives, so the monster does not move.

8822b142a9f12f48.name: setup_griffon_attacks
8822b142a9f12f48.doc: Registers the knockback and Griffon combo hit boxes, loads the Griffon effects and attaches a flame effect to the monster. Sets life to 0.34 and the camera mode.

882863369d304b02.name: fight_target_normally
882863369d304b02.doc: Combat loop before the monster is enraged: picks the close, mid or far routine by distance, and returns when the target gets far or the monster becomes enraged.

882a1f50da3f443b.name: play_death_and_halt
882a1f50da3f443b.doc: Death state: starts the death, makes the monster lockable again, plays the death motion and finishes in the halted state.

8836c1872c4b7116.name: wait_motion_end
8836c1872c4b7116.doc: Meant to wait for the current motion to end, but the old-numbered motion-end check runs as get_life, which reads nonzero while the monster is alive, so it returns 1 after one frame.

8852857d0fde5864.name: get_floor_time_since
8852857d0fde5864.doc: Returns how much floor time has passed since record_floor_time was called for the slot.

885905ce3eba8d0b.name: on_land
885905ce3eba8d0b.doc: Recovers from a throw, ends active roses and returns success.

885d1af682a745a6.name: play_death_and_drop_items
885d1af682a745a6.doc: Death state: stops moving, faces the target, starts the item drops, plays the death motion and finishes the death, then idles forever.

88617a76b5849cb0.name: wander_or_wait_idle
88617a76b5849cb0.doc: Idle behaviour while the monster has not noticed the player: walks away from walls, wanders around its home point or around the target, or stands and watches. Returns 1 if the target was detected while standing.

8881ad622e9a2d0f.name: fight_by_distance
8881ad622e9a2d0f.doc: Loop that picks close, mid or long-range behaviour from the flat distance to the target and circles instead when its priority is poor. Returns when the target is over 180 units away.

8889644a5f4134fc.name: swing_attack_one
8889644a5f4134fc.doc: Plays attack 1 once and waits for it to end.

88a6198268b10a88.name: hover_until_threatened
88a6198268b10a88.doc: Hovers paused. Returns 5 (dodge) when another butterfly is close or the player comes within 200 units at speed above 3, 0 when the round ends and 3 when it resets.

88a87c7cfd14bac4.name: wait_or_circle_target
88a87c7cfd14bac4.doc: Used when the monster must not attack yet: half the time circles the target, otherwise stands or plays the taunt.

88a9b4beaac1cfb6.name: follow_target_for_a_while
88a9b4beaac1cfb6.doc: Walks after the target for up to 240 frames, then stands.

88b0901892bd304b.name: wander_until_target_detected
88b0901892bd304b.doc: Idle behaviour for an unaware flier: turns away from walls, drifts home, circles, wanders or hovers waiting. Returns 1 when it notices the target.

88b0a340ce1d28e9.name: setup_linda
88b0a340ce1d28e9.doc: Init program of Linda the elephant (e214a and e214a2): registers body parts and attack hit windows, sets starting monster vars (queueing attack 2 then idle), preloads the Vanguard shockwave effect, sets the clip distance and stands.

88bf6d77dadda0a0.name: turn_to_target_random
88bf6d77dadda0a0.doc: Turns toward the target, but with the given percent chance offsets the aim by the offset angle to one random side.

88dd1909aa7f6eb2.name: strafe_until_target_near
88dd1909aa7f6eb2.doc: While the target is 300 or more away, flies to the point 240 units from the target at 30 degrees (playing the step right or step left motion, but the same point either way), turns toward the target, or stands watching it. Returns 0 once the target is nearer. Not called by this script.

88ddf6d00b043c47.name: attack_at_close_range
88ddf6d00b043c47.doc: Close-range choice: half the time attacks in place, repeating 1 to 3 times when the target is under 50 units, otherwise spits venom.

88ea3d556a0d7f2a.name: wait_until_facing_angle_or_target_in_view
88ea3d556a0d7f2a.doc: Waits for the monster to face the given angle but returns -1 as soon as the target comes into view. Otherwise returns the frames waited.

88f1318464b5f190.name: walk_to_point_around_position
88f1318464b5f190.doc: Walks to a point on a circle around a fixed position (such as home), facing it first. Returns the move result.

88f3930ade9edd7d.name: swing_attack_1_then_2_early
88f3930ade9edd7d.doc: Plays attack 1 and switches to attack 2 at 43.2 percent of the first motion.

88f4cdbadd047b3c.name: shoot_thunder_shot
88f4cdbadd047b3c.doc: Turns to the target, plays attack 2 while tracking it, spawns the thunder shot launch effect at the face frame, then the looping thunder shot at motion time 0.608 with the monster's attack value.
