8917235c99f730c2.name: count_hits_and_restore_life
8917235c99f730c2.doc: If this piece may attack, checks for lost life and bumps the hit counter when it dropped. Then refills life to maximum so the piece cannot die.

8918e786435f5223.name: pick_wary_action
8918e786435f5223.doc: Used when another monster is nearer the target: stands, circles the target at about 85 units or plays idle taunts.

8920496c9906c882.name: fight_by_distance_range
8920496c9906c882.doc: Loop that returns when the target is beyond 270 units or the rage counter is zero. Picks the far, mid or near action by distance, or circles the target when other monsters are closer.

894113559dc50228.name: lerp_float
894113559dc50228.doc: Linear interpolation from start to finish_value by t.

8947343ad583c713.name: wait_motion_watch_target
8947343ad583c713.doc: Waits for the motion to end. Returns 1 if the target comes into view first, 0 if the motion ended.

897cbf6cc792cff2.name: react_to_player_disguise
897cbf6cc792cff2.doc: If the player is disguised, runs the follow behavior.

89a2e55ef17eecd4.name: idle_near_target
89a2e55ef17eecd4.doc: Low-priority behaviour near the target: play idly, circle the target, or stand watching it.

89ad4ebb5919ba2d.name: follow_player_while_disguised
89ad4ebb5919ba2d.doc: While the player is disguised, keeps facing the monster toward the player. Returns once the disguise ends. The monster kind parameter is unused.

89b3ed6336500fea.name: idle_while_player_disguised
89b3ed6336500fea.doc: If the player is disguised as a monster, runs the idle-and-face-player loop; otherwise does nothing.

89b92ef94323fe76.name: record_damage_taken
89b92ef94323fe76.doc: Records the last hit in monster variable set 2: slot 6 gets the attack type of the last hit and slot 7 the life lost (prev_life minus life).

89ebba36ac2a49c4.name: strafe_or_idle
89ebba36ac2a49c4.doc: Half the time either walks to a point 30 to 60 degrees around the player at 90 to 120 units and turns back to face it, or stands waiting up to 30 frames for the player to come within 40 units; the rest of the time plays the idle play motion. Used while the player is 175 units or more away and when other monsters are nearer the player.

89ee5945d921751d.name: idle_forever
89ee5945d921751d.doc: Does nothing, one frame at a time, forever.

89fb19e05d4a0a94.name: wander_or_wait_for_target
89fb19e05d4a0a94.doc: Idle behaviour: backs away from walls, returns toward home if far from it, otherwise randomly stands waiting for the player, circles the target, or walks in a random direction. Returns 1 if the player was detected while waiting.

8a1557d46a2b386e.name: attack_with_shockwave
8a1557d46a2b386e.doc: Swings, then spawns the S wave L effect on the ground at the weapon collision point carrying the monster attack value.

8a5c608aa565cf1b.name: turn_to_target_random
8a5c608aa565cf1b.doc: Turns toward the target, with offset_chance percent chance of aiming offset_deg to a random side, and waits until done.

8a60f76609bb655d.name: circle_target_when_crowded
8a60f76609bb655d.doc: Used when the monster is low priority: circles the target at about 120 units, stands watching it, or plays the idle taunt.

8a8700f89b352480.name: start_dripping_effect
8a8700f89b352480.doc: Creates the dripping lava effect on the monster and stores it in a global.

8a8d5f5b4451bf75.name: set_aggro_timer
8a8d5f5b4451bf75.doc: Sets the aggro timer (monster variable set 2, slot 12), the frames counted so far toward the aggro duration.

8a972d363e643b84.name: begin_locked_action
8a972d363e643b84.doc: Forbids guard and dodge, resets motion, stops turning, turns off scripted movement and marks the monster busy.

8a9e189a1e4aea24.name: setup_attacks_and_goo_effects
8a9e189a1e4aea24.doc: Registers the normal hits on the whole of attack 1 and on attack 3 (0.346 to 0.448), loads the sticky goo effects into a free texture block when one is available, and starts the monster AI with init_monster_ai.

8ab0c8fe3608bda3.name: fight_at_mid_range
8ab0c8fe3608bda3.doc: Mid range choice: runs up and attacks with attack 1 or 2, or walks closer.

8abbed475ae67631.name: play_knockdown_and_get_up
8abbed475ae67631.doc: Knockdown program: locks the monster, plays the knocked-flying motion with a knockback, lies down 30 frames, then gets up.

8aca70a19da7b2e7.name: fly_to_height
8aca70a19da7b2e7.doc: Moves straight up speed units per frame (down only when target_y is negative, since only its sign sets the direction) until within speed plus near_dist of height target_y; vertical movement stops for good 25 units above the ground or at ground level. Returns 1 on arrival, the check_flight_step result if blocked, or 0 after max_frames.

8ad076b1f5ca2a13.name: stand_idle_frames
8ad076b1f5ca2a13.doc: Stops moving, restarts the stand motion and waits the given number of frames.

8aef9e846170bc06.name: stand_idle_frames
8aef9e846170bc06.doc: Stops moving, plays the stand motion and waits the given frames.

8afaff933523e770.name: drift_moon_until_timer_ends
8afaff933523e770.doc: Slides the moon away from the world origin toward the point 5000 units from the origin in its direction, at a speed that covers that gap in 9000 frames (2.5 minutes; it does not stop there). When the stopwatch event info reaches zero it stops the moon and runs event script 1201 once.

8b01c2cd1032b417.name: walk_random_direction_updating
8b01c2cd1032b417.doc: Turns by a random angle and walks a random distance, stopping at obstacles.

8b39ac2b6dc78ac2.name: turn_and_walk_in_direction
8b39ac2b6dc78ac2.doc: Turns toward an angle and walks that way for the given distance. Returns the move result.

8b4d2cfb09b9a045.name: approach_at_medium_range
8b4d2cfb09b9a045.doc: Turns to the target and runs toward it for 45 frames.

8b699745b32eac83.name: track_target_until_motion_end
8b699745b32eac83.doc: Keeps turning toward the target until the current motion ends.

8b7b0c7be6ccd2de.name: turn_to_angle
8b7b0c7be6ccd2de.doc: Starts a turn to the given yaw in degrees at the given turn speed and waits until it is reached. Returns the frames spent turning.

8b92a66a027b6247.name: play_limp_loop
8b92a66a027b6247.doc: Loops the limp motion while the piece is down.

8b949c92e578fce2.name: fight_at_close_range
8b949c92e578fce2.doc: Close range choice: attack 1 most of the time, otherwise chases the target, stands watching it, or walks straight toward it.

8b9509d21b2a1ea6.name: throw_cross_cutter
8b9509d21b2a1ea6.doc: Attack 2: fires a cross cutter projectile at the target carrying the monster's attack power.

8bb2bd081ee3ad36.name: get_offset_in_direction
8bb2bd081ee3ad36.doc: Writes the ground plane offset of length dist at base_angle plus angle_offset into out_x[0] and out_z[0].

8bd7e4144af97e81.name: run_ai_step
8bd7e4144af97e81.doc: One AI decision. While rage hits remain: without aggro it fights within 250 units and wanders otherwise; with aggro it fights within 170 units, runs at the target within the aggro range, or drops the aggro. With no rage hits left it fights enraged.

8bd83ed49ed9333d.name: summon_minion_when_ready
8bd83ed49ed9333d.doc: In the red, invincible phase (variable 3 equal to 2), once the slot 1 timer passes 60 frames and fewer than 13 monsters exist, creates monster 630 just below the boss, resets the slot 2 timer and counts the minion.

8c3d44601e219b59.name: wander_when_idle
8c3d44601e219b59.doc: Idle behaviour while no target is engaged: backs away from walls, walks around its home point, stands watching, or paces around the target, recording the movement type in a monster variable. Returns 1 as soon as the target is detected, otherwise 0.

8c4a0ab0a8883c08.name: turn_to_target_with_random_offset
8c4a0ab0a8883c08.doc: Turns toward the target, with the given percent chance of aiming the offset to the left or right of it. Returns the frames waited.

8c4a901bbebd2d83.name: choose_action
8c4a901bbebd2d83.doc: Picks a behaviour from the situation flags: attack and wait when in range, wander or turn when the target is far, turn when it is behind, run in when it is ahead.

8c5bf91ccff19ead.name: is_facing_target_within_degrees
8c5bf91ccff19ead.doc: Meant to return 1 if the target lies within angle_deg degrees either side of the monster's facing, otherwise 0. In this script's old native numbering the target angle read runs get_pos and the rotation read has no native, so the result does not reflect the facing.

8c5c74e01d74131d.name: turn_to_face_target_and_wait
8c5c74e01d74131d.doc: Turns to face the target at the given speed and waits for the turn to finish. Returns the frames waited.

8c5f71cb63759c1f.name: act_on_situation_flags
8c5f71cb63759c1f.doc: Picks an action from the situation flags: attack when close in front, run at a far target, turn to face one behind, or mostly step back or sidestep with a 10% chance of walking nearer.

8c9adf03c8c5ba7d.name: block_attack_with_guard
8c9adf03c8c5ba7d.doc: Uninterruptible guard knockback for 8 frames, then returns to standing.

8caf812f03d0f542.name: fire_beam_then_return_to_arena
8caf812f03d0f542.doc: Sky phase action. Fires the sweeping beam (twice below 10 percent life), clears the sky flag and returns to the ground phase.

8cb50f76b588a4c8.name: walk_around_point
8cb50f76b588a4c8.doc: Turns toward a point at the given radius and angle around a fixed point and walks to it.

8cd43de57729f622.name: track_target_frames
8cd43de57729f622.doc: Turns toward the target every frame for the given number of frames, then stops turning. The speed goes to the turn unconverted, so it is in radians per frame; the values callers give, such as 5, make the monster face the target almost at once.

8cdde590289203ce.name: wait_for_move_end
8cdde590289203ce.doc: Waits for the current move to end, up to max_frames frames.

8cea5cb27178fc51.name: decide_behavior
8cea5cb27178fc51.doc: One AI step. While the rage counter is above zero it wanders or fights by distance, otherwise it uses the enraged fight loop.

8cf541c8a36b042c.name: choose_ai_by_rage_and_aggro
8cf541c8a36b042c.doc: Update step: with rage hits left, uses the calm AI when the target is within 280 units (or the idle wander when unaggroed and farther, or runs in and shoots when aggroed and farther); with none left, runs the enraged AI.

8d5f65b178172eda.name: play_magma_death_scene
8d5f65b178172eda.doc: Ends the lava effects, plays the (magma) death motion, runs event 570 and halts.

8d7bbea76480b65a.name: fight_with_no_rage_hits_left
8d7bbea76480b65a.doc: Fight loop once the monster is enraged; it never returns. Within 100 units it dashes (beyond 60) or pounces, or walks up; farther out it dashes 600 units (30%), walks up, or walks back or sideways.

8d93f9c420483219.name: face_player_while_disguised
8d93f9c420483219.doc: Idle loop used while the player is disguised: turns to face the player when not already facing within 60 degrees, otherwise stands. Ends when the disguise is removed.

8da82ea27a1d404f.name: on_update
8da82ea27a1d404f.doc: Allows guard and dodge, then each frame uses the normal AI when the target is within 190 units or the wander behaviour when farther.

8db7db34c754b96a.name: attack_at_close_range
8db7db34c754b96a.doc: Close-range choice: mostly swings attack 1, otherwise circles the target or steps back.

8dbfbfbe733e374b.name: face_target_until_motion_end
8dbfbfbe733e374b.doc: Turns toward the target every frame at speed_deg degrees per frame, with the aggro update, until the current motion reaches its last frame, then stops turning.

8dbfd2fb4ea2cfab.name: run_ai_forever
8dbfd2fb4ea2cfab.doc: Allows guarding and dodging, then runs the decision logic every frame.

8dc7d5ae227a9216.name: play_death_and_run_event
8dc7d5ae227a9216.doc: Plays the death motion with no smoke, waits 30 frames and runs event script 560.

8dddec383167d4f5.name: wait_until_landed
8dddec383167d4f5.doc: Land program in the b02a raw numbering, meant to wait until the monster's height above the ground drops below 0.1, wait 3 frames, reset the motion and stop moving, wait 30 frames and return 1. The motion reset is a call with no native on this disc (_EXT_155), so it never happens.

8debda76153d6ab0.name: wait_move_until_near_target
8debda76153d6ab0.doc: Waits while the current move runs. Returns 1 when the target is within stop_dist, 2 when the move ended elsewhere, 0 on timeout; stops moving unless it timed out.

8dffc1004a3dd0bf.name: charge_at_target
8dffc1004a3dd0bf.doc: Does the attack 2 rolling charge at the player for up to 120 frames (the charge_frames argument is ignored), playing sound 6 if it gets within 19 units of the player, then stands.

8e130f29b3b2a11d.name: chase_target_in_flight
8e130f29b3b2a11d.doc: Flies toward the target's current position each frame, hovering above the ground, and tilts to face it if tilt_to_target is set. Returns 1 when close, the blocking result if blocked, 0 on timeout.

8e13fb8f0dcb9f69.name: on_dodge_melee
8e13fb8f0dcb9f69.doc: Dodges a melee attack with a step back (about a third of the time) or a sidestep.

8e1b36b5634f3299.name: lock_and_end_flight
8e1b36b5634f3299.doc: Forbids guard and dodge, resets the motion, stops turning, waits a frame, turns scripted flight off and sets the action status to 1.

8e25143f99fc5fda.name: reset_for_action
8e25143f99fc5fda.doc: Blocks guard and dodge, clears the motion, movement and turning, faces the target, waits a frame and sets act status 1.

8e3bf86fdd0ee263.name: on_guard
8e3bf86fdd0ee263.doc: Turns to the target quickly, raises the guard, is pushed back, holds 60 frames and lowers the guard.

8e4654701f8920ac.name: choose_close_range_action
8e4654701f8920ac.doc: Picks an action when the target is within 85 units: mostly one of the attack combos after turning, sometimes a step back or circling the target.

8e4dbf0bd4a6460d.name: is_target_in_view
8e4dbf0bd4a6460d.doc: Returns 1 when the target is closer than max_dist and within half_angle_deg of the monster's facing, else 0. The angle test does not wrap at plus or minus 180 degrees, so a target just across that line from the facing counts as out of view.

8eb10a1edb054097.name: turn_until_facing_angle
8eb10a1edb054097.doc: Waits until the monster's yaw is within the tolerance of the given angle or the frame limit passes, then stops turning. Returns the frames waited.

8ecec26d82962ef6.name: wait_for_turn_or_target_in_view
8ecec26d82962ef6.doc: Waits until the monster has turned to angle_deg, stopping early. Returns -1 if the target comes into view, otherwise the frames waited.

8ed77f56bed4c62f.name: toggle_ai_mode
8ed77f56bed4c62f.doc: Switches between AI mode 2 and 1, turning the velocity attribute on when going to mode 1 and off when going to mode 2.

8ee8cb594045b36a.name: sweep_beam_across_arena
8ee8cb594045b36a.doc: Attack 2. Fires a DE beam from a random point 500 units out across the arena through the target over 90 frames, turning the boss with it, at 1.8x attack damage.

8eed8d3f8c1cb8b5.name: strafe_or_watch_target
8eed8d3f8c1cb8b5.doc: Half the time circles the player at about 90 units, otherwise stands watching.

8ef568f90fe5707f.name: fight_target_by_distance
8ef568f90fe5707f.doc: Loops while the target is within 230 units and rage hits remain, choosing long, medium or close behaviour by distance (140, 85).

8ef6ccb16857e06f.name: run_monster_ai
8ef6ccb16857e06f.doc: Allows guard and dodge, then runs the behaviour pick every frame.

8f59fce62a56edbe.name: back_step_dodge_melee
8f59fce62a56edbe.doc: Snaps to face the target, back steps away and unlocks.

8f65a9d77f9a6423.name: fight_target_in_range
8f65a9d77f9a6423.doc: Fight loop used while rage hits are left: picks the close, mid or long range behaviour from the target distance. Returns when the target is more than 230 units away or the rage hits run out.

8f754191e9371e26.name: perform_aerial_attack_sequence
8f754191e9371e26.doc: Close-range sequence: runs the waypoint route if the target is on raised ground, swings, usually drill-charges, takes off, circles the arena dropping bombs when below 20% life, hovers toward the target and drops a bomb, half the time follows the target dropping bombs, and lands. It rests 90 frames after a follow that did not fail, then chases on foot for up to 90 frames and rests again if the chase timed out without reaching the target.

8f7a73511c32acbb.name: get_up_after_landing
8f7a73511c32acbb.doc: Land program after being thrown: finishes the throw (10 frames), stops and ends the throw again, waits another 10 frames, plays the get-up motion and returns 1.

8f7e2e059d528c72.name: sidestep_random
8f7e2e059d528c72.doc: Walks and turns to the target, then flies past it with fly_around_target_step at 150 degrees to a random side, 50 units beyond the target distance, over up to 30 frames.

8f8c2277d6e213b4.name: chase_and_swing_at_target
8f8c2277d6e213b4.doc: Walks up to the target and plays attack 1, a knockback swing registered in on_init.

8f9c1c959f18f8bb.name: turn_to_face_target
8f9c1c959f18f8bb.doc: Turns toward the target and waits for the turn to finish. Returns the frames waited.

8fafe5777033f5bb.name: get_height_limits
8fafe5777033f5bb.doc: Reads the movement height range from monster vars 0 and 1.

8fb375ef741552c7.name: leap_in_and_wander
8fb375ef741552c7.doc: On first run picks a free one of eight ring slots in monster var 8 (dying at once if all are taken), appears 80 units underground at radius 400 and leaps 140 units toward the centre over 30 frames. Afterwards loops forever alternating a wander and a 40 to 119 frame stand; it has no attack of its own.

8fd28fed48cb31f0.name: setup_aggro_and_clip
8fd28fed48cb31f0.doc: Sets the aggro range to 500 and near range to 80, initialises several monster vars, stores the spawn position in the globals and sets a clip distance of 500.

8fd3d342201af8f2.name: fight_target_enraged
8fd3d342201af8f2.doc: Fight loop once the rage hits are used up: swings attack 1 or runs at the target by distance.

8fdcaeaf745b9c34.name: fight_at_long_range
8fdcaeaf745b9c34.doc: Long-range choice (170 to 290 units): stands watching the target or walks closer.

8fe216503bd747f3.name: face_player_while_disguised
8fe216503bd747f3.doc: Idle loop used while the player is disguised: turns to face the player when not already facing within 60 degrees, otherwise stands. Ends when the disguise is removed.

9022c4ded783f3bd.name: fly_toward_target
9022c4ded783f3bd.doc: Turns to the target and flies toward it frame by frame. Returns 1 when close enough, a hit code when blocked, 0 on timeout.

902cde498a64707a.name: run_past_target_and_slash
902cde498a64707a.doc: Runs at the target, then heads for the point 200 units from where it started along the original heading to the target while doing attack 1 until 59.5% progress.

90344eb4038df1d0.name: wait_motion_watch_target
90344eb4038df1d0.doc: Waits for the motion to end, returning 1 early if the target comes into view.

905075429314e183.name: choose_behavior
905075429314e183.doc: Per frame decision: fights or wanders when not aggro, runs at the target while aggro and in range, or runs the no-rage fight loop when no rage hits remain.

905105c40fe5c3ba.name: on_knockdown
905105c40fe5c3ba.doc: Locks the monster facing the target and ends the locked action.

9059a95daf61d854.name: fly_and_attack_loop
9059a95daf61d854.doc: Update program, meant to fly to 60 units above the ground at the target, then loop the feather volley, the feather rain and the energy absorb with 60, 60 and 20 frame flying pauses. Under this script's old numbering the monster neither turns nor flies, and the wait inside fire_feather_volley never ends, so it stalls in the first volley.

9062ed0d5d6ca4a4.name: dodge_step_right
9062ed0d5d6ca4a4.doc: Sidestep to the right, invulnerable from frame 10 to 24 of the step motion. When the target is within 110 units it heads for a point 200 units to its right at 3.6 per frame, covering about 50 units in that window; otherwise it moves to a point 85 units from the target, 30 degrees to its side, while turning to face it.

9069324ac73f98d0.name: play_boss_defeat
9069324ac73f98d0.doc: Hides the boss02 map parts, plays the death sound and event script 501, then the death motion and finishes the death.

908077e0c036e7ab.name: dash_forward_by_target_distance
908077e0c036e7ab.doc: Faces the target and moves forward as far as the target is away. Returns -1 without moving if a wall is in the way.

909a112fbe611453.name: wait_motion_time
909a112fbe611453.doc: Waits until the current motion reaches the given progress or ends. A tolerance of -1 means 0.03. Returns the frames waited.

90bbed808301dad8.name: fly_and_get_up_when_stunned
90bbed808301dad8.doc: Plays the knocked-flying and get-up motions while stunned.

90bc5f2f5a02f760.name: turn_to_angle_and_wait
90bc5f2f5a02f760.doc: Starts turning to the angle at the given speed and waits until it faces that way.

90f0f37b2f6a8a3c.name: reset_motion_old
90f0f37b2f6a8a3c.doc: Meant to reset the motion, but in this script's old native numbering the call runs get_attack instead, so it does nothing.

90f522a0e9eb6712.name: act_at_far_range
90f522a0e9eb6712.doc: Calm long-range choice: walk closer, stand watching, or turn and charge.

90f90b3777df12fb.name: freeze_for_knockdown
90f90b3777df12fb.doc: Start of the knockdown reaction: stops moving and turning, snaps to face the target and waits a frame.

9106d822ff42b838.name: fight_target_by_range
9106d822ff42b838.doc: Main fight loop: runs the user monster mode, returns when the target is beyond 300, and picks the far, mid or close range behaviour by distance (or circles when its priority is too low).

9108339cc499f3e3.name: fly_accelerating_to_point
9108339cc499f3e3.doc: Flies in a straight line to the point with constant acceleration, scaling the model each frame, and stops near the point or when blocked. Returns the frames used.

9155040daf164908.name: wander_when_target_far
9155040daf164908.doc: Idle behaviour while the target is not close: turns away from walls, wanders around its home point, circles the target, waits to notice the target, or walks off in a random direction. Returns 1 when the target is detected.

9167a68d3dc2228e.name: act_at_close_range
9167a68d3dc2228e.doc: Close range behaviour: 80% lunge slash, otherwise walks around the target or steps back.

91760f23058d4ab5.name: wait_motion_end_updating
91760f23058d4ab5.doc: Waits until the current motion ends, running the life bookkeeping each frame. Always returns 1.

91877f945535dbd6.name: wait_motion_time
91877f945535dbd6.doc: Meant to wait until the motion progress is within tolerance of time (0.03 when tolerance is -1), but the old-numbered progress read runs as get_no_damage_count, so it waits until that hit count is within tolerance of time, which for a time between the tolerance and 1 - tolerance never happens. Returns the frames waited.

918f83acdf10e01b.name: cast_curse_shot
918f83acdf10e01b.doc: Winds up attack 2 while facing the player, then fires the curse shot from the magic_coll bone, which flies on as a looping shot carrying the attack data.

9191a91e86236db1.name: run_range_ai
9191a91e86236db1.doc: Main combat loop. Sets the enrage stage in var 4 to 2 once life falls below 50 percent (stage 1 is never set), records the player's range band in var 5 (1 near under 400, 2 mid, 4 far from 800), and runs the surface or magma phase. Returns when the player is 1200 or more units away.

91c29ab103904b55.name: fight_by_distance
91c29ab103904b55.doc: Chooses close, mid or far range behaviour by distance to the target.

91c48f05a697161a.name: taunt_then_rocket_or_dash
91c48f05a697161a.doc: Either plays with the target and then fires a rocket volley, or dashes at the target.

91cc3e11099aa8b7.name: fight_near_target
91cc3e11099aa8b7.doc: Fight loop: waits while too many monsters are attacking, uses mid-range behaviour from 145 to 300 and close-range behaviour otherwise. Returns when the target is beyond 300.

91d33908be972caf.name: roll_at_aggro_target
91d33908be972caf.doc: Plays attack 2 in, tracks the target, rolls toward it and ends with attack 2 out.

91d71d1be0e935f5.name: fly_backward
91d71d1be0e935f5.doc: Meant to fly directly away from its facing direction, but the distance is never assigned, so how far it goes is undefined. Used as the back-off option in fight_at_close_range.

91ea82f080915d9a.name: hold_still_in_air
91ea82f080915d9a.doc: Stops moving in place with velocity control on.

91f2f051db80c025.name: setup_poison_spitter
91f2f051db80c025.doc: Init program: registers the two combo attack hit windows, loads the poison fluid effects into a free texture block if one exists, and starts the monster AI.

91f4079b39b3620b.name: wander_until_target_detected
91f4079b39b3620b.doc: Idle behaviour for an unaware monster: turns away from walls, drifts toward its home point, circles, wanders or stands waiting. Returns 1 when it notices the target.

91f62d5220b4cc9f.name: act_at_long_range
91f62d5220b4cc9f.doc: Long range choice: waits in view, circles the target, or flies toward it.

91f8d94cf6ebb832.name: run_fight_loop
91f8d94cf6ebb832.doc: Main loop: runs one decision step each frame.

92205b7789d4bb37.name: fly_backward
92205b7789d4bb37.doc: Meant to fly backward, away from the monster's facing, but the distance is never set, so how far it goes is undefined; the return value is undefined too.

922abd4a7174be89.name: fly_around_or_wait_for_target
922abd4a7174be89.doc: Half the time flies, with the walk motion, to a point 120 to 150 units from the target at 30 to 60 degrees to a random side, 25 units above the ground, for up to 60 frames, then turns to face it. Otherwise stands and waits up to 30 frames for the target to come into view.

922f414cac5b7753.name: walk_around_point
922f414cac5b7753.doc: Walks to the point radius units from the given point at angle_deg around it, turning to face it first. Returns the result of wait_move_until_near.

92347c2379225814.name: jump_to_far_side_from_target
92347c2379225814.doc: Leaps in a 50-frame arc to the spot 400 units from the arena centre on the side opposite the target (along the line from the target through the centre), turning toward the target and immune to damage during the jump. Shakes the camera on landing.

923e129bba3928b9.name: setup_nose_bomb
923e129bba3928b9.doc: Sets the hana_obj action object, a clip distance of 120, no lock-on and clears monster vars 0 and 1.

9245c0173b71c99a.name: wander_with_random_offset
9245c0173b71c99a.doc: Walks to a random point at a random angle and distance from the current position.

925398a3d1b54fb4.name: hover_idle_while_player_disguised
925398a3d1b54fb4.doc: Tries to hover 5 units above the ground at its own spot (fly_to_point ignores the 25 passed as y), then idles while the player is disguised as a monster, turning to face the target when it is more than 90 degrees off. Returns when the player is no longer disguised.

925da7820d55b491.name: shoot_elemental_bolt
925da7820d55b491.doc: Plays attack 1, tracks the target and fires a bolt from the dcol0 point: fire for kinds 112 to 115, ice 116 to 119, thunder 120 to 123, wind 124 to 127, holy 128 to 131. The bolt carries the monster's attack value.

926deb4257a54cca.name: swoop_attack_at_target
926deb4257a54cca.doc: Turns to the target and plays attack 1 while flying straight at the target's position at speed 10.5, 3 units above the ground, for up to 27 frames, then stands for 9 frames.

92791ba86c444575.name: get_state
92791ba86c444575.doc: Writes this piece's state (monster variable 2, private to the piece) into out_state[0]: 1 attack, 4 limp, 2 recover, 3 or 0 idle.

927dfcba574fae5b.name: wait_frame_update
927dfcba574fae5b.doc: Waits one frame. This variant does not run the aggro update.

9292d8a3ca3f7c9d.name: get_target_situation_flags
9292d8a3ca3f7c9d.doc: Returns bit flags describing the target: 1 within 160 units, 2 farther, 4 in front, 8 not in front, 16 in front within 45 degrees and 135 units.

92c1b309954d9eca.name: fly_around_target
92c1b309954d9eca.doc: Turns and flies to a point at the given angle and radius around the target. Returns the result of the flight.

92cb8bf3e454bfe0.name: approach_at_mid_range
92cb8bf3e454bfe0.doc: Rolls at the target, chases it, or circles it.

92cbd1f8854ba764.name: approach_at_mid_range
92cbd1f8854ba764.doc: Mid-range choice: idle play, sword combo, circling the target or a charge.

92dc6d123f14b3bb.name: calc_dash_deceleration
92dc6d123f14b3bb.doc: Computes the per-frame speed change that makes a dash of the given length slow to a stop, written to accel_out; 0 if duration is 0.

9311a09eb00a8b6c.name: play_blown_away
9311a09eb00a8b6c.doc: Plays the knocked flying motion, waits 30 frames, gets up and unlocks.

9311deaeda0a761b.name: begin_death_reaction
9311deaeda0a761b.doc: Old-numbering copy of start_death: calls get_home_pos with no outputs (meant as stop_moving), stops turning and calls the unregistered _EXT_141 (meant as start_death_drops), so only the turn stop takes effect.

931386820ec36bf0.name: step_sideways_dodge
931386820ec36bf0.doc: Steps 100 units to a random side with a sideways step motion, invulnerable during the movement, then returns to standing.

931706db47c95a56.name: stop_and_reset_motion
931706db47c95a56.doc: Stops movement and turning and resets the motion.

93180a034a11ab97.name: apply_form_visuals
93180a034a11ab97.doc: Switches the blue or red light effect on, sets the form flag and applies the green or red texture.

9327e2bc5d075041.name: wait_move_end_updating
9327e2bc5d075041.doc: Waits up to max_frames for the move_to to finish, running the aggro update each frame. Returns 0 when the move ended; falls off the end with no value on timeout.

932b85961ceac443.name: on_update
932b85961ceac443.doc: Keeps aiming at the target and fires a shot with a 30 percent chance each cycle when the cannon points almost straight at the target. Waits shorter between cycles when the ship has set monster var 8.

9361f57310219228.name: watch_disguised_player
9361f57310219228.doc: While the player is disguised, the monster stands and only turns toward the player (at 4.5 speed, walking) when the player leaves a 60 degree arc in front of it. Ends when the disguise is gone. The monster_kind argument is not used.

936db177d7d3a7fc.name: turn_random_side
936db177d7d3a7fc.doc: Turns by a random amount to a random side of the current heading and returns the frames waited. The retry loop after the first return is unreachable.

936fe68d4e715ee5.name: side_step_dodge
936fe68d4e715ee5.doc: Steps 100 units left or right at random while invulnerable.

93a8caa80133fbc9.name: advance_sequence_counter
93a8caa80133fbc9.doc: Death program in the b02a raw numbering, meant to compare a reading minus 18 with what is likely shared monster variable 8, adding one to it on a match and resetting it to 0 otherwise, so the b02a monsters can count defeats in order. The variable read and writes are calls with no native on this disc (_EXT_18, _EXT_17), so nothing is counted.

93c01329e7ab692e.name: stop_motion_and_wait_forever
93c01329e7ab692e.doc: Lifted program: stops the current motion (stop_current_motion only calls reset_motion) and then waits forever while held.

93c93eddca458d69.name: freeze_when_lifted
93c93eddca458d69.doc: Stops the bomb, makes it invulnerable, stops the pulse color and flags var 1 as lifted, then waits forever.

93e3cad00fc4bcc3.name: fight_while_enraged
93e3cad00fc4bcc3.doc: Enraged fight loop (runs while no rage hits are left): up close it chases and dives (90 percent) or shoots a water ball, farther out it mostly shoots. Returns 0 once rage hits are available again. Not called in this script.

93e3f19dfdb63abc.name: restore_life_and_trigger_phase_change
93e3f19dfdb63abc.doc: Checks the phase change and puts life back to 67 percent, so this monster cannot die from damage.

94050b47b361e77e.name: on_init
94050b47b361e77e.doc: Registers the attack hit window, loads the rose, tornado, shield and warp effects, switches the camera to the low player mode and clears the monster variables.

9407bf948d86ba20.name: on_stun
9407bf948d86ba20.doc: Plays knocked flying then get up, then ends the stun.

9424be6ca3d4b7eb.name: run_or_charge_at_target
9424be6ca3d4b7eb.doc: Either runs at the target or charges at it swinging.

944a0fbe22bb2ddd.name: fight_at_close_range
944a0fbe22bb2ddd.doc: Close range choice (target under 150): swing, slam or walk toward the target.

94698de9a1ea96a8.name: act_at_long_range
94698de9a1ea96a8.doc: Long range choice: turns to the target and walks up to it.

9480836eaa3b93e2.name: run_and_lunge_slash
9480836eaa3b93e2.doc: Runs at the target and does the lunging attack 1.

9492156dfaae5e0c.name: face_player_while_disguised
9492156dfaae5e0c.doc: Idle loop while the player is disguised: turns to face the player when not already within 60 degrees of facing it, and stands otherwise. Returns when the disguise is removed.

94973a8222857598.name: run_behavior_forever
94973a8222857598.doc: Main loop: fights enraged when rage is used up, otherwise fights or wanders depending on the target distance.

94a3a4428ee3b82f.name: play_death_and_run_event
94a3a4428ee3b82f.doc: Starts the death, runs event script 500, plays the death motion with no smoke and a quick death, then halts.

94c7fc9ee2b5bd7f.name: fight_with_slam_and_nose_bullets
94c7fc9ee2b5bd7f.doc: Unused combat loop: wanders or watches when its priority is above 2; within 75 it slams, from 75 to 200 it fires nose bullets, and beyond 200 it fires nose bullets 65 percent of the time, otherwise walks toward the target or circles it. Returns when there is no target.

94e43c7ea21bd790.name: choose_behavior_by_rage_and_aggro
94e43c7ea21bd790.doc: Chooses between fighting, approaching or wandering based on aggro state, distance and rage hits.

94e868b612fb50d0.name: wait_for_move_end
94e868b612fb50d0.doc: Waits until the current move ends or max_frames pass.

9535874bc63ff8cb.name: run_after_target
9535874bc63ff8cb.doc: Runs after the target for up to 90 frames, then stands.

953741d1beb3fc92.name: recover_from_throw_and_reset
953741d1beb3fc92.doc: Recovers from a throw, waits 10 frames and resets the motion.

95616a95b3bcde74.name: fight_by_distance
95616a95b3bcde74.doc: Fight loop using the close, mid or long range behaviour by target distance (140 and 240 unit breaks), circling or holding when other monsters have priority. Never checks rage hits. Returns when the target is beyond 350 units.

957f84d51cb80dfc.name: wander_random_direction
957f84d51cb80dfc.doc: Walks a random distance along a randomly rotated heading.

9583133f5a1e3247.name: track_monster_until_time
9583133f5a1e3247.doc: Keeps turning toward another monster until the motion progress is within tolerance of time.

959686f427c62e3d.name: on_init
959686f427c62e3d.doc: Sets up the battleship boss: links the p01_battleship map part at height 200, loads smoke, damage, machine gun, explosion, cannonball and muzzle flash effects, initialises the shared life counters in monster vars 64 and 65, plays its ship sound, removes the clip distance and sets a low camera.

95ab5782ac04d6f5.name: get_ground_y_at
95ab5782ac04d6f5.doc: Writes the ground height below x, y, z into out[0].

95e7ffeb9aff4e8a.name: glide_to_point
95e7ffeb9aff4e8a.doc: Glides to a point, slowing so that it ends near it. Stops early near the point or at 500 units from the arena centre, and caps height at 70.

95f31278afc20ad4.name: turn_toward_monster_until_motion_progress
95f31278afc20ad4.doc: Keeps turning toward another monster until the current motion reaches the given progress.

960c4b1c09e51344.name: wait_for_move_end
960c4b1c09e51344.doc: Waits until the move ends or max_frames pass.

962190367f15f0a7.name: start_death
962190367f15f0a7.doc: Start of the death reaction: stops moving and turning and scatters the death drops. In this script's old numbering apply_reserved_texture and DIRECT end_throw stand for stop_moving and start_death_drops.

962882d0115ac4dc.name: wait_turn_to_angle
962882d0115ac4dc.doc: Waits until the monster faces angle_deg within a tolerance, or max_frames pass. Returns the frames waited.

9645dfbf6f046d1d.name: attack_at_mid_range
9645dfbf6f046d1d.doc: At 75 to 135 units it runs in, lunges, or circles the target.

9659adfd462ca32b.name: spawn_minion_at_random_spot
9659adfd462ca32b.doc: Creates monster 1001 at one of three fixed positions.

965b6854ed02d9f7.name: stand_idle_frames
965b6854ed02d9f7.doc: Stops moving, plays the stand motion and waits for the given number of frames.

966378709f5c7eb3.name: face_monster_until_motion_progress
966378709f5c7eb3.doc: Keeps turning toward another monster until the motion progress is within the tolerance of the given value (default 0.05).

96642f2a57b03e96.name: on_knockdown
96642f2a57b03e96.doc: Knocked flying for 25 frames, lies stunned for 30 frames, then gets up and stands.

96674e465f5dc43c.name: fire_feather_rain
96674e465f5dc43c.doc: Meant to play attack 1 and fire six rounds of Griffon feather L2 effects from the four wing bones (dcol_l00, dcol_l01, dcol_r00, dcol_r01) at random spread angles, then play the attack-out motion. The motion and spawn calls are old-numbered (the motions run as set_life, the spawns as get_monster_grade, set_damage_kind_rate and set_entry_object_size), and wait_motion_time can never end, so no feathers are fired and the script waits there forever.

96819e13949658da.name: fly_straight_to_point
96819e13949658da.doc: Flies the monster in a straight line toward a point, held at hover_height above the ground (dest_y is replaced), one step of the given length per frame. Returns 1 when within speed plus arrive_margin of the point, the nonzero result of the flight collision check if blocked, or 0 after max_frames.

96a173d7dbda8dc8.name: wait_turn_watch_target
96a173d7dbda8dc8.doc: Like wait_turn_to_angle, but gives up and returns -1 as soon as the target comes into view.

96ac0f9f4607bdf4.name: wander_around_home
96ac0f9f4607bdf4.doc: Idle behaviour. Turns away from walls, walks back toward home when more than 300 units away, otherwise stands watching for a target or wanders around the target or in a random direction. Returns 1 when it detects a target.

96adfaefad5c973b.name: act_at_long_range
96adfaefad5c973b.doc: Long range behaviour: 80% ice shot or look around, otherwise walk or fly toward the target or wait for it to appear in view.

96bea6b6946e74ac.name: get_aggro_near_range
96bea6b6946e74ac.doc: Reads the monster's near aggro range, stored in monster variable 2 slot 9, into out[0].

96cb49bc3218138f.name: run_ai_loop
96cb49bc3218138f.doc: Allows guard and dodge, then each frame fights if the target is within 350 units or else picks a flying action.

96d17ca7fd601545.name: run_at_target_swinging
96d17ca7fd601545.doc: Turns to the target, then chases it with the attack 1 motion looping at twice the given speed for up to 30 * max_seconds frames (half that many seconds at 60 fps), stopping within 55 units, and stands for 9 frames.

96d37b9859607e0d.name: turn_to_target_wait
96d37b9859607e0d.doc: Turns toward the target at turn_speed_deg and waits for the heading to be reached (up to 360 frames), then stops turning. Returns the frames waited.

96d57616eca4d997.name: wait_motion_end_or_target_in_view
96d57616eca4d997.doc: Waits until the motion ends (returns 0) or the target enters the view cone (returns 1).

96d9e0acca574fa7.name: wait_motion_end_tracking_damage
96d9e0acca574fa7.doc: Waits for the current motion to end while tracking damage. Returns 1.

96dc11080691a416.name: lunge_at_target
96dc11080691a416.doc: Turns to the target and plays attack 2, dashing 100 units toward it between 32% and 40% of the motion for a damaging charge.

96e27b2689218212.name: throw_bombs_at_target
96e27b2689218212.doc: Turns to the target and throws bombs from the kabo frame, one per attack 2 motion, until throw_count is reached (its counter is never initialised). The bomb effect depends on the monster grade: pumpkin bomb, gooey peach, stone berry or final bomb, each carrying the monster's attack value.

96e77ab1e400fe74.name: on_init
96e77ab1e400fe74.doc: Registers the normal attack hit, loads the petrify shot and sticky hit effects into a free texture block and sets up the AI.

96efb09fc31fe21c.name: on_stopped
96efb09fc31fe21c.doc: Stops all actions and holds the damage pose until the stop and long stop status flags clear, then stands.

9706006b18e6a8c7.name: fight_while_enraged
9706006b18e6a8c7.doc: Combat loop used once the monster is enraged. Under 95 units it mostly swings (the plain swing under 75, the windup swing beyond) or walks closer; farther out it mostly does the windup swing (65 percent) or walks closer. Strafes when it is not one of the nearest monsters, and returns when the player is further than 225.

97109a0c9575447e.name: idle_forever
97109a0c9575447e.doc: Waits frame after frame and never returns.

971d846ccc2ccddc.name: play_death_motion
971d846ccc2ccddc.doc: Plays the death motion, finishes the death and halts forever.

9721d5152a69251e.name: wait_target_detected
9721d5152a69251e.doc: Waits until the target is seen or heard. Returns 1 if detected, 0 on timeout.

9728ad6baf1b792d.name: fire_demon_beam_sweep
9728ad6baf1b792d.doc: Turns to face the target, starts the demon beam launch and loop effects (the loop with 1.8 times the monster's attack) at a random point 170 units from the arena center, and sweeps the beam end point from there through the target's position for 90 frames while facing it. Then ends the beam and waits 150 frames.

973022de3a402d40.name: fight_once_enraged
973022de3a402d40.doc: Combat loop once no rage hits are left (enraged). Within 110 units it lunges once (60 percent) or one to four times; further out it mostly fires a curse bullet, otherwise runs at the target or side-steps. Returns 0 once rage hits are available again.

975270223b06038b.name: turn_and_step_back_from_melee
975270223b06038b.doc: Faces the target, steps back invulnerably, and allows guard and dodge again.

975386177f321c85.name: step_sideways
975386177f321c85.doc: Steps 100 units to a random side (50 percent each) at speed 6 with the step motion, then returns to standing. The no-damage bit is set and cleared in the same frame before the step, so the monster is not actually immune while stepping.

9757a2b561b82bab.name: act_at_mid_range
9757a2b561b82bab.doc: Mid range choice: usually shoots a wind shot, otherwise wanders and chases, circles the target in flight or flies sideways.

97a476ae8a2ebe76.name: fly_in_random_direction
97a476ae8a2ebe76.doc: Turns by a random angle and flies a random distance ahead.

97ab4800e44849fd.name: dodge_forward_attack
97ab4800e44849fd.doc: Dodges with the dodge-in motion, then rushes through the target's position with the dodge attack.

97aef1f958ac2e1f.name: wait_turn_to_angle
97aef1f958ac2e1f.doc: Waits up to max_frames for the monster to face angle_deg within 3 degrees (the check meant to widen this to the turn speed compares radians with 3.0, so it never does) or for get_angle_side to report it within the turn speed, then stops turning. Returns the frames waited.

97b5da66502d7ea4.name: on_update
97b5da66502d7ea4.doc: Main loop for the frightened creature: each frame senses the nearest monster, picks a fear state and plays it.

97b94ae5a724483f.name: charge_at_target_then_back_off
97b94ae5a724483f.doc: Loops attack 1 while rushing the target at 5.25 units per frame for up to max_frames, then turns to face it and steps back.

97c24bc9e5a9a102.name: start_stun_grounded
97c24bc9e5a9a102.doc: Makes the boss damageable, disables guard and dodge, turns scripted flight off and stops all movement for a stun.

97cf4c825bdbfbfa.name: turn_to_angle
97cf4c825bdbfbfa.doc: Turns to angle_deg at speed_deg (both wrapped to plus or minus 180) and waits until done. Returns the frames used.

97e798f3a27e96a0.name: wait_motion_time
97e798f3a27e96a0.doc: Waits frame by frame until the motion progress (0 to 1) is within tolerance of time (0.03 when tolerance is -1) or the motion ends. Returns the frames waited.

97ffa90b275704a5.name: walk_in_direction
97ffa90b275704a5.doc: Turns to the world heading angle_deg at turn_speed_deg, then walks dist units along it at move_speed (at least move_speed + 1). A heading below the turn speed, including every negative heading, is first increased by the turn speed. Returns 1 if the target comes within stop_dist, 2 when the walk ends, 0 after max_frames.

9802f61a8fb0c384.name: on_init
9802f61a8fb0c384.doc: Registers the spin knockback hit box, loads the ultrasonic wave and spin effects, clears monster variable 0, starts the monster AI and sets the minimum damage that aggroes it to 5 percent of max life.

9812395bc0d98cce.name: track_target_until_motion_end
9812395bc0d98cce.doc: Keeps turning toward the target every frame until the current motion has ended, then stops turning.

983519ea26919749.name: struggle_while_lifted
983519ea26919749.doc: Plays the struggle motion forever while the player holds it.

98392af9b5ba157d.name: choose_behaviour_by_aggro
98392af9b5ba157d.doc: Top-level AI step. While rage hits are left: without aggro it fights a target within 230 and otherwise wanders; with aggro it fights within 140, runs at the target within the aggro range, or drops the aggro. With no rage hits left it runs the enraged fight loop.

9840b1761dfed8c6.name: hover_if_player_disguised
9840b1761dfed8c6.doc: If the player is disguised as a monster, hovers with the boss's monster kind passed on.

984990496d73a704.name: reset_all_roses
984990496d73a704.doc: Sends the reset command to all six roses.

98513dc7f52a4b3c.name: choose_and_perform_attack
98513dc7f52a4b3c.doc: Runs one step of the attack cycle chosen by variable 3: 0 chases and spits, 1 chases and swings, 2 does nothing, 3 walks to a random corner (10 percent) or chases and swings, then 30 percent of the time chases and spits, and 4 spits 20 percent of the time before the cycle restarts. First, when the recent damage in variable 11 passes 150, it swings, spawns an Electric Fish if it is the only monster, threatens for 210 frames and clears the recent damage.

98563649ddb6044a.name: wait_frames_tracking_damage
98563649ddb6044a.doc: Waits the given number of frames with damage tracking.

98677fa0950d0179.name: wait_turn_watch_target
98677fa0950d0179.doc: Waits while turning to an angle, returning -1 early if the target comes into view.

987517e0e82d1bc1.name: wander_or_wait_for_target
987517e0e82d1bc1.doc: Idle behaviour: backs away from walls, drifts toward its home point, waits for the target, strolls around it or walks randomly. Returns 1 when it notices the target.

987abb60edaff22e.name: sidestep_shot
987abb60edaff22e.doc: Faces the target and steps left or right at random, invulnerable for 10 frames, to avoid a shot.

9889fb6159d11b9b.name: on_init
9889fb6159d11b9b.doc: Registers the weak combo hit boxes, loads the Vanguard shockwave effect into a free texture block, and starts the monster AI.

988eeb175a1c54d5.name: shoot_fire_shot
988eeb175a1c54d5.doc: Sets attack state 2, turns to the target and plays attack 2. Spawns the dragon fire shot launch effect at the dcol_00 frame and, at motion time 0.583, the looping fire shot aimed at the target with the monster's attack value.

98ae5f59818bd3ec.name: finish_throw
98ae5f59818bd3ec.doc: Ends a thrown state: clears no-damage, stops moving, waits 10 frames with the aggro update, then resets the motion.

98b44f5d366c9b9e.name: wait_forever_checked
98b44f5d366c9b9e.doc: Waits forever, checking the phase change each frame.

98b7ea5e896a4074.name: guard_then_maybe_counter
98b7ea5e896a4074.doc: Plays the guard motions and a small knockback, then 30 percent of the time counters with attack 2.

98d3d854f4f1efee.name: dodge_melee_with_side_step
98d3d854f4f1efee.doc: Turns to the target and side-steps around it, invulnerable during the step. The back-step branch never runs, because get_random_int(20) is always under 20.

98dbc2a7166f026e.name: swing_double_attack
98dbc2a7166f026e.doc: Plays the double attack while turning toward the target for 18 frames, then stands.

98f6029253f39425.name: track_monster_until_time
98f6029253f39425.doc: Keeps turning toward another monster until the current motion's progress is within tolerance of time (default 0.05 when -1), then stops turning.

9900275a89671152.name: charge_at_target_position
9900275a89671152.doc: Faces the target and rushes to its current position in the suicide charge motion for up to 90 frames, then stands for 8 frames.

99246dd3bf479eb2.name: recover_after_throw
99246dd3bf479eb2.doc: Recovers from being thrown, waits 10 frames and resets the motion.

994bec14603e7093.name: fly_chase_target
994bec14603e7093.doc: Chases the moving target through the air, retargeting every frame. With tilt set the body pitches toward the target.

997648e0eb1ce0c0.name: on_update
997648e0eb1ce0c0.doc: Main loop: runs one AI decision every frame.

9984b8568f5633bd.name: wait_for_turn_unless_target_seen
9984b8568f5633bd.doc: Like waiting for a turn to finish but returns -1 as soon as the target is inside the given view cone. Otherwise returns the frames waited.

99a103a3aa5975d8.name: walk_random_direction
99a103a3aa5975d8.doc: Meant to turn up to angle_range degrees, but converts the range to radians and then the random turn to radians again, so it turns a whole number of degrees from 0 to about angle_range/57, always to the same side (under 57 it does not turn). If 100 units ahead are clear it walks base_dist + move_speed plus a random 0 to dist_range units; if less is clear but more than clearance it walks just the random amount; otherwise it returns -1 without moving. clearance is also the stop distance of the wait: returns 1 if the target comes within clearance, 2 when the walk ends, 0 after max_frames.

99e429a50f5e1935.name: walk_in_direction
99e429a50f5e1935.doc: Despite the parameter names, the first argument is the turn speed in degrees and the second the walk speed. Turns to the world heading angle_deg, then walks dist units along it (at least the walk speed + 1). A heading below the turn speed, including every negative heading, is first increased by the turn speed. Returns 1 if the target comes within stop_dist, 2 when the walk ends, 0 after max_frames.

9a0675d2692089a1.name: wait_move_until_near_target
9a0675d2692089a1.doc: Waits, checking the death flag each frame, for the move started by move_to. Returns 1 when the target comes within stop_distance, 2 when the move ends and 0 after max_frames.

9a0c036e1c13d5cc.name: strafe_or_wait
9a0c036e1c13d5cc.doc: Half the time flies to a point 60 units from the target, 30 to 60 degrees to either side, for up to 50 frames and turns to face it (the 120 to 150 radius it rolls is unused); otherwise stands and waits up to 30 frames for the target within 30 units and 45 degrees.

9a234261c2bb3034.name: fight_target_by_range
9a234261c2bb3034.doc: Loop that returns when the target is beyond 240 units. It wanders if another monster is nearer, otherwise picks the far, mid or near action from the distance.

9a2a2b2eee039d8f.name: stop_and_unlock
9a2a2b2eee039d8f.doc: Stops the current motion, movement and turning; the guard and dodge lock it takes is released at once, so the monster can still guard and dodge.

9a5a49fda5e038db.name: chase_and_lunge
9a5a49fda5e038db.doc: Chases the target to melee range, turns to it and lunges 200 units forward with the first attack.

9a5ead4c98016ecf.name: check_low_life_event
9a5ead4c98016ecf.doc: Checks whether the low life event should run.

9a96126baaf8963f.name: move_in_direction
9a96126baaf8963f.doc: Moves dist units (at least move_speed + 1) along heading angle_deg at move_speed without turning, until the walk ends, the target comes within stop_dist or max_frames pass. Stops moving afterward.

9a9771e3291b64bb.name: track_monster_for_frames
9a9771e3291b64bb.doc: Keeps turning toward another monster for the given number of frames.

9ab551bbd5941859.name: turn_then_chase_target
9ab551bbd5941859.doc: Turns to face the target, then each frame walks toward a point speed plus stop_distance units ahead of itself in the target's direction, at its own height, until within stop_distance (returns -1) or max_frames pass.

9ae24c2bcb33a6ab.name: reposition_around_target
9ae24c2bcb33a6ab.doc: Half the time circles the target at about 90 units, otherwise stands and waits for it to come into view. Used when another monster has attack priority.

9ae762b89289c5d5.name: save_home_position
9ae762b89289c5d5.doc: Stores the monster's current position in the globals, with the height set to zero.

9b09662830204b49.name: recover_after_throw
9b09662830204b49.doc: Recovers from being thrown, runs the shared idle step for 10 frames and resets the motion.

9b09b3a8efbe52a5.name: turn_random_side_updating
9b09b3a8efbe52a5.doc: Turns to a random angle to the left or right of the current yaw, updating the boss, and returns the frames waited. The loop over tries never repeats because it returns after the first turn.

9b19c64778419f22.name: fight_with_no_rage_hits_left
9b19c64778419f22.doc: Behavior once no rage hits remain: attacks at close range, adds a paralysis shot for a farther target, otherwise flies toward the target.

9b649df5bcb099f5.name: get_knocked_down_and_rise
9b649df5bcb099f5.doc: Is knocked flying, lies down for 45 frames and plays the get-up motion.

9b8890824f2ad204.name: play_idle_taunts
9b8890824f2ad204.doc: Repeats the play motion repeat_count times, sometimes stepping back and turning toward the target afterwards, then stands.

9bb101f1d9ed600e.name: can_reach_point
9bb101f1d9ed600e.doc: Returns 1 if the straight path to the point is clear, otherwise 0.

9bd3529480ab677f.name: init_flying_swordsman
9bd3529480ab677f.doc: Registers the attack 2 spin hits and sword trails, loads the fire shot effects when a texture block is free, enables flying movement with a maximum height of 60 and sets up the AI.

9be3b4db054def10.name: idle_until_target_near
9be3b4db054def10.doc: While the player is 175 units or more away, keeps running strafe_or_idle (circling, waiting or the play motion); returns once the player is closer.

9bfd83f4ea96816d.name: face_user_monster_if_any
9bfd83f4ea96816d.doc: If the player is disguised in a form this monster's kind recognises as its own (get_player_disguise is not -1), runs face_player_while_disguised until that ends, standing and turning to face the player whenever it is more than 60 degrees off; otherwise returns at once. The monster kind it passes is not used.

9c1633a0f2a4cc71.name: set_aggro_near_range
9c1633a0f2a4cc71.doc: Stores the near aggro range in monster variable set 2, index 9. Nothing reads it back: get_aggro_near_range is never called.

9c171085ca262400.name: fight_by_distance_loop
9c171085ca262400.doc: Loops while the target is within 220 units, choosing the far, mid or close attack by distance. Returns when the target leaves range.

9c2cfc96803a1ed0.name: move_to_height_and_facing
9c2cfc96803a1ed0.doc: Walks the monster 2 units per frame to the target height and turns 0.05 rad per frame to the target yaw, then returns 0. If abort_on_split is set and monster var 8 becomes 16, returns 5 immediately.

9c531b0c28af26f5.name: follow_target_for_a_while
9c531b0c28af26f5.doc: Walks after the target for up to 240 frames, then stands.

9c610c3f6fdd8fd7.name: get_knocked_flying_and_get_up
9c610c3f6fdd8fd7.doc: Plays the knocked-flying motion, stays down for 30 frames with act status 1, then plays the get-up motion and stands.

9c7a57f6ed310713.name: turn_to_face_target_within_frames
9c7a57f6ed310713.doc: Turns toward the target, waiting at most max_frames. Returns the frames waited.

9c808e4b5e8a4c26.name: on_update
9c808e4b5e8a4c26.doc: Main loop: fights when the target is within 300 horizontally, otherwise picks a flying action.

9ca6319dfdd667ab.name: wait_turn_watch_target
9ca6319dfdd667ab.doc: Turns toward the angle and stops early with -1 if the target comes into view. Otherwise returns the frames waited.

9cc3e3ac09f9d5a5.name: setup_attack_hits_and_effects
9cc3e3ac09f9d5a5.doc: Registers the Infe sword attack hits for attacks 1 and 2, the sword trails and the red wave effect, sets monster variable 0 to 0 and starts the AI.

9cc568f264915a90.name: run_behavior_forever
9cc568f264915a90.doc: Main loop: runs the top level behaviour choice every frame.

9cccb1a02568b51d.name: turn_to_target_for_frames
9cccb1a02568b51d.doc: Keeps turning toward the target at the given speed until the frame budget is used up. Returns the frames spent turning.

9cce0e2403c9f9c1.name: wait_tracked_frames
9cce0e2403c9f9c1.doc: Waits the given number of frames with fight tracking.

9ce5bdad8797639d.name: fight_enraged_until_target_leaves
9ce5bdad8797639d.doc: Enraged fight loop, used once no rage hits remain: melee combo when the target is within 50, venom spit at longer range, and an idle watch if too many monsters are attacking. Returns when the target is beyond 250.

9cee730c8bfb53cf.name: track_target_until_time_updating
9cee730c8bfb53cf.doc: Turns toward the target each frame until the motion reaches the given time.

9d0545307817712d.name: recoil_from_hit_with_invulnerability
9d0545307817712d.doc: Sets the defense rate by facing (60 degrees), plays the damage knockback and stays invulnerable until the motion ends plus 6 frames, then waits 6 more frames and stands.

9d132806fdbf3490.name: turn_by_angle
9d132806fdbf3490.doc: Turns the model by delta_deg from its current yaw and returns the frames spent.

9d2067c7032eb968.name: choose_wander_move
9d2067c7032eb968.doc: Idle roaming AI: turns away from walls, resets home when far, waits for the target to be detected, circles, turns or flies off at random.

9d3663975cd41889.name: watch_disguised_player
9d3663975cd41889.doc: Stands and turns to face the player while the player is disguised as a monster, returning when the disguise ends.

9d37bc6307891a75.name: approach_distant_target
9d37bc6307891a75.doc: Loop that walks or runs toward the target until it is within 300 units, sometimes standing and watching.

9d4eb904ef9b0461.name: accumulate_damage_taken
9d4eb904ef9b0461.doc: Compares the current life with the last seen value and adds the loss to the recent damage counter (variable 11) and the total damage counter (variable 13).

9d6e80d7454fa8de.name: fight_close_range
9d6e80d7454fa8de.doc: Close range choices: run in and attack, walk in and attack, or dodge backward and sidestep.

9d8b881b35a9ee1d.name: update_and_wait_frames
9d8b881b35a9ee1d.doc: Runs update_and_wait_frame the given number of times.

9d916d49c00c1d4a.name: get_up_after_throw
9d916d49c00c1d4a.doc: Recovers after landing from a throw and gets up. Returns 1.

9da4407979b5427a.name: choose_behavior
9da4407979b5427a.doc: Top-level behaviour pick. Calm monsters fight when the player is within 220 and wander otherwise; aggravated monsters fight within 90 and approach otherwise; enraged ones use the enraged combat loop.

9db4e5c0e213b531.name: chase_target_clear
9db4e5c0e213b531.doc: Chases the target like chase_target but gives up with -2 if a wall blocks the line to it, or -1 when close.

9db6bffe8f77f51f.name: attack_with_shockwave
9db6bffe8f77f51f.doc: Linda's attack 2: plays the attack motion, after 25 frames (30 scaled to PAL) starts turning toward the target at a speed that closes the gap in about 30 frames, and 21 frames later spawns the Vanguard shockwave effect 16 units ahead carrying the attack power; then stands for 12 frames.

9dd5c8d0f346798f.name: watch_player_if_disguised
9dd5c8d0f346798f.doc: Starts watch_disguised_player only if the player is disguised in the form this monster's kind recognises as its own (get_player_disguise is not -1); otherwise returns at once.

9de30e7f07aa9a7a.name: fly_around_target
9de30e7f07aa9a7a.doc: Turns a flying monster toward a point at angle_deg and radius around the target, then flies there in a straight line with fly_straight_to_point. Returns the flight result.

9de9069720c8b6f2.name: idle_if_player_disguised
9de9069720c8b6f2.doc: If the player is disguised as a monster, runs the watch-target loop for this monster kind.

9e21b1ad21fd4860.name: turn_and_walk_in_direction
9e21b1ad21fd4860.doc: Turns to an angle and walks the given distance in that direction. Returns the wait_move_until_near_target result.

9e233b80029aee30.name: side_walk_to_angle
9e233b80029aee30.doc: Meant to turn to the given world angle in degrees with the walk left or right motion, then stand. It converts the angle to radians before passing it to turn_to_angle, which expects degrees, so the monster always turns to within about 3 degrees of world yaw 0; the motion is picked from the sign of the unwrapped difference between the new angle and the current yaw.

9e2c123cee460569.name: throw_nose_bomb
9e2c123cee460569.doc: Plays the nose bomb motion and creates a bomb monster (type 1000) in front of its nose aimed at the target. The first time it does this, it runs event script 540.

9e4193ca87ba64c3.name: lunge_forward_attack
9e4193ca87ba64c3.doc: Turns to the target, plays attack 1 and from frame 12 to frame 40 walks at 2.8 units per frame toward a point 100 units ahead (about 78 units in that time), then stands for 9 frames.

9e48a48fcc86685c.name: wait_frames_update
9e48a48fcc86685c.doc: Waits the given number of frames.

9e4b9bc9f1b5fd8c.name: fly_at_target
9e4b9bc9f1b5fd8c.doc: Turns to face the target, then flies toward its position at hover height. Returns 1 on arrival, the blocking result if blocked, 0 on timeout.

9e61bf7d044c40d8.name: wait_while_moving
9e61bf7d044c40d8.doc: Waits max_frames frames, then calls halt_movement, which does nothing under this script's old numbering. Returns the frames waited. The per-frame read (meant as get_air_height, run as check_move_end) is discarded, and the other arguments are unused.

9ebcbe4876dc3e41.name: play_normal_attack
9ebcbe4876dc3e41.doc: Plays attack 1, the normal sword attack, to its end and stands for 8 frames.

9ec5b010cdcbd253.name: hover_toward_target
9ec5b010cdcbd253.doc: Meant to turn toward the target and fly to its x and z at height_offset above the ground, returning -1 when a wall lies within 100 units ahead (any hit leaves a distance of 0, below a positive min_distance). The turn, target, position and move calls are old-numbered (the target read runs as set_home_pos and overwrites the home position), so the monster neither turns nor flies; otherwise it returns an unset value.

9ece6164bcb0b7ae.name: play_boss_se
9ece6164bcb0b7ae.doc: Plays a sound effect on this monster.

9ed2c42eb2f1a917.name: wait_until_facing
9ed2c42eb2f1a917.doc: Waits until the yaw is within tolerance of angle.

9ed8c126d475cc6f.name: spit_and_approach
9ed8c126d475cc6f.doc: Turns to the target, spits sticky goo, then walks closer for up to 45 frames.

9f1d627a02dbbd97.name: get_knocked_over_and_up
9f1d627a02dbbd97.doc: Runs when the piece is stunned: makes it damageable and halts it, plays the knocked flying and get up motions, then plays the faint motion until the stun stars run out and allows guard and dodge again.

9f1f0699974d40b6.name: face_target_for_frames
9f1f0699974d40b6.doc: Keeps turning toward the target for the given number of frames.

9f20495e5a9f48f8.name: walk_to_target
9f20495e5a9f48f8.doc: Turns to face the target, then walks straight along that heading as far as the target's distance. Returns -1 without moving when the clear distance ahead is under move_speed plus stop_dist, otherwise 1 if the target comes within stop_dist, 2 if the walk ends, 0 on timeout.

9f35dd8a211a095f.name: turn_to_target_random
9f35dd8a211a095f.doc: Turns toward the target, with the given percent chance of an offset to a random side.

9f3976e827bdba67.name: dodge_melee_with_back_step
9f3976e827bdba67.doc: Faces the target, backs away invulnerable and stands.

9f5119d31db1df88.name: switch_attack_mode
9f5119d31db1df88.doc: Clears the move counter and sets the attack mode in variable 9. Mode 1 is the tornado dash mode; mode 0 dashes to a random arena point and returns to the rose mode.

9f55c255344b8adc.name: on_death
9f55c255344b8adc.doc: Plays the knocked-flying death motion after starting the drops, then idles forever.

9f6199f69553513b.name: chase_and_slam_shockwave
9f6199f69553513b.doc: Walks up to the target and plays attack 2, spawning a Vanguard shockwave under each of the dcol0 and dcol1 points at 0.64 of the motion, with the monster's attack power.

9f67c2d4e779d1e9.name: init_clip_distance
9f67c2d4e779d1e9.doc: Sets the view clipping distance: normal monsters get clip distance 35 (700 world units) and record their start position in scratch_x, scratch_y and scratch_z, which nothing else reads; bosses get 999999. Afterwards scratch_y is forced to 0.

9f7c2e298e453255.name: fight_with_no_rage_hits_left
9f7c2e298e453255.doc: Fight loop used while the rage counter is zero: shoots bolts, charges or flanks when the target is within 140 units, otherwise shoots or flies closer. Returns once rage hits are left.

9f8ca97489d7151e.name: turn_random_side
9f8ca97489d7151e.doc: Turns by a random amount to a random side of the current heading and returns the frames waited. The retry loop after the first return is unreachable.

9f92ffdd910c5e64.name: wait_for_move_or_target_near
9f92ffdd910c5e64.doc: Waits during a move_to, ticking the fight tracking, until the target is within stop_dist (stops and returns 1), the move ends (stops and returns 2) or max_frames pass (returns 0).

9f9c1b986e82819f.name: get_ground_y
9f9c1b986e82819f.doc: Writes the ground height under the monster (its y minus its height above ground) into out[0].

9fb67dc613b69b57.name: sidestep_around_target
9fb67dc613b69b57.doc: Dodge: becomes invulnerable and steps left or right to a point 30 degrees around the target, then waits for the motion to end.

9fd5eee6ecaea0c1.name: check_event_and_run_melee_ai
9fd5eee6ecaea0c1.doc: Allows guard and dodge and stands, then every frame checks the timed event trigger and runs the shared melee AI (range flags, action choice, action), which swings, uses shockwaves and walks toward the target.

9febb1788ee1a09e.name: watch_disguised_player
9febb1788ee1a09e.doc: If the player is currently disguised as a monster, runs wait_while_player_disguised.

a00c9e1cea8a54be.name: turn_to_target_wait
a00c9e1cea8a54be.doc: Turns toward the target and waits until facing it.

a00e8b9c93aa7943.name: turn_to_angle_and_wait
a00e8b9c93aa7943.doc: Starts turning toward an absolute angle at the given speed and waits until the boss faces it.

a0145f24a94ba78e.name: fight_calm_close_range
a0145f24a94ba78e.doc: Close range choice while not enraged: attack, circle the target or step back.

a02a159182d95549.name: set_form_flag
a02a159182d95549.doc: Sets or clears the given bits in the form flags in monster var 6.

a02a9905bab5149b.name: is_target_in_view_cone
a02a9905bab5149b.doc: Meant to return 1 if the target point is within half_angle of the facing direction and within max_dist. In the b02a raw numbering neither the angle nor the distance is computed on this disc (see get_angle_difference_to_point and get_distance_2d), so the result does not reflect the target.

a0382fa8ab379663.name: walk_in_direction
a0382fa8ab379663.doc: Turns to the world heading angle_deg at turn_speed_deg, then walks dist units along it at move_speed (at least move_speed + 1). A heading below the turn speed, including every negative heading, is first increased by the turn speed. Returns 1 if the target comes within stop_dist, 2 when the walk ends, 0 after max_frames.

a045f22a629fbc7d.name: set_defense_by_facing
a045f22a629fbc7d.doc: Sets the defense rate to 10.0 when the monster faces the target within 80 degrees and 0.5 when it does not.

a059b1a0a6db3320.name: get_damage_taken
a059b1a0a6db3320.doc: Reads the last recorded hit (attack type and damage, second variable set slots 6 and 7) into attack_type[0] and damage_value[0].

a06d8156fd6ec337.name: sidestep_to_dodge_melee
a06d8156fd6ec337.doc: Dodges a melee attack with a 100-unit sidestep, then allows guard and dodge again. The step-back branch is never taken because the 0 to 19 roll is always under 20.

a08b1b6e9fe310c2.name: walk_in_direction
a08b1b6e9fe310c2.doc: Walks the given distance along an angle given in degrees, without turning first.

a093f41b40aa8449.name: spin_forward_attack
a093f41b40aa8449.doc: Plays attack 3: turns to the target and winds up, then spins toward a point 300 units ahead at 6.4 units per frame for 45 frames (about 290 units) with the spin effect, the loop motion's hit windows active, and recovers. spin_frames is ignored; the spin always lasts 45 frames.

a0a7e7b44a7f25da.name: turn_to_target_until_motion_time
a0a7e7b44a7f25da.doc: Keeps turning toward the target until the motion progress is within the tolerance of the given value. A tolerance of -1 means 0.05.

a0b228976428d3a7.name: walk_to_target
a0b228976428d3a7.doc: Turns to face the target, then walks straight along that heading as far as the target's distance. Returns -1 without moving when the clear distance ahead is under move_speed plus stop_dist, otherwise 1 if the target comes within stop_dist, 2 if the walk ends, 0 on timeout.

a0c80a206093beba.name: wait_until_facing_angle
a0c80a206093beba.doc: Waits until the monster's yaw is within the larger of 3 degrees and the given tolerance of the angle (both in degrees), or max_frames pass, then stops turning. Returns the frames waited.

a0d8d8af25dcca22.name: circle_or_dash_with_tornado
a0d8d8af25dcca22.doc: Decrements the move counter, then either dashes around the target or chases it and casts a tornado.

a0f9200b7d7c213e.name: decide_behavior
a0f9200b7d7c213e.doc: One AI step. While the rage counter is above zero it wanders or fights by distance, otherwise it uses the enraged loop. Raises guard rate to 10 while charging from afar.

a0ffea87551ac959.name: approach_or_vanish
a0ffea87551ac959.doc: Half the time chases the target, otherwise vanishes and reappears at its position.

a1543bb9ce9ddd51.name: lock_and_face_target
a1543bb9ce9ddd51.doc: Disables guard and dodge, stops all movement, snaps to face the target and marks the boss as busy.

a18d1dc6b8badbb6.name: move_beside_target
a18d1dc6b8badbb6.doc: Moves to a point at angle_deg around the target at the current target distance, shortened by the clearance check. Returns -1 if there is no room.

a195dbe585ce02f1.name: wait_move_end_checked
a195dbe585ce02f1.doc: Waits until the current move ends or time runs out.

a19c33f1b9f9b41d.name: fight_far_range
a19c33f1b9f9b41d.doc: Far range choices: run or walk after the target, wait, or charge combo.

a1a36247ca3458c1.name: shoot_fireballs_until_close
a1a36247ca3458c1.doc: Keeps shooting fireballs until the target comes within 210, closing in or waiting between shots.

a1b5408915c7cc41.name: setup_atla_light
a1b5408915c7cc41.doc: Makes the monster a floating, collision-free, always visible Atlamillia light that ignores the map and bodies, and clears its state var.

a1e9d7ad7b950dc0.name: slash_or_throw_knife
a1e9d7ad7b950dc0.doc: At melee range plays attack 1 with a lunge. Farther than 90 units there is a 15% chance (0% for kind 600) to play attack 2 and throw the clown soldier knife effect with the monster's attack value.

a20abb885c4ce58f.name: turn_to_target_and_wait
a20abb885c4ce58f.doc: Turns to face the target at the given speed (degrees) and waits until it does.

a21d0af76177ae83.name: setup_battleship_turret
a21d0af76177ae83.doc: Attaches the turret to its mount on the battleship map part (handles 27 to 34 select the mount), adds its life to the shared hull life pool in monster variable 64 and loads the machine gun effect.

a24404e20e93b0d4.name: turn_toward_monster_until_motion_progress
a24404e20e93b0d4.doc: Keeps turning toward another monster until the motion progress is near the target value.

a26e39ace7902e0b.name: follow_target_briefly
a26e39ace7902e0b.doc: Walks after the target for up to 90 frames, then stands.

a2898dd6cd057484.name: reset_for_knockdown
a2898dd6cd057484.doc: Disallows guard and dodge, resets motion, faces the target and sets act status 1.

a2bcfb45546c0c65.name: get_up_after_throw_and_fly
a2bcfb45546c0c65.doc: Recovers from a throw, waits 10 frames, turns scripted movement back on and resets the motion.

a2f2b74edbace354.name: turn_to_target_wait
a2f2b74edbace354.doc: Turns toward the target at the given turn speed and waits until facing it (up to 360 frames).

a3003d66bead1384.name: turn_and_use_weak_attack
a3003d66bead1384.doc: Walks while turning to face the target, then plays attack 3 (the weak attack) and stands.

a3055130698795e1.name: walk_with_footstep_shakes
a3055130698795e1.doc: Waits for the current move to finish for up to max_frames, shaking the camera on footstep frames. Returns 2 when the move ends.

a3122d6398e8500f.name: guard_attack
a3122d6398e8500f.doc: Locks interrupts and guards, 65 percent of the time briefly and otherwise after turning toward the target and holding the guard for 60 frames.

a316e34198cb4b58.name: on_death
a316e34198cb4b58.doc: Plays the death motion and then idles forever.

a341ef45dd219492.name: set_seagra_index
a341ef45dd219492.doc: Stores this piece's index (0 to 5) in monster variable 5.

a343730db48ed75c.name: attack_at_close_range
a343730db48ed75c.doc: Close range choice: shoots a gear arrow or poison arrow, backs away, or does a few step-backs.

a346ab303139d124.name: face_target_at_speed
a346ab303139d124.doc: Starts turning toward the target at speed_deg degrees per frame and waits until it faces the target, up to 360 frames. Returns the frames spent.

a34d4d32325fb8a9.name: on_init
a34d4d32325fb8a9.doc: Loads the Himara spin attack and sticky goo effects into a free texture block and starts the monster AI with a 150 frame aggro duration.

a351db6d8e81568c.name: track_target_frames
a351db6d8e81568c.doc: Turns toward the target for the given number of frames, then stops turning. turn_speed goes to the turn as given, so it is in radians per frame.

a364a526bda01df7.name: cast_giltoni_magic
a364a526bda01df7.doc: Casts the Giltoni magic with attack plus 10, once normally and twice at an angle spread below 40% life. The boss is invulnerable for 48 frames afterwards.

a37088972c2b137f.name: run_no_rage_ai
a37088972c2b137f.doc: AI loop when no rage hits remain. Inside 160 units it uses ultrasonic waves or the spin charge, farther away it spins or walks up to the target. Returns 0 when rage hits return.

a390b97c64580ed6.name: init_flying_monster
a390b97c64580ed6.doc: Sets up a flying monster: no height cap (999.9), wall margin of 35, clip distance 600 (12000 world units) and scripted movement on.

a3ba434f474ddd4b.name: wait_frames_checking_phase
a3ba434f474ddd4b.doc: Waits the given number of frames, running the phase check each frame.

a3de2acad8d535ce.name: fly_in_random_direction
a3de2acad8d535ce.doc: Turns by a random angle and flies a random distance in that direction.

a3f3fb269e9f8148.name: wait_frames_orbiting
a3f3fb269e9f8148.doc: Waits the given number of frames while the boss keeps orbiting.

a4185bcb6028edaa.name: wait_target_in_view
a4185bcb6028edaa.doc: Waits until the target is inside the view cone. Returns 1 if seen, 0 on timeout.

a424a6744ac51763.name: watch_disguised_player
a424a6744ac51763.doc: Stands facing front until the player is no longer disguised, turning to keep the player within 90 degrees of its heading.

a442aab6038adee6.name: wait_while_player_disguised
a442aab6038adee6.doc: If the player is disguised, calls the disguise wait loop.

a456f0830f769667.name: setup_attacks_and_effects
a456f0830f769667.doc: Registers the sword attack hits and trails for the double attack, mid-range attack and moonsault, and loads the Gil shield and magic effects.

a458c2bb6aef502f.name: fly_in_random_direction
a458c2bb6aef502f.doc: Turns to a random angle within angle_range, then flies a random distance (min_dist plus up to dist_range) straight ahead. Returns the result of fly_straight_to_point.

a4783c24b8a67e18.name: trigger_event_after_harmless_hits
a4783c24b8a67e18.doc: Runs event script 501 once when 5 or more hits on the monster have done no damage and the floor timer has passed 900 frames. Monster var 6 marks that it already ran. Nothing in the script calls it.

a4b7868ccb790b84.name: sidestep_around_target
a4b7868ccb790b84.doc: Becomes invulnerable and steps left or right to a point 30 degrees around the target at the same distance, then becomes vulnerable again.

a4bb0145c7c91bc7.name: close_in_on_target
a4bb0145c7c91bc7.doc: Within 270 units, either runs at the target for up to 90 frames or charges with the combo attack (even chance); farther out it just runs at the target.

a4ca0312a11a2351.name: stop_in_place
a4ca0312a11a2351.doc: Cancels flight by targeting the current position at zero speed, then stops moving.

a4d551e57694c5b9.name: run_to_random_far_point
a4d551e57694c5b9.doc: Turns toward a random point 500 units from the centre and flies there.

a4eadfd03acbed9a.name: wait_motion_end_tracking_damage
a4eadfd03acbed9a.doc: Waits until the current motion ends, with damage tracking. Always returns 1.

a4f5d71840da1218.name: move_beside_target
a4f5d71840da1218.doc: Moves to the point beside the target at angle_deg, returning -1 if the way is blocked. Otherwise returns the result of wait_move_until_near.

a4f7fcc66dec82b0.name: strafe_sideways
a4f7fcc66dec82b0.doc: Flies toward a point 300 units to one side of its facing (facing minus 90 degrees when go_left is set, plus 90 otherwise) for up to max_frames, so a short max_frames cuts the move well short of 300. The returned value is never assigned.

a4feefe767ec59c5.name: trigger_event_after_harmless_hit
a4feefe767ec59c5.doc: Once, when at least one hit on the monster has done no damage and the floor timer has reached 900 frames (15 seconds), sets monster var 6 and runs event script 501.

a50042c8173a903f.name: fly_to_point
a50042c8173a903f.doc: Flies in a straight line to (x, z) at ground height plus height, moving speed units per frame and checking each step with check_flight_step. Returns 1 when within speed plus near_dist, the (negative) blocked code if a step hits a wall or exceeds the maximum height, 0 on timeout. The y argument is ignored.

a51ea744a3e337c7.name: play_damage_and_recover
a51ea744a3e337c7.doc: Plays the damage motion, waits 12 frames and returns to standing.

a54325e3b76472f7.name: begin_locked_action
a54325e3b76472f7.doc: Starts a scripted action: forbids guard and dodge, resets the motion, stops moving, snaps to face the target, waits a frame and sets act status 1 so other characters see it as busy.

a5788fa07c914666.name: get_rose_state
a5788fa07c914666.doc: Returns the state a rose (0 to 5) reports in monster variable 14+rose; 3 means it was hit.

a58b110cd39b96a6.name: walk_in_absolute_direction
a58b110cd39b96a6.doc: Walks toward the point at the given world angle and distance until near or the time is up.

a58f110021961a8f.name: recover_after_throw
a58f110021961a8f.doc: After landing from a throw, waits 10 frames, plays the get up motion and returns to standing. Returns 1.

a5c582c296a669a8.name: fire_nose_bullets
a5c582c296a669a8.doc: Nose attack: turns to the target, plays the attack motion, then every 4th frame fires a nose shot from the chain point away from the nose, with the monster's attack as damage. Guard and dodge are allowed during the firing window and forbidden after.

a5c85ce61cf5dc38.name: hold_still_for_melee_dodge
a5c85ce61cf5dc38.doc: Locks guard and dodge, stops in place and unlocks again.

a5ecab006b0a851b.name: play_idle_motion_tracking_target
a5ecab006b0a851b.doc: Plays the play motion while tracking the target until it ends.

a5ed6442e5228c13.name: turn_to_target_for_frames
