a5ed6442e5228c13.doc: Keeps turning toward the target for the given number of frames, then stops turning. The turn speed is passed to the turn in degrees without converting it, so the monster snaps round almost at once.

a61021592a08dcee.name: choose_passive_action
a61021592a08dcee.doc: Used when priority is above 100: stand and watch, circle the target, or idle play.

a616e41ff18e02ba.name: get_frames_to_point
a616e41ff18e02ba.doc: Writes into out_frames[0] the frames needed to reach the point from the current position at the given speed.

a6182bf0abc46b65.name: reset_roses_and_wait
a6182bf0abc46b65.doc: Casts the tornado, resets all roses and waits until they are all in state 0, then returns phase 1.

a65b4a58dd779793.name: die_or_get_back_up
a65b4a58dd779793.doc: 10 percent of the time the monster plays the death motion invulnerable, revives with 20 percent life (get_random_float(0.3) truncates to 0), gets up and returns 0; otherwise it dies normally.

a664864b148a01f7.name: spawn_water_splash_and_idle
a664864b148a01f7.doc: Allows guard and dodge, spawns the foot water splash effect at the world point 0, 50, 0 and then waits forever.

a67d602bbc41bdd6.name: chase_or_wander_forever
a67d602bbc41bdd6.doc: Each frame fights the target if within 300 units, otherwise wanders.

a67ea6a2053f002d.name: run_chosen_action
a67ea6a2053f002d.doc: Runs the action in monster var 1: 1 swing, 2 shockwave, 7 idle delay, 8 walk toward target, 9 shockwave attack on a target behind.

a6848b302fe478af.name: wait_target_detected
a6848b302fe478af.doc: Waits up to max_frames, returning 1 as soon as the monster sees or hears the target, else 0.

a686c097f69ae09f.name: fight_until_target_leaves
a686c097f69ae09f.doc: Fight loop that returns once the target is further than 320 units. Inside 130 units it picks attack 2, a rocket volley, a lunge or a dash; further out it lunges or dashes at the target.

a6913499b4c08b8b.name: wander_in_flight_or_wait_for_target
a6913499b4c08b8b.doc: Flying idle behaviour: avoids walls, drifts back toward its home point, hovers waiting for the target, circles or flies randomly. Returns 1 if it notices the target while hovering.

a692f02665e4aebd.name: attack_repeat_swing_if_close
a692f02665e4aebd.doc: Attack 1, repeated up to two more times while the target stays within 70 units.

a6a033308f79d44b.name: wait_for_motion_end_or_target_seen
a6a033308f79d44b.doc: Waits until the motion ends (returns 0) or the target comes into view (returns 1).

a6bab7330912be4d.name: on_init
a6bab7330912be4d.doc: Registers the normal GC attack hits for attack 1, the weak poison hit for attack 2 and the dodge return hit, and sets up the AI.

a6fcb9d839e694b1.name: watch_player_if_disguised
a6fcb9d839e694b1.doc: If the player is disguised as a monster, waits and watches until the disguise ends.

a7034ecb069fd147.name: start_knockdown_grounded
a7034ecb069fd147.doc: Disables guard and dodge, resets the motion, turns scripted flight off and marks the boss as busy.

a7074a128d1a0098.name: on_update
a7074a128d1a0098.doc: Main loop: runs the bomb behavior every frame.

a70e65b10dfbe255.name: move_random_offset
a70e65b10dfbe255.doc: Moves a random distance in a random direction relative to its heading.

a72b070892c5a25c.name: is_path_blocked
a72b070892c5a25c.doc: Measures the clear space in the given direction and returns -1 if it is shorter than the distance, otherwise 0.

a736655d87729c82.name: pick_mid_range_action
a736655d87729c82.doc: Chooses an action for a target 120 to 200 units away: a thunder shot, or flying 60 frames around the target and then watching it.

a73fe1219da29a0b.name: act_at_medium_range
a73fe1219da29a0b.doc: Medium range choice: run in, shoot the petrify shot, walk up, circle the target or idle.

a7431eb44946481c.name: fight_enraged
a7431eb44946481c.doc: Attack loop used once the monster is enraged. Backs off when it is not among the nearest monsters, otherwise fireballs from mid range or lunges or approaches up close; returns when the target is farther than 210.

a7476dcb582df780.name: idle_while_player_disguised
a7476dcb582df780.doc: Stands, turning to face the target when it is more than 60 degrees off, while the player is disguised as a monster; returns when the disguise ends.

a74ef0558f013d05.name: on_damage
a74ef0558f013d05.doc: Stops everything. 95 percent of the time plays the damage knockback and counts the hit in monster variable 1; otherwise walks back and shoots.

a76599540de4938d.name: walk_toward_target_until_in_range
a76599540de4938d.doc: Walks toward the target for 90 to 180 frames. Returns 0 once the target is within 240 units and 1 on timeout.

a78dc693bd11e14a.name: act_at_mid_range
a78dc693bd11e14a.doc: Mid-range behaviour: shoots, dashes after a turn, circles, steps sideways or runs at the target.

a7a174921399a3d5.name: sidestep_around_target
a7a174921399a3d5.doc: Turns to the target, then walks 30 degrees to the right or left around it at the same distance at the given move speed, taking no damage for up to 9 frames of the move before stopping and waiting for the motion to end. The waits before and during the move end early when the target is within 40 units and 45 degrees of the facing.

a7b40362ea4960ac.name: play_idle_motion_watching_target
a7b40362ea4960ac.doc: Plays the play motion repeats times, about 33 frames each. With watch_target 1 it returns 1 as soon as the target comes within watch_dist + 10 units in any direction.

a7cb3d63d5128432.name: struggle_while_lifted
a7cb3d63d5128432.doc: Plays the struggle motion while the player holds the monster.

a7dea502516c5f42.name: explode_and_stay_as_wreck
a7dea502516c5f42.doc: Stops the machine gun, plays the warship damage effect and smoke, makes the turret unlockable and undamageable, takes 700 life off the linked monster and then waits forever.

a81834add0943266.name: hold_damage_pose_while_stopped
a81834add0943266.doc: Stop-status handler: cancels all actions, plays the damage motion with no knockback and holds it until the stop status bits (8 and 0x20) clear, then returns to the stand motion. Prints a debug line.

a84619a29d52a7aa.name: run_fight_loop
a84619a29d52a7aa.doc: Sets the no-guard and no-push flags, then loops: while rage hits remain it waits for the target to come close and runs the calm range-based fight; once enraged it runs the enraged fight loop.

a8828f64663b2ac5.name: choose_behavior_by_rage_and_aggro
a8828f64663b2ac5.doc: Chooses between fighting, charging or wandering based on aggro state, distance and rage hits.

a8b043c1979ce58f.name: fight_target_normally
a8b043c1979ce58f.doc: Combat loop before the monster is enraged: picks the close, mid or far routine by distance, and returns when the target is far or the monster is enraged.

a8bbaedd788879fe.name: chase_distant_target
a8bbaedd788879fe.doc: Loop that walks toward the target or waits for it to come into view until it is within 300 units.

a8de5728f2bb8c34.name: get_point_on_circle
a8de5728f2bb8c34.doc: Writes the point at the given angle and radius around the center (cx, cz) into out_x[0] and out_z[0].

a903d77567e14d32.name: chase_target_checking_clearance
a903d77567e14d32.doc: Like chasing the target, but returns -2 if the straight path to it is blocked and -1 once close enough.

a923686a63a45950.name: fight_at_long_range
a923686a63a45950.doc: Long-range choice (135 to 180 units): mostly thunder shots or the idle turn, sometimes flies closer or waits for the target.

a9511d2a0ef38434.name: on_dodge_melee
a9511d2a0ef38434.doc: Dodges a melee attack by facing the target and stepping sideways, then turns back to the target, stands and allows guard and dodge again. The step-back branch never runs because the 0 to 19 roll is always under 20.

a966576f7cec7503.name: circle_target_or_idle
a966576f7cec7503.doc: Circles the target, waits for it to come into view, or plays with the target.

a96c2705c8b7572a.name: dodge_shot_with_counter
a96c2705c8b7572a.doc: Dodges a shot: about 30 percent of the time rushes through the target with the dodge attack, otherwise plays the dodge-in and dodge-return motions in place. The sidestep branch is unreachable (its roll must exceed 100).

a9a5e724e6bb4845.name: glide_to_point_near_target
a9a5e724e6bb4845.doc: Glides to a random point 125 units from the target and faces the target.

a9e75119ac264dca.name: run_up_and_lunge_slash
a9e75119ac264dca.doc: Runs at the player, swings (attack 1) and lunges 100 units forward, then stands.

a9f97dd4c8afd21e.name: walk_after_target
a9f97dd4c8afd21e.doc: Walks toward the target for up to 240 frames, stopping at 45 units, then stands.

a9fb8934fadb04aa.name: swing_attack
a9fb8934fadb04aa.doc: Plays the attack 1 motion and returns to standing.

aa02102df01d3ee3.name: lunge_in_random_direction
aa02102df01d3ee3.doc: Turns to a random heading and lunges with attack 1, with guard and dodge disabled during the lunge. The target point takes its X offset from the sine of the yaw but its Z offset from the cosine of the Z rotation, so it lies 200 units along Z plus a sideways yaw-dependent offset rather than straight ahead.

aa03585eff78dffc.name: finish_throw
aa03585eff78dffc.doc: Ends a thrown state: clears no-damage, stops moving, waits 10 frames with the aggro update, then resets the motion.

aa0d61004cb21ffe.name: circle_or_watch_target
aa0d61004cb21ffe.doc: Waiting behaviour while another monster holds the attack slot: walks a short arc around the target, stands watching it, or plays the idle motion.

aa0f9e3b480a7ef9.name: is_facing_target_rad
aa0f9e3b480a7ef9.doc: Meant to return 1 when the monster faces within arc/2 radians of the target direction shifted by offset, else 0. It is written in an old call numbering: the rotation read has no native at its number and does nothing, and the target angle read returns the monster's x position instead, so the result does not reflect the facing.

aa1c1dd775becf9a.name: explode_on_landing
aa1c1dd775becf9a.doc: Land program of bomb monsters: stops, ends the throw and self-destructs.

aa42440ef5e0026c.name: dash_step_back
aa42440ef5e0026c.doc: Invulnerable back step: heads for a point 200 units behind at 3.6 per frame for 15 frames (about 54 units), with the step back motion.

aa937a6b49011362.name: pause_before_next_action
aa937a6b49011362.doc: Waits for the number of frames stored in monster var 5, then resets that delay to 40.

aaabbcc2efcafdc9.name: on_init
aaabbcc2efcafdc9.doc: Registers the attack hit windows and sword trails, loads the fireball effects into a free texture block and initialises the shared AI.

aab3d6880b3817a4.name: slide_to_orbit_start
aab3d6880b3817a4.doc: Sets orb state 8 and slides from the current position to a point 30 units away over 45 frames. Then sets orb state 16.

aabdb57a3a987854.name: choose_wander_action
aabdb57a3a987854.doc: Idle wander. Turns away from walls, returns toward home when too far, and otherwise stands watching, circles, turns or walks. Returns 1 when it detects the target while standing.

ab036db84fb345cd.name: track_target_until_motion_end
ab036db84fb345cd.doc: Keeps turning toward the target until the motion ends.

ab03a5ea6a02048c.name: play_idle_antics
ab03a5ea6a02048c.doc: Repeats the play motion, sometimes stepping back when the target is close, with short pauses between.

ab0deb6f1f2d02c8.name: wait_stun_end
ab0deb6f1f2d02c8.doc: Meant to show the stun stars and wait until they are gone. In this toolkit both calls use old native numbers that reach unrelated natives, so no stars are shown and the wait does not follow the stun.

ab0f9bfcbdfdb202.name: fire_rocket_barrage
ab0f9bfcbdfdb202.doc: Walks up to the target and plays attack 3, firing a homing rocket from the dcol2 frame every 8 frames, launched upward in a random world direction within 90 degrees of +Z rather than of its facing. The frames argument is ignored: the barrage lasts 32 frames, doubled when no rage hits are left.

ab240fd56a36eb75.name: accelerate_to_point
ab240fd56a36eb75.doc: Flies the boss in a straight line to a point with constant acceleration chosen to cover the distance in the scaled time. Returns 0 if the path becomes invalid, otherwise the frames flown.

ab3ab36710d4e59e.name: face_target_and_attack
ab3ab36710d4e59e.doc: Turns to the target, then lunges (90 percent) or fires a curse bullet.

ab9631a99822efb1.name: fight_while_calm
ab9631a99822efb1.doc: Calm combat loop. Watches a disguised player and picks the far, mid or close behaviour by distance. Returns when the player is further than 280 or the monster becomes enraged.

abb33b0fe882918b.name: swipe_at_target
abb33b0fe882918b.doc: Turns to the target and plays attack 1 while tracking it.

abd039808a1b8ced.name: absorb_energy_from_lights
abd039808a1b8ced.doc: Stops in place and sets monster var 30 to 4, the command that sends the three Atramilia lights up to circle above the boss, then plays the energy absorb motions, staying invincible and flickering while all three circle. Afterwards it restores lighting and colour, plays the absorb-out motion and clears the invincibility.

abd43ca23603e6a1.name: act_at_far_range
abd43ca23603e6a1.doc: Calm long-range choice: approach, stand and watch, cast the curse, or circle the player.

abec43734760ed18.name: play_damage_blowback
abec43734760ed18.doc: Damage reaction: stops everything, plays the damage motion with a 3 frame knockback, waits for it to end plus 12 frames, then returns to standing.

abfb9288302cba4a.name: run_combat_loop
abfb9288302cba4a.doc: Allows guard and dodge and repeats the combat decision step every frame.

ac00de6e5e8a8189.name: get_up_after_throw
ac00de6e5e8a8189.doc: Recovery after being thrown: ends the throw (finish_throw waits 10 frames), stops, waits 10 more frames, plays the get-up motion to its end and returns 1.

ac035f24e33ea6cb.name: setup_bomb_thrower
ac035f24e33ea6cb.doc: Registers attack 1, then loads the bomb effects for this monster's grade (pumpkin bomb, gooey peach, stone berry or final bomb) into a free texture block. Grade 0 also sets the photo window, then the shared monster AI is initialised.

ac1364c1e5919986.name: get_situation_flags
ac1364c1e5919986.doc: Returns bit flags describing the target: 1 within 320 units, 2 farther (which also clears monster var 0), 4 facing it within 90 degrees, 8 facing away, 16 within 40 units and within 30 degrees of the monster's facing, 32 free to attack (among the four monsters nearest the target, or no rage hits left).

ac175558599b1b6c.name: wander_forward_in_random_direction
ac175558599b1b6c.doc: Meant to turn up to angle_range degrees, but converts the range to radians and then the random turn to radians again, so it turns a whole number of degrees from 0 to about angle_range/57, always to the same side. If 100 units ahead are clear it walks min_dist + move_speed plus a random 0 to dist_range units; if less is clear but more than clearance it walks just the random amount; otherwise it returns -1 without moving. Returns 1 if the target comes within clearance, 2 when the walk ends, 0 after max_frames.

ac3f90564b98285d.name: choose_wander_action
ac3f90564b98285d.doc: Wander AI. Picks a random idle action: turn away from walls, return toward home, walk around the home point or the target, walk straight, or wait and watch for the player. Sets monster var 0 to 1, 4, 8, 16 or 32 to record which action it chose. Returns 1 when it noticed the target.

ac4772ccd8c671dd.name: fight_with_no_rage_hits_left
ac4772ccd8c671dd.doc: Fight loop used while the rage counter is zero: runs up and lunges or shoots a feather volley when the target is near, otherwise lunges or runs closer. Returns once rage hits are left.

ac51e2d06be84802.name: wait_target_detected
ac51e2d06be84802.doc: Waits frame by frame up to max_frames for the target to be seen or heard (can_detect_target). Returns 1 when detected, 0 on timeout.

ac5439c1ace1d677.name: fly_in_direction
ac5439c1ace1d677.doc: Flies the given distance along a heading in degrees without turning the model first. Returns the result of fly_straight_to_point.

ac9777e34a59f774.name: turn_to_target_and_guard
ac9777e34a59f774.doc: Turns to the target, raises its guard, plays the guard knockback and lowers the guard again.

ac9cc0b9587aedb8.name: chase_target_until_close
ac9cc0b9587aedb8.doc: Each frame turns toward the target and moves to its position until within stop_dist (returns -1) or max_frames pass (returns the frames used).

ac9d48faa01caecd.name: chase_target_checked
ac9d48faa01caecd.doc: Chases the target while checking clearance each frame. Returns -1 when within near_dist, -2 when the line to the target is blocked, else the frames used.

aca6d335550c4c48.name: wait_or_circle_target
aca6d335550c4c48.doc: Used when other monsters are nearer the target: half the time plays the taunt; otherwise it either circles the target at 130 to 160 units or stands and watches for up to 30 frames, evenly.

acb07a51e2136776.name: turn_to_face_target
acb07a51e2136776.doc: Walks in place turning until the monster faces the target.

acd3795dd3dbbbad.name: sync_shared_life_and_check_death
acd3795dd3dbbbad.doc: Subtracts the life lost since the last frame from the shared total life in monster var 64 and runs on_death when this monster's life reaches 0.

acdf28679f658fc0.name: look_around_for_target
acdf28679f658fc0.doc: Turns left, right, right and left in turn, standing and waiting at each heading. Returns 0 as soon as the target is seen.

ace053aae0010572.name: rise_above_host
ace053aae0010572.doc: Sets orb state 1 and flies to 100 units above the host over 60 frames. Then sets orb state 2.

acf2ee79ef4c998b.name: pick_idle_movement
acf2ee79ef4c998b.doc: Picks a random idle behavior: turning away from walls, returning toward home, circling the target, or waiting to detect it. Returns 1 if it detected the target.

acf7f0a5ffb29867.name: wander_around_home
acf7f0a5ffb29867.doc: Idle behaviour. Turns away from a wall closer than 50, circles its home point when more than 300 units from it, otherwise stands watching for a target, turns, circles the target or walks straight ahead. Returns 1 when it detects a target.

acfb73203f703d60.name: walk_around_target
acfb73203f703d60.doc: Turns to face the point radius units from the target at angle_deg around it (0 is the side facing this monster), then walks there at move_speed. Only move_speed + stop_dist units ahead are probed: if less is clear, the walk is cut to the clear distance, and -1 is returned without moving when that is under twice stop_dist. Otherwise waits up to max_frames and returns 1 once the target is within stop_dist, 2 when the walk ends, 0 on timeout, and stops moving.

ad32b3666ef52555.name: fight_close_range
ad32b3666ef52555.doc: Close range choices: fly in and dive, circle the target, or fly backward.

ad3c9121ddc1bdac.name: attack_at_close_range
ad3c9121ddc1bdac.doc: Fires a holy shot at once if the target is under 40 units, then fires a holy shot (sometimes after a sidestep), backs away, or flies 100 units off at 35 degrees from straight back.

ad4ec4e6c44edcd3.name: wander_or_wait_for_target
ad4ec4e6c44edcd3.doc: Idle behaviour: turns away from a wall closer than 42, circles its home point when more than 300 from it, otherwise waits for the target, turns, strolls around the target or walks straight ahead. Returns 1 when it notices the target.

ad547db7f1a7106b.name: walk_in_direction
ad547db7f1a7106b.doc: Despite the parameter names, the first argument is the turn speed in degrees and the second the walk speed. Turns to the world heading angle_deg, then walks dist units along it (at least the walk speed + 1). A heading below the turn speed, including every negative heading, is first increased by the turn speed. Returns 1 if the target comes within stop_dist, 2 when the walk ends, 0 after max_frames.

ad690663eae09434.name: turn_toward_target_with_offset_chance
ad690663eae09434.doc: Turns toward the target, with chance percent of aiming offset_angle degrees to either side, and waits.

ada7d149e60088d2.name: fight_at_far_range
ada7d149e60088d2.doc: Far range choice (target 210 to 280 away): closes in by running or walking, circles, taunts or fires a fire ball.

adc7b95ef40d843e.name: follow_player_while_disguised
adc7b95ef40d843e.doc: While the player is disguised, keeps turning to face the player. Returns once the disguise ends.

adc984502f332857.name: run_ai_step
adc984502f332857.doc: One AI decision: fights normally when not enraged, using the aggro range to switch between idle wandering, chasing and fighting; uses the enraged routine otherwise.

ade8cbcaa9fc1b26.name: circle_above_owner_with_light
ade8cbcaa9fc1b26.doc: Sets state 32, creates the Atlamillia light effect owned by this monster, and circles at radius 30 above the owner for 150 frames before ending the effect and setting state 64.

adedd0b65ea45223.name: turn_to_angle
adedd0b65ea45223.doc: Turns to the absolute heading angle_deg at turn_speed_deg degrees per frame, wrapping both to the -180 to 180 range, and waits until the heading is reached or about 360 divided by the speed frames pass. Returns the frames waited.

adef6cd6864b1184.name: chase_target_flying
adef6cd6864b1184.doc: Recomputes the target each frame and flies toward it at hover_height above the ground, facing it (with pitch when pitch_to_target is set). Returns 1 when close, the check_flight_step result on an obstruction, or 0 after max_frames.

adfd8bc39ea4e69a.name: on_stun
adfd8bc39ea4e69a.doc: Plays knocked flying until near the ground, then get up, restores flight attributes, places the monster 10 units above the ground and ends the stun.

ae06b072ea5ccab1.name: chase_target_checking_clearance
ae06b072ea5ccab1.doc: Like chase_target_stopping_short but returns -2 if the segment to the target is not clear.

ae1a8b4c3979ab1c.name: choose_wander_action
ae1a8b4c3979ab1c.doc: Wander AI. Picks a random idle action: turn away from walls, return toward home, walk around the home point or the target, walk straight, or wait and watch for the player. Sets monster var 0 to 1, 4, 8, 16 or 32 to record which action it chose. Returns 1 when it noticed the target.

ae2b1c4cdf257d53.name: act_at_close_range
ae2b1c4cdf257d53.doc: Close range choice: usually flies at the target and swoops, otherwise circles the target or flies backward.

ae3883cf42c3428a.name: fly_in_random_direction
ae3883cf42c3428a.doc: Turns by a random angle and flies a random distance in that direction.

ae3aa4c9c9cf4ad2.name: on_init
ae3aa4c9c9cf4ad2.doc: Registers the two combo hit boxes and the two attack 2 hit boxes and starts the monster AI.

ae6fa809b3e51188.name: track_monster_until_time
ae6fa809b3e51188.doc: Turns to keep facing the given monster until the motion progress reaches the given time.

ae90bc93fa9a872f.name: fly_turning_toward_target
ae90bc93fa9a872f.doc: Flies forward 1 unit per frame at height 800, turning at most 0.025 radians per frame toward the target while it is within 0.5 radians and 800 units of its facing, otherwise toward the point (268.8, -322.4). Shows a found-it or not-here line and ends once facing within 0.005 radians of the target. b02a raw numbering.

aea7698f70428841.name: chase_target_steps
aea7698f70428841.doc: Turns to face the target, then each frame turns toward it and walks to the point move_speed plus stop_dist ahead of the monster on the line to the target, for up to max_frames. Returns -1 as soon as the target is within stop_dist, otherwise the frames used.

aeab07cf3c1c21bb.name: update_fight_tracking
aeab07cf3c1c21bb.doc: Tracks damage taken and checks the stall timeout.

aec2defb76f044cd.name: far_action_before_rage
aec2defb76f044cd.doc: Far-range choice (160 to 280 units) before the monster is enraged: approach, stand watching, lunge in a random direction, side-step or curse bullet.

aed3ca3e63b4bdc6.name: wait_for_turn_to_angle
aed3ca3e63b4bdc6.doc: Waits, checking the low life event each frame, until the monster's yaw is within tolerance_deg (or at least 3 degrees) of angle_deg or max_frames pass, then stops turning. Returns the frames waited.

aee308e8ab28ea63.name: wait_move_or_target_near
aee308e8ab28ea63.doc: Waits up to max_frames for the move_to walk to end or the target to come within distance, stopping the move either way. Returns 1 if the target got near, 2 if the walk ended, 0 on timeout (get_player_status and apply_reserved_texture are the old-numbered check_move_end and stop_moving).

aeeeed0ac101218b.name: turn_in_place_to_target
aeeeed0ac101218b.doc: Plays the circle motion while turning toward the target until it faces it, or until the target is within 50 units, which also clears the queued actions. Then stands.

aef3b327353add8b.name: get_frames_since_record
aef3b327353add8b.doc: Returns how many frames have passed since record_floor_time was called for the slot.

aef83b2ba245c97e.name: attack_when_target_behind
aef83b2ba245c97e.doc: Only calls the shockwave attack; chosen when the target is behind the monster.

af00e240ddf966f8.name: switch_phase_when_due
af00e240ddf966f8.doc: Switches phase: from red to blue after 6 minions have been counted, and from blue back to red after the slot 0 timer passes 300 frames.

af239d15c1f467a7.name: swing_attack_1
af239d15c1f467a7.doc: Plays attack 1 while tracking the target until 40.8 percent of the motion, then lets it finish.

af597b458319d128.name: play_blown_away
af597b458319d128.doc: Faces the target, is knocked flying, lies down for 30 frames and gets up.

af6e7e58b0b9e675.name: count_down_fuse_when_lifted
af6e7e58b0b9e675.doc: Lifted program: stops the bomb, clears its velocity attribute and colour pulse, sets monster var 1 to 1 and keeps counting the fuse in monster var 2 from where it was up to 195 frames. In the last 30 frames it turns its lighting off and flashes red and yellow over its normal colour, beeping about every 8 frames, then explodes.

af74a8f0b80d05f1.name: face_user_monster_if_any
af74a8f0b80d05f1.doc: If the player is disguised as a monster, runs face_target_while_disguised for this monster kind until the disguise ends; otherwise returns at once.

af9b62c4909c41e1.name: face_target_while_disguised
af9b62c4909c41e1.doc: Idle loop for a monster while the player is disguised: keeps standing and turns toward the target when it is more than 60 degrees off. Returns once the player is no longer disguised.

af9ce9a4e77020a4.name: strafe_or_wait
af9ce9a4e77020a4.doc: Either walks around the target at a random side angle or stands waiting for the target to come into view.

afa2f9ea2f7f1056.name: walk_around_point
afa2f9ea2f7f1056.doc: Walks to a point at angle_deg and radius around the given point (x, y, z), turning toward it first.

afae2713e19af68d.name: turn_toward_target_with_random_offset
afae2713e19af68d.doc: Turns toward the target, with offset_chance percent probability of aiming offset_deg to a random side. Returns the frames waited.

afb72a6e145d27b1.name: approach_and_summon
afb72a6e145d27b1.doc: Walks toward the target and summons monsters if the target is over 200 units away and fewer than 18 monsters exist.

afb879ee96ab24a8.name: backstep_from_target
afb879ee96ab24a8.doc: Flying backstep: becomes undamageable, plays the step-back motion and after 4 frames flies for up to 10 frames straight away from the target to 30 to 40 units farther than it is now, 25 units above the ground. Waits for the motion to end and stops.

b00f37ffd83b532d.name: wander_forward_random_distance
b00f37ffd83b532d.doc: Turns a few degrees to one side and walks ahead. The angle range is converted to radians before the random pick and again after it, so the turn is only 0 to 6 degrees for a 360 degree range. With nothing within 100 units ahead it walks min_dist + speed + a random 0 to dist_range; otherwise it walks only the random distance, or returns -1 if a wall is within near_dist. Otherwise returns the result of waiting for the move.

b0647e3ffa9d78e7.name: choose_behavior_by_aggro
b0647e3ffa9d78e7.doc: Chooses between fighting, running to the target or wandering based on aggro state and distance, or fights without rage hits left.

b06d344d9ed3c14f.name: strafe_until_target_near
b06d344d9ed3c14f.doc: While the target is 240 or more away, flies around it in step motions or stands and watches. Returns when the target is closer.

b06f72667322d7f8.name: approach_distant_target
b06f72667322d7f8.doc: Loop that returns once the target is within 270 units: walks toward it or stands watching.

b0d0bd66947ac28d.name: on_death
b0d0bd66947ac28d.doc: Plays the death motion after starting the drops, then idles forever.

b0e32706bcb8a2ce.name: wait_frames
b0e32706bcb8a2ce.doc: Waits frames / 30 * 25 frames with a bare wait. The integer division runs first, so counts under 30 wait nothing and the rest round down to a multiple of 25.

b0eaf77b694587e7.name: choose_behavior
b0eaf77b694587e7.doc: Top-level behaviour pick. When calm and not aggravated it fights if the player is within 225 and wanders otherwise. Once aggravated it chases, or fights if the player is within 95. When enraged it uses the enraged combat loop.

b13b72eb9db51743.name: move_in_direction
b13b72eb9db51743.doc: Moves dist units along an absolute angle without turning first.

b13eb86c7a8d7481.name: turn_and_guard
b13eb86c7a8d7481.doc: Turns to the target and guards for 30 frames, with a guard knockback.

b1642d4d6228bbf5.name: clear_flag_bits
b1642d4d6228bbf5.doc: Clears the bits of mask from flags[0].

b1a1acdec774adc5.name: stop_for_dodge_melee
b1a1acdec774adc5.doc: Runs on a melee dodge: clears the no-body-hit attribute, stops, then re-allows guard and dodge.

b1a2462a3f5f4587.name: pick_mid_range_action
b1a2462a3f5f4587.doc: Chooses an action for a target 90 to 140 units away: usually the flame shot, otherwise walks up or circles.

b1b4a31fd9cb922a.name: fight_calm_mid_range
b1b4a31fd9cb922a.doc: Mid range choice while not enraged: charge, spit goo, approach or circle.

b1c7cbee678f59fa.name: recover_from_throw_and_wait
b1c7cbee678f59fa.doc: Meant to clear the no-damage attribute, stop moving, end the thrown state, wait 10 frames and reset the motion. In this script's old native numbering the calls run set_photo_window, get_home_pos and get_attack, and the end_throw call has no native, so only the 10-frame wait happens as meant.

b1d797bc04c784cd.name: fight_at_mid_range
b1d797bc04c784cd.doc: Mid range: casts a shot, then approaches and shoots again, runs in, watches, or circles the target.

b1db05c384db0090.name: choose_idle_wander_action
b1db05c384db0090.doc: Leftover walking idle behaviour from the generic monster template: turns away from walls, wanders back toward home or strafes around the target. Returns 1 if the target is detected, and is not called by this monster's update loop.

b1ff4dd7fe07567f.name: recover_after_throw
b1ff4dd7fe07567f.doc: Recovers from being thrown and waits 10 frames.

b2013a90adf2fb7c.name: update_target_range_flags
b2013a90adf2fb7c.doc: Writes into monster var 0 a bit set describing the player: distance band 1 (within 50), 2 (within 240), 4 (within 760) or 8 (beyond), 16 within 240, 64 within 90, and 32 or 128 when the monster faces the player within a 45 or 80 degree arc.

b2070a325cf5af41.name: fight_while_rage_hits_left
b2070a325cf5af41.doc: Fight loop used when rage hits are left: picks the far, mid or close routine by distance. Returns 0 when the target is beyond 230 units or no rage hits remain.

b20c9dce359cb77b.name: watch_target_if_disguised
b20c9dce359cb77b.doc: If the player is transformed into a monster, hovers watching them until the transformation ends.

b2118ed1381f1958.name: vanish_to_dodge_melee
b2118ed1381f1958.doc: Vanishes and reappears at the target to avoid a melee attack.

b21dc8ab89f5985a.name: walk_to_point_around_target
b21dc8ab89f5985a.doc: Turns toward and walks to the point at an angle and distance from the target, shortened by walls. Returns -1 if there is no room.

b22271005eef778f.name: turn_to_target_for_frames
b22271005eef778f.doc: Turns toward the target for the given number of frames, then stops turning.

b233f4bdaaf0d697.name: fly_at_target
b233f4bdaaf0d697.doc: Turns to face the target, then flies in a straight line toward the spot at the target's position and ground height plus height, with speed units per frame, checking each step with check_flight_step. The direction is fixed at the start. Returns 1 when within speed plus near_dist, the blocked code (-1 wall, -2 height) on a hit, 0 on timeout.

b247c72bb899548e.name: wait_stun_end
b247c72bb899548e.doc: Shows the stun stars and waits until they are gone. Written in this script's old native numbering, where the two DIRECT calls shown as turn_to and move_to stand for show_stun_stars and get_stun_stars_left.

b25805e2cd6b103d.name: walk_around_target
b25805e2cd6b103d.doc: Turns to face the point radius units from the target at angle_deg around it (0 is the side facing this monster), then walks there at move_speed. Only move_speed + stop_dist units ahead are probed: if less is clear, the walk is cut to the clear distance, and -1 is returned without moving when that is under twice stop_dist. Otherwise waits up to max_frames and returns 1 once the target is within stop_dist, 2 when the walk ends, 0 on timeout, and stops moving.

b26af16665246e50.name: turn_and_slash_combo
b26af16665246e50.doc: Turns to the target, plays attack 1 until 0.595 into the motion, then attack 2, and returns to standing.

b2733caf21b10fbe.name: run_toward_target
b2733caf21b10fbe.doc: Turns to the target and runs at it for up to 120 frames.

b27b6d3d3de7c315.name: side_step_walk
b27b6d3d3de7c315.doc: Walks sideways the given distance to the left or right. The wall check measures the clearance straight ahead, not to the side, and subtracts it from the distance; it returns -1 without moving if less than min_dist remains.

b2a1870deecde8a0.name: chase_target_clear
b2a1870deecde8a0.doc: Like chase_target, but first checks that the straight line to the target is clear. Returns -1 once closer than stop_dist, -2 if the line is blocked, otherwise the frames spent.

b2bad94299b8a628.name: turn_to_target_until_motion_end
b2bad94299b8a628.doc: Keeps turning toward the target until the motion ends.

b2c9d66f4cbcfe7c.name: shoot_until_target_leaves
b2c9d66f4cbcfe7c.doc: Fight loop used once no rage hits remain, returning when the target is beyond 240 units: fires thunder shots, sometimes after a random sidestep, or wanders while its attack priority is above 2.

b2dfd7aa352d7115.name: run_at_target
b2dfd7aa352d7115.doc: Runs toward the target for up to 120 frames, then stands.

b33f57564ab8c781.name: get_distance_to_partner
b33f57564ab8c781.doc: Writes into out_distance[0] the ground distance to the monster whose handle is in shared variable 30.

b374732b2669b3df.name: end_stun
b374732b2669b3df.doc: Plays the faint motion and waits until the stun stars are gone, then allows guarding and dodging again (the DIRECT finish_death(1/2, 0) calls are the old-numbered set_mask_flag).

b37f3d391f64fb22.name: dodge_melee_by_stepping
b37f3d391f64fb22.doc: Locks interrupts, faces the target and steps sideways (always, since the roll is below 20) before returning to standing; the step-back branch is never reached. Then allows guard and dodge again.

b38ea20a2bbbc06e.name: dash_ahead_toward_target
b38ea20a2bbbc06e.doc: Turns to the target and moves straight ahead the target's distance. Returns -1 without moving if there is not enough clear space.

b38f086e34b1231c.name: glide_to_target
b38f086e34b1231c.doc: Faces the target, then glides to its position at the given height offset above the ground.

b3a515df48ba7a04.name: wait_frames_tracking_damage
b3a515df48ba7a04.doc: Waits the given number of frames while tracking damage.

b3b2a63cdf621ad6.name: sidestep_dodge_melee
b3b2a63cdf621ad6.doc: Locks interrupts, turns to the target, side-steps around it and unlocks.

b3b415cd0a92cd45.name: play_guard_motion
b3b415cd0a92cd45.doc: Locks interrupts, plays the guard-in motion, a small guard knockback and the guard-out motion, then unlocks.

b3b48651be5aace3.name: recoil_from_hit
b3b48651be5aace3.doc: Plays the damage knockback and returns to the stance.

b3be2ab4a9018f77.name: update_boss_state
b3be2ab4a9018f77.doc: Per frame boss logic: checks life (setting the shared variable 64 on death, which makes the minions die), summons minions, updates the phase and the flash, and orbits the ring. Body hits are off for 150 frames after each minion summon or beam (the slot 2 timer), and once that timer passes 300 frames with the flash finished it flies to the center, fires the beam, flies to the far side and swims back onto the ring.

b3ce6302f4b3bd42.name: block_attack_with_guard
b3ce6302f4b3bd42.doc: Uninterruptible guard: guard-in motion, short guard knockback, 8 frames of holding, guard-out, then stand.

b4045772573b10d0.name: act_at_mid_range
b4045772573b10d0.doc: Mid range choice: usually flies toward the target, otherwise waits in view or circles the target.

b42bd10ec0ef83ab.name: watch_player_disguise
b42bd10ec0ef83ab.doc: If the player is disguised, waits in the disguise watch loop.

b43adf304253df59.name: fight_mid_range
b43adf304253df59.doc: Mid range choices: fireball or lunge after turning, chase the target, or circle it and lunge if it got close.

b442cc71bbeddb96.name: walk_toward_distant_target
b442cc71bbeddb96.doc: Walks toward a target farther than 295 units or waits for it to come into view, returning when it is within 295.

b46a290c6868b5ba.name: fight_while_rage_hits_remain
b46a290c6868b5ba.doc: Fight loop while rage hits remain: picks the long, medium or close range behavior by distance. Returns when the target is past 240 or no rage hits remain.

b4907131d52e12e3.name: fly_to_sky_then_rise_at_corner
b4907131d52e12e3.doc: Sky phase entry. Becomes impossible to lock on, warps with an effect, climbs to height 500 and curves off toward a far point while shrinking. It then takes damage from every damage kind, is placed 1000 units below the arena corner nearest the target at ten times its normal scale, and flies up to height -100 before it can be locked on again.

b4a8262eb3c47ef5.name: choose_idle_wander_action
b4a8262eb3c47ef5.doc: Leftover walking idle behaviour from the generic monster template: turns away from walls, wanders back toward home or strafes around the target. Returns 1 if the target is detected, and is not called by this monster's update loop.

b4c1d9ce1bea44f4.name: on_update
b4c1d9ce1bea44f4.doc: Main loop: while rage hits remain, fights within 240 horizontally or picks a flying action; once enraged (no rage hits left) runs the enraged fight loop.

b4d6c9321fa361e0.name: walk_to_melee_range
b4d6c9321fa361e0.doc: Walks toward the target while turning to it. Returns 0 on reaching 50 units, 1 if it loses the target's facing arc or the target is over 240 away.

b4f745ba0521ec31.name: act_at_mid_range
b4f745ba0521ec31.doc: Mid range choice: usually shoots, sometimes circles the target, walks back and shoots, backs away, or sidesteps.

b4fed73ec6bcf0ee.name: fight_calm_mid_range
b4fed73ec6bcf0ee.doc: Mid range choice while not enraged: wait, turn, approach or circle the target.

b50ad05c23e9809a.name: face_monster_for_frames
b50ad05c23e9809a.doc: Turns toward another monster by handle every frame for the given number of frames, then stops turning. speed_deg is degrees per frame.

b51695370b88ab5e.name: chase_target_until_close
b51695370b88ab5e.doc: Walks or spins toward the target for up to max_frames frames. Returns -1 as soon as the target is within stop_distance, otherwise the frames used.

b51882cfd6f46b15.name: count_summoned_minion
b51882cfd6f46b15.doc: Adds one to monster variable 20, the counter of minions summoned since the last phase change.

b531a23cf2098dd2.name: lunge_attack
b531a23cf2098dd2.doc: Walks up to the target, then plays attack 1, dashing 100 units forward in the middle of the motion. Sometimes follows with the play motion.

b53a5ace69484aca.name: rush_forward_attack
b53a5ace69484aca.doc: Attack 1: swings while edging toward a point 200 units ahead at 1.8 per frame, moving only for a frame at the start and 24 frames at the end (about 45 units), then shakes the camera on impact.

b53ddb66338e0be8.name: turn_to_angle_and_wait
b53ddb66338e0be8.doc: Starts turning toward an absolute yaw in degrees and waits until it is reached. Returns the frames waited.

b5423dd3166d7c86.name: orbit_camera_for_frames
b5423dd3166d7c86.doc: Runs the arena camera update once per frame for the given number of frames.

b5464ae5d3f00483.name: run_toward_target
b5464ae5d3f00483.doc: Runs toward the target until close enough (40 units if flag 32 is set, otherwise 160). Returns 1 if the target is behind or too far, 0 once in range.

b546f760712bc7d9.name: wander_when_idle
b546f760712bc7d9.doc: Idle behaviour while no target is engaged: backs away from walls, walks around its home point, stands watching, or paces around the target, recording the movement type in a monster variable. Returns 1 as soon as the target is detected, otherwise 0.

b56061457840ef8c.name: get_aggro_timer
b56061457840ef8c.doc: Reads the aggro timer (monster variable set 2, slot 12), the frames counted so far toward the aggro duration, into out[0].

b561100cb77e3e2f.name: wait_motion_watch_target
b561100cb77e3e2f.doc: Waits frame by frame until the current motion ends or the target comes into view. Returns 0 when the motion ended, 1 when the target was seen first.

b5614211733b5053.name: back_step_away
b5614211733b5053.doc: Plays the back step motion; after 10 frames turns invulnerable and moves toward a point 100 units straight behind at 4.2 units per frame for 8 frames (about 34 units), then stops, becomes damageable again and waits for the motion to end.

b597a93ccf970ed4.name: choose_combat_or_idle_behaviour
b597a93ccf970ed4.doc: One decision step: when not enraged it fights, wanders or chases depending on aggro state and distance; once enraged it runs the enraged fight.

b59f7715f0723721.name: dash_toward_point
b59f7715f0723721.doc: Dashes in a straight line toward a point, decelerating along the way. If it ends up behind the arena edge (z below 92) it teleports back, and it stops when the way is blocked. Returns frames moved.

b5ca1963faa0b50b.name: start_smoke_effect
b5ca1963faa0b50b.doc: Creates the lava smoke effect on the monster and stores it in a global.

b5d6d9afbbb254b1.name: stop_all_actions
b5d6d9afbbb254b1.doc: Stops moving and turning, resets the motion and clears the act status.

b5e91b257e757acf.name: get_facing_dot_to_target
b5e91b257e757acf.doc: Adds the yaw of the monster in active slot 0 to this monster's yaw and returns its dot product with the direction from the target to this monster, so -1 means aimed straight at the target (b15a turrets fire below -0.98).

b62b7fede5c1d759.name: setup_emerging_monster
b62b7fede5c1d759.doc: Initialises the monster vars, sets the clip distance to 40, the stand motion and near-opaque alpha.

b6354c14ea8167b0.name: dodge_shot_by_moving
b6354c14ea8167b0.doc: Dodging a shot sends the butterfly to a new formation slot.

b635c0ff1f3c21ea.name: pick_long_range_action
b635c0ff1f3c21ea.doc: Chooses one action for a target 140 to 240 units away: usually closes in or fires the red wave, rarely wanders or taunts.

b63d0a14096af46a.name: sidestep_invulnerable
b63d0a14096af46a.doc: Steps 100 units left or right at random, invulnerable for the middle of the motion.

b644011939a76471.name: check_player_disguise
b644011939a76471.doc: If the player is disguised, waits until the disguise ends.

b64ce0250dbfb469.name: wait_until_target_in_view
b64ce0250dbfb469.doc: Waits up to max_frames until the target is in the view cone. Returns 1 if seen.

b664c1bccd7ea26b.name: choose_action_by_aggro
b664c1bccd7ea26b.doc: Decides what to do each update: fight when the target is within 400 and it is not aggroed, walk up to it otherwise, or when aggroed fight or approach by distance, dropping the aggro when the target is out of range.

b6759a499d15ccf7.name: swim_to_random_ring_point
b6759a499d15ccf7.doc: Picks a point on a ring of radius 400 around the arena center at a random angle of 0 to 2/pi radians (about 36 degrees), at a height of 200 that wobbles by 30 with variable 19, turns to it, glides there in 80 frames and switches to the swim loop.

b6d1ff148a1c8b6d.name: run_boss_attack_cycle
b6d1ff148a1c8b6d.doc: Update program. Repeats: glides to an arena edge point or a point near the target (even odds), then fires a feather volley, waits 60 frames, fires the fast volley, waits 60 frames, absorbs energy from the Atramilia lights, scatters feathers and waits 60 frames, setting monster var 30 to 8 after each attack.

b6e18f30aa33661e.name: backstep_from_target
b6e18f30aa33661e.doc: Turns to the target, plays the walk-back motion and from frame 8 walks at speed straight away from the target toward a point 40 to 50 units farther than it is now, taking no damage; at frame 16 it stops moving and can be damaged again, and it stands once the motion ends.

b6f221c157de834e.name: turn_to_target_limit
b6f221c157de834e.doc: Turns toward the target and waits until facing it or the frame limit.

b6fd58628f43aea9.name: wait_target_in_view
b6fd58628f43aea9.doc: Waits up to max_frames frames until is_target_in_view with view_range and view_angle. Returns 1 when the target is seen, 0 on timeout.

b70f10155c674abc.name: wait_motion_end_update
b70f10155c674abc.doc: Runs the per-frame update every frame until the current motion has finished. Returns 1.

b71041c01de63a57.name: step_back_invulnerable
b71041c01de63a57.doc: Invulnerable 100 unit hop backward with the step back motion.

b7171a03a1165dc8.name: fight_target_by_distance
b7171a03a1165dc8.doc: Loops while the target is within 270 units and rage hits remain, picking the long, medium or close range behaviour by distance (160, 90).

b71751b3e95bb30d.name: wait_target_in_view
b71751b3e95bb30d.doc: Waits up to the frame limit for the target to be within the distance and half-angle in front of the monster. Returns 1 if it came into view.

b71d0dc0bb6b2afa.name: wait_motion_end_or_target_in_view
b71d0dc0bb6b2afa.doc: Waits until the motion ends (returns 0) or the target enters the view cone (returns 1).

b7376f3c814e27c3.name: check_life_change
b7376f3c814e27c3.doc: Compares the monster's life with the value stored last frame. Returns 1 when dead, 2 when it lost life (recording the hit) and 0 otherwise.

b741ee2204236018.name: pick_mid_range_action
b741ee2204236018.doc: Chooses an action for a target 100 to 180 units away: usually walk up, sometimes attack immediately.

b77c47180eeeb942.name: setup_seadra_attacks
b77c47180eeeb942.doc: Registers the Seadra attack hits: two Seadra attack 2 hits on attack 1 (radius 8 at object 1 and 13.2 at object 2), the Seadra attack hit on attack 2 and the Seadra attack 3 hit on the dodge return motion. Then resets monster variable 0, initialises the AI and extends the clip distance.

b78f69aa66fe54ee.name: turn_and_fly_toward_angle
b78f69aa66fe54ee.doc: Turns to the given angle in degrees, then flies the given distance in that direction. Returns the result of the flight.

b79b068e68165ca7.name: dodge_shot_by_sidestepping
b79b068e68165ca7.doc: Locks interrupts and sidesteps 30 degrees left or right around the target at speed 3, taking no damage while moving, then stands and re-allows guard and dodge.

b7a543cd1ed834a0.name: turn_to_face_target
b7a543cd1ed834a0.doc: Turns toward the player at the given speed and waits until facing. Returns the frames used.

b7a550dc623c20d5.name: choose_behavior_by_aggro
b7a550dc623c20d5.doc: If not aggroed, starts fighting when the target is within 600 and otherwise waits for it; if aggroed, fights when within 200 and charges when within the aggro range.

b7e1573d27ed7bd7.name: fly_around_target_step
b7e1573d27ed7bd7.doc: Turns to the target, then plays the right (step_right = 1) or left step motion and flies from its position along the direction away from the target turned by angle_deg, target distance plus extra_dist units, first at 5 then at 25 units above the ground, frames/2 frames each.

b7e80d940e3b75c6.name: trigger_first_hit_event
b7e80d940e3b75c6.doc: The first time the monster has a hit of type 0 while dungeon flag 51 is unset, it sets the flag and runs event script 2510.

b80a75f0aac69cff.name: approach_until_in_range
b80a75f0aac69cff.doc: Walks toward the target until it is within 280, sometimes standing to watch instead. Not called by this script.

b80b7d22839a3ae7.name: fly_toward_angle
b80b7d22839a3ae7.doc: Flies distance units along angle_deg (degrees) from the current position, held at ground height plus height (fly_to_point ignores the y it is given), and returns the fly_to_point result.

b82619ef5e60307c.name: block_attack
b82619ef5e60307c.doc: Plays the guard-in, guard and guard-out motions, with a longer hold after turning toward the player 35% of the time.

b8323dbddebfbccc.name: setup_moon_actor
b8323dbddebfbccc.doc: Makes the moon an object with no collision or lock-on, no clipping distance limit and velocity control, and attaches it to the map part p06_d06b03-0.

b845438e83c95ed1.name: swoop_at_target
b845438e83c95ed1.doc: Turns to the target and plays attack 1 while flying at 10.5 units per frame toward the player's x and z, 2 units above the ground under the monster, stopping about 20 units short or after 27 frames; then finishes the motion and stands 9 frames.

b845b6bec0c85d73.name: on_update
b845b6bec0c85d73.doc: Main loop: idles until the target is within 300, then fights, or uses the enraged routine once enraged.

b879f00c4fd5bc45.name: wait_until_facing_angle
b879f00c4fd5bc45.doc: Waits until the monster's yaw is within the larger of 3 degrees and the given tolerance of the angle (both in degrees), or max_frames pass, then stops turning. Returns the frames waited.

b8b6dca8910fd22e.name: walk_random_direction
b8b6dca8910fd22e.doc: Meant to turn up to angle_range degrees, but converts the range to radians and then the random turn to radians again, so it turns a whole number of degrees from 0 to about angle_range/57, always to the same side (under 57 it does not turn). If 100 units ahead are clear it walks base_dist + move_speed plus a random 0 to dist_range units; if less is clear but more than clearance it walks just the random amount; otherwise it returns -1 without moving. clearance is also the stop distance of the wait: returns 1 if the target comes within clearance, 2 when the walk ends, 0 after max_frames.

b8c9ed1623a5b2f0.name: choose_close_range_action
b8c9ed1623a5b2f0.doc: Close-range choice: half the time one of three attacks (lunge, attack 2, weak attack); otherwise a dodge, or three strafing steps beside the target.

b8d8a117e1987d97.name: run_behaviour_loop
b8d8a117e1987d97.doc: Allows guarding and dodging, then runs the behaviour chooser every frame forever.

b8f171105513cd87.name: walk_in_direction
b8f171105513cd87.doc: Turns to the world heading angle_deg at turn_speed_deg, then walks dist units along it at move_speed (at least move_speed + 1). A heading below the turn speed, including every negative heading, is first increased by the turn speed. Returns 1 if the target comes within stop_dist, 2 when the walk ends, 0 after max_frames.

b90d46c374ce73c2.name: chase_target_in_steps
b90d46c374ce73c2.doc: Faces the target, then each frame steps toward a point speed + stop_dist toward it. Returns -1 once closer than stop_dist, otherwise max_frames when time runs out.

b9136680608e4148.name: setup_water_splash
b9136680608e4148.doc: Loads the foot water splash effect and sets the clip distance to 120.

b917f00b45d1dffb.name: track_target_frames_updating
b917f00b45d1dffb.doc: Turns toward the target each frame for the given number of frames, then stops turning.

b95542add00e4f4f.name: fly_in_facing_direction
b95542add00e4f4f.doc: Turns to a heading in degrees and flies the given distance along it.

b97a64c4d8d35810.name: spit_poison_mist
b97a64c4d8d35810.doc: Plays attack 2, tracks the target, and spawns the poison mist effect from the dcol2 bone with the monster's attack value.

b97c03cb6570c338.name: turn_random_side
b97c03cb6570c338.doc: Turns by a random amount to a random side and waits. The loop returns on its first pass.

b9b2efc811e0047c.name: watch_player_if_disguised
b9b2efc811e0047c.doc: If the player is disguised, runs the facing loop for this monster kind.

b9b41695b0ea8921.name: attack_midrange_lunge
b9b41695b0ea8921.doc: Plays the mid-range attack and steps up to 60 units toward the target while turning.

b9bbcbd4471febda.name: counter_or_recoil_from_hit
b9bbcbd4471febda.doc: On a hit, 35 percent of the time turns toward the target and counters with attack 1, otherwise plays the damage reaction for 16 frames.

b9c09279bf00f257.name: spin_charge_forward
b9c09279bf00f257.doc: Plays the attack 2 wind-up, then spins toward a point 300 units ahead at 3.2 units per frame with the knockback spin effect for 45 frames, and plays the wind-down. The argument is ignored.

b9d2fa242647d897.name: fade_skin_color
b9d2fa242647d897.doc: Applies the skin color stored in monster vars 6 to 8 and fades it a step darker or brighter depending on the magma flag and the fade state in var 9.

b9d83514ccd6cfd0.name: get_up_after_throw
b9d83514ccd6cfd0.doc: Finishes the throw (10 frames), stops and ends the throw again, waits another 10 frames, plays the get-up motion to the end and returns 1.

b9d8a3c404d645a2.name: wait_move_or_target_near
b9d8a3c404d645a2.doc: Waits up to max_frames frames for the move_to walk to end or the target to come within near_dist, stopping the move either way. Returns 1 if the target got near, 2 if the walk ended, 0 on timeout.

ba0dc93428130ba1.name: lunge_repeatedly
ba0dc93428130ba1.doc: Repeats the forward lunge count times, facing the target before each, then stands.

ba10373c60d9dc09.name: stop_turning
ba10373c60d9dc09.doc: Stops any turn by turning to the current yaw at speed 0.

ba26c79208996c9a.name: strafe_or_watch_target
ba26c79208996c9a.doc: Half the time circles the player at about 110 units, otherwise stands watching the player.

ba32e87a8c8ed794.name: face_then_chase_target
ba32e87a8c8ed794.doc: Turns to face the target, then chases it until within stop_dist (returns -1) or max_frames pass (returns the frames used).

ba40b6e6274bbf64.name: fly_random_forward_updating
ba40b6e6274bbf64.doc: Turns to a random absolute yaw from 0 to max_turn_angle degrees (not relative to its facing), then flies min_distance plus up to max_extra_distance units forward at hover_height above the ground, updating the boss.

ba49de9f39ca05ed.name: attack_combo_early_second_swing
ba49de9f39ca05ed.doc: Attack 1 then attack 2 after 45 percent of the first motion.

ba53083e55c3e426.name: pick_mid_range_action
ba53083e55c3e426.doc: Turns to the target and chases it for up to 90 frames.

ba55d1fdbe4f1cbe.name: act_on_aggro_state
ba55d1fdbe4f1cbe.doc: Main decision per cycle. With rage hits left it fights in range, wanders otherwise, and follows the target when aggro is active. Without rage hits it runs the spent fight loop.

ba7e4d3e11d408db.name: turn_until_facing_angle
ba7e4d3e11d408db.doc: Waits, frame by frame, until the boss faces the angle within the tolerance, the turn direction flips, or the frame limit is reached. Returns the frames used.

baa42208ce15f5e2.name: wander_and_look_for_target
baa42208ce15f5e2.doc: Idle behaviour: turns away from a wall closer than 49, circles its home point when more than 250 from it, or randomly turns, circles the target, walks straight ahead or stands looking for the target. Sets monster var 0 to the chosen wander kind and returns 1 when it detects the target.

bacfdd8dd86a3a75.name: setup_butterfly
bacfdd8dd86a3a75.doc: Turns off map and body collision, makes the butterfly unlockable and undamageable until it flies to its start slot, sets a long clip distance, registers frame bcol00 as action object 0 and starts in state 1.

bae21383c32ef91a.name: turn_to_target_limit
bae21383c32ef91a.doc: Turns to face the target, waiting at most max_frames.

baec236e8c92a3e2.name: get_stunned_after_hit
baec236e8c92a3e2.doc: Halts and makes the monster damageable, plays the damage motion and waits 8 frames, then plays the faint motion until the stun stars run out and allows guarding and dodging again.

bafd7113508a09f3.name: watch_user_monster
bafd7113508a09f3.doc: If the player is disguised in the form this monster's kind recognises as its own (get_player_disguise is not -1), runs face_player_while_disguised until that ends; does nothing otherwise. The monster kind it passes is not used.

bb01635395aec5d2.name: fight_while_enraged
bb01635395aec5d2.doc: Combat loop for the enraged state (rage counter at zero or below); returns 0 as soon as the counter is above zero. When another monster is nearer the target it chases or stands for 30 frames. Otherwise it tests a target distance that is never set, so the 140 to 240 unit branch never runs and it always picks a sword combo, attack 2, the red wave swing or a chase. Nothing in this script calls it.

bb10df8e2ddcf81e.name: fade_out_light_on_death
bb10df8e2ddcf81e.doc: Sets state 128, ends the light effect and plays the death motion, then finishes the death and idles forever.

bb2d49816db3ebd3.name: melee_swing_attack
bb2d49816db3ebd3.doc: If above y -5, faces the target and plays attack 2, the knockback swing.

bb3a5399f6e63fa3.name: walk_random_direction
bb3a5399f6e63fa3.doc: Meant to turn up to angle_range degrees, but converts the range to radians and then the random turn to radians again, so it turns a whole number of degrees from 0 to about angle_range/57, always to the same side (under 57 it does not turn). If 100 units ahead are clear it walks base_dist + move_speed plus a random 0 to dist_range units; if less is clear but more than clearance it walks just the random amount; otherwise it returns -1 without moving. clearance is also the stop distance of the wait: returns 1 if the target comes within clearance, 2 when the walk ends, 0 after max_frames.

bb5fdaa4adb8a2b1.name: walk_to_point_with_slams
bb5fdaa4adb8a2b1.doc: Same as step_toward_point_or_slam, looped for up to max_frames. Returns 2 on arrival.

bb6cca2c87d434c3.name: stand_idle_frames
bb6cca2c87d434c3.doc: Stops moving, plays the stand motion and waits the given frames.

bb79d9f3bbd65f01.name: play_idle_loop
bb79d9f3bbd65f01.doc: Plays the idle play motion for the given number of 100-frame rounds. When watch_target is 1 it returns 1 as soon as the target comes into view.

bbac2ec2e3c7d161.name: sidestep_shot
bbac2ec2e3c7d161.doc: Faces the player and does the sideways dodge step.

bbadd12ec30778f4.name: move_toward_angle
bbadd12ec30778f4.doc: Walks distance units (at least move_speed plus 1) toward angle_deg at move_speed without turning, until the walk ends, the target comes within near_dist or max_frames pass, then stops moving.

bc09bd1c257fc2e3.name: on_init
bc09bd1c257fc2e3.doc: Registers two knockback attack hit windows for attack 2, loads the fire shot effects, sets up flight with a maximum height of 40 and lifts the monster 15 units.

bc3b2a67a7966ebe.name: on_update
bc3b2a67a7966ebe.doc: Stops moving, allows guard and dodge, then runs the AI step every frame.

bc425b6cdb2e720b.name: get_abs_float
bc425b6cdb2e720b.doc: Returns the absolute value of value.

bc63fe345f257bc2.name: spin_to_face_target
bc63fe345f257bc2.doc: Plays the left or right spin motion, whichever is shorter, until facing the target.

bc6f7e720e19b240.name: sidestep_around_target
bc6f7e720e19b240.doc: Invulnerable step to the left or right to a point on a circle around the target, playing the matching step motion.

bc720f4db143ca50.name: turn_random_angle_from_facing
bc720f4db143ca50.doc: Turns to a random yaw left or right of the current facing (30 plus base plus up to range degrees), using base as the turn speed too, and returns the frames waited. The loop over count never repeats because it returns after the first turn.

bc8bfeae8f011640.name: walk_toward_target
bc8bfeae8f011640.doc: Walks toward the target for up to 240 frames, then stands.

bccac9850267dc57.name: chase_distant_target
bccac9850267dc57.doc: Loop that walks, runs or scans left and right toward a target farther than 310 units, and returns once it is within 310.

bcd0dc3639088008.name: wait_n_frames
bcd0dc3639088008.doc: Waits for the given number of frames.

bce51e1644864a45.name: rush_at_target_then_fire
bce51e1644864a45.doc: Turns to the target, runs at it for up to 60 frames, then 40 percent of the time shoots a fire shot.

bcf466d23a05b5f3.name: wait_until_facing_angle_or_target_in_view
bcf466d23a05b5f3.doc: Waits for the monster to face the given angle but returns -1 as soon as the target comes into view. Otherwise returns the frames waited.

bd084d5bdf8ce4a6.name: run_combat_loop
bd084d5bdf8ce4a6.doc: If not yet enraged, loops: approaches and fights when the target is within 200 units or the monster is aggroed, otherwise idles. Once enraged it only runs the enraged fight.

bd53ecc4274bbc00.name: turn_to_target_limit
bd53ecc4274bbc00.doc: Turns toward the target for at most max_frames and returns the frames spent.

bd7557d1d1cd9a1e.name: fight_while_enraged
bd7557d1d1cd9a1e.doc: Loop that returns when the target is beyond 270 units. Close up it chases and uses attack 1, attack 2 or the combo; farther away it runs at the target.

bd8e16bb2bc267b6.name: move_in_direction
bd8e16bb2bc267b6.doc: Moves dist units along a heading without turning the model first, and waits for the move to end.

bda5cfb7a3105916.name: compute_phase_duration_and_wait
bda5cfb7a3105916.doc: Runs the unused phase duration calculation, then the full per-frame boss update, and waits one frame.

bdca47a40fc297aa.name: fly_to_point
bdca47a40fc297aa.doc: Flies in a straight line toward x, z at speed units per frame, aiming at height units above the ground under the monster at the start (y is ignored). Vertical motion stops for good once the monster would be 60 or more units above the ground, or at ground level. Each frame goes through wait_frame_checking_phase. Returns 1 within speed plus near_dist of the point, the check_flight_step result (-1 wall ahead, -2 too high or no ground) if a step is blocked, or 0 after max_frames.

be068325cb7ff62c.name: turn_toward_target_until_motion_progress
be068325cb7ff62c.doc: Keeps turning toward the target until the motion progress is near the target value.

be280cf0c2baeb60.name: decide_behavior
be280cf0c2baeb60.doc: One AI step. While the rage counter is above zero it wanders or fights by distance, otherwise it uses the enraged fight loop with raised defense.

be288c7e3e8736e6.name: wander_when_target_far
be288c7e3e8736e6.doc: Idle behaviour while the target is not close: turns away from walls, wanders around its home point, circles the target, waits to notice the target, or walks off in a random direction. Returns 1 when the target is detected.

be319986c9b84595.name: fight_at_close_range
be319986c9b84595.doc: Close range choice: pounces if within 60 units, otherwise dashes, or walks sideways or backward.

be41788c6b55e0d2.name: wait_until_target_near
be41788c6b55e0d2.doc: Waits until the target is within 2400 units or the timeout in frames runs out.

be5516885fa48389.name: read_last_hit_and_damage
be5516885fa48389.doc: Reads variables 5 and 6 into the two output arrays.

be55ff41ec9a5005.name: turn_by_angle
be55ff41ec9a5005.doc: Turns by delta_deg relative to the current heading and waits until done.

be72b973c3cf5b81.name: fly_to_target_at_height
be72b973c3cf5b81.doc: Meant to turn toward the target and fly, slowing near the end, to the target's x and z at height_offset above the ground. The turn, position, target and height reads are old-numbered (the target read runs as set_home_pos and overwrites the home position) and fly_to_point_decelerating does not move the monster, so it neither turns nor flies.

be7e2f8b3edeaf07.name: chase_target_until_close
be7e2f8b3edeaf07.doc: Each frame turns toward the target and moves to its position until within stop_dist (returns -1) or max_frames pass (returns the frames used).

be86f878816bd85c.name: track_target_frames
be86f878816bd85c.doc: Turns toward the target every frame for the given number of frames, then stops turning. Despite the parameter name, turn_speed_deg goes to the turn unconverted, so it is in radians per frame; the values callers give, such as 4.2, make the monster face the target almost at once.

be8bc2ec784dbb93.name: die_and_drop_loot
be8bc2ec784dbb93.doc: Stops moving, starts the death drops, plays the death motion to its end, finishes the death and then waits forever.

bec04af2aabac7a7.name: setup_mammo_attacks
bec04af2aabac7a7.doc: Init program: registers the two claw swipe hit windows on attack 1, loads the Vanguard shockwave effect if a texture block is free, clears monster var 1, starts the AI and extends the clip distance.

bec924ae28788940.name: fly_back_from_target
bec924ae28788940.doc: Turns damage off, plays the step back motion and after 3 frames flies toward a point 30 to 40 units farther from the target than now, 25 units above the ground, at the given speed for at most 8 frames (about 24 units at the 3.0 its caller passes); then turns damage back on and waits for the motion to end.

bed30abb8bd519fe.name: choose_mid_range_action
bed30abb8bd519fe.doc: Mid-range choice at 120 to 170 units, before rage: lunge or self-destruct, run at the target, chase, or circle it.

bed6a6dc27423596.name: step_back_and_shoot
bed6a6dc27423596.doc: Becomes invulnerable and steps back about 30 units behind the target distance, then stands and shoots a bullet.

bee3eccb17884ff2.name: classify_target_situation
bee3eccb17884ff2.doc: Returns a bit mask describing the target: 4 or 8 for within or outside its facing arc, 1 or 2 for within or beyond 240 units, and 16 when it is close (under 50) and almost straight ahead.

beeedef3cd726d38.name: fly_wander_random
beeedef3cd726d38.doc: Turns by a random angle and flies a random distance ahead.

bf0a2ea46b892f0e.name: set_flying_attribs
bf0a2ea46b892f0e.doc: Turns scripted movement on or off, the attribute bits that let a script move the monster freely.

bf1671bc16e7de12.name: walk_toward_target
bf1671bc16e7de12.doc: Walks or spins toward the target a few units per frame until within 80 units, or until a random 40 to 99 frames have passed with the target behind it; then clears the stored AI choices (reset_ai_values) and stops. Returns 0.

bf3f8c370dc502f4.name: wait_until_facing_angle_or_target_seen
bf3f8c370dc502f4.doc: Like wait_until_facing_angle but returns -1 as soon as the target is inside the view cone.

bf448227eeaaf938.name: fight_while_enraged
bf448227eeaaf938.doc: Fight loop once the monster is enraged (no hits left to enrage it): attack 1 inside 90 units, otherwise mostly attack 2, walking to the target or strafing.

bf4ca0adc692c922.name: run_ai_loop
bf4ca0adc692c922.doc: Main loop: runs one AI step every frame.

bf5e8b28f96cc365.name: fight_target_normally
bf5e8b28f96cc365.doc: Combat loop before the monster is enraged: picks the close, mid or far routine by distance and returns when the target is far or the monster becomes enraged.

bf76b81ecbfd0062.name: walk_to_random_arena_point
bf76b81ecbfd0062.doc: Picks a random angle and walks to the point 300 units from the arena center, then turns to face the player.

bf7e6068b41c5259.name: strafe_or_wait_until_target_near
bf7e6068b41c5259.doc: Until the target comes within 300 units, sidesteps 30 degrees around it, turns to face it or stands waiting for it to come into view. Never moves toward the target and is not called in this script.

bf8e62d1e3dc10f6.name: run_combat_loop
bf8e62d1e3dc10f6.doc: Allows guard and dodge, then repeats the combat decision step every frame.

bf9d323279416aed.name: watch_disguised_player
bf9d323279416aed.doc: While the player is disguised, the monster stands and only turns toward the target (at 3.5 speed, walking) when it is more than 60 degrees to either side of its facing. Ends when the disguise is gone. The argument is not used.

bfab4643dceb23ce.name: face_target_for_frames
bfab4643dceb23ce.doc: Keeps turning toward the target at the given speed in degrees for the given number of frames, then stops turning.

bfb7e3f715435399.name: on_update
bfb7e3f715435399.doc: Main loop: runs the distance-based attack choice while the AI mode is 2 and idles otherwise.

bfba9827cecb09b1.name: fight_by_distance
bfba9827cecb09b1.doc: Loop that picks the long, medium or close range behavior by target distance, and wanders or watches when the priority is above 1.

bfdc9c049f932c32.name: watch_player_if_disguised
bfdc9c049f932c32.doc: If the player is disguised as a monster, waits and watches until the disguise ends.

bfe4ee91c45ab153.name: act_at_close_range
bfe4ee91c45ab153.doc: Close-range behaviour: backs away if too near, otherwise swoops, circles, steps sideways or flies backward.

bffddb7ed0c5d60b.name: engage_target_with_chase_or_ice_shot
bffddb7ed0c5d60b.doc: Loops while the target is within 300 units: gives way to others of higher priority, flies in and swoops (90 percent) or shoots (10 percent) under 120 units, otherwise mostly shoots. Returns 0 when the target leaves. Not called in this script.

c007405f8dbef079.name: walk_forward_by_target_distance
c007405f8dbef079.doc: Faces the target, then walks straight ahead as far as the target is away. Returns -1 without moving if a wall is closer than speed + arrive_dist ahead, otherwise the result of waiting for the move (1 near the target, 2 arrived, 0 timeout).

c02a96b410dd596d.name: fly_and_get_up_when_stunned
c02a96b410dd596d.doc: Plays the knocked-flying and get-up motions with interrupts locked, then runs the shared stun-then-unlock routine.

c054e4799269d421.name: step_back_from_target
c054e4799269d421.doc: Invulnerable backward step to extra_dist more than the target's current distance. Afterwards may play idle, charge, or just stand.

c06e319cd252671d.name: watch_target_while_disguised
c06e319cd252671d.doc: Stands and turns to keep facing the target (within 90 degrees) for as long as the player is disguised as a monster.

c0733cb8dcce6968.name: step_back_invulnerable
c0733cb8dcce6968.doc: Becomes immune to damage, plays the step-back motion and heads for a point 100 units behind at 3.2 per frame, but stops moving after about 5 frames (roughly 16 units); stays immune until the motion ends, then stands.

c07c0cc8f1071db4.name: dodge_step_back
c07c0cc8f1071db4.doc: Faces the player, turns invulnerable and plays the walk-back motion, then after 8 frames moves toward a point 40 to 50 units further from the player than now at speed for only 8 frames (about 24 units at speed 3), then stops and stands.

c095b0038f58af1c.name: get_slot_position
c095b0038f58af1c.doc: Computes the world position of a formation slot: eight points on a circle of radius 625 around the arena centre at height 812.5.

c09f6fc16b5ac9ba.name: step_sideways_in_place
c09f6fc16b5ac9ba.doc: Plays a random left or right step motion without moving, invulnerable from frame 5 to 20 of it, then stands.

c0bcb5c753e188bb.name: track_monster_frames
c0bcb5c753e188bb.doc: Keeps turning toward another monster for the given number of frames, then stops turning.

c0c266f83e83c814.name: idle_until_target_approaches
c0c266f83e83c814.doc: Idles until the target comes within 220 units, then turns to face it and sets monster var 0 to 1. Also ends when the monster becomes aggroed.

c0c4193d5e41ee9d.name: back_away_and_cast
c0c4193d5e41ee9d.doc: If the target is within 180 units, steps back 80 units and casts magic. If it is farther and not within 90 degrees ahead, runs at it and attacks instead and returns 0; otherwise casts from where it stands.

c0c9885328db4967.name: explode_pirate_bomb
c0c9885328db4967.doc: Ends any throw, kills the bomb quietly and spawns the pirate bomb explosion with the monster's attack power at its position (or on the target if it is at the origin).

c0c9e75fadf89408.name: shoot_arrow_while_circling
c0c9e75fadf89408.doc: Draws a DE arrow at full attack power (the 0.4x value it computes is overwritten) and flies 45 degrees around the arena centre at its current radius, releasing the arrow on frame 31.

c0e3c75aecd241b3.name: act_at_mid_range
c0e3c75aecd241b3.doc: Calm mid-range choice: stand and watch, turn to face the player, walk up to the player (faster when life is low) or strafe around it.

c0f4d7bc12958bf3.name: wait_motion_end
c0f4d7bc12958bf3.doc: Waits frame by frame until the motion-end reading is non-zero, then returns 1.

c10cbb6de1c6deab.name: dodge_shot_by_sidestepping
c10cbb6de1c6deab.doc: Steps sideways to dodge a shot.

c10d2a9abaeefadf.name: track_target_until_time
c10d2a9abaeefadf.doc: Keeps turning toward the target until the motion reaches the given time. A tolerance of -1 means 0.05.

c12b45ffdf9b803a.name: wait_turn_watch_target
c12b45ffdf9b803a.doc: Waits for a turn already started toward angle_deg until facing it within the turn speed or max_frames pass, running the aggro update each frame. Returns -1 at once if the target comes into view, otherwise the frames spent.

c13da9dbbd2e1963.name: walk_toward_target_if_clear
c13da9dbbd2e1963.doc: Turns to face the target, then walks 100 units straight ahead when nothing blocks the next 100 units; returns -1 at once when a wall is closer (and stop_dist is above 0). Otherwise returns the wait_move_until_near result: 1 when the target is within stop_dist, 2 when the walk ended, 0 after max_frames.

c1700458656aa0cb.name: wait_move_end_update
c1700458656aa0cb.doc: Waits until the current move ends or max_frames passes, checking the low life event each frame.

c1918775978b52df.name: act_at_medium_range
c1918775978b52df.doc: Medium range choice: approach and attack, vanish, walk up, or circle the target.

c197ae637d6a1574.name: wait_move_until_near
c197ae637d6a1574.doc: Waits while moving. Returns 1 once within stop_dist of the target, 2 when the move reaches its point, 0 on timeout.

c1a22defdfd64c23.name: release_pollen_when_ready
c1a22defdfd64c23.doc: If the shared pistil stage in monster var 17 is 7, creates the rafflesia pollen effect and, when monster var 8 is 0 (the Rainbow Butterfly is whole), sets var 8 to 16 to make the butterfly boss split. Returns 0.

c1add27ac03c28b2.name: is_facing_target_deg
c1add27ac03c28b2.doc: Degree version of is_facing_target_rad: returns 1 when the monster's yaw is within arc_deg total of the target's direction turned by offset_deg.

c1bc9ea3feb3a596.name: roll_at_target
c1bc9ea3feb3a596.doc: Plays attack 2 in, then rolls toward the target and ends with attack 2 out. Both parameters are unused.

c1c0c873e7ccd93a.name: on_dodge_melee
c1c0c873e7ccd93a.doc: Dodges a melee attack by teleporting behind the target and dashing at it with a tornado, or by stepping back if near the arena edge and low.

c1c3196e65e1a9dd.name: step_back_dodge
c1c3196e65e1a9dd.doc: Turns to the target and steps back to a point 40 to 50 units farther from it than now, invulnerable for about 9 frames of the step.

c1d336620806b1b4.name: swing_in_place
c1d336620806b1b4.doc: Turns to the target and plays attack 2 while tracking it, then stands.

c1fdc88a2b818073.name: move_around_target_to_angle
c1fdc88a2b818073.doc: Unused. Walks without turning toward the point angle_deg around the target at the current target distance (0 is the side facing this monster). The wall check probes straight ahead along its facing, not toward the point: if less than 100 units ahead are clear the move is cut to that length along the direction to the point, and -1 is returned without moving when that leaves less than twice stop_dist. Otherwise returns the wait result: 1 if the target comes within stop_dist, 2 when the move ends, 0 after max_frames.

c213199d517588ae.name: stand_idle_frames_updating
c213199d517588ae.doc: Stops moving, plays the stand motion and updates the boss for the given frames.

c21bb036ccb7c044.name: attack_at_far_range
c21bb036ccb7c044.doc: Far range choice (300 units or more): beyond 650 units it first lunges; then 85 percent of the time it does the arm swing, otherwise chases for up to 90 frames.

c21c0ade60d8da23.name: on_update
c21c0ade60d8da23.doc: Main loop: runs one AI decision every frame.

c2395574bf28c678.name: fly_backward
c2395574bf28c678.doc: Flies backward away from the monster's facing direction using the given speed and hover height.

c245c2b5d29a1e0e.name: curve_toward_point
c245c2b5d29a1e0e.doc: Flies the boss toward a point on a curved path that starts rotated by curve_angle and bends toward the point by homing_weight, optionally re-tracking the target position each frame. Used for the drill charge. Returns the frames flown, or 0 if the path becomes invalid.

c26659eb8d5fe144.name: move_toward_angle_and_distance
c26659eb8d5fe144.doc: Turns to an angle, then moves the given distance in that direction. Returns the wait result.

c2813b9b09d03f8c.name: get_knocked_down_and_rise
c2813b9b09d03f8c.doc: Plays the knocked-flying motion with knockback, lies down 45 frames and gets up.

c2c5a7098366851e.name: run_at_target
c2c5a7098366851e.doc: Runs at the target for up to 180 frames, then stands.

c2ff2aa3f3726e04.name: on_damage
c2ff2aa3f3726e04.doc: Plays the damage knockback and counts the hit in variable 4.

c32c43acec1a46b8.name: fight_at_mid_range
c32c43acec1a46b8.doc: Mid range choice: throw bombs, step back several times, or dash past the target and faint for 90 frames.

c330f4950662a6d6.name: turn_to_face_target
c330f4950662a6d6.doc: Turns toward the target and waits for the turn to finish. Returns the frames waited.

c351a1cb304ab584.name: act_at_close_range
c351a1cb304ab584.doc: Close range choice: approach and swing or shoot, step back or sidestep and swing, or run around the target.

c36132505f2458e8.name: turn_then_chase_target
c36132505f2458e8.doc: Meant to turn toward the target and walk at it each frame, returning -1 once closer than stop_dist or the frames spent after max_frames. In this toolkit's old numbering the distance read, target read, move and stops run get_kind_pos, set_home_pos, get_distance_to and get_home_pos, the rotation read has no native, and this toolkit's turn helpers do not turn either, so the monster neither turns nor moves, its home position is overwritten each frame, and the -1 exit tests a distance that is never read.

c36efd245bcc1e2b.name: run_at_target
c36efd245bcc1e2b.doc: Runs at the target for up to 120 frames.

c370f31cd352e84c.name: walk_to_random_corner
c370f31cd352e84c.doc: Sets variable 0 to 64 and walks to one of three fixed spots for up to 600 frames, then faces the target.

c3be0cef678c0033.name: wander_or_wait_for_target
c3be0cef678c0033.doc: Idle AI turn: steers away from walls, drifts back toward home when far from it, otherwise waits for the target, circles it, wanders or turns at random. Returns 1 when the target is detected while waiting.

c3cdcfbd91063065.name: wait_move_end_updating
c3cdcfbd91063065.doc: Waits up to max_frames for the current move to finish, running the life bookkeeping each frame. Returns 0 when the move ends.

c3dfb673791de3cf.name: turn_to_random_side_of_current_heading
c3dfb673791de3cf.doc: Picks a random yaw to the left or right of the current heading and turns to it. Returns after the first turn, so the stand-and-wait code after it never runs.

c3e8d56b45b16837.name: on_lifted
c3e8d56b45b16837.doc: Struggles while the player holds it up.

c3f26ca5a8b30ecc.name: recover_from_throw_and_reset
c3f26ca5a8b30ecc.doc: Recovers from being thrown, waits 10 frames and clears the motion.

c3f46849e4299fdf.name: setup_monster_attacks
