c3f46849e4299fdf.doc: Registers two attack hits (weak guard-crush on attack 1, weak knockback on attack 2), clears monster variable 0 and sets the default AI values with init_monster_ai.

c40bf746bde3034c.name: run_flying_combat_loop
c40bf746bde3034c.doc: Loops forever: while rage hits remain it fights by range within 240 units horizontally or chooses a flying action, otherwise it runs the shooting loop.

c423f84372948781.name: recoil_from_knockdown
c423f84372948781.doc: Locks and faces the target, plays the damage knockback and recovers.

c458eff939e48896.name: turn_toward_target_with_jitter
c458eff939e48896.doc: Turns toward the target direction, with the given percent chance of adding or subtracting a jitter angle, and waits for the turn.

c46266ebe0ad4c39.name: fly_to_height
c46266ebe0ad4c39.doc: Flies straight up or down toward the given height. Returns 1 on arrival or the flight-blocked code.

c4a07d70da97cd19.name: turn_by_angle
c4a07d70da97cd19.doc: Turns relative to the current heading by delta_deg and waits until done.

c4a6b8f2f366173b.name: walk_toward_target_until_close
c4a6b8f2f366173b.doc: Walks toward the target at speed 1.75 for up to 240 frames, then stands.

c4ae567bd12e3e0f.name: glide_to_point_in_frames
c4ae567bd12e3e0f.doc: Moves the monster in a straight line to the point so that it arrives after the given number of frames.

c4b13ad6993c48b3.name: idle_forever
c4b13ad6993c48b3.doc: Runs the shared per-frame idle step (aggro update and AI tick) in an endless loop.

c512c8fecc95ff31.name: walk_straight_at_angle
c512c8fecc95ff31.doc: Walks the given distance along a heading and waits.

c516a64bc2ad7c8c.name: on_dodge_melee
c516a64bc2ad7c8c.doc: Dodging a melee hit: faces the target and sidesteps around it with invulnerability.

c51f8ff03bad9824.name: recover_from_throw_and_reset
c51f8ff03bad9824.doc: Recovers from being thrown, waits 10 frames and resets the motion.

c53efe82e66d1a70.name: read_monster_var_16
c53efe82e66d1a70.doc: Reads monster variable 16 into the first element of the array.

c53f5814f6c0d7e9.name: get_up_after_landing
c53f5814f6c0d7e9.doc: After being thrown, plays the get-up motion. Returns 1.

c54af9f8f9502d77.name: turn_random_side
c54af9f8f9502d77.doc: Meant to turn left or right at random by up to angle_range degrees plus the turn speed plus 30, but get_random_float and get_random_int are handed angle and roll by value instead of by address, so neither is set and the turn uses whatever those locals hold. Waits for the turn and returns the frames used; the loop returns on its first pass, so tries does not matter.

c54eb98258006494.name: run_ai_step
c54eb98258006494.doc: One AI decision: fights normally when not enraged, using the aggro range to switch between idle wandering, chasing and fighting; uses the enraged routine otherwise.

c54ed54215cdeb7a.name: fly_toward_angle
c54ed54215cdeb7a.doc: Flies dist units along an absolute angle without turning first.

c54fbdb29088a620.name: face_target_now
c54fbdb29088a620.doc: Meant to turn the monster to face the target at once, but it is written in an old call numbering: the first call reads the monster's position and the second has no native at its number, so the monster does not turn at all.

c5564712bd8b7798.name: idle_around_target
c5564712bd8b7798.doc: Low priority behaviour: circles the target, stands and waits, or plays the idle motion.

c56377f1ecd6b558.name: play_light_fade_death
c56377f1ecd6b558.doc: Sets state var 27 to 128, ends the Atlamillia light effect and plays the death motions, then halts.

c57b5a858b5733dc.name: fight_target_enraged
c57b5a858b5733dc.doc: Fight loop once the rage hits are used up: charges, sword combos, sidesteps and step backs by distance, until the rage state ends.

c58339af9c56a776.name: heal_weakest_monster
c58339af9c56a776.doc: Once monster var 7 has reached 300, picks the monster within 200 units with the lowest life ratio, or itself if its own is lower, and if that ratio is at most 0.9 plays the recover motion and heals it for 24 to 30 percent of its max life with a green damage number, then resets var 7. Returns 0 when var 7 is still under 300 or the patient's life reaches 0 during the heal, and -1 when nobody needs healing.

c587cb877c1fd429.name: halt_and_forbid_guard_and_dodge
c587cb877c1fd429.doc: Forbids guard and dodge, resets the motion and stops turning and moving.

c5894ee8de796594.name: wait_motion_watch_target
c5894ee8de796594.doc: Waits for the motion to end and returns 1 early if the target comes into view, 0 if the motion ended first.

c5c3926c3d6e6abe.name: dodge_melee_attack
c5c3926c3d6e6abe.doc: Dodges an incoming melee attack by turning to the target and dashing sideways, then allows guard and dodge again. The step-back branch never runs because the roll (0 to 19) is always under 20.

c5d09f61be800317.name: dash_sideways_invulnerable
c5d09f61be800317.doc: Steps left or right at random and dashes 100 units sideways, taking no damage between 28% and 68% of the motion.

c5de20731872204b.name: sidestep_invulnerable
c5de20731872204b.doc: Steps left or right at random to a point around the target while taking no damage, ending with the damage immunity switched off.

c5efcca70fd8e6d3.name: walk_around_point
c5efcca70fd8e6d3.doc: Walks to a point on a circle around a fixed point such as the arena centre.

c615a2d2967fbca9.name: pick_near_range_action
c615a2d2967fbca9.doc: Chooses one action for a close target: walk up and swing or use attack 2, dodge by stepping, or circle the target.

c622f81d1d7a8d8f.name: run_flying_caster_ai
c622f81d1d7a8d8f.doc: Main loop. While rage hits remain and it is not aggroed: when the target is within 290 (flat) it fights by distance, first flying at the target and playing the transform motion if monster var 7 is 2 (then setting it to 1); otherwise it wanders, beforehand setting var 7 to 2 and playing the front-facing stand motion when its last read of var 7 was not 2, and afterwards setting var 7 to 1. Because a finished wander leaves var 7 at 1, the transform plays only when the target comes near before a wander has finished. When aggroed it fights within 160 or runs at the target inside the aggro range, judged by the flat distance read on the last unaggroed frame. With no rage hits left (enraged, or a boss) it uses attack_while_enraged.

c6287ff642144647.name: on_knockdown
c6287ff642144647.doc: Ends flight, plays knocked flying, stays down 30 frames, gets up and resumes flight.

c63e54b35f08c9ce.name: setup_flame_shot_attack
c63e54b35f08c9ce.doc: Registers the normal attack hit for attack 1, loads the flame shot effects and starts the AI.

c640a3706dacde44.name: fly_toward_target
c640a3706dacde44.doc: Turns to the target, then flies toward it frame by frame. Returns 1 when close enough, a hit code when blocked, 0 on timeout.

c647e2154c732970.name: attack_at_close_range
c647e2154c732970.doc: Close-range choice: mostly walks up and uses a slash or combo, sometimes steps back or dashes sideways, or circles the target before an attack 1.

c64d773613d14749.name: turn_toward_monster_for_frames
c64d773613d14749.doc: Keeps turning toward another monster for a set number of frames.

c658825b3d160096.name: struggle_while_lifted
c658825b3d160096.doc: Lifted program: plays the struggling motion and waits forever while the player holds the monster.

c6799a19e8029d63.name: recover_after_throw
c6799a19e8029d63.doc: Finishes being thrown and plays the get up motion.

c67d8884b1e44a65.name: choose_idle_wander_action
c67d8884b1e44a65.doc: Leftover walking idle behaviour from the generic monster template: turns away from walls, wanders back toward home, or strafes around the target in the stance-walk motion. Returns 1 if the target is detected, and is not called by this boss.

c6a049755a8edb03.name: bite_at_target
c6a049755a8edb03.doc: Plays attack 1 if the target is very close, otherwise attack 2, then stands for 15 frames.

c6b0e0dff313c90f.name: turn_and_walk_forward
c6b0e0dff313c90f.doc: Turns to an angle, then walks the given distance along it. Returns the move wait result.

c6cbbf43467dc384.name: wait_turn_to_angle
c6cbbf43467dc384.doc: Waits until the monster faces angle_deg (tolerance at least 3 degrees), then stops turning. Gives up after max_frames and returns the frames waited.

c6df3c4cc5af4fb3.name: choose_idle_movement
c6df3c4cc5af4fb3.doc: Idle AI step for a flyer: picks a random behaviour (fly away from a close wall, circle the home point, hover and watch, turn in place, circle the target, fly straight ahead) and records it in slot 0 of the second variable set (4 circling, 8 watching, 16 turning, 32 straight). Returns 1 when one of the two rarer watch branches detects the target and 0 after the far-from-home branch; other paths end without a return value. A seventh branch (random flight, recording 1 in monster var 0) tests a variable that is never set.

c6e4b7e16d5a1740.name: rise_and_droop_on_hit
c6e4b7e16d5a1740.doc: Rises up and droops again when hit, with sound effects 3 and 4.

c6eb80376398fdab.name: play_ship_attack_round
c6eb80376398fdab.doc: One attack round: flies to the point 1000 units out past the target, sets monster var 8 to 1 while turning to the orbit angle and holding 240 frames, then twice flies to a random one of four points 600 units around the origin (heights 150 to 300), turning toward the next of the four points as it goes.

c70150c6f3a5982a.name: choose_idle_movement
c70150c6f3a5982a.doc: Picks the next idle move at random: turn away when there is no room ahead, return toward home when far from it, circle the target, or move toward it. Sets monster variable 0 to the move chosen. Returns 1 when it detects the target.

c71dd68e905315c4.name: fly_to_point_around_target
c71dd68e905315c4.doc: Picks a point around the target, turns to face it and flies there. Returns the result of the flight.

c720c61c34706eda.name: chase_target_inside_arena
c720c61c34706eda.doc: Chases the target. Returns -1 if the target is within stop_dist or is more than 380 units from the arena center.

c725d55c838c98d4.name: wait_motion_end_update
c725d55c838c98d4.doc: Runs update_and_wait until the current motion ends. Returns 1.

c73a19bea896583a.name: wait_for_target_near
c73a19bea896583a.doc: Waits up to the given frames and returns 1 as soon as the player is within the distance.

c75e904bfd4bc16f.name: wait_motion_end_updating
c75e904bfd4bc16f.doc: Waits frame by frame, updating aggro, until the current motion ends. Returns 1.

c77016596c8c378c.name: move_random_offset
c77016596c8c378c.doc: Moves to a point a random distance and angle ahead of the monster, and waits until it is within stop_dist or max_frames pass. Returns the wait result.

c7810a6c8619d987.name: move_beside_target
c7810a6c8619d987.doc: Moves to a point beside the target at angle_deg around it, stopping short if a wall is ahead. Returns -1 if blocked.

c7910442afd71c69.name: wait_for_target_in_view
c7910442afd71c69.doc: Runs frames until the target is within view distance and angle. Returns 1 if seen, 0 on timeout.

c79a704ece8590f8.name: chase_and_slash
c79a704ece8590f8.doc: Walks toward the target, turns to face it and plays attack 1, tracking the target for the first frames of the swing.

c7a24e76c3afdd25.name: walk_to_target
c7a24e76c3afdd25.doc: Turns to face the target, then walks straight along that heading as far as the target's distance. Returns -1 without moving when the clear distance ahead is under move_speed plus stop_dist, otherwise 1 if the target comes within stop_dist, 2 if the walk ends, 0 on timeout.

c7ab45fd24d22bf2.name: arc_toward_target_then_fuse
c7ab45fd24d22bf2.doc: Lobs the bomb toward the target on a decaying arc until it drops below the target's height or its speed runs out after about 63 frames (when it starts within 30 units horizontally of the target it drops 15 units and arcs straight up instead). Then runs the 195-frame fuse, pulsing in size and colour in the last 30 frames, and self-destructs; coming within 50 units of the target during the arc detonates it at once.

c7dcf6c310089653.name: fight_at_long_range
c7dcf6c310089653.doc: Long range choice: run toward the target, walk toward it, or stand watching it.

c7fc03f483dba220.name: fly_around_point
c7fc03f483dba220.doc: Turns and flies to the point distance units from x, y, z on the monster's own side of it, swung angle degrees around it, at hover_height above the ground.

c806437ad39d102f.name: can_detect_target
c806437ad39d102f.doc: Returns 1 when the target is closer than view_dist and the monster's yaw is within half_angle_deg of the direction to the target, or when the target is closer than hear_dist and moving faster than min_speed; else 0. The cone test does not wrap angles, so it can miss a target whose direction lies across the 180 degree seam from the monster's yaw.

c82377e7fa00dab6.name: wander_around_home
c82377e7fa00dab6.doc: Idle behaviour. Turns away from a wall closer than 79, circles its home point when more than 300 from it, otherwise stands watching for a target, turns, circles the target or walks straight ahead. Returns 1 when it detects a target.

c830d9e1f477b9c2.name: run_at_target_and_attack
c830d9e1f477b9c2.doc: Runs at the target if farther than 80 units, then uses the double or mid-range attack with a 4% chance, otherwise a moonsault.

c832c7162ddc9608.name: fly_toward_heading
c832c7162ddc9608.doc: Flies a distance along an absolute heading without turning first.

c8578bed30f81ee9.name: reposition_around_target
c8578bed30f81ee9.doc: Circles the target at about 120 units, waits for it to come into view, or plays its idle motion. Used when another monster has attack priority.

c86bbab59ef5eef5.name: fight_at_long_range
c86bbab59ef5eef5.doc: Long range choice: mostly turns randomly looking for the target or shoots feathers, otherwise walks closer or waits.

c8a4a5d235d4ee30.name: leave_magma
c8a4a5d235d4ee30.doc: If in magma, climbs out toward the player or to a point 250 units from the arena center, and resets the magma flag. Returns 0 if it climbed out, 1 if it was not in magma.

c8c2b879fb6610d5.name: chase_target_clear
c8c2b879fb6610d5.doc: Turns to face the target, then chases it each frame for up to max_frames, probing 25 units above the ground for walls move_speed + stop_dist ahead. Returns -1 when within stop_dist, -2 when the probe hits a wall, otherwise the frames used.

c8c99404b1995dc6.name: watch_player_if_disguised
c8c99404b1995dc6.doc: If the player is currently disguised, hands over to the watch routine, otherwise does nothing.

c8dbb0223c3ed323.name: watch_target_if_disguised
c8dbb0223c3ed323.doc: If the player is transformed into a monster, stands watching them until the transformation ends.

c8e33690bde068b1.name: freeze_and_face_target
c8e33690bde068b1.doc: Forbids guard and dodge, stops everything, snaps to face the target and sets act status 1.

c8ee88a41faa2f9e.name: reset_player_camera
c8ee88a41faa2f9e.doc: Returns the camera to following the player and clears any camera limits.

c8f1bf37c933f016.name: turn_by_angle
c8f1bf37c933f016.doc: Turns by delta_deg relative to the current heading at turn_speed_deg and returns the frames spent. When the new heading passes 180 degrees either way the wrap is faulty and the monster turns to a small wrong angle instead.

c8f2c7ad1102b1dc.name: fly_to_height_updating
c8f2c7ad1102b1dc.doc: Moves straight up speed units per frame (down only when target_y is negative, since only its sign sets the direction) until within speed plus stop_margin of height target_y, updating the boss each frame; vertical movement stops for good 200 units above the ground or at ground level. Returns 1 on arrival, the check_flight_step result if blocked, or 0 after max_frames.

c8f35923fb4e2a5b.name: recover_from_throw_and_resume_flying
c8f35923fb4e2a5b.doc: Recovers from being thrown, waits 10 frames, turns scripted movement back on and resets the motion.

c921a98319de1d17.name: dodge_shot_by_side_step
c921a98319de1d17.doc: Faces the target, steps sideways, then restores guard and dodge.

c93655011b20ad73.name: fight_at_long_range
c93655011b20ad73.doc: Long-range choice (200 to 300 units): chase, run when under half life, orbit the target, taunt, or fire a shot.

c9478fb1d1c0c72b.name: on_damage
c9478fb1d1c0c72b.doc: Stops moving and plays the damage motion with a small knockback, then waits 16 frames.

c94fd129324a480a.name: setup_dash_attacks
c94fd129324a480a.doc: Registers two knockback hit windows on attack 1 and one normal hit on attack 2, sets the photo window for grade 0 monsters and initializes the AI.

c9734bdcdad5a23e.name: advance_at_far_range
c9734bdcdad5a23e.doc: Mostly walks toward the target, sometimes waits, rarely wanders.

c9743246dc631acf.name: side_step_dodge
c9743246dc631acf.doc: Steps randomly left or right around the target, invulnerable during the step.

c97a7cbc685f36b1.name: act_at_medium_range
c97a7cbc685f36b1.doc: Medium range choice: fly toward the target, wait, or fly around it.

c9869aa378e65331.name: sidestep_to_dodge_melee
c9869aa378e65331.doc: Dodges a melee attack by snapping to face the target and stepping sideways, then allows guard and dodge again. The step-back branch is never taken because the 0 to 19 roll is always under 20.

c9961e6a40d95a08.name: chase_target_steps
c9961e6a40d95a08.doc: Like chase_target, but aims at a point on the line to the target, offset by the move speed and stop distance. Returns -1 once closer than stop_dist, otherwise the frames spent.

c9a80c4e1198d33a.name: choose_behavior_by_aggro
c9a80c4e1198d33a.doc: Top level choice: fights while enraged; otherwise fights, wanders or chases depending on aggro state and distance to the target.

c9b125622abd1552.name: play_and_watch_target
c9b125622abd1552.doc: Plays the idle play motion and waits until the target is in view.

c9b9b7274b8b0d31.name: approach_until_near
c9b9b7274b8b0d31.doc: Chases the target or waits until it is within 290.

c9e98f593c20cd26.name: walk_toward_target
c9e98f593c20cd26.doc: Walks toward the target for up to 240 frames, then stands.

c9ebefbf13b7c304.name: chase_target_until_close
c9ebefbf13b7c304.doc: Turns to the target, then each frame turns toward it and moves to its position until within stop_dist (returns -1) or max_frames pass (returns the frames used).

c9f29d8dca30db98.name: read_last_damage
c9f29d8dca30db98.doc: Writes the damage recorded by record_last_damage into out_damage[0].

ca23e0c750ba9d5a.name: fight_by_distance_until_enraged
ca23e0c750ba9d5a.doc: Loop that picks close, mid or long-range behaviour by target distance. Returns when the target is over 300 units away or the rage counter is zero.

ca412080fd1e2ccc.name: toggle_phase
ca412080fd1e2ccc.doc: Switches between the red phase (variable 3 equal to 2, invincible) and the blue phase (1, vulnerable) and restarts the colour flash.

ca514bdf65d868f2.name: rise_to_hover_height
ca514bdf65d868f2.doc: Plays the walk motion and flies up to height 30.

ca5cccd9aee69bd5.name: walk_toward_target
ca5cccd9aee69bd5.doc: Walks toward the target for up to 240 frames, then stands.

ca91ac91e4fce610.name: fight_with_rage_hits_left
ca91ac91e4fce610.doc: Fight loop used while rage hits are left: long range behaviour from 180 to 290 units, mid range from 100 to 180, close range below. Returns when the target is beyond 290 units or the rage hits run out.

ca95906b8fd81d2f.name: run_at_target
ca95906b8fd81d2f.doc: Turns toward the target and runs at it for up to 120 frames.

caa9b087a39143ad.name: run_idle_and_combat_loop
caa9b087a39143ad.doc: Stands until the target comes within 500 units or the monster is hit, then loops forever fighting within 240 units and chasing otherwise.

cab51e3e25dcc2b4.name: attack_at_mid_range
cab51e3e25dcc2b4.doc: Mid-range choice: fireball, circle-run then spin attack, or run straight at the target.

cad272064091d7bc.name: choose_attack_by_distance
cad272064091d7bc.doc: One fighting decision before enrage: circles if many monsters are closer to the target, otherwise picks the close, mid or far routine.

cae1aab34f95d842.name: fly_around_target
cae1aab34f95d842.doc: Turns toward the point angle degrees around the target and flies there.

cb04f42f39401b28.name: act_at_medium_range
cb04f42f39401b28.doc: Medium range choice: lunge, rocket barrage, run in, circle or play with the target.

cb10a472d3c0d95d.name: choose_fly_action
cb10a472d3c0d95d.doc: Picks and runs one flying behaviour for a wandering flyer: turns to a random heading when a wall is close ahead, and when over 300 from home either circles the home point or hovers watching for the target; otherwise it randomly hovers and watches, turns in place, circles the target or flies ahead (a last wander branch tests a local that is never set). Sets monster variable 2 slot 0 to the chosen behaviour bit. Returns 1 when one of the two checked watches spots the target and 0 after the far-from-home choice; on the other paths it returns without setting a value.

cb18a7f9fabe8ccf.name: wait_move_until_near_target
cb18a7f9fabe8ccf.doc: Waits while the current move runs. Returns 1 when the target is within stop_dist, 2 when the move ended elsewhere, 0 on timeout; stops moving unless it timed out.

cb1cc902e6c7c669.name: run_to_nearest_corner
cb1cc902e6c7c669.doc: Picks the nearest of four fixed arena corner points and runs there, with guard and dodge locked.

cb38620d6e663ce0.name: act_at_long_range
cb38620d6e663ce0.doc: Long range behaviour: 70% run at the target, 7% walk to it, otherwise stand watching.

cb4275d40e28e4dd.name: idle_if_player_disguised
cb4275d40e28e4dd.doc: If the player is disguised in the form this monster's kind recognises as its own (get_player_disguise is not -1), runs idle_until_disguise_ends until that ends; otherwise returns at once.

cb7f168b1ecc2517.name: summon_sprouts
cb7f168b1ecc2517.doc: Plays attack 2 with a puff of smoke, then, if fewer than 7 monsters exist, creates three monster 610 in a row in front of itself.

cb7f8f627ac9b5a8.name: walk_to_target
cb7f8f627ac9b5a8.doc: Each frame turns toward the target and moves to its position until within stop_dist. Returns -1 when close, otherwise the frames used.

cb8c4389dc46cac3.name: begin_knockdown_state
cb8c4389dc46cac3.doc: Starts a knockdown: forbids guard and dodge, resets the motion and turning, waits a frame, switches scripted movement off and sets act status 1. The counterpart of end_knockdown_and_resume_flight.

cb98a3fae0a27d9b.name: choose_idle_wander_action
cb98a3fae0a27d9b.doc: Leftover walking idle behaviour from the generic monster template: turns away from walls, wanders back toward home or strafes around the target. Returns 1 if the target is detected, and is not called by this monster's update loop.

cba4ef535ad72c74.name: orbit_around_center
cba4ef535ad72c74.doc: Moves the boss along a circle of radius 180 around (250, 0, 250) at height 105, facing the centre. The angular step oscillates between limits that flip when exceeded.

cba66f2124d222b5.name: reset_ai_values
cba66f2124d222b5.doc: Resets monster variables 1 to 4 to -1, clearing the melee AI's stored choices.

cbb2f4f3778f9934.name: wait_while_player_disguised
cbb2f4f3778f9934.doc: Stands still, turning to face the player when not already within 60 degrees, until the player is no longer in a monster disguise.

cbb32f18517394e0.name: fire_demon_beam_with_launch
cbb32f18517394e0.doc: Like fire_demon_beam_sweep, but first creates the launch beam, waits 90 frames, then creates the loop beam with 1.8 times the monster's attack and sweeps its end point toward the target for 90 frames.

cbc61c2b3677449b.name: choose_combat_or_idle_behaviour
cbc61c2b3677449b.doc: One decision step: when not enraged it fights, idles or chases depending on aggro state and distance; once enraged it runs the enraged fight.

cbd0e3ac316431f7.name: block_attack
cbd0e3ac316431f7.doc: Plays the guard motion with a pushback for 8 frames.

cbffdb4783e24dfd.name: lunge_attack
cbffdb4783e24dfd.doc: Faces the target and plays attack 1 (the poison hit); after 10 frames moves toward a point 100 units ahead at 2.7 units per frame for 12 frames (about 32 units), then stops and waits 3 more frames without returning to the stand motion.

cc0598ba77ed7790.name: setup_flying_limits
cc0598ba77ed7790.doc: Sets flying limits: maximum height 999.9, wall margin 50, clip distance 600, and flying attributes on.

cc1ddef2a9bc8de5.name: get_speed_boost
cc1ddef2a9bc8de5.doc: Meant to read the speed boost from monster var 9, but it calls set_monster_var with the local's address instead of get_monster_var, so it overwrites var 9 and writes the unset local to out_boost.

cc290fd6f80f10de.name: act_at_long_range
cc290fd6f80f10de.doc: Long range choice: spits fire most of the time, sometimes wanders toward the target, otherwise walks closer and flies after it or waits in view.

cc2f05d936116955.name: step_back_from_target
cc2f05d936116955.doc: Plays the back-step motion and hops to a point 30 to 40 units farther from the target, straight away from it, at speed for about 12 frames. Takes no damage for the first 7 frames.

cc8bdaf086ae1b3f.name: face_monster_until_time
cc8bdaf086ae1b3f.doc: Keeps turning toward another monster until the motion progress is within tolerance of the given time.

cc8fc2fae183d7b0.name: on_guard
cc8fc2fae183d7b0.doc: Guard reaction: locks interrupts, plays the guard in, knockback and out motions, then unlocks.

ccb3816a4e9e1d20.name: add_speed_boost
ccb3816a4e9e1d20.doc: Meant to add the speed boost from monster var 9 to the given speed, but get_speed_boost never loads it, so it adds an unset local instead (and overwrites var 9).

ccbb0c136e7e831d.name: approach_until_in_range
ccbb0c136e7e831d.doc: Walks toward the target or waits until it is within 270.

ccceb1e877138c83.name: dodge_melee_by_stepping_back
ccceb1e877138c83.doc: Snaps to face the target and makes an invulnerable 100-unit step back, then stands and restores guard and dodge.

ccf30dac0b655ef0.name: circle_target_or_wait
ccf30dac0b655ef0.doc: Half the time circles the target at 160 or more units, otherwise stands and waits for it to come into view.

cd10b3f06452dde2.name: store_position_in_globals
cd10b3f06452dde2.doc: Meant to save the monster's position in spawn_x, spawn_y, spawn_z (an old-numbered get_pos that the engine runs as loop_se_on_monster, so nothing is read), then zeroes spawn_y.

cd26ccf799cb42cf.name: approach_until_in_range
cd26ccf799cb42cf.doc: Walks toward the target or stands and watches until it is within 550 units.

cd3accd7c5f7bc12.name: on_death
cd3accd7c5f7bc12.doc: Sets variable 64, plays the death motion, runs event script 600 and finishes the death.

cd50c44a7ec357fe.name: on_death
cd50c44a7ec357fe.doc: Cannon death: starts the drops, spawns the warship damage effect and smoke at its position, makes itself unlockable and undamageable, and deals 900 damage to the ship (monster var 67). Then idles forever.

cd51a1ceb57b9d3d.name: idle_while_player_disguised
cd51a1ceb57b9d3d.doc: Drops to hover 5 units above the ground (speed 4, up to 150 frames), then stands, turning to the target whenever it is more than 90 degrees off, until the player's disguise ends.

cd5279ccdbbaf17b.name: walk_up_to_target
cd5279ccdbbaf17b.doc: Walks toward the target, facing it, until within 30 units or 240 frames pass.

cd548ff38f3cb7a9.name: wait_frames_update
cd548ff38f3cb7a9.doc: Waits the given number of frames while keeping the aggro bookkeeping running.

cd6fca39414e6b08.name: wait_frames_checking_phase
cd6fca39414e6b08.doc: Waits the given frames, checking the phase change each frame.

cd795ef3ebccdf0f.name: chase_target
cd795ef3ebccdf0f.doc: Chases the target each frame, aiming at a point stop_dist short of it. Returns -1 when close, otherwise the frames used.

cd83296464a9db6c.name: shoot_elemental_ball
cd83296464a9db6c.doc: Plays attack 2 and spawns the launch and loop shot effects of its own element (fire, ice, thunder, water or wind) from its face toward the target.

cd838df38f9ce18c.name: init_monster_ai
cd838df38f9ce18c.doc: Initialises monster AI globals: records the spawn position as home with y zeroed (non-bosses) and sets clip distance 35 (700 world units), or 999999 for bosses.

cd83a191b8e2db50.name: walk_in_direction
cd83a191b8e2db50.doc: Walks the given distance along an absolute angle without turning first.

cd86d95ebb0ec10f.name: turn_and_wander_forward
cd86d95ebb0ec10f.doc: Meant to turn up to angle_range degrees, but converts the range to radians and then the random turn to radians again, so it turns a whole number of degrees from 0 to about angle_range/57, always to the same side. If 100 units ahead are clear it walks base_dist + move_speed plus a random 0 to dist_range units; if less is clear but more than stop_dist it walks just the random amount; otherwise it returns -1 without moving. Returns 1 if the target comes within stop_dist, 2 when the walk ends, 0 after max_frames.

cda3719057dbaa01.name: tick_until_motion_progress
cda3719057dbaa01.doc: Runs frames until the motion is at the given progress, within the tolerance (default 0.03) or ends. Returns the frames waited.

cddcad5a2e65092f.name: chase_target_in_flight
cddcad5a2e65092f.doc: Flies after the target, re-aiming every frame, optionally tilting to match the climb.

cde0166d8b906fcd.name: idle_if_player_disguised
cde0166d8b906fcd.doc: If the player is disguised, runs the disguised idle behaviour for this monster kind.

cde9a6bd8566e332.name: choose_close_range_action
cde9a6bd8566e332.doc: Close-range choice under 120 units, before rage: lunge, self-destruct with a chance that rises as life falls below 70 percent, circle the target or step back.

cded15a949d28876.name: charge_instead_of_dodging_shot
cded15a949d28876.doc: When monster var 0 has bit 2, 4 or 16 set (turning to fire or firing nose bullets, circling while wandering, or standing watching) or the target is over 300 units away, runs at the target and does the charge and shockwave instead of dodging the shot; otherwise does nothing.

cdf3bb42d60b7de5.name: halt_on_dodge
cdf3bb42d60b7de5.doc: Dodge program (bound to dodge_shot or dodge_melee): forbids guard and dodge, stops the motion, turning and movement, then allows guard and dodge again at once, so the monster just halts.

ce054dc776f2172d.name: choose_behavior
ce054dc776f2172d.doc: Top-level behaviour pick. Calm monsters fight when the player is within 280 and wander otherwise; aggravated monsters fight within 180 and run at the player otherwise; enraged ones use the enraged combat loop.

ce0cacfd4ff6bc9d.name: chase_target_clear
ce0cacfd4ff6bc9d.doc: Chases the target, but returns -2 if a wall blocks the path to it and -1 when within stop_dist.

ce0cff4371343016.name: start_turn_to_target
ce0cff4371343016.doc: Starts turning toward the target at speed radians per frame. Written in the b02a raw numbering, where the calls shown (get_monster_var2, set_dungeon_flag) stand for get_target_angle and turn_to.

ce10a1504be6881f.name: pick_far_range_action
ce10a1504be6881f.doc: Picks a far range action at random: walking closer, standing, circling or the flame shot.

ce114d5d86248fdc.name: on_death
ce114d5d86248fdc.doc: Plays the death motion and increments the shared kill counter in variable 127. When the fourth one dies it runs event 510.

ce1c059df5b7395b.name: walk_around_target_by_angle
ce1c059df5b7395b.doc: Walks to the point at the given angle around the player, keeping the current distance.

ce2a3b58484edf89.name: on_update
ce2a3b58484edf89.doc: Allows guard and dodge, then each frame uses the normal AI when the target is within 350 units, the wander behaviour when farther, or the no-rage AI once rage hits are used up.

ce7739a7369b6740.name: pick_near_range_action
ce7739a7369b6740.doc: Chooses an action for a target under 120 units away: first fires a thunder shot if the target is within 40, then fires a thunder shot (sometimes after a random sidestep), backsteps, or flies 100 units away at 35 degrees off straight back.

ce7f0df4f3d4c624.name: arc_toward_point
ce7f0df4f3d4c624.doc: Flies toward a point along a curved path, bending to one side by the curve amount, until within stop_dist.

ce8a1ed3b429ca86.name: fly_to_height
ce8a1ed3b429ca86.doc: Moves straight up speed units per frame (down only when target_y is negative, since only its sign sets the direction) until within speed plus arrive_margin of height target_y; vertical movement stops for good 30 units above the ground or at ground level. Returns 1 on arrival, the check_flight_step result if blocked, or 0 after max_frames.

ce9e20f343a3f884.name: act_at_medium_range
ce9e20f343a3f884.doc: Medium range choice: fire nose bullets, run in for the shockwave attack, approach, or circle the target.

cea55191df0d5a6a.name: run_in_and_cast_tornado
cea55191df0d5a6a.doc: Runs to the target, plays attack 2 and spawns San's tornado effect at the boss, carrying its attack value.

ceb9aaf8492fb839.name: attack_with_swing
ceb9aaf8492fb839.doc: Linda's attack 1: plays the attack motion, returns to standing and waits 12 frames.

cee4febae5cce413.name: wait_until_target_detected
cee4febae5cce413.doc: Waits up to max_frames until the detection test finds the target. Returns 1 if detected.

cee8cd55c53753da.name: attack_at_mid_range
cee8cd55c53753da.doc: Mid-range choice (80 to 150 units): spits venom at a short or long arc, or plays one of its two melee attacks.

cf0ed5f049f2f8dc.name: approach_at_mid_range
cf0ed5f049f2f8dc.doc: Strikes, walks toward the target, or strafes beside it.

cf1a320db6c215c6.name: on_update
cf1a320db6c215c6.doc: Allows guard and dodge and runs one decision step every frame.

cf30a447f516cbdb.name: fight_at_far_range
cf30a447f516cbdb.doc: Far range choice: mostly runs toward the target, sometimes walks, waits for it or circles.

cf49093a5f7ab591.name: fight_at_far_range
cf49093a5f7ab591.doc: Far range choice (target 200 to 240 away): an ice ball or flying around the target at 45 degrees. The roll it checks is never drawn, so the choice depends on a stale value.

cf49ec896f99b61c.name: wait_frames_update
cf49ec896f99b61c.doc: Runs update_and_wait for the given number of frames.

cf4f5e34dffdd0a3.name: walk_forward_toward_target
cf4f5e34dffdd0a3.doc: Faces the target and walks 100 units straight ahead. Returns -1 without moving if a wall is within 100 units ahead.

cf649e9a26005887.name: fly_to_point_around_target
cf649e9a26005887.doc: Picks the point ring_param_b units from the target at ring_param_a degrees around it from the monster's side (get_pos_around_target), turns to face it and flies there hovering hover_height above the ground. Returns the result of the flight.

cf86b2a69c4bf7f5.name: turn_to_angle
cf86b2a69c4bf7f5.doc: Turns to the absolute heading angle_deg at turn_speed_deg degrees per frame, wrapping both to the -180 to 180 range, and waits until the heading is reached or about 360 divided by the speed frames pass. Returns the frames waited.

cf8bab4dbc87b56e.name: read_attack_enabled
cf8bab4dbc87b56e.doc: Reads this piece's shared attack flag, writes it into out_enabled[0] and returns it.

cf9b058b935f1fa1.name: run_to_flank_position
cf9b058b935f1fa1.doc: Turns to face a point 200 units from the target at 120 degrees to one side and runs to it.

cfb2944db3b37a39.name: get_knocked_down_and_rise
cfb2944db3b37a39.doc: Plays the knocked-flying motion with a knockback, lies down for 30 frames and gets up.

cfb307405b325c94.name: spit_sticky_goo
cfb307405b325c94.doc: Plays attack 2 while tracking the target, then spawns a sticky goo projectile at the dcol1 point with the monster's attack power.

cfc426453da3c053.name: turn_to_angle_degrees
cfc426453da3c053.doc: Turns the monster to the given yaw in degrees at the given speed and waits until it is facing it. Returns the frames waited.

cfdf637772a440fe.name: on_update
cfdf637772a440fe.doc: Allows guarding and dodging, then repeats the attack round forever.

cfe85429d3217901.name: face_target_on_dodge_melee
cfe85429d3217901.doc: Dodge melee program, meant to forbid guard and dodge, turn at once to face the target, stand and allow guard and dodge again. The calls are old-numbered: the facing call (_EXT_68) has no native, the stand motion runs as set_life and the guard and dodge locks set the floor's visible monster limit, so it only waits a frame.

d013df2e7e618bdb.name: get_up_from_stun
d013df2e7e618bdb.doc: Plays the knocked-flying and get-up motions and then waits out the stun.

d01e32f13ba99701.name: wander_in_flight_or_wait_for_target
d01e32f13ba99701.doc: Flying idle behaviour: avoids walls, drifts back toward its home point, stands waiting for the target, circles or flies randomly. Returns 1 if it notices the target while waiting.

d02dd41154340c75.name: run_toward_target
d02dd41154340c75.doc: Runs after the player for up to 90 frames and then stands.

d037854b3d84191d.name: fly_around_point
d037854b3d84191d.doc: Flies to a point at radius from the given point, angle_deg around it, turning to face it first. Returns the flight result.

d070e3fae3ced604.name: wait_motion_end_update
d070e3fae3ced604.doc: Waits frame by frame until the current motion ends, then returns 1. In this toolkit wait_frame_update is a bare wait, so no aggro update runs.

d089bc2bd2281032.name: recoil_from_damage
d089bc2bd2281032.doc: Stops all actions, plays the damage knockback, waits 16 frames and stands.

d09237d81e4b1cec.name: track_target_until_motion_end
d09237d81e4b1cec.doc: Keeps turning toward the target until the current motion ends.

d092a4c01369ce1c.name: fight_enraged
d092a4c01369ce1c.doc: Combat loop once the monster is enraged: shockwave, swing combos and chases by distance, hanging back if more than three monsters are closer to the target.

d0a56bf218137e3b.name: wait_to_detect_target
d0a56bf218137e3b.doc: Waits up to max_frames for can_detect_target to succeed. Returns 1 when the target is detected, 0 otherwise.

d0c34af9ab75b713.name: fight_close_range
d0c34af9ab75b713.doc: Close range choices: fireball or lunge after approaching, back away, or circle the target.

d0cbc4f43a57bbc1.name: wait_motion_end_updating
d0cbc4f43a57bbc1.doc: Updates the boss each frame until the current motion ends.

d0d9a5c0fa50f148.name: sidestep_sideways_away
d0d9a5c0fa50f148.doc: Steps left or right at random, 90 degrees from the facing direction, moving toward a point 100 units away while undamageable, then returns to the stand loop. Its waits end early once the target is within 40 units and 45 degrees of its facing.

d0e157325b61a1c9.name: threaten_for_frames
d0e157325b61a1c9.doc: Plays the threaten motion, loops it for the given frames in state 32 and then returns to standing.

d0f7e250c938f97d.name: play_idle_motion
d0f7e250c938f97d.doc: Plays the play motion until the target is in view or about 56 frames pass, then stands.

d0fbb2c38883e856.name: slash_attack_1_tracking
d0fbb2c38883e856.doc: Plays attack 1 while turning toward the target for 9 frames (11 at 30 fps scaled to PAL), then waits for the motion to end.

d108b815391c2cb8.name: recover_from_limp
d108b815391c2cb8.doc: Makes the piece invulnerable and plays the return motion. If the shared shock flag is set it also shows the electrocution effect on itself.

d10df74cb5dd6bfb.name: run_toward_target_and_shoot
d10df74cb5dd6bfb.doc: Runs at the target to within 160 units, then 70 percent of the time shoots a poison arrow.

d11c90c52ccd176d.name: walk_around_point_updating
d11c90c52ccd176d.doc: Walks to a point at the given angle and radius around a fixed point.

d1264a7029224429.name: turn_and_use_attack_two
d1264a7029224429.doc: Walks while turning to face the target, then plays attack 2 and stands.

d14054107cde5554.name: wait_frames_update
d14054107cde5554.doc: Waits the given number of frames, running the aggro update each frame.

d1468ec980ff3b94.name: recoil_then_faint
d1468ec980ff3b94.doc: Hit reaction: plays the damage motion for 12 frames, then the faint motion until the stun ends.

d15a02394c84d21c.name: stand_idle_frames
d15a02394c84d21c.doc: Stops moving, plays the stand motion and waits the given number of frames.

d17079a75fee43c1.name: back_step_invulnerable
d17079a75fee43c1.doc: Steps backward from the target to a point a bit farther away, invulnerable during the step.

d195634a39ae5f12.name: fight_until_rage_hits_left
d195634a39ae5f12.doc: Enraged fight loop, used while no rage hits are left: unless more than four monsters are nearer the target, walks or runs up to it and swings attack 1 or 2 or a combo. The close-or-far test reads target_dist, which this function never sets, so the branch is fixed by the uninitialised value. Returns 0 as soon as rage hits left becomes positive; distance never ends it.

d19d782922a8c274.name: track_target_until_motion_progress
d19d782922a8c274.doc: Keeps turning toward the target until the motion reaches the given progress.

d19ea67094fdc824.name: fight_in_range_loop
d19ea67094fdc824.doc: Loop calling the close, mid or far action by distance to the target. Returns 0 when the target is farther than 550.

d1a407ed8f0d4d30.name: walk_to_angle_around_target
d1a407ed8f0d4d30.doc: Walks to the point at the given angle around the target, stopping short if a wall is closer. Returns -1 if there is no room.

d1d0fab187204e31.name: chase_target_at_own_height
d1d0fab187204e31.doc: Like chase_target, but keeps the monster's own height while moving toward the target.

d1d4f010f9e9bdf4.name: walk_toward_target
d1d4f010f9e9bdf4.doc: Walks toward the target for up to 90 frames, then stands.

d1d84fb43db2b4c0.name: choose_idle_movement
d1d84fb43db2b4c0.doc: Picks the next idle move at random: turn away when there is no room ahead, return toward home when far from it, circle the target, or move toward it. Sets monster variable 0 to the move chosen. Returns 1 when it detects the target.

d1e2b660ecc80a20.name: get_hit_count
d1e2b660ecc80a20.doc: Writes the number of hits this piece has taken into out_count[0].

d1f625c0c5bb8322.name: turn_to_target_random
d1f625c0c5bb8322.doc: Turns toward the target, with a percent chance of aiming off to a random side by the offset.

d20515f68a211e20.name: setup_boss_and_lights
d20515f68a211e20.doc: Init program: sets the boss attributes (always visible, free velocity, no map or body collision, visible monster limit 15) and the low player camera, stores its handle in monster var 31 for the lights and clears the command in var 30, creates the three Atramilia lights (kinds 618 to 620), loads the Griffon feather effects into a free texture block, and clears var 7 and the flicker counter.

d2064979e7e013bf.name: face_target_while_disguised
d2064979e7e013bf.doc: Idle loop for a monster while the player is disguised: keeps standing and turns toward the target when it is more than 60 degrees off. Returns once the player is no longer disguised.

d21793b763da50cb.name: update_and_wait
d21793b763da50cb.doc: Advances one frame: refreshes aggro from damage taken and, while aggro is on, ticks its timer and turns aggro off when the timer runs out; then adds one to the frame counter in monster variable 7 and waits a frame.

d234c5a57018d741.name: turn_and_fly_to_target_spot_updating
d234c5a57018d741.doc: Turns toward the target, then flies to a spot at the target.

d2388cdfeb033337.name: recover_from_throw_and_reset
d2388cdfeb033337.doc: Recovers from being thrown, waits 10 frames and clears the motion.

d249f81338d4281c.name: update_and_wait_frame
d249f81338d4281c.doc: Runs the per-frame boss update and waits one frame.

d24f8443485a59fa.name: chase_target_on_foot
d24f8443485a59fa.doc: Runs after the target in steps for up to 120 frames, then goes back to standing.

d26fefd8ddb34a52.name: chase_and_attack_loop
d26fefd8ddb34a52.doc: Main loop. It checks the first-hit event, approaches the target and acts on the result: turns to face it, attacks by distance, or turns then attacks. When the target is far it stands and occasionally turns toward it.

d272192329f1f842.name: swing_attack_two_then_dash_attack_one
d272192329f1f842.doc: Plays attack 2, then loops attack 1 while dashing at the target.

d290ccbacf921577.name: act_at_long_range
d290ccbacf921577.doc: Long range choice: rocket barrage or approach by running or walking.

d2a854ee6b59ef63.name: recoil_from_guarded_hit
d2a854ee6b59ef63.doc: Plays the guard motion with a small knockback, waits 8 frames and unlocks interrupts.

d2bd2745b83cfaae.name: chase_target_clear
d2bd2745b83cfaae.doc: Chases the target like chase_target but returns -2 if a wall blocks the line to it and -1 when within stop_dist.

d2e85428d1f3eb71.name: pick_far_range_action
d2e85428d1f3eb71.doc: Turns to the target and chases it for up to 90 frames.

d2eab0050ebd38f9.name: wander_or_wait_for_target
d2eab0050ebd38f9.doc: Idle behaviour: backs away from walls, returns toward home if far from it, otherwise randomly stands waiting for the player, circles the target, or walks in a random direction. Returns 1 if the player was detected while waiting.

d2ec971cd8ec4189.name: trigger_low_life_event
d2ec971cd8ec4189.doc: Once only, when life falls below 0.34, sets monster var 7 and runs event script 501.

d2fff94e424a5773.name: calc_pitch_to_point
d2fff94e424a5773.doc: Writes the wrapped pitch angle from the monster to the point (x, y) into out_pitch.

d32246ccd3e718a5.name: choose_wander_move
d32246ccd3e718a5.doc: Idle roaming AI: backs away from walls, returns toward home when far, otherwise waits for the target, walks around it, turns or walks off at random.

d326a6b029f87ee6.name: turn_then_chase_target
d326a6b029f87ee6.doc: Turns to face the target, then each frame walks toward a point speed plus stop_dist units ahead of itself in the target's direction, at its own height, until within stop_dist (returns -1) or max_frames pass.

d33946e05397e888.name: fly_in_direction
d33946e05397e888.doc: Turns to angle_deg, then flies the given distance in that direction at the given height. Returns the flight result.

d340afaf16bc971e.name: store_beam_effect_handle
d340afaf16bc971e.doc: Stores an effect handle in the beam effect variable of the given slot.

d34920803bd7b695.name: chase_and_lunge_attack
d34920803bd7b695.doc: Chases the target, turns to face it, then plays attack 1 which hops 100 units forward. Sometimes follows with the play motion.

d36b2e4cb2c9a703.name: run_toward_target
d36b2e4cb2c9a703.doc: Runs at the target for up to 180 frames, then returns to the stand motion.

d36f0fcb264411ac.name: chase_target
d36f0fcb264411ac.doc: Each frame turns toward and walks at the target until it is within near_dist. Returns -1 when it got that close, otherwise the frames passed (max_frames on timeout).

d37dc36311507e2a.name: watch_disguised_player
d37dc36311507e2a.doc: While the player is disguised, the monster stands and only turns toward the player (walking, at 0.75 degrees per frame) when the player leaves a 60 degree arc in front of it. Ends when the disguise is gone. The monster_kind argument is not used.

d37eb94f921542b8.name: get_knocked_down_and_rise
d37eb94f921542b8.doc: Plays the knockdown, lies still for 30 frames, rises invulnerable and then checks for a phase change.

d3a6f2fd34bb2d50.name: fly_in_facing_direction
d3a6f2fd34bb2d50.doc: Turns to a heading in degrees and flies the given distance along it.

d3c9567371b5c247.name: swing_attack_one_then_two
d3c9567371b5c247.doc: Plays attack 1, then switches to attack 2 after 18 frames (22 at 30 fps scaled to PAL) and waits for it to end.

d3e3a3defeb87b97.name: track_target_until_motion_end
d3e3a3defeb87b97.doc: Turns to keep facing the target until the current motion ends.

d3e967f8dee4dffd.name: walk_forward_toward_target
d3e967f8dee4dffd.doc: Faces the target and walks forward as far as the clearance check allows. Returns -1 if the clear distance is shorter than stop_dist.

d3eb892eab0dc4b5.name: fight_target_before_rage
d3eb892eab0dc4b5.doc: Normal fight loop while not enraged: picks close, mid or far behaviour from the target distance. Returns when the target is further than 230 units or the rage hits are used up.

d4079af2a3c9538a.name: play_idle_loop
d4079af2a3c9538a.doc: Loops the idle play motion for repeat_count periods of 70 frames (84 at 30 fps scaled to PAL). When watch_target is 1, returns 1 as soon as the target comes within 75 units and 45 degrees of the front; otherwise returns 0 after the last period.

d40c26dea3aae521.name: dodge_sideways
d40c26dea3aae521.doc: Steps 100 units to a random side, left or right with equal odds, taking no damage during the middle of the step.

d41ec8d582bc8771.name: choose_flying_attack_or_move
d41ec8d582bc8771.doc: Flying monster AI: 65 percent flies at the target and dives; otherwise 15 percent flies in an arc 30 to 90 degrees around the target, else it turns to the target and sidesteps 300 units (67 percent) or tries to back off (33 percent).

d42298b1aa1ab5f6.name: setup_attack_hit_and_lighting
d42298b1aa1ab5f6.doc: Init program: registers the attack 2 knockback hit window, disables lock-on, clears monster variable 0 so the minion plays its landing on first update, sets the model color and lighting, starts the AI and extends the clip distance so the minion is never culled.

d4252e56ce98fe91.name: fight_loop_once_enraged
d4252e56ce98fe91.doc: Enraged fight loop, run while no rage hits remain; returns once rage hits are back. Repositions when more than four monsters are nearer the target; otherwise claws under 75 units, rolls at 75 to 90, and farther away mostly rolls (70 percent) or else chases or circles.

d464e8a34039111d.name: get_slot_timer_elapsed
d464e8a34039111d.doc: Returns frames elapsed on a slot timer: the floor timer minus the value stored by reset_slot_timer in monster variable 30 + slot.

d46dec7ece556b26.name: run_monster_ai
d46dec7ece556b26.doc: Allows guarding and dodging and clears the act status (old-numbered DIRECT finish_death and start_death_drops calls), then loops idle_until_target_near and fight_while_calm. It never uses fight_while_enraged, so an enraged monster within 175 units just stands.

d4708a1173e2e616.name: face_monster_until_motion_progress
d4708a1173e2e616.doc: Keeps turning toward another monster until the motion progress is within the tolerance of the given value (default 0.05).

d47d217be8624c85.name: on_death
d47d217be8624c85.doc: Plays the death motion, waits 30 frames and runs event script 502, then idles forever.

d4875f301e597e6a.name: run_current_action
d4875f301e597e6a.doc: Runs the handler for the action in monster var 1: 4 wander, 3 stand and wait, 1 and 2 do nothing.

d492be459f6d4263.name: flip_vulnerable_form
d492be459f6d4263.doc: Plays a sound, fades the model out, switches to the other form (changing which damage kinds hurt it) and fades back in.

d49481450f0c8b36.name: hold_still_to_dodge
d49481450f0c8b36.doc: Holds still in the air as a melee dodge.

d4c63c05b23af5d3.name: fight_target_by_distance
d4c63c05b23af5d3.doc: Loops while the target is within 230 units and rage hits remain, picking behaviour by distance (135, 90).

d4db9c4afafab880.name: moonsault_away_from_melee
d4db9c4afafab880.doc: Answers a melee attack with the moonsault.

d4ec4ccc4c8d37c1.name: on_land
d4ec4ccc4c8d37c1.doc: After being thrown: recovers, plays get up and returns 1.

d4ecf57712f367b4.name: fight_while_enraged
d4ecf57712f367b4.doc: Enraged combat loop that nothing calls. Lunges under 90 units, otherwise mostly charges with attack 2, walks up or strafes, and strafes or idles when more than two monsters are nearer the player. Returns when the player is further than 175.

d5036f8146035766.name: track_target_for_frames
d5036f8146035766.doc: Keeps turning toward the target for the given number of frames. The original passes turn_speed in degrees straight to the turn without converting it, so the monster snaps round almost at once.

d509a8d7b9762641.name: stand_stopped_until_status_ends
d509a8d7b9762641.doc: Plays the damage motion and waits until the stop status flags clear, then stands and resumes the AI.

d50b167c844ed2d9.name: recoil_from_damage
d50b167c844ed2d9.doc: Plays the damage knockback, then recovers to the stance and restarts the monster state.

d543a9efbfcd43ab.name: turn_by_angle_offset
d543a9efbfcd43ab.doc: Turns by an offset relative to the current heading.

d55e307d1220ac26.name: dodge_melee_by_stepping_back
d55e307d1220ac26.doc: Steps back to dodge a melee attack.

d58120d416b008ff.name: hover_while_player_disguised
d58120d416b008ff.doc: Floats up to height 25, then idles in place while the player is disguised as a monster, turning to face the target when it is not within 90 degrees. Returns when the disguise is removed.

d586e1bff4145b9b.name: play_idle_motion
d586e1bff4145b9b.doc: Plays the idle play motion and waits for it to end.

d58ea8c9056eb59a.name: move_to_orbit_position
d58ea8c9056eb59a.doc: Flies over 60 frames to the orbit position around the leader, computed from the two angles in monster vars 0 to 2.

d58ede4ce0866772.name: reset_for_action
d58ede4ce0866772.doc: Blocks guard and dodge, clears the motion, movement and turning, faces the target, waits a frame and sets act status 1.

d591de3510663b65.name: struggle_forever
d591de3510663b65.doc: Plays the struggle motion while lifted.

d5a52e45549a3891.name: step_back_from_target
d5a52e45549a3891.doc: Plays the step back motion and moves to a point 30 to 40 units farther from the target than now, at the given speed. The monster takes no damage during the first part of the step.

d5c2e203cb2f377e.name: fight_at_mid_range
d5c2e203cb2f377e.doc: Mid range choice (target 140 to 240 away): guard charge, fire ball, or flying around the target before looking for it.

d5e961a564019417.name: sidestep_around_target
d5e961a564019417.doc: Invulnerable sidestep to the left or right to a point at the same distance around the target.

d5e9fc9cb130c42b.name: stand_still_for_frames
d5e9fc9cb130c42b.doc: Stops moving, plays the stand motion and waits.

d5eb7b8c6a3b4a25.name: attack_while_enraged
d5eb7b8c6a3b4a25.doc: Attack choice once enraged (no rage hits left, or a boss at -1): charge attack or elemental shot within 100, shot or run at it within 160, run at it when farther. Returns 0 without acting while rage hits remain.

d5f092ede6a41452.name: hover_while_player_disguised
d5f092ede6a41452.doc: While the player is disguised as a monster, flies down to 5 units above the ground (up to 150 frames), then only turns to face the target whenever it is more than 90 degrees off, until the disguise ends.

d5ff18ddc08a116d.name: play_guard_motion
d5ff18ddc08a116d.doc: Locks interrupts, plays the guard-in motion and holds the guard motion for 8 frames before standing again.

d60012ea87864184.name: approach_distant_target
d60012ea87864184.doc: Walks toward the player or waits for the player to come into view until the player is within 225 units.

d62a49e064fc7bdb.name: wait_motion_time
d62a49e064fc7bdb.doc: Waits until the motion progress is within tolerance of time (default 0.03) or the motion ends. Returns the frames waited.

d64d77058f17280f.name: wait_for_target_detected
d64d77058f17280f.doc: Waits up to max_frames until the monster can detect the target. Returns 1 if it did.

d677cecd0518f71e.name: update_forever
d677cecd0518f71e.doc: Updates the boss every frame without ever returning.

d6782dbcbec69c6b.name: take_hit_and_recover
d6782dbcbec69c6b.doc: Subtracts one from the remaining hit counter. At zero the boss falls and stays down, ending the fight (returns 0); otherwise it falls, gets up, returns to the center and returns phase 5.

d686eeb17e53a363.name: claw_attack
d686eeb17e53a363.doc: Sets attack state 1, turns to the target, plays attack 1 while tracking until motion time 0.267, then stands for 9 frames.

d68f107f8565e29b.name: attack_at_mid_range
d68f107f8565e29b.doc: Fires a wind shot, with or without a side-step, or flies around the target by 45 degrees either way.

d69195bd68df873b.name: wait_motion_watch_target
d69195bd68df873b.doc: Waits until the motion ends or the target enters view (max_dist, half_angle_deg). Returns 0 when the motion ended, 1 when the target was seen.

d6b14ec9879e58cf.name: wait_motion_time
d6b14ec9879e58cf.doc: Waits frame by frame until the motion progress is within tolerance of time (0.03 when tolerance is -1) or the motion ends. Returns the frames waited.

d6b5860a00472ef1.name: swing_attack_two
d6b5860a00472ef1.doc: Sets monster var 0 to 2 and plays attack 2 while turning toward the target.

d6c2266c2994c3d9.name: track_target_until_motion_end
d6c2266c2994c3d9.doc: Keeps turning toward the target until the current motion ends.

d6c2a2440f79e4d3.name: guard_with_knockback
d6c2a2440f79e4d3.doc: Plays the guard motions with a guard knockback.

d6c6fb0b228d9309.name: lunge_at_target
d6c6fb0b228d9309.doc: Plays attack 3, rushing to the player's position with a camera shake.

d6ccbdeb14e4762d.name: fly_backward
d6ccbdeb14e4762d.doc: Flies away from the direction the monster is facing, held at hover_height above the ground. The back distance and the returned result are never assigned in the decompiled code.

d6cf30be786caa6e.name: move_beside_target
d6cf30be786caa6e.doc: Walks without turning to the point angle_deg around the target from the monster's own position, at the monster's current distance from the target, so a small angle steps sideways around it. Only the monster's facing is probed, up to 100 units: if less is clear, the walk is cut to that distance along the travel direction, and -1 is returned without moving when it is under twice stop_dist. Otherwise returns 1 once the target is within stop_dist, 2 when the walk ends, 0 after max_frames, and stops moving.

d6e88c73503e1420.name: fly_sideways
d6e88c73503e1420.doc: Flies 300 units to the monster's right (go_right set) or left. The flight result is dropped, so the return value is undefined.

d70ba841ce8de158.name: choose_behaviour_by_aggro
d70ba841ce8de158.doc: Top-level AI step. With rage hits left it fights, wanders when the target is far, or runs at a target in aggro range; with none left it uses the plain fight loop.

d7192010c99bc43a.name: wait_motion_end_and_halt
d7192010c99bc43a.doc: Meant to wait until the current motion ends, then halt movement and return 1. The old-numbered motion-end check runs as get_life, which reads nonzero while the monster is alive, so it returns 1 at once without waiting, and halt_movement does nothing. The arguments are unused.

d73105be3a3d7217.name: chase_target_by_steps
d73105be3a3d7217.doc: Each frame turns toward the target and re-targets a move to it. Returns -1 once within stop_distance, otherwise the frames spent.

d73acc34e317950d.name: roar_when_damaged
d73acc34e317950d.doc: Clears invulnerability and roars, with fireballs once enraged.

d75811011174b748.name: stop_turning
d75811011174b748.doc: Meant to stop the current turn by turning to the monster's present yaw at speed 0, but in this old numbering both calls land on no native, so it does nothing.

d788981e9fbfc160.name: turn_by_angle_and_wait
d788981e9fbfc160.doc: Turns by delta_angle degrees relative to the current heading and waits.

d7920cda22c7a22a.name: wait_until_target_detected
d7920cda22c7a22a.doc: Waits up to max_frames and returns 1 as soon as the monster sees or hears the target, else 0.

d7bc8d8583af0c52.name: turn_toward_target_for_frames
d7bc8d8583af0c52.doc: Turns toward the target every frame for the given number of frames, then stops turning. Despite the parameter name, turn_speed_deg goes to the turn unconverted, so it is in radians per frame; a degree value such as 4.2 makes the monster face the target almost at once.

d7c39cabd1668113.name: set_wall_margin
d7c39cabd1668113.doc: Sets how close the flying monster may get to walls, monster variable set 2 index 16.

d7f1fb0254701adc.name: face_target_until_time
d7f1fb0254701adc.doc: Keeps turning toward the target until the motion progress is within tolerance of the given time.

d81dc135212d887a.name: wait_motion_end_checking_death
d81dc135212d887a.doc: Waits for the current motion to end, checking the death flag each frame. Returns 1.

d821918fe42db7ec.name: turn_by_relative_angle
d821918fe42db7ec.doc: Turns by an angle in degrees relative to the current yaw and waits for it to finish.

d824a1b9ed0dd44f.name: fly_at_target
d824a1b9ed0dd44f.doc: Faces the target and flies to its position at a fixed height above the ground.

d8319993651afc9f.name: attack_at_mid_range
d8319993651afc9f.doc: Fires a holy shot, with or without a sidestep, or flies around the target by 45 degrees either way.

d83208fee2a52c3e.name: wait_forever
d83208fee2a52c3e.doc: Waits frame after frame, never returning.

d8357b608dc54c4e.name: recoil_from_damage
d8357b608dc54c4e.doc: Damage program, meant to stop, play the damage motion with a knockback, wait 12 frames and return to standing. The motion and knockback calls are old-numbered (set_life and get_body_radius), wait_motion_end returns after one frame, and stop_actions_and_disable_lighting turns the model lighting off, so it only waits about 13 frames with the model unlit.

d836c5fa04f62871.name: get_up_after_throw
d836c5fa04f62871.doc: After being thrown and landing, ends the throw, waits 10 frames and plays the get-up motion.

d83821d81454045f.name: fight_at_far_range
d83821d81454045f.doc: Far range choice (target 230 to 330 away): walks toward the target or stands.

d85e20263b90abcc.name: charge_at_target
d85e20263b90abcc.doc: Charge: attack 1 wind-up, then rushes at the target for 12 frames per charge_scale unit, then the wind-down. Longer charges end with an idle play motion.

d87608aeeb89bca2.name: fight_while_calm
d87608aeeb89bca2.doc: Combat loop before the monster is enraged: keeps checking for allies to heal and picks the close, mid (90 to 135) or far (135 to 230) routine by distance. Returns when the target is too far or the monster becomes enraged.

d8ae6140b38cf466.name: circle_or_play_near_target
d8ae6140b38cf466.doc: Low-priority behaviour near the target: circle it, stand watching it, or play idly.

d8b72b2d4db856fb.name: struggle_while_lifted
d8b72b2d4db856fb.doc: Plays the struggle motion forever while lifted.

d8c196f951d0c85a.name: attack_at_close_range
d8c196f951d0c85a.doc: Close range choice: attack 1 or 2, spin attack, or run toward the target.

d8c5f271a092840c.name: sync_shared_life_and_check_death
d8c5f271a092840c.doc: Subtracts the life lost since the last frame from the shared total life in monster var 64 and runs on_death when this monster's life reaches 0.

d8ceec6b319fcde6.name: set_aggro
d8ceec6b319fcde6.doc: Sets the aggro state (second variable set slot 5). Turning it off resets dodge and guard rates to 1.0.

d8e48132ba9b6d6c.name: leap_at_target_and_return
d8e48132ba9b6d6c.doc: Attack 1: faces the target, lunges forward to the target's distance over about 22 frames, then moves back for 25 frames toward its starting X but the lunge's Z, so it only returns to where it started when the lunge was along X.

d8e8d35ac8366e83.name: on_lifted
d8e8d35ac8366e83.doc: Ends active roses and waits forever while held.

d92aeceb72950798.name: run_swordsman_ai
d92aeceb72950798.doc: Allows guarding and dodging and runs the behaviour chooser every frame.

d9300c408333e085.name: dodge_step_back
d9300c408333e085.doc: Steps back invulnerable to just outside the player's distance plus 40 to 50 units, then stands.

d932c252eee551bc.name: recover_after_throw
d932c252eee551bc.doc: Recovers from being thrown, waits 10 frames and resets the motion.

d9727a6cbad405f3.name: is_facing_target_within
d9727a6cbad405f3.doc: Returns 1 when the monster's heading is within half_arc_deg of the target angle, otherwise 0. The angle test does not wrap at plus or minus 180 degrees, so a target just across that line from the heading counts as outside the arc.

d9914b6f70a4be29.name: sidestep_invulnerable
d9914b6f70a4be29.doc: Turns to face the target, then steps left or right at random with damage disabled, flying toward a point 100 units to that side at 9.8 units per frame for only 6 frames, so it covers about 59 units.

d9b60141c7000659.name: play_damage_blowback
d9b60141c7000659.doc: Hit reaction: cancels current actions, plays the after-damage motion with a 3 frame knockback, waits for it to end plus 12 frames, then returns to the stand motion.

d9b6425a83fc9fe9.name: attack_with_lunge
d9b6425a83fc9fe9.doc: Attack 1: turns to the target, plays the attack and 12 frames in lunges toward a point 100 units ahead at 2.55 units per frame, stopping after 15 frames (about 38 units), then waits 4 more frames.

d9c243f0e2f12563.name: approach_at_long_range
d9c243f0e2f12563.doc: Long range choice: mostly walks toward the target, sometimes wanders in a random direction.

d9c2e05d7938fd68.name: wait_move_end_update
d9c2e05d7938fd68.doc: Waits up to max_frames for the current move to end.

d9d8bfcdeaab27a9.name: shoot_until_target_leaves
d9d8bfcdeaab27a9.doc: Fight loop used once no rage hits remain, returning when the target is beyond 240 units horizontally: fires holy shots, sometimes after a random sidestep, or wanders while its attack priority is above 2.

d9ffdfd5a87a0fdd.name: wait_move_until_near
d9ffdfd5a87a0fdd.doc: Waits up to max_frames for a move_to walk, restoring life each frame. Returns 1 as soon as the target is within stop_dist, 2 when the walk reaches its point, 0 on timeout; stops moving on 1 or 2 but not on timeout.

da0b3b5e1a5a3738.name: wait_move_end_update
da0b3b5e1a5a3738.doc: Waits up to max_frames frames, keeping the model lighting matched to the rage state, until the move_to walk finishes. Returns 0 when the walk ended; on timeout it falls off the end with no defined result.

da28604a11c8b259.name: track_damage_and_timers
da28604a11c8b259.doc: Counts hits that land within 100 frames of the hit that opened the current burst (a later hit restarts slot timer 2 and zeroes the count) and calls do_nothing when the count passes 3. Also raises var 22 every 600 frames (flip form) and var 23 every 1500 frames (go to the sky phase).

da295759f1ffe034.name: rise_and_sway_instead_of_dying
da295759f1ffe034.doc: Raises the stalk, bumps the stage in monster var 17 (stage 6 jumps to 7) and sways until the var is reset, releasing pollen at stage 7. Then it droops and restores full life so the monster never dies.

da3f5ed88d0f805e.name: choose_behavior
da3f5ed88d0f805e.doc: Top-level behaviour pick. Calm monsters fight if the player is within 250 and wander otherwise; aggravated monsters charge or fight within 80; enraged ones use the enraged combat loop.

da47effec46b86e0.name: on_init
da47effec46b86e0.doc: Registers the claw hit boxes for attack 1, loads the three fire shot effects, lifts the monster 20 units, sets flying limits (max height 45) and starts the monster AI.

da50a3dc237047ba.name: idle_or_watch_target
da50a3dc237047ba.doc: Venom spitter idle choice: half the time it plays its idle play motion, first turning to the target on a coin flip; otherwise it stands and waits up to 30 frames for the target to be in view.

da6f377f321e31ac.name: on_dodge_shot
da6f377f321e31ac.doc: Dodge against shots: becomes invulnerable during the dodge in motion, faces the target and plays the dodge return motion.

da881108993d2db0.name: fight_at_close_range
da881108993d2db0.doc: Close range: attack 1, a dodge move, or strafing beside the target.

dabd4666ab0d6362.name: face_player_while_disguised
dabd4666ab0d6362.doc: Idle loop used while the player is disguised: turns toward the player when not facing within 90 degrees, otherwise stands. Ends when the disguise is removed.

dac53b0ab61e0213.name: on_init
dac53b0ab61e0213.doc: Registers attack hit windows for the claw swing and drill attacks, loads the pirate bomb explosion and Pol jet effects, sets the player camera, initial AI mode 2, flying limits (max height 80) and the monster AI.

dad285fd161a3e51.name: stop_current_motion
dad285fd161a3e51.doc: Stops the current motion of the monster and its chained parts (reset_motion); it does not replay it.

dadca0c29378389c.name: play_idle_and_wait
dadca0c29378389c.doc: Plays the idle motion and waits for the target to come into view.

dadf4a3521d8ef91.name: fight_by_range_until_target_leaves
dadf4a3521d8ef91.doc: Fight loop that picks the close, mid or long range action from the distance to the target. It returns when the target is over 360 units away or no rage hits are left.

dae6c93894e059f9.name: fly_to_ring_around_point
dae6c93894e059f9.doc: Flies to a point on a circle of the given radius around a center, on the far side of the monster rotated by an angle offset, turning to face it first. Returns the result of the flight.

dafcfcd2e447710a.name: turn_to_random_angle
dafcfcd2e447710a.doc: Turns left or right of the current heading by 30 + turn_speed + a random 0 to range degrees and waits until facing it. Returns the frames waited; tries is never used because it returns on the first pass.

db053b9ed1f10c4a.name: get_aggro_duration
db053b9ed1f10c4a.doc: Reads the aggro duration in frames, stored in monster variable 2 slot 11, into out[0].

db0d78f2b055f70f.name: play_guard_in_and_out
db0d78f2b055f70f.doc: Plays guard in, the guard knockback, and guard out; 65 percent of the time it holds guard for 8 frames, otherwise it first turns to the target and holds for 60.

db7c3299f058b19b.name: step_back_from_target
db7c3299f058b19b.doc: Plays the step back motion and moves to a point further from the target while taking no damage for the first frames. The parameter is the movement speed.

db86682a9f6799a4.name: idle_until_target_near
db86682a9f6799a4.doc: Circles or watches until the target comes within 225.

db86ec945e76e8ee.name: wander_until_target_detected
db86ec945e76e8ee.doc: Idle behaviour for an unaware monster: turns away from walls, drifts toward its home point, circles, wanders or stands waiting. Returns 1 when it notices the target.

db8fa0030d2b2258.name: rush_in_on_dodge_shot
db8fa0030d2b2258.doc: Dodge reaction to gunshots: when monster var 0 has bit 2, 4 or 16 set (winding up or firing nose bullets, or standing watch) or the player is over 300 units away, runs straight at the player (6 units per frame, up to 90 frames) and does the shockwave charge; otherwise does nothing.

dbaaa810462d3a39.name: wind_up_and_charge
dbaaa810462d3a39.doc: Holds the attack 1 pose for wind_up_periods periods of 15 frames, faces the target, then rushes it for charge_frames frames at 3 units per frame per period, so longer wind-ups charge faster. After more than 2 periods it plays the idle play motion for 15 frames per period.

dbabb74ee1f94ae2.name: do_nothing_arg
dbabb74ee1f94ae2.doc: Takes one int argument and does nothing; used as a placeholder callback.

dbb9262c947e2a5c.name: face_target_on_knockdown
dbb9262c947e2a5c.doc: Knockdown program: locks the monster, turns it to face the target and ends the locked action, with no knockdown animation.

dbbfbda648011310.name: setup_curse_caster
dbbfbda648011310.doc: Registers the attack 1 hit window, loads the curse shot and recovery effects into free texture blocks and starts the heal timer at 90.

dbc6bc3eeb2bde02.name: circle_or_wait_near_target
dbc6bc3eeb2bde02.doc: Used when the monster is not among the nearest attackers: half the time stands watching for the target (30 units, 30 frames), otherwise does nothing. The circling and idle-play branches retest the same roll and can never run.

dbc71c79d61c6081.name: shoot_flame_shot
dbc71c79d61c6081.doc: Turns to the target, plays attack 2 while tracking it, and spawns the looping flame shot at dcol1 with the monster's attack value.

dbee6dff1847bb01.name: command_roses_in_random_pattern
dbee6dff1847bb01.doc: Picks one of six patterns at random and commands all six roses to act: the odd roses then the even ones, the even then the odd, roses 3 to 5 then 0 to 2, or 0 to 2 then 3 to 5 (the two groups 90 frames apart), or one at a time 30 frames apart from rose 5 down to 0 or from 0 up to 5. It then waits 90 frames.

dbf6d12eccbc71da.name: wait_until_target_detected
dbf6d12eccbc71da.doc: Waits up to max_frames for the monster to detect the target with the given detection parameters. Returns 1 if detected, 0 on timeout.

dbfe286321712333.name: wait_motion_time
dbfe286321712333.doc: Waits until the motion progress is within tolerance of the given time or the motion ends. A tolerance of -1 means 0.03.

dc098fa276fea1a1.name: hover_random_direction
dc098fa276fea1a1.doc: Meant to turn by a random angle of up to angle_range degrees and fly base_distance plus speed plus a random distance up to distance_range at height_offset above the ground, or only the random distance when a wall is within 100 units ahead, returning -1 when that wall is closer than clearance. The turn, facing, clearance and move calls are old-numbered and reach unrelated natives, so the monster neither turns nor flies; otherwise it returns an unset value.

dc14f001af5bc0b6.name: move_in_direction
dc14f001af5bc0b6.doc: Moves dist units along an absolute angle without turning first.

dc1f655573b2efda.name: guard_and_counter
dc1f655573b2efda.doc: Guards a hit with a knockback and afterwards counterattacks 30 percent of the time with attack 2.

dc7c4b6194b8eedf.name: circle_or_hold
dc7c4b6194b8eedf.doc: Half the time circles the target at 120 to 150 units, otherwise stands and watches.

dcbbcb2581cfdccd.name: wait_target_in_view
dcbbcb2581cfdccd.doc: Waits up to max_frames, returning 1 as soon as the target is within max_dist and half_angle_deg of the monster's facing, else 0.

dcc244b9f9b19f2e.name: charge_and_maybe_shoot
dcc244b9f9b19f2e.doc: Runs at the target for up to 60 frames and, if it does not reach it, rises back to hover height; then 70% of the time shoots an elemental ball.

dcd0153c556f4040.name: fly_backward
dcd0153c556f4040.doc: Flies backward away from the current heading. The distance is never set, so the move stays in place.

dcd3e3e878ffc92f.name: approach_until_in_range
dcd3e3e878ffc92f.doc: Walks toward the target, or stands and watches, until it is within 330. Not called by this script.

dcdb264f83e0baaa.name: swoop_at_target
dcdb264f83e0baaa.doc: Turns to the target, plays attack 1 and swoops down onto the target position it had when the attack began, then stands.

dcee85b294025c98.name: run_at_target
dcee85b294025c98.doc: Runs toward the target for up to 120 frames.

dd32a0e7e1e204d6.name: attack_by_distance
dd32a0e7e1e204d6.doc: Plays attack 1 if the target is under 30 units away, otherwise attack 2, then stands for 3 frames.

dd55a530095ff866.name: turn_toward_target_with_offset
dd55a530095ff866.doc: Turns toward the target, with offset_chance percent probability of aiming offset_deg to a random side, and waits for the turn.

dd5b4dcda7fd17b8.name: retreat_while_target_far
dd5b4dcda7fd17b8.doc: Loop for when the player is 1200 or more units away: sets var 5 to 8, then each round leaves the magma if in it, or else walks to a ring point and fires the flame ring, 80 percent of the time then diving into the magma pool nearest the player. Returns 0 once the player is back within 1200 units. Nothing in this script calls it.

dd6251fa106f785a.name: sidestep_with_brief_invulnerability
dd6251fa106f785a.doc: Steps randomly left or right and takes no damage for frames 5 to 20 of the step, then returns to standing.

dd6cf1955c49817d.name: wait_forever
dd6cf1955c49817d.doc: Waits frame after frame, never returning.

dd73aa4c5384665d.name: approach_distant_target
dd73aa4c5384665d.doc: Loop that returns once the target is within 240 units: side-steps around it, turns toward it or stands watching.

dd7838e500590c4e.name: turn_random_side
dd7838e500590c4e.doc: Turns left or right (50/50) by a random amount up to angle_range plus turn_speed_deg plus 30 degrees, waits for the turn and returns the frames used. Returns on the first try, so the retry loop never repeats.

dd79722f63bec2dd.name: run_flying_monster_ai_loop
dd79722f63bec2dd.doc: Main loop: while rage hits remain it fights by distance when the target is within 220 units horizontally, otherwise picks a wandering flying action; with no rage hits left it runs the no-rage fight loop.

dd8127ccc06278d4.name: wait_move_end_update
dd8127ccc06278d4.doc: Waits up to max_frames for the current move to end. Returns 0 when it ended, with no defined result on timeout.

ddc2c4b3a7362ef2.name: recover_after_throw
ddc2c4b3a7362ef2.doc: Recovers from a throw, waits 10 frames, re-enables scripted movement and resets the motion.

ddc8f73325df8423.name: walk_around_point
ddc8f73325df8423.doc: Turns toward and walks to a point on a circle around a fixed position.

ddcf197264002267.name: get_target_state_flags
ddcf197264002267.doc: Returns bit flags about the target: 4 when facing it within 30 degrees, 8 otherwise, 1 within 160 units, 2 farther away, and 16 when facing it within 22.5 degrees and within 60 units.

ddf1a256ac61f53f.name: wait_target_in_view
ddf1a256ac61f53f.doc: Waits up to max_frames for the target to be within view distance and angle. Returns 1 if seen, 0 on timeout.

ddf7fa8e2afeab13.name: on_death
ddf7fa8e2afeab13.doc: Falls to the ground and plays the death motion.

de2c468e72f2543f.name: walk_random_direction
de2c468e72f2543f.doc: Meant to turn up to angle_range degrees, but converts the range to radians and then the random turn to radians again, so it turns a whole number of degrees from 0 to about angle_range/57, always to the same side (under 57 it does not turn). If 100 units ahead are clear it walks base_dist + move_speed plus a random 0 to dist_range units; if less is clear but more than clearance it walks just the random amount; otherwise it returns -1 without moving. clearance is also the stop distance of the wait: returns 1 if the target comes within clearance, 2 when the walk ends, 0 after max_frames.

de36274faca15191.name: dash_step_right
de36274faca15191.doc: Sidestep to the right, invulnerable from frame 10 to 24: when the target is within 120 units it heads for a point 200 units to its right at 3.6 per frame (about 50 units covered), otherwise it steps in to a point 90 units from the target, 30 degrees to its side, while turning to face it.

de4d91fe47837d76.name: get_max_height
de4d91fe47837d76.doc: Writes into out[0] the highest height above ground this flyer may reach (monster variable set 2, slot 17).

de62921ff146142a.name: wait_turn_watch_target
de62921ff146142a.doc: Waits while turning toward an angle. Returns -1 at once if the target comes into view, otherwise the frames waited.

de662ea0f6fe3b1e.name: update_and_wait
de662ea0f6fe3b1e.doc: Runs the per-frame life bookkeeping, then waits one frame. Every blocking helper in this script ticks through here.

de6e2775f182d070.name: move_to_circle_start
de6e2775f182d070.doc: Sets state 8 and moves the light 45 frames to a point 30 units around its current position, then sets state 16.

de8f82798ade63c9.name: swing_attack_three
de8f82798ade63c9.doc: Turns to the target and plays the attack 3 motion.

de93d9170e2b2645.name: react_if_player_disguised
de93d9170e2b2645.doc: If the player is disguised in the form this monster's kind recognises as its own (get_player_disguise is not -1), runs face_target_while_disguised until that ends; otherwise returns at once. The monster kind it passes is not used.

dec5dd6243daf4ce.name: on_init
dec5dd6243daf4ce.doc: Registers the weak knockback attack hit, loads the shockwave and nose shot effects into a free texture block and sets a huge clip distance.

deda7bf83cb66452.name: cast_magic_burst
deda7bf83cb66452.doc: Plays the magic motion and spawns one or two Gil magic bolts (50 percent chance of a spread of two) at the target, at 1.2 times its attack power. The monster is invulnerable for 48 frames.

dee5cec80bc06de3.name: run_toward_target_and_shoot
dee5cec80bc06de3.doc: Runs toward the target and, 70 percent of the time when within 295, shoots the petrify shot.
