def1c8da605303c0.name: get_butterfly_slot
def1c8da605303c0.doc: Returns the formation slot stored for the butterfly.

df08f516d8552e63.name: wait_frames_update
df08f516d8552e63.doc: Waits the given number of frames, checking the low life event each frame.

df16ab8425642e29.name: fight_at_mid_range
df16ab8425642e29.doc: Mid range choice: may charge, then shoots (sometimes after flanking) or flies around the target.

df1d5c96b012b5bb.doc: Prints the debug text 'shot escape' and does nothing else.

df2e31f8950f31a1.name: dodge_melee_by_stepping_back
df2e31f8950f31a1.doc: Steps backward, then restores guard and dodge.

df4316d71a1652e8.name: setup_feather_flyer
df4316d71a1652e8.doc: Meant to forbid guard and dodge, halt, turn on free velocity and no map collision, set a 9999.9 clip distance, load the three Griffon feather effects and store the position in the globals. Only the player camera mode is set as meant: the other calls are old-numbered and reach unrelated natives (set_visible_monster_limit, set_photo_window, stop_color_pulse, get_entry_object_pos), and store_position_in_globals reads nothing, leaving spawn_y 0.

df4cd2f57e431112.name: dodge_melee_by_stepping_back
df4cd2f57e431112.doc: Dodges a melee attack by turning to the target and stepping back.

df5a61ac21d2f599.name: on_update
df5a61ac21d2f599.doc: Allows guard and dodge, stops sound effect 5, and runs one decision step every frame.

df757dc81189aed1.name: orbit_leader_step
df757dc81189aed1.doc: Places the monster on its orbit around the leader monster at the stored angles, then advances both angles by angle_step.

df7ad6dd1916347f.name: turn_to_target_and_wait
df7ad6dd1916347f.doc: Starts turning toward the target and waits until the monster faces it, using wait_turn_to_angle with a limit of 360 frames, then stops turning. Returns the frames spent turning.

df8d388d833836f9.name: check_life_change
df8d388d833836f9.doc: Compares the monster's life to the value saved last call. Returns 1 when it is dead, 2 when it lost life (recording the hit), 0 otherwise; saves the new life each time.

df9853b6eefd5c6c.name: begin_knockdown_state
df9853b6eefd5c6c.doc: Starts a knockdown: forbids guard and dodge, resets the motion, stops turning, waits a frame, turns scripted flight off and sets act status 1. Unused here; the counterpart of end_knockdown_and_resume_flight.

dfab6e09561a6c9b.name: wait_motion_watch_target
dfab6e09561a6c9b.doc: Waits for the current motion to end. Returns 1 early if the target comes into view, 0 when the motion ends.

dfde3553812ae42a.name: idle_forever
dfde3553812ae42a.doc: Updates and waits every frame forever.

dfe27edc2de9061b.name: knock_flying_then_faint
dfe27edc2de9061b.doc: Stun program: clears no-damage and halts, plays the knocked-flying and get-up motions, then plays the faint motion until the stun stars run out and allows guard and dodge again.

dfea7beeb693bd2c.name: counter_or_sidestep_shot
dfea7beeb693bd2c.doc: Reacts to a shot with a cross cutter counter (70 percent) or a sidestep, to the right when the world yaw toward the target is negative and to the left otherwise.

dfeec0aea733c9dd.name: track_monster_until_time
dfeec0aea733c9dd.doc: Keeps turning toward another monster until the motion reaches the given time.

e02d7814d47c0914.name: slam_ground_with_attack_4
e02d7814d47c0914.doc: Plays attack 4, spawns a shockwave at the dcol01 bone position 14 frames in and shakes the camera; the mirror of slam_ground_with_attack_3, used when the target is on the other side.

e05105348ac5c61e.name: fall_until_landed
e05105348ac5c61e.doc: Stops moving, starts the death drops and plays the damage motion until the monster is on the ground.

e0620b7268af3c89.name: turn_and_attack_1
e0620b7268af3c89.doc: Faces the target, plays the first attack motion to its end, then stands for 9 frames. Sets state 1 with the walk motion first.

e06fe6da671458c4.name: on_death
e06fe6da671458c4.doc: Stops its sounds, plays the death motion and loop, then runs event script 504 and finishes dying.

e076d39e99c0a6a2.name: shoot_ice_shot
e076d39e99c0a6a2.doc: Turns to the target, plays attack 2 and spawns the ice shot effects from the face, passing the monster's attack value to the shot.

e07c78dfd52f7852.name: fight_after_rage_ends
e07c78dfd52f7852.doc: Fighting loop used once no rage hits are left. It walks up to the target and uses a dash attack or an attack combo, and walks toward it when over 95 units away. Returns when rage hits are available again.

e08bdba790d94b04.name: record_floor_time
e08bdba790d94b04.doc: Stores the current floor timer in monster var 3 plus the slot, marking when an action last happened.

e0a642bc17cb7f60.name: attack_at_far_range
e0a642bc17cb7f60.doc: Fires a holy shot or flies around the target. The roll is never set, so the branch is fixed by the uninitialised value.

e0ba92177e650530.name: react_to_player_disguise
e0ba92177e650530.doc: If the player is disguised, runs the follow behavior.

e0d23c96fee51918.name: track_monster_frames
e0d23c96fee51918.doc: Keeps turning toward another monster for the given number of frames.

e0e58cf785c7294d.name: heal_weakest_ally
e0e58cf785c7294d.doc: When the heal timer in monster var 7 is at least 300, finds the monster within 150 units with the lowest life (or itself) and, if that is under 90% life, casts the recovery spell on it, healing about 24% to 30% of its maximum life with a green damage number, and resets the timer. Returns 0 at once while the timer is under 300 and 0 if the target dies during the cast, -1 when nothing needed healing; after a heal the return value is undefined.

e0f0dc65504d1681.name: shoot_ice_ball
e0f0dc65504d1681.doc: Plays attack 1, tracking the target, and spawns an ice shot from the dcol0 point, then the looping ice shot carrying the monster's attack power.

e0f3c78b79b11673.name: wait_forever
e0f3c78b79b11673.doc: Waits forever with a bare wait each frame, skipping the per-frame update that idle_forever runs; scripts use it as the lifted program.

e0fab457f9ef6c2e.name: turn_until_facing_or_target_seen
e0fab457f9ef6c2e.doc: Like turning to an angle but returns -1 as soon as the target comes into view. Otherwise returns the frames waited.

e110e11a88d2686a.name: dodge_melee_by_sidestep
e110e11a88d2686a.doc: Dodges a melee attack by turning to the target and making an invulnerable sidestep. The roll is always below 20, so the step-back branch is never reached.

e13917111c171ba0.name: raise_guard_and_hold
e13917111c171ba0.doc: Uninterruptible guard: raises the guard, holds it briefly, lowers it and stands.

e13baa43326e1c44.name: fly_to_height
e13baa43326e1c44.doc: Moves vertically toward target_y at the given speed for up to max_frames, stopping inside the tolerance. Returns 1 on arrival, a collision code if blocked, 0 on timeout.

e14a80288f7b7769.name: scan_left_and_right_for_target
e14a80288f7b7769.doc: Turns left, right, right again and left again by the given angle, waiting after each turn for the target to appear within the view distance. Returns 0 as soon as the target is seen.

e14c650eb35524b5.name: side_step_invulnerable
e14c650eb35524b5.doc: Plays the left or right side step motion (random) and, after 6 frames, heads for a point 100 units to that side at 1.75 units per frame, stopping 8 frames later (about 14 units). It takes no damage only during those 8 moving frames, then waits for the motion to end and stands.

e156f6385affc1d1.name: attack_at_mid_range
e156f6385affc1d1.doc: Mid range attack choice: within 303 units it rushes (20 percent) or fires zero to two circling arrows; beyond that it curves toward the target (10 percent) or shoots an aimed arrow. After the arrows it watches the player for 9 frames and returns 1 if the sky phase started.

e177c977ad506453.name: step_back_dodge
e177c977ad506453.doc: Plays the backstep motion while invulnerable and, after 8 frames, moves toward a point 100 units behind at 4.5 units per frame for only 7 frames (about 30 units), then waits for the motion to end and stands.

e18f471a3cbc0096.name: wait_for_move_end_or_target_near
e18f471a3cbc0096.doc: Runs frames while the move started by move_to runs. Returns 1 when the target comes within stop_dist, 2 when the move ends and 0 on timeout.

e195acab64c55b44.name: wander_or_watch
e195acab64c55b44.doc: Half the time sets state 64 and walks a random arc around the target about 200 to 230 units out, then turns to face it. Otherwise sets state 16, stands and waits up to 30 frames for the target to come into view.

e1966c56dfcc5d81.name: approach_at_far_range
e1966c56dfcc5d81.doc: Mostly runs at the target, sometimes walks toward it or waits.

e1c38083a7345b7c.name: recover_from_throw_and_fly
e1c38083a7345b7c.doc: Recovers from a throw, waits 10 frames and resumes scripted flight.

e1cb000f1955897f.name: fly_sideways
e1cb000f1955897f.doc: Flies 300 units to the left or right of its current facing.

e1eca3a4e0c4010c.name: turn_to_target_and_attack
e1eca3a4e0c4010c.doc: Walks while turning to face the target, plays attack 2, then stands for 9 frames.

e1f26b453299c244.name: fight_by_distance
e1f26b453299c244.doc: Picks the far (160 to 290), mid (100 to 160) or close behaviour by flat distance to the target, or circles if too many monsters are attacking.

e201dcc12437c0b2.name: face_shooter_on_dodge_shot
e201dcc12437c0b2.doc: Dodge reaction to gunshots that neither dodges nor attacks: halts, snaps to face the target, turns toward it with the walk motion, stands and allows guarding and dodging again.

e2256979db7ef5c9.name: wait_frame_tracking_damage
e2256979db7ef5c9.doc: Runs the damage and timer tracking and waits one frame. Most waits in this file go through it.

e22781691600af62.name: move_around_point
e22781691600af62.doc: Turns and walks to the point distance units from x, y, z on the monster's own side of it, swung angle degrees around it. Returns the wait_for_move_or_target_near result.

e23df919cb9fea72.name: turn_and_walk_in_direction
e23df919cb9fea72.doc: Turns to an angle and walks the given distance in that direction. Returns the wait_move_until_near_target result.

e26c99c4a931ea37.name: watch_disguised_player
e26c99c4a931ea37.doc: Stands and turns to face the player for as long as the player is in a disguise, returning once the disguise ends.

e26e4a4da9c88d72.name: run_monster_ai_loop
e26e4a4da9c88d72.doc: Allows guarding and dodging and stands, then runs the shared monster 189 behaviour routines every frame.

e26ef575abfb4e5f.name: on_dodge_shot
e26ef575abfb4e5f.doc: Dodge: snaps to face the target, turns to it walking, then stands and unlocks.

e27674db42d83c17.name: wait_for_roses_ready
e27674db42d83c17.doc: Waits the given frames and until all roses are in state 0, then returns the next phase number 2.

e276ed1996329a38.name: init_swinging_monster
e276ed1996329a38.doc: Registers the weak attack hit for attack 1 and sets up the AI.

e29477a01f33f0fb.name: idle_for_frames
e29477a01f33f0fb.doc: Stops, plays the stand motion and waits the given number of frames.

e2a4a7625482f54b.name: wait_out_fear_delay
e2a4a7625482f54b.doc: Waits for the number of frames stored in monster variable 4, then resets that variable to 30.

e2ad770d9c4470df.name: fight_by_distance_until_enraged
e2ad770d9c4470df.doc: Loop that picks close, mid or far fighting by target distance. Returns when the target is over 310 units away or the rage counter hits zero.

e2cc172e1b1d80ec.name: fight_by_range_until_target_leaves
e2cc172e1b1d80ec.doc: Fight loop that watches a disguised player, heals weak monsters, and picks the close, mid or long range action. It returns when the target is over 255 units away or no rage hits are left.

e2d4b26373007a22.name: setup_melee_monster
e2d4b26373007a22.doc: Init program: registers the hit windows of attacks 1, 2 and 3 (attack 3 is the weak attack) and starts the monster AI.

e2efc7c45973ec9f.name: on_update
e2efc7c45973ec9f.doc: Main loop: runs one AI decision every frame.

e3022474f7b94812.name: wander_toward_random_heading
e3022474f7b94812.doc: Meant to turn up to max_angle_deg, but converts the range to radians and then the random turn to radians again, so it turns a whole number of degrees from 0 to about max_angle_deg/57, always to the same side. If 100 units ahead are clear it walks min_dist + speed plus a random 0 to max_dist units; if less is clear but more than wall_margin it walks just the random amount; otherwise it returns -1 without moving. Then returns the wait result: 1 if the target comes within wall_margin, 2 when the walk ends, 0 after max_frames.

e314bc710c8417d7.name: fly_toward_angle_updating
e314bc710c8417d7.doc: Flies a distance in the direction of an angle without turning first.

e318ae83d4182104.name: check_player_disguise
e318ae83d4182104.doc: If the player is disguised, hovers until the disguise ends.

e319fd2ad53f9362.name: turn_by_angle
e319fd2ad53f9362.doc: Turns relative to the current heading by delta_deg and waits until done.

e32a1ad0eb794646.name: skirt_target_and_charge
e32a1ad0eb794646.doc: Loops moving to a random point around the target and pausing; returns 0 if the target is farther than 200. Once enraged it charges with a 40 percent chance each round.

e33064b7a9adc5ed.name: run_ai_loop
e33064b7a9adc5ed.doc: Allows guard and dodge, then runs the behaviour step every frame.

e344f5c0ca7599d3.name: fight_at_mid_range
e344f5c0ca7599d3.doc: Mid-range choice (110 to 170 units): stands watching the target or walks closer.

e34a188b6abea3b4.name: perform_drill_charge
e34a188b6abea3b4.doc: Drill attack, used when the target is at least 110 units away. Rises, loops the drill motion while curving into the target position, then returns to the ground. Monster variable 15 is 1 for the duration, which makes damage reactions play the stagger motions.

e34b05f12ed4fdb8.name: run_behavior_forever
e34b05f12ed4fdb8.doc: Main loop: runs the top level behaviour choice every frame.

e352c4384fac2417.name: sidestep_invulnerable
e352c4384fac2417.doc: Dodge for shots: with damage disabled it steps 30 degrees left or right around the target.

e35db9e868bef4b5.name: on_init
e35db9e868bef4b5.doc: Clears the state variables, starts the frightened stand motion and makes this creature impossible to lock on to or damage.

e360d0b8c3f848e3.name: wait_turn_to_angle
e360d0b8c3f848e3.doc: Waits until the yaw is within the turn speed of the requested angle or max_frames pass, then stops turning. Returns the frames waited.

e389ad5594b4ac72.name: chase_target_clear
e389ad5594b4ac72.doc: Turns to face the target, then chases it each frame for up to max_frames, probing 25 units above the ground for walls move_speed + stop_dist ahead. Returns -1 when within stop_dist, -2 when the probe hits a wall, otherwise the frames used.

e3b8c76e11b82459.name: dodge_shot_by_side_step
e3b8c76e11b82459.doc: Steps sideways away from a shot, then restores guard and dodge.

e3b93f287da33d27.name: fly_chase_target
e3b93f287da33d27.doc: Flies at the target each frame, re-aiming as it moves, optionally tilting the model toward it. Returns 1 on arrival, the blocking result if blocked, 0 on timeout.

e3d256f0efdd4e66.name: face_target_after_dodge
e3d256f0efdd4e66.doc: Snaps to face the target, stands, and re-enables guard and dodge.

e3d5179b521b5082.name: get_seagra_index
e3d5179b521b5082.doc: Writes this piece's index (0 to 5) into out_index[0].

e3ddd3d382a55184.name: dodge_melee_by_backstepping
e3ddd3d382a55184.doc: Faces the target and backsteps; with 80 percent chance (40 when it can be enraged) it follows with a counter lunge via the dodge-and-counter routine.

e3f021681638385b.name: act_at_long_range
e3f021681638385b.doc: Long range choice: run or walk toward the target, or stand and watch.

e40989fa69cc21f4.name: wander_while_idle
e40989fa69cc21f4.doc: Idle behaviour while no target is engaged: turns away from walls, drifts back toward home when far from it, and otherwise randomly stands watching, turns, circles the target or walks around. Returns 1 when a target is detected.

e409c6555923c160.name: set_scale_params
e409c6555923c160.doc: Stores the current scale, per-frame scale change and its limits in monster vars 11, 10, 12 and 13.

e41036762b3447d5.name: turn_to_angle_and_wait
e41036762b3447d5.doc: Starts turning toward an absolute yaw in degrees and waits until it is reached. Returns the frames waited.

e43ab24499ad072f.name: decide_behavior
e43ab24499ad072f.doc: One AI step. Unaggroed: wanders, or acts on the situation if the target is under 100 units. Aggroed: within 75 it resets the guard rate to normal, drops aggro and acts on the situation; elsewhere inside the aggro range it quadruples its guard rate and charges; outside the range it resets the guard rate and drops aggro.

e43d0c5372d5df8e.name: on_init
e43d0c5372d5df8e.doc: Registers the weak knockback attack hits for attacks 1, 2 and the spin, loads the spin effect and sets up aggro and clip distance.

e453fb26bdb3fe7c.name: fight_at_close_range
e453fb26bdb3fe7c.doc: Close range choice: attack 2 or a lunge, circling the target, or stepping back invulnerable.

e4708067994aba5b.name: rise_instead_of_dying
e4708067994aba5b.doc: Runs the rise and sway sequence instead of dying.

e4761e46d61702dc.name: setup_light_orb
e4761e46d61702dc.doc: Disables guard and dodge and map and body collision, clears the movement vars and loads the Atla light effect.

e478e76693a06414.name: wander_while_idle
e478e76693a06414.doc: Idle behaviour while no target is engaged: turns away from walls, drifts back toward home when far from it, and otherwise randomly stands watching, turns, circles the target or walks around. Returns 1 when a target is detected.

e49c9fd320bd1703.name: run_toward_target
e49c9fd320bd1703.doc: Runs at the target for up to 120 frames and then stands.

e4a0ce09a0c1433e.name: recoil_from_hit
e4a0ce09a0c1433e.doc: Stops all actions, plays the damage motion with pushback and returns to the idle behaviour.

e4a403ac8ad3d467.name: scan_left_and_right
e4a403ac8ad3d467.doc: Turns by angle_deg right, left, left and right again, waiting wait_frames at each heading. Returns 1 as soon as the target is in view.

e4cbab821ac5add5.name: choose_next_action
e4cbab821ac5add5.doc: Takes the queued action in monster vars 2 and 3 if there is one; otherwise queues a stand and wait of 60 to 119 frames after a wander. Always returns 0.

e4e5d0a01887d57a.name: step_sideways_around_target
e4e5d0a01887d57a.doc: Plays the step left or right motion and moves to a point 45 degrees around the target, taking no damage while moving.

e4fb0451b22f333b.name: wait_until_turned_to_angle
e4fb0451b22f333b.doc: Waits until the monster's yaw is within tolerance of angle_deg or max_frames pass, then stops turning. Returns the frames waited.

e4fd30d18cd5bcfb.name: init_monster_ai
e4fd30d18cd5bcfb.doc: Sets default aggro values: range 500, near range 80, no damage minimum, aggro off, aggro duration 150 frames and timer 0. Records the spawn position (y zeroed) and sets clip distance 35 (700 world units) for normal monsters or 999999 for bosses.

e50e477471c13a69.name: fly_wander_random
e50e477471c13a69.doc: Turns to a random angle and flies min_dist plus a random distance in that direction at the given height. Returns the fly_to_point result.

e513c1c8c82e9d20.name: chase_target_until_near
e513c1c8c82e9d20.doc: Walks toward the target while turning to it. Returns -1 if within stop_dist, otherwise the frames spent.

e527422d9b549b7a.name: move_random_offset
e527422d9b549b7a.doc: Moves a random distance in a random direction around its heading, without a clearance check.

e538d8ad16029ce1.name: swoop_and_pull_back
e538d8ad16029ce1.doc: Turns to the target and plays attack 1, then flies at 5.25 units per frame to 10 units above the ground at the target's starting position (up to 60 frames). It then faces the target and, with the attack 1 out motion, flies toward a point 150 units beyond itself on the far side from the target, 50 units above the ground, at 2.1 units per frame for at most 30 frames (about 63 units).

e55073fbb10eb95b.name: fight_mid_range
e55073fbb10eb95b.doc: Mid range choices: fly fast toward the target, wait, or circle it.

e5725cb9f406b8d3.name: apply_scale_step
e5725cb9f406b8d3.doc: Adds the per-frame rate to the model scale while it stays between the limits, and applies it.

e58843469786ce54.name: face_then_chase_target
e58843469786ce54.doc: Faces the target, then chases it for up to max_frames, each frame heading for the point move_speed + stop_dist ahead toward it. Returns -1 once within stop_dist, otherwise the frames spent.

e5a82425ccc35ce7.name: write_monster_var_16
e5a82425ccc35ce7.doc: Stores a value in monster variable 16.

e5b3e295205eee37.name: wait_frame_checking_death
e5b3e295205eee37.doc: Waits one frame, but first, if monster variable 64 (the death flag) is set, plays the death sequence with the item drops and never returns. Used in place of a bare wait by the movement helpers.

e5bdea2b6d0c9683.name: wait_turn_watch_target
e5bdea2b6d0c9683.doc: Waits for a turn toward angle_deg to finish, but returns -1 at once if the target comes into view. Otherwise returns the frames waited.

e5caf6611007f2be.name: fight_at_long_range
e5caf6611007f2be.doc: Long range choice: dash at the target, walk toward it, or fire a short rocket volley. Sometimes plays with the target first at high life.

e5d17b02aebb4293.name: fly_backward_updating
e5d17b02aebb4293.doc: Meant to fly backward, away from the monster's facing, at hover_height above the ground, but the distance is never set, so how far it goes is undefined; the return value is undefined too.

e5ee34d906fe5a95.name: step_back_with_invincibility
e5ee34d906fe5a95.doc: Plays the step back motion, makes the monster undamageable from frame 5 to frame 16 (6 and 20 scaled to PAL), then switches to the stand loop without waiting for the step to finish.

e5f376d9ab90077c.name: wait_motion_watch_target
e5f376d9ab90077c.doc: Waits frame by frame until the current motion ends or the target comes into view. Returns 0 when the motion ended, 1 when the target was seen first.

e6184538aad10437.name: turn_and_fly_to_target_spot
e6184538aad10437.doc: Turns to the target, then flies to the spot where the target stood when the move began, hovering above the ground. Returns 1 on arrival, the blocking result if blocked, 0 on timeout.

e62bbfaffa0d0b03.name: fly_sideways
e62bbfaffa0d0b03.doc: Flies 300 units to the left (go_left) or right of the monster's facing via fly_to_point at ground height plus height. The result of the flight is not captured, so the return value is undefined.

e6349dafde5b4580.name: wait_motion_end_update
e6349dafde5b4580.doc: Waits until the current motion ends, checking the low life event each frame. Always returns 1.

e636f156e412d93b.name: recover_after_throw_landing
e636f156e412d93b.doc: Land program: recovers from the throw with scripted flight restored, waits, gets up and sets its height 10 above the ground. Returns 1.

e64c63e4ff23e8af.name: run_battle_ai
e64c63e4ff23e8af.doc: Allows guarding and dodging and then picks a new action forever.

e659b3447aacacd7.name: cast_magic_barrage
e659b3447aacacd7.doc: If the target is within 90 it casts the close burst. Otherwise it charges and then fires 3 to 4 looping Gil magic effects at 1.1 times its attack power.

e674c26995529f4d.name: act_at_mid_range
e674c26995529f4d.doc: Calm mid-range choice: turn and charge, walk up, do nothing, or strafe around the player.

e689b7f2d8bb2253.name: fight_at_mid_range
e689b7f2d8bb2253.doc: Mid range choice: summon monsters, walk toward the target, wander in a random direction, or stand watching it.

e696d38fa62d21ea.name: pick_far_range_action
e696d38fa62d21ea.doc: Chooses an action for a target 200 to 240 units away: a thunder shot or flying around the target at 45 degrees. The roll it checks is never drawn, so the choice depends on a stale value.

e6a042e3e7aad81d.name: smash_with_both_hands
e6a042e3e7aad81d.doc: Plays the smash motion and spawns a Vanguard shockwave at each hand on the ground, shaking the camera.

e6a265c7aaecd0bb.name: stop_and_forbid_dodge
e6a265c7aaecd0bb.doc: Sets the no-dodge mask flag and stops the current motion, movement and turning. allow_dodge_again clears the flag.

e6dd07c8a05d9b92.name: track_monster_until_time
e6dd07c8a05d9b92.doc: Keeps turning toward another monster until the current motion reaches the given progress.

e700698b9c1a5259.name: face_target_and_step_sideways
e700698b9c1a5259.doc: Dodge program for shots: halts, turns to face the target, steps 100 units to a random side, returns to standing and allows guarding and dodging again. step_sideways sets and clears the no-damage bit in the same frame, so the step is not invulnerable.

e710be47e316f807.name: fight_while_calm
e710be47e316f807.doc: Combat loop before the monster is enraged: picks the close, mid (95 to 145) or far (145 to 225) routine by target distance. Returns when the target is too far or the monster becomes enraged.

e7136cd3ba239fdc.name: sidestep_invulnerable
e7136cd3ba239fdc.doc: Steps left or right at random to a point around the target while taking no damage, ending with the damage immunity switched off.

e717c12f26050978.name: orbit_owner_and_cast_light
e717c12f26050978.doc: Update program of the yellow light. Whenever the command in monster var 30 is 4 and the angle step is not within 0.0004 of zero it rises above the owner; state 2 in var 29 then moves to the circle start, state 16 circles with the light effect, and state 64 flies back to the orbit position and sets state 4. Every frame it orbits the owner with an angle step that swings between plus and minus pi/32.

e71a2e773e70e64f.name: set_attack_enabled
e71a2e773e70e64f.doc: Sets the shared flag (variable 20 plus this piece's index) that lets this piece start its attack.

e72a9983b562cc8b.name: slash_at_target
e72a9983b562cc8b.doc: Turns to the player, swings (attack 1) for 37 frames and stands for 9 frames.

e73ddf2d6901f240.name: wait_or_circle_target
e73ddf2d6901f240.doc: Used when the monster must not attack yet: half the time flies around the target, otherwise stands and watches.

e745e015742bd705.name: load_shot_effects
e745e015742bd705.doc: Init program: resets monster var 0, loads the fast shot, pirate bomb explosion and M smoke effects into a free texture block when one is available, and starts the monster AI with init_monster_ai.

e7479ee80fad0db5.name: circle_around_point
e7479ee80fad0db5.doc: Walks to a point on a circle of given radius around the centre, offset by the angle from the bearing to that centre.

e75695a40e22697d.name: fly_to_height
e75695a40e22697d.doc: Flies straight up or down to a height. Returns 1 on arrival, a nonzero collision result if blocked, or 0 on timeout.

e75f07bd5e968653.name: record_last_hit
e75f07bd5e968653.doc: Stores the last hit type in monster var 16 and the life lost in var 17.

e76557deda1c4872.name: choose_behaviour
e76557deda1c4872.doc: Per-frame decision. When not aggroed it fights if the target is within 320 units and otherwise wanders; when aggroed it dashes at the target and clears the aggro flag.

e77fbd4baa0760c1.name: turn_to_angle
e77fbd4baa0760c1.doc: Turns to the absolute heading angle_deg at turn_speed_deg degrees per frame, wrapping both to the -180 to 180 range, and waits until the heading is reached or about 360 divided by the speed frames pass. Returns the frames waited.

e79873798bf7e8bc.name: finish_throw_and_return_true
e79873798bf7e8bc.doc: Ends the throw state and returns 1.

e7a1404428b760c8.name: fight_at_mid_range
e7a1404428b760c8.doc: Mid range (90 to 140): attack 2, walking toward the target, or strafing beside it.

e7a8e28be17fcbe0.name: fly_to_point
e7a8e28be17fcbe0.doc: Flies in a straight line toward a point at a fixed height above the ground, stopping when it is within speed plus margin of it or blocked. Returns 1 when it arrived, a non-zero hit code when blocked, 0 when time ran out.

e7bcad9e8db8e41d.name: wait_move_until_near
e7bcad9e8db8e41d.doc: Waits up to max_frames for a move_to walk, checking for death each frame. Returns 1 as soon as the target is within stop_dist, 2 when the walk reaches its point, 0 on timeout; stops moving on 1 or 2 but not on timeout.

e7bd3925f50d3cda.name: back_step_and_cast
e7bd3925f50d3cda.doc: If the target is within 180 units, steps back 80 units and casts a magic burst or barrage (50 percent each). If it is farther and not within 90 degrees ahead, runs at it and attacks instead and returns 0; otherwise casts from where it stands.

e7d128f6393571b9.name: run_ai_step
e7d128f6393571b9.doc: One AI decision: checks the phase change and runs the rose mode or the tornado mode.

e7d835c68861d63a.name: lunge_at_target_attack
e7d835c68861d63a.doc: Attack 3: lunges to the target's position during the swing, then shakes the camera.

e7ef24f04fe93d09.name: approach_then_attack_target
e7ef24f04fe93d09.doc: Update program: lets the monster guard and dodge, then repeatedly runs the attack routine when the target is within 240 units and otherwise walks toward the target.

e7fc7bca387bb749.name: track_monster_frames
e7fc7bca387bb749.doc: Keeps turning toward another monster for the given number of frames.

e81be5b8cb2ac451.name: close_in_on_distant_target
e81be5b8cb2ac451.doc: Walks toward a target further than 250 units, or waits, until the target comes within 250 units.

e822184cd6c79620.name: is_target_within_distance
e822184cd6c79620.doc: Returns 1 if the player is closer than the given distance, else 0.

e8441275bbc5e3a9.name: run_minion_ai
e8441275bbc5e3a9.doc: Update program of the summoned Arch Demon minion. On first spawn (monster variable 0 clear) it plays the fall motion until it is under 30 units above the ground, lands and sets the variable. After that it fights by distance every frame.

e85800e15f86d8a7.name: recoil_from_hit
e85800e15f86d8a7.doc: Plays the damage motion with pushback and returns to standing.

e86c2c5b73a1c650.name: setup_thunder_flyer
e86c2c5b73a1c650.doc: Loads the thunder shot effects, sets up flight with a maximum height of 30, starts the AI and lifts the monster 15 units.

e86c4e19d4704e4c.name: walk_around_point
e86c4e19d4704e4c.doc: Turns toward and walks to a point on a circle around a fixed position.

e87ee5ed1a3ef410.name: rise_gradually
e87ee5ed1a3ef410.doc: Raises the monster by the given height over the given frames while facing the player.

e8a25d2649826d46.name: fly_wander_random
e8a25d2649826d46.doc: Turns a random angle, then flies a random distance forward. Returns the result of the flight.

e8b988727a49240e.name: is_point_in_rect_any_corners
e8b988727a49240e.doc: Like is_point_in_rect, but the two corners may come in either order.

e8ca38cb014d20ab.name: switch_lava_effect
e8ca38cb014d20ab.doc: Starts the dripping lava effect when dripping is nonzero (the heated state, used on diving into magma) or the smoke effect when it is 0 (the cooled state after the surface phase), and ends the other one.

e8ca9818b9eb90d9.name: run_monster_ai
e8ca9818b9eb90d9.doc: Allows guard and dodge, then runs the behaviour pick every frame.

e8d59fb04dadf1ca.name: wait_forever
e8d59fb04dadf1ca.doc: Loops forever, keeping the aggro bookkeeping running.

e8d99a1d18001b60.name: stand_for_frames
e8d99a1d18001b60.doc: Stops moving, plays the stand motion and waits the given frames.

e8fbf050662aadbb.name: fight_until_enraged
e8fbf050662aadbb.doc: Fight loop for the phase before it is enraged (hits left to enrage above 0): circles or watches when other monsters have priority, otherwise fights at far, mid or close range by distance. Returns when the target is beyond 225 or no hits are left to enrage it.

e900558bc78f62bf.name: play_death_and_end_battle
e900558bc78f62bf.doc: Plays the death motion with the quick-dead flag, then runs event script 510 and holds forever.

e93ab1ecb4f37117.name: wait_move_until_near
e93ab1ecb4f37117.doc: Waits up to max_frames for a move_to walk. Returns 1 as soon as the target is within stop_dist, 2 when the walk ends, 0 on timeout; stops moving on 1 or 2.

e943dbc290970ceb.name: fight_calm_mid_range
e943dbc290970ceb.doc: Mid range choice while not enraged: attack, run in, walk in, circle or do nothing.

e963bc08cff6c756.name: setup_pollen_flower
e963bc08cff6c756.doc: Disables map collision and lock-on, loads the rafflesia pollen effects and registers the shokushu (tentacle) frame as action object 0.

e97304091f827f8a.name: fight_at_mid_range
e97304091f827f8a.doc: Mid range choice: usually dashes at the target, otherwise stands, plays, approaches or strafes.

e97a31624e80aded.name: step_back_from_target
e97a31624e80aded.doc: Invulnerable backward step to a point 30 to 40 units further from the target than now, at the given speed, ending in the stand motion.

e992b8d47c4ec3ab.name: charge_at_target
e992b8d47c4ec3ab.doc: Charge attack: attack 1 wind-up while facing the target, then rushes twice the target's distance ahead for charge_frames frames, then the wind-down.

e9959999d650f463.name: charge_at_target
e9959999d650f463.doc: Runs at the target for up to 180 frames and returns to standing.

e99d8fc7e4d18f96.name: on_update
e99d8fc7e4d18f96.doc: Main loop: chooses behavior every frame.

e9a3e8e25b4a4b75.name: turn_to_yaw_at_current_height
e9a3e8e25b4a4b75.doc: Turns to the given yaw at the current height, stopping early if the split signal arrives. It drops the turn's result and always returns 0, so its callers' checks for 5 never succeed.

e9b156c5d44ceb8d.name: dash_with_attack_two
e9b156c5d44ceb8d.doc: Plays attack 2 while dashing at the target for 15 frames.

e9b259b02e2bf565.name: setup_butterfly_boss
e9b259b02e2bf565.doc: Allows up to 15 visible monsters, turns off map and body collision, places the boss at (260, 850, -320), loads the butterfly effects, allows a photo (number 1015) during the whole merge motion and registers frame body2--a40 as action object 0.

e9e389024a96a4ec.name: wander_until_target_detected
e9e389024a96a4ec.doc: Idle behaviour for an unaware monster: turns away from walls, drifts back toward its home point, circles, wanders or stands waiting. Returns 1 when it notices the target.

e9e3c3a82254c0fe.name: walk_to_target_updating
e9e3c3a82254c0fe.doc: Turns to the target and moves toward it if the path is clear. Returns -1 if blocked.

e9eeaa85e276cf8b.name: strafe_or_watch_target
e9eeaa85e276cf8b.doc: Half the time circles the player at about 80 units, otherwise stands watching the player.

ea0264c330422071.name: turn_random_side
ea0264c330422071.doc: Turns to a random side of the current heading, left or right with equal odds, by a random angle up to angle_range plus 30 degrees. Returns the frames spent.

ea087acf06dcbb63.name: run_magma_boss_ai
ea087acf06dcbb63.doc: Turns on velocity-driven movement and turns off map collision, forbids guarding but allows dodging, then runs the range loop forever.

ea0f57c9dd8c0ad1.name: play_damage_then_stun
ea0f57c9dd8c0ad1.doc: Makes the monster damageable, forbids guarding and dodging and halts it, plays the damage motion once, then plays the faint motion until the stun stars run out and allows guarding and dodging again.

ea25a8c5e1bf3950.name: teleport_out
ea25a8c5e1bf3950.doc: First half of a teleport: sets the warping flag, makes the boss invulnerable, plays the San warp effect and fades the model out.

ea26f7c6276b8d4b.name: read_last_hit
ea26f7c6276b8d4b.doc: Reads the last hit type and life lost back from monster variables 6 and 7.

ea3d68ee20bffc9f.name: setup_melee_attacks
ea3d68ee20bffc9f.doc: Registers the swing hit windows for attack 1 and the rolling charge hit windows for attack 2, and initialises the AI.

ea4d33e05dd4e4c7.name: attack_at_close_range
ea4d33e05dd4e4c7.doc: Close-range choice: spin attack, step back and fireball, or retreat directly away from the target.

ea589bf78051bedc.name: track_target_frames
ea589bf78051bedc.doc: Turns toward the target every frame for the given number of frames, then stops turning. Despite the parameter name, turn_speed_deg goes to the turn unconverted, so it is in radians per frame; the values callers give, such as 4.2, make the monster face the target almost at once.

ea860b153d9dffb9.name: turn_to_random_side_of_current_heading
ea860b153d9dffb9.doc: Picks a random yaw to the left or right of the current heading and turns to it. Returns after the first turn, so the stand-and-wait code after it never runs.

ea98450dada9b9f6.name: step_back_from_target
ea98450dada9b9f6.doc: Invulnerable step back to a point farther from the target.

eac4c340a090a13a.name: stand_watching_target
eac4c340a090a13a.doc: Plays the idle play motion and waits for the player to come near.

ead8dc22b55bd2de.name: run_enraged_ai
ead8dc22b55bd2de.doc: Enraged AI loop, used once the rage hits are used up. If the target is within 120 flat units it usually flies in and swoops, otherwise spits fire or flies closer. Returns 0 when rage hits return.

eae0b9835c293f5e.name: choose_far_range_action
eae0b9835c293f5e.doc: Far-range choice at 170 to 280 units, before rage: run at the target, walk toward it, or stand and watch for up to 75 frames.

eaf7138a9c11add9.name: fly_chase_target
eaf7138a9c11add9.doc: Flies after the target, re-aiming each frame, at hover_height above the ground. With pitch_flag it also pitches toward the target.

eb0205364def4851.name: set_aggro_duration
eb0205364def4851.doc: Stores the aggro duration in frames in monster variable 2 slot 11.

eb21b30d2d024252.name: swing_attack
eb21b30d2d024252.doc: Faces the target, plays attack 2 for 28 frames, then stands for 9 frames.

eb2ac09e47c98c6e.name: recoil_from_damage
eb2ac09e47c98c6e.doc: Damage program: stops moving and turning, plays the damage motion with a 3 step knockback, waits for it to end and then 8 more frames.

eb4ef344f0f67b17.name: move_in_direction
eb4ef344f0f67b17.doc: Moves dist units toward angle_deg without turning first, and waits for the move to end or the target to come within stop_dist.

eb623a519a63048f.name: wander_random
eb623a519a63048f.doc: Picks a random heading and distance, turns and walks there if the way ahead is clear. Returns -1 if blocked.

eb77ab52d5df3ce7.name: choose_action_by_rage_and_aggro
eb77ab52d5df3ce7.doc: Per-update choice. With no rage hits left it runs the enraged fight loop. Otherwise, when not aggroed, it fights calmly within 280 units or picks an idle move beyond; when aggroed and the target is inside the aggro range, it clears aggro and fights calmly under 110 units or turns and lunges or shoots a curse bullet from farther; outside the range it just clears aggro.

eb81941c22a35ef0.name: fly_toward_angle
eb81941c22a35ef0.doc: Flies the given distance in the direction of the given angle in degrees, without turning first. Returns the result of the flight.

eb926f9d037c2a40.name: on_knockdown
eb926f9d037c2a40.doc: Locks the monster, plays knocked flying, stays down 15 frames and gets up, then sets monster variable 0 to 1.

ebe8b5524a5ed32b.name: play_attack_1_and_wait
ebe8b5524a5ed32b.doc: Plays the first attack motion and waits for it to end.

ebeb6f6e3c115f8c.name: swing_at_target
ebeb6f6e3c115f8c.doc: Walks up to the player, swings (attack 1) while tracking the player, then recovers to standing.

ebf8f1a92fdf7436.name: run_behaviour_loop
ebf8f1a92fdf7436.doc: Allows guarding and dodging, then runs the behaviour chooser every frame forever.

ec0dee20e0c111c2.name: move_random_offset
ec0dee20e0c111c2.doc: Moves to a point at a random angle and a random distance (base_dist plus up to dist_range) without turning first. Returns the result of wait_move_until_near.

ec130e64424b5b4c.name: orbit_owner_step
ec130e64424b5b4c.doc: Places the light on its orbit around the owning monster using the angles in monster vars 1 and 2, then advances both angles by angle_step.

ec191ca40738bcd8.name: chase_target_updating
ec191ca40738bcd8.doc: Chases the target, updating the boss, until within stop_dist or max_frames pass.

ec26ef7d4c4ff931.name: wander_ahead_randomly
ec26ef7d4c4ff931.doc: Turns a few degrees to one side and walks ahead. The angle range is converted to radians before the random pick and again after it, so the turn is only 0 to 6 degrees for a 360 degree range. With nothing within 100 units ahead it walks base_dist + speed + a random 0 to random_dist; otherwise it walks only the random distance, or returns -1 if a wall is within arrive_dist. Otherwise returns the result of waiting for the move.

ec289dd2045ed613.name: fly_at_target
ec289dd2045ed613.doc: Turns to face the target, then flies toward its position at hover height. Returns 1 on arrival, the blocking result if blocked, 0 on timeout.

ec5a74f6a270500e.name: hide_until_reform_signal
ec5a74f6a270500e.doc: Makes the monster invisible and waits until monster var 8 becomes 9, then returns 3.

ec7903abc9f8fb07.name: wait_motion_end_update
ec7903abc9f8fb07.doc: Waits until the current motion ends, running the aggro update each frame. Has no timeout and returns 1.

ec82fe7d75bef3c0.name: lay_eggs_then_climb_wall
ec82fe7d75bef3c0.doc: Becomes invulnerable and lays six monsters of type 25 behind itself, then climbs the wall with the camera on the player.

ecbce14c7689841b.name: chase_and_attack_one
ecbce14c7689841b.doc: Walks to the target, then plays attack 1 while turning toward it and waits for the motion to finish.

ecc3545d28bf3098.name: turn_randomly_then_chase_if_seen
ecc3545d28bf3098.doc: Turns to a random world heading, stands for 9 frames, then watches for up to 45 frames; if the target comes into view within 300 units it flies after it for up to 150 frames.

ecd05134c911cc8c.name: slash_combo_two_hits
ecd05134c911cc8c.doc: Plays attack 1, then after 18 frames (22 at 30 fps scaled to PAL) switches to attack 2 and waits for it to end.

ecdcc7e42f7c7914.name: maybe_melee_combo
ecdcc7e42f7c7914.doc: On a 50 percent roll, turns to the target, attacks once, and if the target is still within 50 follows with a 1 to 3 hit combo.

ece5cbcd04972547.doc: Prints the debug text 'sword escape' and does nothing else.

ece81ce7461e6b8f.name: track_target_until_time
ece81ce7461e6b8f.doc: Keeps turning toward the target until the current motion's progress is within tolerance of time (default 0.05), then stops turning.

ecf395f00dcbae89.name: fight_at_close_range
ecf395f00dcbae89.doc: Close range choice: 80 percent runs in for the slam or fires nose bullets, otherwise sometimes circles the target.

ecf55d90de86d69e.name: fight_at_close_range
ecf55d90de86d69e.doc: Close range choice (target under 210): mostly runs at the target then swipes or breathes fire, otherwise strafes around it.

ecf56b64e412a97c.name: fight_target_before_rage
ecf56b64e412a97c.doc: Normal fight loop while the monster is not enraged: picks close, mid or far behaviour from the target distance. Returns when the target is further than 250 units or the rage hits are used up.

ecf97b8777f65c5f.name: watch_disguised_player
ecf97b8777f65c5f.doc: Stands still until the player is no longer disguised, turning to face the player whenever it is not within 60 degrees.

ed0bd33be251d2c9.name: wait_target_detected
ed0bd33be251d2c9.doc: Waits up to the frame limit for the monster to see or hear the target. Returns 1 if it did.

ed414a0c0c907dc4.name: wander_or_wait_for_target
ed414a0c0c907dc4.doc: Idle AI turn: steers away from walls, drifts back toward home when far from it, otherwise waits for the target, circles it, wanders or turns at random. Returns 1 when the target is detected while waiting.

ed9e46fbbfcb428a.name: move_random_offset
ed9e46fbbfcb428a.doc: Moves to a point at a random angle and a random distance (base_dist plus up to dist_range) without turning first. Returns the result of wait_move_until_near.

edae157f0a599cf2.name: run_to_flank_position
edae157f0a599cf2.doc: Turns toward a point 165 units from the target at 120 degrees to its left or right, and runs there.

edbbfd838c08b6c6.name: play_with_target
edbbfd838c08b6c6.doc: Walks to face the target, plays the play motion while tracking the target for 67 frames scaled to PAL, then stands.

edcb04e9c9392b64.name: shoot_ultrasonic_waves
edcb04e9c9392b64.doc: Turns to the target, plays attack 1 and at 0.36 of the motion spawns two ultrasonic wave effects, the second offset 60 units to the side, both carrying the monster's attack value.

ede75bef2a6cebab.name: turn_to_target_and_step_back
ede75bef2a6cebab.doc: Snaps to face the target and hops back.

edfeb8754e2d9dcb.name: on_init
edfeb8754e2d9dcb.doc: Starts the floor timer and marks the time, clears the monster variables, turns off body hits and sets an unlimited clip distance.

ee04d35a0c591d86.name: side_step_dodge
ee04d35a0c591d86.doc: Walks 100 units left or right at random while invulnerable.

ee0ad2d6667b1cd4.name: attack_at_close_range
ee0ad2d6667b1cd4.doc: Mostly runs at the target then uses the claw swipe or shockwave, occasionally runs in or circles the target instead.

ee0be6059450b36c.name: wait_target_detected
ee0be6059450b36c.doc: Waits up to max_frames frames until can_detect_target sees or hears the target. Returns 1 on detection, 0 on timeout.

ee1a44a5cd0e2a2e.name: fight_at_mid_range
ee1a44a5cd0e2a2e.doc: Mid range choice: circle the target (35 percent), play idly for one to three rounds, sidestep once or twice while the target stays beyond 95 units, or walk toward the target.

ee37bcce1dbcc512.name: begin_knockdown_state
ee37bcce1dbcc512.doc: Disables guard, dodge and scripted movement and sets the act status to 1 at the start of a knockdown.

ee409abc69fd5eb4.name: choose_wander_action
ee409abc69fd5eb4.doc: Wander AI. Picks a random idle action: turn away from walls, return toward home, walk around the home point or the target, walk straight, or wait and watch for the player. Sets monster var 0 to 1, 4, 8, 16 or 32 to record which action it chose. Returns 1 when it noticed the target.

ee451ed704388267.name: tick_frame
ee451ed704388267.doc: Updates the fight tracking and waits one frame.

ee565a593f0e44a2.name: on_lifted
ee565a593f0e44a2.doc: Plays the struggle motion while lifted.

ee5943d3b2ef5dbf.name: face_player_while_disguised
ee5943d3b2ef5dbf.doc: Stands and turns to face the player until the player is no longer disguised.

ee740f3aa19cc121.name: choose_far_range_action
ee740f3aa19cc121.doc: Far-range choice: walk up to the target, stand and watch, circle it 30 degrees to either side, or turn and use attack 2.

ee79eed1ebd26776.name: chase_target_clear
ee79eed1ebd26776.doc: Chases the target like chase_target_steps but gives up and returns -2 if a wall blocks the line to it, or -1 when already near.

ee7be8fcd82b3755.name: choose_ai_by_rage_and_aggro
ee7be8fcd82b3755.doc: Update step: with rage hits left, uses the normal AI when the target is within range (or the wander behaviour when unaggroed and far, or the chase when aggroed), otherwise runs the no-rage AI.

ee7c61bdd886ebca.name: turn_to_target_limit
ee7c61bdd886ebca.doc: Turns toward the target at the given turn speed and waits up to max_frames.

ee80636c818acb1e.name: turn_or_attack_by_distance
ee80636c818acb1e.doc: Within 75 units, 80% of the time sets the defense rate by facing, turns to face the target closely and stands 10 frames; otherwise walks up and slashes. From 75 to 230 units it turns to face the target (95%) or uses the charge attack.

ee8ff065556b72ef.name: on_lifted
ee8ff065556b72ef.doc: Plays the struggle motion forever while lifted.

eeadf65c84428d2d.name: watch_player_if_disguised
eeadf65c84428d2d.doc: If the player is currently disguised, hands over to the watch routine, otherwise does nothing.

eeb4e3bf73d99f2e.name: fight_while_calm
eeb4e3bf73d99f2e.doc: Combat loop used when the monster has no rage hits left. Charges when the target is within 75, fires nose bullets when it is within 200 or sometimes beyond, and otherwise walks up to the target or circles it. Returns 0 once rage hits are available.

eecb06bab9c946dc.name: turn_by_angle
eecb06bab9c946dc.doc: Turns by an angle relative to the current facing.

eeeac649c2a4423a.name: fly_around_point
eeeac649c2a4423a.doc: Picks the point on a circle of the given radius around a center, shifted by an angle from the line to the monster, turns to it and flies there. Returns the result of fly_straight_to_point.

ef1d0913ee7c20ef.name: track_monster_frames
ef1d0913ee7c20ef.doc: Keeps turning toward another monster for the given number of frames.

ef277ed8c318b5d5.name: walk_to_angle_around_target
ef277ed8c318b5d5.doc: Walks to a point at the given angle around the target at the same distance, returning -1 if there is not enough room.

ef29a16c5c65d638.name: setup_guard_stance
ef29a16c5c65d638.doc: Registers the knockback attack on attack 1, starts in the guard loop and sets the photo window for grade 0 monsters.

ef407c8d1a924a34.name: run_rose_boss_fight
ef407c8d1a924a34.doc: Boss loop: a state machine over the phases above, three hits ending it. When the fight ends it runs event script 501.

ef455ab09b40d587.name: wait_motion_end_or_target_in_view
ef455ab09b40d587.doc: Waits for the motion to end. Returns 1 if the target came into view first, else 0.

ef5997d2409b0a7f.name: wander_when_idle
ef5997d2409b0a7f.doc: Idle behaviour (not called by this boss's main loop): flies away from walls, around its home point or the target, ahead along its facing, or stands watching, recording the chosen action in slot 0 of the second variable set. Returns 1 if a watch detects the target and 0 after the moves made far from home; the near-home moves fall off the end with no defined result, and one of the near-home watches ignores detection. The random wander branch tests a variable that is never set, so it never runs.

ef617baa7f25d651.name: perform_next_attack_step
ef617baa7f25d651.doc: Steps through a cycle by variable 3: attack 1, attack 2, a threaten whose length depends on the hit counters, a walk to a random spot, then an occasional attack 1.

ef7747866ac91216.name: fight_by_range_forever
ef7747866ac91216.doc: Update program: allows guard and dodge and clears the act status, then loops forever: strafes or waits until the target is within 175 units, then picks far (140-175), mid (90-140) or close range actions by distance until it moves away. Once no rage hits are left, fight_by_range_until_far returns at once, so near the target the monster only waits.

ef994603e970ad6f.name: look_around_for_target
ef994603e970ad6f.doc: Turns left, right, right and left in turn, standing at each heading. Returns 0 as soon as the target is seen.

efc85b1169ca6783.name: sidestep_to_dodge_shot
efc85b1169ca6783.doc: Faces the target and sidesteps invulnerably.

efcb81cc61903cf6.name: run_ai_step
efcb81cc61903cf6.doc: One AI decision: fights normally when not enraged, using the aggro range to switch between idle wandering, chasing and fighting; uses the enraged routine otherwise.

f04d6b7177b1e3fc.name: fly_to_point
f04d6b7177b1e3fc.doc: Flies in a straight line toward target_x, target_z at speed units per frame, aiming at ground_offset above the ground under the monster at the start (target_y is ignored). Vertical motion stops for good once the monster would be 45 or more units above the ground, or at ground level. Returns 1 within speed plus tolerance of the point, the check_flight_step result (-1 wall ahead, -2 too high or no ground) if a step is blocked, or 0 after max_frames.

f051f60625f17c4d.name: wait_until_facing
f051f60625f17c4d.doc: Waits until the monster's yaw is within tolerance radians of angle.

f0a9c981430a9dc5.name: chase_target_while_path_clear
f0a9c981430a9dc5.doc: Turns to face the target, then chases it each frame, returning -2 if a wall blocks the line to the target and -1 once within the stop distance.

f0ad13ad5854214d.name: make_damageable_and_halt
f0ad13ad5854214d.doc: Clears the no-damage attribute so the monster can be hurt, forbids guard and dodge, and stops movement, turning and the current motion.

f0b4b777fd840960.name: get_wall_margin
f0b4b777fd840960.doc: Reads the flying wall margin, stored in monster variable 2 slot 16, into out[0].

f0b4d2d995e29045.name: swing_attack_2
f0b4d2d995e29045.doc: Turns to the target, plays attack 2 and stands for 3 frames.

f0c664f37750f762.name: turn_to_angle
f0c664f37750f762.doc: Meant to turn to the absolute heading angle_deg at turn_speed_deg degrees per frame and wait until it is reached, but in this toolkit the turn call (and the heading read in wait_turn_to_angle) use old native numbers that do nothing, so the monster does not turn and the call mostly just waits up to about 360 divided by the speed frames. Returns the frames waited.

f0e857067522bb65.name: run_monster_ai
f0e857067522bb65.doc: Allows guard and dodge, then runs the behaviour pick every frame.

f0f9b68af466c6c5.name: attack_repeatedly
f0f9b68af466c6c5.doc: Plays attack 1 count times, turning toward the target during each. When it attacked more than once, the monster then faints for 20 frames per attack.

f0fb3a00b0b0d094.name: chase_target_checking_path
f0fb3a00b0b0d094.doc: Faces the target, then each frame steps toward a point speed * 10 toward it. Returns -1 once closer than stop_dist, -2 when map collision blocks the next speed + stop_dist units toward the target (checked 25 units above the ground), otherwise max_frames when time runs out.

f101e9191d73bb44.name: stop_jet_effects
f101e9191d73bb44.doc: Ends the two jet exhaust effects stored in monster variables 3 and 4, if they exist.

f1389e9cd3f6c2f3.name: setup_dual_form_boss
f1389e9cd3f6c2f3.doc: Registers the attack 3 hits, creates the blue and red light effects, loads the arrow, beam and warp effects and the green and red texture images, and sets the starting form, position, limits and timers.

f167b5b78002cf2c.name: wait_motion_last_frame
f167b5b78002cf2c.doc: Waits until the motion status reads 4, meaning the motion has reached its last frame.

f18b9f510ba2f965.name: dodge_step_back
f18b9f510ba2f965.doc: Invulnerable back step: from frame 9 to 24 of the step back motion it heads for a point 200 units behind at 3.6 per frame, covering about 54 units.

f18d5a9b15b3543c.name: run_venom_spitter_ai
f18d5a9b15b3543c.doc: Main loop: while rage hits remain it waits for the target to come within 250 and fights with the calm loop; once enraged it uses the enraged fight loop.

f18dec7681721331.name: reposition_around_target
f18dec7681721331.doc: Half the time circles the target at about 130 units, otherwise stands and waits for the target to come into view. Used when another monster has attack priority.

f19d5ee94f89ea8d.name: choose_next_actions
f19d5ee94f89ea8d.doc: Fills the four action queue slots in monster vars 1 to 4 from the situation flags and random rolls, or shifts the queue forward when actions are already queued.

f1a056fd94e42b35.name: cast_elemental_shot
f1a056fd94e42b35.doc: Plays attack 2, tracking the target, and fires the grade's fire, wind, ice or thunder shot from the col_magic frame toward the target with the monster's attack as damage.

f1b2d9cefcd368bf.name: face_target_and_move_ahead
f1b2d9cefcd368bf.doc: Turns to the target, then moves 100 units straight ahead, stopping when the target is within stop_dist or after max_frames. Returns -1 without moving when less than 100 units ahead are clear.

f1b68813f6d79e01.name: is_target_in_view_cone
f1b68813f6d79e01.doc: Returns 1 if the target point is within half_angle of the facing direction and within max_dist.

f1b8e24d6a0385bb.name: wait_n_frames
f1b8e24d6a0385bb.doc: Waits the given number of frames, checking the phase change each frame.

f1e9c2454554d1cd.name: do_melee_attack
f1e9c2454554d1cd.doc: Plays attack 1 while turning toward the target for about 13 frames, and waits for the motion to end.

f21caaf11beb1b8b.name: get_knocked_down_and_rise_flying
f21caaf11beb1b8b.doc: Is blown away, lies for 30 frames and gets up, then returns to flight.

f247f71628c68e53.name: walk_toward_target
f247f71628c68e53.doc: Walks toward the target for up to 240 frames, then stands.

f25218482e3faa56.name: freeze_and_face_target
f25218482e3faa56.doc: Forbids guard and dodge, resets motion, stops movement and turning, snaps to face the target and sets the act status to 1.

f262691c4afa5b3d.name: turn_by_angle_and_wait
f262691c4afa5b3d.doc: Turns by an angle relative to the current yaw and waits for the turn to finish. Returns the frames waited.

f2644b9c940d4688.name: play_dodge_attack
f2644b9c940d4688.doc: Plays the dodge attack motion, which swings with a knockback hit box, and waits for it to end.

f278a6573d5e4741.name: approach_distant_target
f278a6573d5e4741.doc: Walks toward the player or waits in view until the player is within 220.

f286f06dd019bf6c.name: move_beside_target
f286f06dd019bf6c.doc: Moves to a point at angle_deg around the target at the current target distance, shortened by the clearance check. Returns -1 if there is no room.

f2b4bf92d2a20f5a.name: run_user_monster_mode
f2b4bf92d2a20f5a.doc: If the player is disguised as any monster, runs hover_idle_while_player_disguised until the disguise ends: the monster settles to hover just above the ground and turns to face the target whenever it is more than 90 degrees off. Does nothing otherwise.

f2c29e6b7ec02200.name: wait_frame_checking_death
f2c29e6b7ec02200.doc: Waits one frame, but first, if monster variable 64 (the death flag) is set, plays the death sequence and never returns. Used in place of a plain wait throughout this script.

f2c82dde190bd7a7.name: wander_when_idle
f2c82dde190bd7a7.doc: Idle behaviour while no target is engaged: backs away from walls, walks around its home point, stands watching, or paces around the target, recording the movement type in a monster variable. Returns 1 as soon as the target is detected, otherwise 0.

f2ecec88ea1dc821.name: walk_to_target
f2ecec88ea1dc821.doc: Turns to face the target, then walks straight along that heading as far as the target's distance. Returns -1 without moving when the clear distance ahead is under move_speed plus stop_dist, otherwise 1 if the target comes within stop_dist, 2 if the walk ends, 0 on timeout.

f2fd6791ef7648c6.name: wait_turn_watch_target
f2fd6791ef7648c6.doc: Waits for a turn to finish like wait_turn_to_angle, but returns -1 as soon as the target comes into view.

f301d429d96c2a40.name: set_hit_count
f301d429d96c2a40.doc: Sets the number of hits this piece has taken (monster variable 1).

f3278d0fcebe3c07.name: step_back_from_target
f3278d0fcebe3c07.doc: Plays the step back motion and moves to a point further from the target while taking no damage for the first frames. The parameter is the movement speed.

f3396c7978a02f31.name: run_boss_loop
f3396c7978a02f31.doc: On its first run it flips to the form hurt by Monica: the roll sets bit 1 or 2, but setup already set bit 1, so flip_vulnerable_form always lands on form 2. It then loops forever, flipping form when the 600-tick timer has fired (unless in the sky phase) or entering the sky phase when the 1500-tick timer has fired, and then doing the sky-phase action or picking an attack by distance.

f362fcd6c3ac40bb.name: track_target_until_time
f362fcd6c3ac40bb.doc: Keeps turning toward the target until the current motion's progress is within tolerance of time (default 0.05 when -1), then stops turning.

f3650f4f553cabea.name: turn_to_target_wait
f3650f4f553cabea.doc: Turns to face the target and waits until it does.

f367d110f380b126.name: drift_to_offset_point
f367d110f380b126.doc: Sets state var 27 to 8 and moves in a straight line over 45 frames to a point 30 units away from the current position, then sets the state to 16.

f3800010fd86fc37.name: walk_in_direction_updating
f3800010fd86fc37.doc: Despite the parameter names, the first argument is the turn speed in degrees and the second the walk speed. Turns to the world heading angle_deg, then walks dist units along it (at least the walk speed + 1), updating the boss each frame. A heading below the turn speed, including every negative heading, is first increased by the turn speed. Returns 1 if the target comes within stop_dist, 2 when the walk ends, 0 after max_frames.

f39053e9beafb141.name: play_damage_blowback
f39053e9beafb141.doc: Hit reaction: cancels current actions, plays the damage motion with a knockback, waits for it to end plus 12 frames, then returns to the stand motion.

f397ebbf670cf241.name: fight_calm_close_range
f397ebbf670cf241.doc: Close range choice while not enraged: attack, step away or circle.

f3d98c85ee366a76.name: fly_at_angle_by_distance
f3d98c85ee366a76.doc: Flies distance units toward angle (degrees) without turning first.

f3df64fdb3562388.name: step_back_invulnerable
f3df64fdb3562388.doc: Plays the step-back motion and moves 100 units backward with damage disabled.

f3ef7e8dfb301a66.name: move_beside_target
f3ef7e8dfb301a66.doc: Moves to the point at the given angle around the target at the current distance. Returns -1 if a wall is in the way.

f4048df1bc8c14eb.name: run_ai_loop
f4048df1bc8c14eb.doc: Main loop: runs one AI step every frame.

f409a200b21c174a.name: shoot_gear_arrow
f409a200b21c174a.doc: Plays the attack 1 wind-up while turning toward the target, then fires a gear arrow effect with the monster's attack value.

f411c569ed0b879c.name: sidestep_around_target
f411c569ed0b879c.doc: Steps left or right at random to a point on a circle around the target, then turns to face it for up to 50 frames.

f42562f5d4fc983c.name: dodge_back_away
f42562f5d4fc983c.doc: Turns to the target, then plays the walk back motion invulnerable while moving to a point farther from the target.

f449822c37cc0416.name: heal_weakest_ally
f449822c37cc0416.doc: Healer routine: once monster var 7 reaches 300, picks the monster within 200 units with the lowest life ratio (or itself if it is lower), and if that ratio is 0.9 or less plays the recover motions and heals it by 24 to 30 percent of its max life with a green number, then resets var 7. Returns -1 when no one needs healing.

f45c49955c53d035.name: approach_distant_target
f45c49955c53d035.doc: Mostly walks toward a target farther than 230 units, otherwise stands and waits for it to come into view. Returns once the target is within 230.

f46905a3a01cc662.name: nudge_pos_up
f46905a3a01cc662.doc: Raises the monster's position by one unit and returns 1.

f46f854f8c0c3874.name: wander_or_watch_target
f46f854f8c0c3874.doc: Half the time walks around the target at 150 to 180 units, otherwise stands and waits for the target to come into view.

f47205a83660b7ee.name: turn_to_target_limit
f47205a83660b7ee.doc: Turns to face the target, waiting at most max_frames.

f48ae07aca9e828c.name: swing_attack_1
f48ae07aca9e828c.doc: Turns to the target, plays attack 1 and stands for 3 frames.

f49ab47d1f7ab09a.name: step_back_from_target
f49ab47d1f7ab09a.doc: Dodge: walks while turning to face the target, then plays the walk-back motion taking no damage for its first 24 frames. At frame 17 it starts moving at move_speed toward a point 100 to 110 units farther from the target, but stops moving at frame 24, so it covers only about 7 frames of movement. Then waits for the motion to end and stands.

f49ef170a953e14e.name: swipe_at_target
f49ef170a953e14e.doc: Walks, turns to the target, plays attack 1 (a two-hit claw combo registered in on_init) tracking the target until 0.267 of the motion, then stands for 9 frames.

f4adb73cb51ccbe7.name: track_monster_frames
f4adb73cb51ccbe7.doc: Turns toward another monster (monster id) for frames frames, then stops turning.

f4c1076b2409c363.name: move_beside_target_updating
f4c1076b2409c363.doc: Moves to a point at angle_deg around the target at the current target distance, shortened by the clearance check, waiting with per-frame updates. Returns -1 if there is no room.

f4c75da96f6c4ea6.name: recover_from_throw_and_resume_flight
f4c75da96f6c4ea6.doc: Recovers from a throw, waits 10 frames, turns scripted flight back on and resets the motion.

f4fec46bfae0786d.name: turn_and_walk_to_point_around_target
f4fec46bfae0786d.doc: Turns toward a point at the given angle and distance around the target and walks to it, shortening the move at a wall. Returns -1 if there is no room.

f50ab74ad66427e2.name: turn_toward_target_with_random_offset
f50ab74ad66427e2.doc: Turns toward the target, with offset_chance percent probability of aiming offset_deg to a random side. Returns the frames waited.

f53f4ad0c100a2f1.name: turn_to_target_and_sidestep
f53f4ad0c100a2f1.doc: Snaps to face the target and sidesteps.

f5404cc3fa9da730.name: stand_for_frames
f5404cc3fa9da730.doc: Stops moving, plays the stand motion and waits the given frames.

f541fe6918971c41.name: setup_magma_boss
f541fe6918971c41.doc: Registers the weak knockback hit windows for attacks 3 and 4, loads the lava effects, sets the low camera mode, the initial monster vars and the dripping effect.

f55a72f444c6bd3e.name: get_up_after_lift
f55a72f444c6bd3e.doc: Recovers from a throw, waits 10 frames and resets the motion.

f569a78a9328f016.name: step_toward_point_or_slam
f569a78a9328f016.doc: One frame of a walk to a point. Occasionally slams the ground if the player is within 75 units, shakes the camera on footstep frames and returns 2 when the move ends.

f58726afe89b9a8b.name: move_random_offset
f58726afe89b9a8b.doc: Moves a random distance in a random direction within the angle range, without turning first. Returns the wait result.

f5880a403a18c710.name: fight_at_long_range
f5880a403a18c710.doc: Long range choice: scan left and right for the target, wait idle watching for it, or stand for 30 frames. Walks toward the target if it is spotted.

f58e8fab9f32db74.name: walk_random_direction
f58e8fab9f32db74.doc: Walks a random distance in a direction randomly rotated from the current heading. Returns the move result.

f595b5af472876c1.name: die_and_run_event_503
f595b5af472876c1.doc: Plays the death motion, finishes the death, waits 30 frames and runs event script 503.

f5b7677baa4d1984.name: step_back_invulnerable
f5b7677baa4d1984.doc: Steps 100 units backward, invulnerable for the middle of the motion.

f5c3038d6790de4b.name: attack_at_close_range
f5c3038d6790de4b.doc: Fires a wind shot, side-steps and fires, backs away, or flies off at an angle. Fires immediately if the target is under 40 units.

f5d43408f65c4d3a.name: recoil_from_hit
f5d43408f65c4d3a.doc: Plays the damage knockback, waits 12 frames and stands again.

f5f4cd509b240a96.name: fall_over_and_die
f5f4cd509b240a96.doc: Plays the knocked flying motion, drops its loot and finishes the death.

f611bbbd05bff564.name: play_then_pounce_if_close
f611bbbd05bff564.doc: Plays the play motion for up to about 104 frames; if the target comes within 45 units in front of the monster during it, pounces at the target.

f61ef1fa0aa37f49.name: back_step_invulnerable
f61ef1fa0aa37f49.doc: Plays the back step motion and, after 6 frames, heads for a point 100 units behind at 1.75 units per frame, stopping 8 frames later (about 14 units). It takes no damage from the start until the move stops, then waits for the motion to end and stands.

f635f2409ed86006.name: dodge_melee_attack
f635f2409ed86006.doc: After a short wait, steps back or sideways away from the player's melee attack, then restores guard and dodge.

f667774890aa663d.name: pursue_target_until_close
f667774890aa663d.doc: Walks after the target at 3.2 units per frame for up to 180 frames, until within 75 units, then stands.

f6723b714b3f7a34.name: spin_attack_toward_target
f6723b714b3f7a34.doc: Attack 2: wind-up, then a spinning flying rush at the target for up to 20 frames per spin_periods, then the wind-down. If the rush reached the target or stopped at a wall (not on timeout or a height block) it hovers for up to 30 frames and half the time follows up with a fireball.

f67ab18250d7ba86.name: wait_move_end_timeout
f67ab18250d7ba86.doc: Waits until the move ends. Returns 1 if max_frames pass first, 0 if the move ended.

f67ad3d80b7875a2.name: lock_and_face_target
f67ad3d80b7875a2.doc: Starts a scripted action: forbids guard and dodge, resets the motion, stops moving, snaps to face the target, waits a frame and sets act status 1.

f6804b7cf3c13410.name: choose_idle_movement
f6804b7cf3c13410.doc: Picks a random idle move: turning away from a wall closer than 35, circling its home point when more than 300 from it (resetting home beyond 800), or standing to look for the target, turning, circling the target or flying straight ahead. Sets monster variable 0 to the move chosen and returns 1 when it detects the target.

f68888a16f7b6bfb.name: act_on_situation
f68888a16f7b6bfb.doc: Chooses the action for the flags from get_situation_flags: bite when close and in front, wait or approach slowly when far, turn when facing away, or run in and pounce at the target when a pounce is queued.

f6ac5f6c56e123af.name: face_user_monster_if_any
f6ac5f6c56e123af.doc: If the player is currently disguised as a monster, runs watch_target_while_disguised for this monster's kind; does nothing otherwise.

f6b82f34143b0a88.name: move_random_offset
f6b82f34143b0a88.doc: Moves forward by a random distance at a random angle offset and waits. Returns the wait result.

f6d23610d5d253e2.name: turn_to_angle
f6d23610d5d253e2.doc: Turns to face angle_deg (degrees) at turn_speed_deg, waiting until it gets there or a full turn's worth of frames pass. Returns the frames spent.

f6d74604e07dee54.name: guard_and_knockback
f6d74604e07dee54.doc: Locks interrupts, plays the guard knockback motion and waits 8 frames before allowing interrupts again.

f6ee373ebc77e9ca.name: wait_while_player_disguised
f6ee373ebc77e9ca.doc: Stands, turning toward the player until the player is no longer disguised.

f70168bf4276f0c6.name: step_back_invulnerable
f70168bf4276f0c6.doc: Invulnerable hop with the step back motion to a point beyond the current target distance.

f71e8d15af5d6fb7.name: struggle_while_lifted
f71e8d15af5d6fb7.doc: Plays the struggle motion forever while lifted.

f729bc01ca87c24d.name: act_at_short_range
f729bc01ca87c24d.doc: Close-range choice: one of the two turning attacks, a vanish, or a circling step.

f75eda3c4ead30d8.name: fight_target_up_close
f75eda3c4ead30d8.doc: Loop that returns when the target is beyond 120 units. When facing it, occasionally uses attack 2 or attack 1; otherwise occasionally steps or turns to face it.

f7763dc51258665d.name: begin_and_end_locked_action
f7763dc51258665d.doc: Begins and immediately ends a locked action, so nothing happens.

f79092e6de5b6f54.name: recoil_from_hit
f79092e6de5b6f54.doc: Stops, plays the damage knockback and stands again.

f7b8a7b95c704524.name: wait_motion_time
f7b8a7b95c704524.doc: Waits until the motion progress is within tolerance of time (default 0.03) or the motion ends. Returns the frames waited.

f7b8d33c1e3dff55.name: wait_motion_end_or_target_in_view
f7b8d33c1e3dff55.doc: Waits until the motion ends (returns 0) or the target enters the view cone (returns 1).

f7d1ef7ca10a6343.name: fly_chase_target
f7d1ef7ca10a6343.doc: Flies toward the target, re-aiming each frame, at ground height plus height with speed units per frame, checking each step with check_flight_step. With tilt set the body pitches along the flight, otherwise only the yaw follows. Returns 1 when within speed plus near_dist, the blocked code on a hit, 0 on timeout.

f7df0dc5a378ac28.name: walk_toward_target_for_a_while
f7df0dc5a378ac28.doc: Walks slowly toward the target for 150 to 239 frames, or until it comes within 2400 units.

f7e368869930e47b.name: fly_random_forward
f7e368869930e47b.doc: Turns by a random angle, then flies a random distance (min_distance plus a random extra) straight ahead. Returns the result of the flight.

f800e4f6ef4ba5a4.name: turn_to_angle_and_wait
f800e4f6ef4ba5a4.doc: Turns to a heading at the given speed and waits until it is reached. Returns the frames spent.

f8111def858c76dc.name: wait_move_until_near
f8111def858c76dc.doc: Meant to wait up to max_frames for a move_to walk, returning 1 when the target is within stop_dist, 2 when the walk ends and 0 on timeout. In this toolkit the move-end, distance and stop calls use old native numbers that reach unrelated natives, so the result does not track the walk and the monster is never stopped.

f814ab4f138d5492.name: walk_around_point
f814ab4f138d5492.doc: Walks to a point on a circle of radius around the given point, angle_deg off the line from the point back to the monster, after turning to face it. Waits until within stop_dist of the target or max_frames pass and returns the wait result.

f8211242344b229b.name: flash_model_on_phase_change
f8211242344b229b.doc: Flashes the model blue or red for 15 frames after a phase change. On the last frame it sets the vulnerable blue phase (no invincibility, texture 1) or the red phase (invincible, texture 0).

f856e412333b36b9.name: turn_randomly_and_run_at_target_if_seen
f856e412333b36b9.doc: Turns to a random heading, waits, and runs at the target if it comes into view within 270 units.

f872b4cd73676925.name: move_random_offset
f872b4cd73676925.doc: Moves a random distance in a random direction without turning, then waits for the move to end.

f8a0257752ba2823.name: on_stun
f8a0257752ba2823.doc: Checks how close the fish frame is to the nearest monster. Within 60 units it runs event script 500 if the monster was threatening (variable 0 is 32), else it swings twice and adds 2 to the head hit count; within 90 it adds one.

f8a431cd8b3711e4.name: wait_motion_watch_target
f8a431cd8b3711e4.doc: Waits for the motion to end, returning 1 early if the target comes into view, or 0 when the motion ends.

f8b4938794321a18.name: chase_target_clear
f8b4938794321a18.doc: Chases the target only while the straight line to it is clear. Returns -1 when close enough and -2 when blocked.

f8d113223a9b700f.name: swing_and_launch_red_wave
f8d113223a9b700f.doc: Plays attack 1 while tracking the target, then spawns the red looping sword wave effect at the dcol1 hit point on the ground with the monster's attack value.

f8eeefb42bac4856.name: sidestep_and_melee_attack
f8eeefb42bac4856.doc: With 50% chance steps left or right around the target, then attacks with the double attack, mid-range attack or moonsault depending on distance and facing.

f8f797bafe9cb263.name: backstep_to_dodge_melee
f8f797bafe9cb263.doc: Dodges a melee attack by backstepping at speed 3, then stands and allows guard and dodge again.

f8ff8324361b5353.name: move_random_offset
f8ff8324361b5353.doc: Moves a random distance in a random direction around its heading, without a clearance check.

f902fa18eebb9f13.name: run_tornado_mode_step
f902fa18eebb9f13.doc: One step of the tornado mode, chosen by the move counter, which counts down from 0: at 0 it dashes in with a tornado and then dashes in again (80 percent chance of a second tornado), at -1 it circles the target or chases it with a tornado, at -2 it dashes in with a tornado again, and at -3 or below it switches back to the rose mode.

f9061ad5406812cf.name: fight_at_far_range
f9061ad5406812cf.doc: Far range: runs at the target, or circles or approaches, and then may follow with a charge attack or a shot.

f90b8800db48467a.name: move_in_direction
f90b8800db48467a.doc: Moves dist units along an absolute angle without turning first.

f9107c3ed9adc5d3.name: wait_stun_end
f9107c3ed9adc5d3.doc: Shows the stun stars and waits until they are gone.

f919c9ed5cbbaa32.name: fight_after_rage_ends
f919c9ed5cbbaa32.doc: Fighting loop used once no rage hits are left. Low-priority monsters back off or watch; otherwise it summons monsters while fewer than 18 exist, uses attack 1 or walks toward the target. Returns when rage hits are available again or the target is over 360 units away.

f92af6820fbc9de8.name: flinch_then_stun
f92af6820fbc9de8.doc: Locks interrupts, plays the damage motion once, then runs the shared stun-then-unlock routine.

f935af0e3aa0d812.name: update_orbit_stage
f935af0e3aa0d812.doc: Tracks damage, then while the damage count in variable 8 is exactly 3, 4 or 5 sets the sway step in variable 1 to 1.5, 2 or 3 times its starting value (rewriting it as positive every frame, so the sign flip in orbit_around_center does not last) and stores pi/720, pi/540 or pi/360 in variable 10, which nothing in this script reads. Then moves the boss one orbit step.

f936ffaf76f2b6ec.name: approach_distant_target
f936ffaf76f2b6ec.doc: Loops until the target is within 400 units, repositioning each time.

f94c87be4b0833d5.name: fight_at_close_range
f94c87be4b0833d5.doc: Close range choice: walks up and attacks with attack 1, 2 or the combo, steps back, dashes sideways, or just approaches.

f95a331f68fa8e1b.name: run_flying_combat_loop
f95a331f68fa8e1b.doc: Loops forever: while rage hits remain it fights by range within 240 units horizontally or wanders in flight, otherwise it runs the shooting loop.

f95ea865c3294a66.name: play_damage_and_stun
f95ea865c3294a66.doc: Clears the body hit flag, plays the damage motion and waits for the stun to end.

f9848feb0dc6f51c.name: dash_sideways
f9848feb0dc6f51c.doc: Sidestep dash to a random side with the matching step motion, aimed at a point 100 units away: it moves at 2.96 units per frame only from 0.3 to 0.6 of the motion, and is invulnerable from the start of the motion until 0.6. Ends in the stand motion.

f98831bdf03458bc.name: trigger_phase_two_at_half_life
f98831bdf03458bc.doc: Once life drops below half, stops the boss's looping sounds, sets variable 8 and runs event script 502 (the mid-fight scene). Does nothing afterward.

f98cd51d1101617e.name: attack_combo_late_second_swing
f98cd51d1101617e.doc: Attack 1 then attack 2 after 55 percent of the first motion.

f98df4ffbd506ce3.name: absorb_energy
f98df4ffbd506ce3.doc: Meant to play the energy absorb motions (in, loop, out). The motion calls are old-numbered and run as set_life, and each wait_motion_end returns after one frame, so it only waits three frames.

f9b40b8c60904dcd.name: get_knocked_down_and_up
f9b40b8c60904dcd.doc: Plays the knocked flying and get up motions, then applies the shared stun routine.

f9bb71c2cc0b3bb8.name: turn_to_face_target_closely
f9bb71c2cc0b3bb8.doc: Turns toward the target until facing it within 5 degrees. Returns 1 when facing, 0 if the frame limit passes.

f9c110a49301cd01.name: unlock_interrupts
f9c110a49301cd01.doc: Old-numbered unlock_interrupts, meant to allow guarding and dodging again. The engine runs set_visible_monster_limit(1, 0) then (2, 0), which leaves the floor's visible monster limit at 2 (the second argument is ignored).

f9d9dd3ad54c01d3.name: fight_at_long_range
f9d9dd3ad54c01d3.doc: Long range choice: walk toward the target to 95 units, or stand watching it.

f9ddff900d320fbd.name: fight_at_far_range
f9ddff900d320fbd.doc: Far range choice (target 240 to 300 away): a fire ball or flying around the target at 45 degrees. The roll it checks is never drawn, so the choice depends on a stale value.

f9f4e604d024b4fb.name: walk_to_target
f9f4e604d024b4fb.doc: Turns to face the target, then walks straight to it, ending stop_dist short or after max_frames. Returns -1 when something blocks the way, otherwise the wait result.

fa1c62d3ab42631c.name: turn_to_angle_updating
fa1c62d3ab42631c.doc: Turns to the angle in degrees at the given speed, updating the boss, and returns the frames waited.

fa1d4153aa691f5f.name: get_flat_target_dist
fa1d4153aa691f5f.doc: Writes into out[0] the distance to the target ignoring height.

fa2875bae9df5f87.name: fly_toward_target_until_near
fa2875bae9df5f87.doc: Moves the monster toward the target a step per frame, staying hover_height above the ground, for up to max_frames. Returns 1 when within speed plus stop_margin of the target, the blocking result if the flight step hits something, 0 on timeout.

fa50280148c4cf77.name: get_knocked_flying_and_get_up
