fa50280148c4cf77.doc: Plays the knocked flying motion, lies down for 30 frames and gets up.

fa75b8d77daf12e0.name: wait_move_end_update
fa75b8d77daf12e0.doc: Waits up to max_frames for the move to end and returns 0 when it ended.

fa99e88babee28d1.name: setup_boss_battle
fa99e88babee28d1.doc: Raises the boss 10 units, sets up timers, monster variables, flight limits and the camera, loads the sticky and demon beam effects and the two reserved texture images.

fa9e69d4df70d689.name: block_attack
fa9e69d4df70d689.doc: Plays guard in, guard with pushback and guard return, with a longer hold after turning to the player 35% of the time.

fac49671b3d23723.name: reposition_around_target
fac49671b3d23723.doc: Half the time flies around the target at about 80 units, otherwise hovers and waits for it to come into view. Used when another monster has attack priority.

fae78642bf091ac1.name: spit_venom_back
fae78642bf091ac1.doc: When a shot is dodged, it faces the target and spits a long venom shot back.

faf46d53e5ea97ff.name: fly_chase_target
faf46d53e5ea97ff.doc: Flies toward the target one step per frame at speed, holding height above the ground, for up to max_frames. Returns 1 when within speed + near_dist of the target, the obstacle code when a flight step is blocked, else 0. tilt pitches the body toward the target.

faf9d9c19f731507.name: flinch_from_damage
faf9d9c19f731507.doc: Forbids guard and dodge, stops moving, plays a damage sound and the damage knockback for 8 extra frames, then allows guard and dodge again.

fb05b0b149d86f3d.name: shuffle_back_three_times
fb05b0b149d86f3d.doc: Plays the dodge return motion three times in a row with stand pauses between.

fb37ebfccd5b8de3.name: counter_attack_on_dodge
fb37ebfccd5b8de3.doc: With a 10 percent chance it becomes invincible for 30 frames and attacks.

fb499e8cdbc0e5ec.name: circle_or_watch_target
fb499e8cdbc0e5ec.doc: Waiting behaviour while another monster holds the attack slot: half the time circles the target at about 100 distance, otherwise stands watching it.

fb59f24d660149d1.name: turn_by_angle
fb59f24d660149d1.doc: Turns by delta_deg relative to the current yaw at turn_speed_deg and waits for it to finish. Returns the frames used; the wrap for large angles is faulty.

fb946c575f6ac3fe.name: on_death
fb946c575f6ac3fe.doc: Stops the jets, plays the death motion, then the death loop and runs event script 500.

fb9a311c629276a8.name: charge_and_slam_shockwave
fb9a311c629276a8.doc: Turns to the target and swings attack 1, tracking the target for 12 frames, then heads for a point 100 units toward it at 5.4 units per frame; 14 frames later (about 76 units) it spawns a Vanguard shockwave below the chn76 joint carrying its attack power and stops. Cannot dodge while it runs.

fba5a92923fdc9df.name: slash_attack_1_repeatedly
fba5a92923fdc9df.doc: Plays attack 1 and repeats it up to two more times while the target stays within 70 units.

fbe1cdf8a08db423.name: strafe_or_wait_for_target
fbe1cdf8a08db423.doc: Circles the target, stands and waits, or plays the idle motion, chosen at random.

fbe3728b6ef38ab5.name: setup_attack_hits_and_photo
fbe3728b6ef38ab5.doc: Registers the weak hit on attack 1 (0.365 to 0.487) and the knockback hit on the whole attack 2 loop, clears monster var 0, sets the attack 1 photo window for grade 0 and starts the monster AI with init_monster_ai.

fc07c06b0a1ed3c6.name: halt_on_guard
fc07c06b0a1ed3c6.doc: Guard program: forbids dodging, stops the motion, movement and turning, then allows dodging again at once, so a guarded hit just halts the monster.

fc1aa16530322447.name: circle_arena_edge_and_cast
fc1aa16530322447.doc: Below 40% life, moonsaults across the arena center (-2195, 488, -475) to the point opposite its own position, up to 270 units from the center. Otherwise runs to the ring of radius 300 on the side away from the target, circling half the arena if the target is nearer the center. Then casts magic. Never runs: its only call is in a branch under if (0).

fc24186d49a7b38b.name: teleport_in
fc24186d49a7b38b.doc: Second half of a teleport: plays the landing motion, faces the target, fades the model back in and makes the boss vulnerable.

fc5dc8a140b3a400.name: rush_target_position
fc5dc8a140b3a400.doc: Turns to the target and plays the run motion, meaning to rush to its position, but fly_constant_speed_to_point never sets its step length, so the boss does not actually fly there.

fc68caadc732d97b.name: choose_idle_movement
fc68caadc732d97b.doc: Picks the next idle move at random: turn away when there is no room ahead, return toward home when far from it, circle the target, or chase it. Sets monster variable 0 to the move chosen. Returns 1 when a chase reaches the target.

fc77c0b3164dedc3.name: get_knocked_flying_and_get_up
fc77c0b3164dedc3.doc: Knockdown state: plays the knocked-flying motion with a 20 step knockback, waits 30 frames between two calls decoded as set_model_lighting(1) and (0), then plays the get-up and stand motions. These scripts use shifted native numbers (set_life here is set_motion); in the other copies of this routine the pair is act status 1 and 0.

fc9663107522fd98.name: act_at_far_range
fc9663107522fd98.doc: Far-range choice (300 to 550): chase on foot, stand and watch, circle, or run at the target.

fc9d053baacc5d36.name: sidestep_randomly
fc9d053baacc5d36.doc: Plays the step right or step left motion at random, waits 27 frames and returns to standing. It does not move the monster or make it invulnerable; the motion carries the step.

fca407d1837187fe.name: watch_player_if_disguised
fca407d1837187fe.doc: Starts watching the player when the player is disguised as another monster.

fcaec99607bc9529.name: track_target_frames
fcaec99607bc9529.doc: Turns toward the target every frame for the given number of frames, then stops turning. The speed goes to the turn unconverted, so it is in radians per frame; the values callers give, such as 5, make the monster face the target almost at once.

fcb996335663d349.doc: Loads the wind shot effects into a free texture block, sets up flight with a maximum height of 40 and lifts the monster 15 units.

fcd60443f9b3404c.name: close_in_on_distant_target
fcd60443f9b3404c.doc: Walks toward a target further than 250 units, or waits, until it comes within 250 units.

fce1da9df19ccacf.name: descend_with_drill_start
fce1da9df19ccacf.doc: Stops the jets, plays the drill attack start motion while invulnerable and descends to the ground.

fcf12f78bbc5a777.name: turn_to_face_target
fcf12f78bbc5a777.doc: Turns toward the target at the given speed and waits until facing it, up to 360 frames. Returns the frames waited.

fd098813436a5450.name: get_knocked_flying_then_stunned
fd098813436a5450.doc: Plays the knocked flying and get up motions, then applies the shared stun routine.

fd207165916a7c20.name: turn_randomly_and_chase_if_seen
fd207165916a7c20.doc: Turns to a random heading, then looks for 45 frames and flies at the target if it comes within 300 units in view.

fd41a9c9f970b2cf.name: restore_life_after_death
fd41a9c9f970b2cf.doc: Runs the low life event if it has not run and restores life to 0.34 so the monster does not die.

fd4bcf7279d804ea.name: face_target_until_motion_progress
fd4bcf7279d804ea.doc: Keeps turning toward the target until the motion reaches the progress value.

fd4d6a17684c8b8a.name: play_death_and_halt
fd4d6a17684c8b8a.doc: Plays the death motion to its end and finishes the death.

fd5ac00bea48cad1.name: lunge_with_attack_one
fd5ac00bea48cad1.doc: Turns to the target and plays attack 1; after 10 frames moves toward a point 100 units ahead at 3.08 units per frame for 23 frames (about 71 units), then stops, stands and waits 9 frames.

fd6cea4fa182a462.name: run_toward_target
fd6cea4fa182a462.doc: Runs toward the target for up to 120 frames, then stands.

fd7a4c59d3bd1307.name: get_scale_params
fd7a4c59d3bd1307.doc: Reads the scale parameters stored by set_scale_params.

fd8f7641e86f1390.name: fire_sticky_and_hold
fd8f7641e86f1390.doc: Frees its formation slot, makes itself untargetable and fires a sticky ball at the player, then flies to the point 1050 high above the arena centre and adds one to monster variable 8; the butterfly that finds it at 15 (the last of the seven to regroup after a reset at 9) sets it to 0 instead, and the others wait until it is 0. Returns 0 if the round ends (variable 8 reaches 8) during the flight, otherwise 1.

fda2801989256b13.name: walk_random_direction
fda2801989256b13.doc: Meant to turn up to angle_range degrees, but converts the range to radians and then the random turn to radians again, so it turns a whole number of degrees from 0 to about angle_range/57, always to the same side (under 57 it does not turn). If 100 units ahead are clear it walks base_dist + move_speed plus a random 0 to dist_range units; if less is clear but more than clearance it walks just the random amount; otherwise it returns -1 without moving. clearance is also the stop distance of the wait: returns 1 if the target comes within clearance, 2 when the walk ends, 0 after max_frames.

fda4d97b73189f44.name: lunge_at_target
fda4d97b73189f44.doc: Plays attack 1, tracking the target for 25 frames and then rushing to its position at the given speed.

fdc201eaa72a4077.name: charge_attack_then_retreat
fdc201eaa72a4077.doc: Flies at the target for up to 75 frames and swings attack 1, then faces it and flies back to a point 150 units from where the target stood, on its own side and 45 units above the ground (up to 30 frames).

fdcfc5583156247e.name: face_target_until_motion_end
fdcfc5583156247e.doc: Keeps turning toward the target until the current motion ends.

fdf0b114d9f47b87.name: walk_random_direction
fdf0b114d9f47b87.doc: Meant to turn up to angle_range degrees, but converts the range to radians and then the random turn to radians again, so it turns a whole number of degrees from 0 to about angle_range/57, always to the same side (under 57 it does not turn). If 100 units ahead are clear it walks base_dist + move_speed plus a random 0 to dist_range units; if less is clear but more than clearance it walks just the random amount; otherwise it returns -1 without moving. clearance is also the stop distance of the wait: returns 1 if the target comes within clearance, 2 when the walk ends, 0 after max_frames.

fe408c74da047cc7.name: fight_by_range_until_target_leaves
fe408c74da047cc7.doc: Fight loop that picks the close, mid or long range action from the distance to the target. It returns when the target is over 230 units away or no rage hits are left.

fe416d104364b432.name: scatter_feathers_from_wings
fe416d104364b432.doc: Plays attack 1 and scatters feathers from four wing points, with more rounds the more monsters are alive. Sets monster var 30 to 2.

fe46584541ef51f5.name: wait_or_strafe_when_crowded
fe46584541ef51f5.doc: Used when another monster has priority: half the time strafes around the target, otherwise stands watching it.

fe5aacb54b3a0d2e.name: fly_to_point
fe5aacb54b3a0d2e.doc: Flies to (x, z) at hover_height above the ground, stopping within speed plus stop_margin of the point (returns 1), on an obstruction (returns the check_flight_step result), or after max_frames (returns 0).

fe68ecacf9e36a62.name: choose_action_by_rage_and_aggro
fe68ecacf9e36a62.doc: Per-update choice: while rage hits remain it fights near targets (under 280 units), idles otherwise, or runs at an aggro target; once the rage hits are used up it fights enraged.

fe6adb1ff81c87be.name: stand_facing_target_while_disguised
fe6adb1ff81c87be.doc: Stands, turning toward the target whenever it is more than 60 degrees off its facing, until the player is no longer disguised as a monster.

fe7da76bbebf858f.name: die_and_stay_dead
fe7da76bbebf858f.doc: Death state: plays the death motion, finishes the death handling and then idles forever.

fe7dd28bdc815f96.name: fight_at_close_range
fe7dd28bdc815f96.doc: Close range choice: charges the target, steps back (sometimes followed by a charge), or walks toward it.

fe7fb0a82019db97.name: start_turn_to_target
fe7fb0a82019db97.doc: Starts turning toward the target at turn_speed radians per frame and returns without waiting.

fe8d846e42d3dda8.name: fight_target_by_distance
fe8d846e42d3dda8.doc: Loops while the target is within 300 units, choosing the long, medium or close range behaviour by distance (300, 200, 120), unless a higher priority monster takes the turn.

fe91578c08767d64.name: fire_rocket_volley
fe91578c08767d64.doc: Plays attack 3 and fires a homing rocket from the dcol2 point every 8 frames, launched upward toward world +Z or turned 1 radian to either side (the random spread is truncated to a whole number), not along the monster's facing. The volley_frames argument is ignored: the volley lasts 32 frames (4 rockets), or 64 (8 rockets) when rage hits left are 0 or below, which includes a boss's -1.

fe98d06f42a72cf9.name: watch_disguised_player
fe98d06f42a72cf9.doc: Stands and turns to face the player while the player is disguised as a monster, returning when the disguise ends.

fe9f78a9f1507e80.name: get_angle_offset_to
fe9f78a9f1507e80.doc: Returns the angle in radians from heading to the direction from (from_x, from_z) to (to_x, to_z), wrapped to -PI to PI.

fea4d88840686fd4.name: roar_and_shoot_fireballs
fea4d88840686fd4.doc: Roars and shakes the camera. When enraged is 1, also launches four fireballs in a ring.

fea6cfd52bf539f5.name: shoot_fireball
fea6cfd52bf539f5.doc: Sometimes hovers in place, then plays attack 1 and, once the motion reaches 0.688, creates the fire shot effect at the dcol_00 frame aimed at the target position, passing the attack data as effect values.

fed3c2012432f23a.name: idle_at_far_range
fed3c2012432f23a.doc: Far-range choice (145 to 225 units) while calm: reads the target distance and a random number but does nothing with them, so the monster just stands for that frame.

ff0e3bd0f107539d.name: can_detect_target
ff0e3bd0f107539d.doc: Returns 1 if the target is inside the view cone within view_dist, or within hear_dist and moving faster than min_speed.

ff28381fcae635eb.name: walk_to_ring_point_and_fire
ff28381fcae635eb.doc: Walks to a random point 250 units from the arena center, turns to the player and fires the flame ring.

ff2ce2764c7ce725.name: turn_to_face_shooter
ff2ce2764c7ce725.doc: Snaps to face the target, walks to turn fully toward it and then stands.

ff3f4798c50a3433.name: dash_sideways_to_dodge_melee
ff3f4798c50a3433.doc: Dodges a melee attack with an invulnerable 100-unit sideways dash, then allows guard and dodge again. The step-back branch is never taken because the 0 to 19 roll is always under 20.

ff4f78e81370e310.name: hop_to_player_and_explode
ff4f78e81370e310.doc: On first run hops in an arc straight ahead along its facing, as far as the player is (at least 80 units), landing at height 0, then slides 16 units forward. It then waits 50 frames and pulses its scale with a blue colour flash for the last 30, beeping each pulse, before exploding.

ff54a09a511b3834.name: wait_motion_watch_target
ff54a09a511b3834.doc: Waits until the motion ends (returns 0) or the target comes into view (returns 1).

ff69739ca933cbc4.name: advance_at_far_range
ff69739ca933cbc4.doc: Mostly walks toward the target to about 110 units, occasionally wanders in a random direction.

ff9a8a0cc0ecbe9f.name: count_living_ship_parts
ff9a8a0cc0ecbe9f.doc: Counts how many of the ship's part monsters (handles 25 to 34) still have life left: group A is parts 26, 31, 32, 33 and 34, group B is parts 25, 27, 28, 29 and 30.

ff9d840bea9f0e11.name: lunge_combo_attack
ff9d840bea9f0e11.doc: Turns to the target and plays attack 1 while tracking it for 20 frames, then moves toward a point 100 units ahead at 1.75 units per frame for 5 frames (about 9 units), waits for the motion to end and stands for 9 frames.

ffa5e2665b6e03cb.name: block_shot_with_guard
ffa5e2665b6e03cb.doc: Raises the guard, plays the guard knockback and lowers the guard again.

ffa91772d8511f3c.name: turn_randomly_then_chase_if_spotted
ffa91772d8511f3c.doc: Turns to a random heading while watching for the target. If it spots the target it runs after it for up to 160 frames, otherwise stands and waits for it to come into view.

ffc2b144749c7bb8.name: chase_target_tracking_damage
ffc2b144749c7bb8.doc: Chases the target frame by frame, returning -1 once within near_dist, else the frames used.

ffc916c40a7f0685.name: wander_or_sidestep
ffc916c40a7f0685.doc: Wanders as when idle 98% of the time, otherwise strafes 80 units to a random side.

ffd1432abd1107e9.name: walk_toward_target_direction
ffd1432abd1107e9.doc: Turns to face the target and, if nothing blocks the 100 units ahead, walks 100 units forward. Returns -1 when a wall is within 100 units, else the move_until_near_or_done result.

fff5f1e3cc44874e.name: get_up_after_landing
fff5f1e3cc44874e.doc: After being thrown, plays the get-up motion, nudges up and returns to walking. Returns 1.

fffd73f9a1554e1c.name: face_target_and_walk_its_distance
fffd73f9a1554e1c.doc: Faces the target, then walks straight ahead for the distance to the target.

fffe1f3b30569b60.name: charge_at_target
fffe1f3b30569b60.doc: Chases the target for 90 frames, then stands for 60 frames.

fffe8240b8130e36.name: act_at_close_range
fffe8240b8130e36.doc: Close range choice: swipe, dive attack, paralysis shot, or fly sideways or backward.
